                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                            idlogin,                             glnourut,                             glid,                             glkontak,                             glkontakkode,                             glkontaknama,                                             gltgl,                              glnotransaksi,                             glnorek,                    glnoreknama,                             glmatauang,                             glkurs,                             gluraian,                             glcatatan,                             gldebit,                             glkredit,                             glsaldo,                                             glinputtgl,                                                     idmsmq,                             gluserid,                   glcustomtext1,           glcustomtext2,           glcustomtext3,           glcustomtext4,           glcustomtext5,glcustomint1,glcustomint2,glcustomint3,glcustomint4,glcustomint5, glcustomdbl1,           glcustomdbl2,           glcustomdbl3,           glcustomdbl4,           glcustomdbl5,                                 glcustomdate1,                                      glcustomdate2,                                      glcustomdate3,                                      glcustomdate4,                                      glcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnourut")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("gltgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(norekNama) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("gluraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("gldebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glsaldo")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("glinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("gluserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                        saldoAwal = saldoAwal + Double.Parse(FixDouble(dr1("glsaldo")))
                    Next
                Else
                    result(2) = "Failed Getting '" & currNorek & "' starting balance." : GoTo selesai
                End If

                'JIKA PERTANGGAL MAKA DIGRUPKAN PERTANGGAL, JIKA TIDAK MAKA TIDAK DIGRUPKAN
                If perTanggal = 1 Then
                    GroupBy = " GROUP BY t.ttgl ASC"
                    sql = "SELECT gl.idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as glnourut, gl.glid, gl.glkontak, gl.glkontakkode, gl.glkontaknama, gl.gltgl, gl.glnotransaksi, gl.glnorek, gl.glnoreknama, gl.glmatauang, gl.glkurs, gl.gluraian, gl.glcatatan, gl.gldebit, gl.glkredit, (CASE gl.glcdc WHEN 'D' THEN @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(gl.gldebit, 0) - IFNULL(gl.glkredit, 0) ELSE @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(gl.glkredit, 0) - IFNULL(gl.gldebit, 0) END) as glsaldo, gl.glinputtgl, gl.idmsmq, gl.gluserid FROM ( SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 0 as glnourut, t.tid as glid, t.tkontak as glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, t.ttgl as gltgl, t.tnotransaksi as glnotransaksi, t.tnorek as glnorek, coa.cnama as glnoreknama, coa.cdc as glcdc, t.tmatauang as glmatauang, t.tkurs as glkurs, 'Mutasi' as gluraian, 'Mutasi' as glcatatan, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) as gldebit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as glkredit, t.tinputtgl as glinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as gluserid FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) AND t.turaian LIKE '%" & FixQuotes(uraian) & "%' " & GroupBy & " ORDER BY t.ttgl, t.tinputtgl, t.tid) as gl, (SELECT @nourut := 1) AS variableInit1, (SELECT @saldo := " & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & ") AS variableInit2 "
                Else
                    GroupBy = ""
                    'sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as glnourut, t.tid as glid, t.tkontak as glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, t.ttgl as gltgl, t.tnotransaksi as glnotransaksi, t.tnorek as glnorek, coa.cnama as glnoreknama, t.tmatauang as glmatauang, t.tkurs as glkurs, t.turaian as gluraian, t.tcatatan as glcatatan, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(t.tdebit,0) ELSE IFNULL(t.tdebitvalas,0) END) as gldebit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(t.tkredit,0) ELSE IFNULL(t.tkreditvalas,0) END) as glkredit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(t.tdebit,0) - IFNULL(t.tkredit,0) ELSE @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(t.tkredit,0) - IFNULL(t.tdebit,0) END) ELSE (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(t.tdebitvalas,0) - IFNULL(t.tkreditvalas,0) ELSE @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(t.tkreditvalas,0) - IFNULL(t.tdebitvalas,0) END) END) as glsaldo, t.tinputtgl as glinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as gluserid FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional', (SELECT @nourut := 1) AS variableInit1, (SELECT @saldo := " & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & ") AS variableInit2 WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) " & GroupBy & " ORDER BY t.ttgl, t.tinputtgl, t.tid"
                    sql = "SELECT gl.idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as glnourut, gl.glid, gl.glkontak, gl.glkontakkode, gl.glkontaknama, gl.gltgl, gl.glnotransaksi, gl.glnorek, gl.glnoreknama, gl.glmatauang, gl.glkurs, gl.gluraian, gl.glcatatan, gl.gldebit, gl.glkredit, (CASE gl.glcdc WHEN 'D' THEN @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(gl.gldebit, 0) - IFNULL(gl.glkredit, 0) ELSE @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(gl.glkredit, 0) - IFNULL(gl.gldebit, 0) END) as glsaldo, gl.glinputtgl, gl.idmsmq, gl.gluserid FROM ( SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 0 as glnourut, t.tid as glid, t.tkontak as glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, t.ttgl as gltgl, t.tnotransaksi as glnotransaksi, t.tnorek as glnorek, coa.cnama as glnoreknama, coa.cdc as glcdc, t.tmatauang as glmatauang, t.tkurs as glkurs, t.turaian as gluraian, t.tcatatan as glcatatan, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(t.tdebit, 0) ELSE IFNULL(t.tdebitvalas, 0) END) as gldebit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(t.tkredit, 0) ELSE IFNULL(t.tkreditvalas, 0) END) as glkredit, 0 as glsaldo, t.tinputtgl as glinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as gluserid FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) AND t.turaian LIKE '%" & FixQuotes(uraian) & "%' " & GroupBy & " ORDER BY t.ttgl, t.tinputtgl, t.tid ) as gl, (SELECT @nourut := 1) AS variableInit1, (SELECT @saldo := " & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & ") AS variableInit2 "
                End If

                'AMBIL SALDO MUTASI NOREK
                dtSMutasi = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dtSMutasi.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT SALDO MUTASI NOREK
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSMutasi.Rows
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SALDO AWAL
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                            idlogin,                             glnourut,                             glid,                             glkontak,                             glkontakkode,                             glkontaknama,                                             gltgl,                              glnotransaksi,                             glnorek,                             glnoreknama,                             glmatauang,                             glkurs,                             gluraian,                             glcatatan,                             gldebit,                             glkredit,                             glsaldo,                                             glinputtgl,                                                     idmsmq,                             gluserid,                   glcustomtext1,           glcustomtext2,           glcustomtext3,           glcustomtext4,           glcustomtext5,glcustomint1,glcustomint2,glcustomint3,glcustomint4,glcustomint5, glcustomdbl1,           glcustomdbl2,           glcustomdbl3,           glcustomdbl4,           glcustomdbl5,                                 glcustomdate1,                                      glcustomdate2,                                      glcustomdate3,                                      glcustomdate4,                                      glcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnourut")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("gltgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnoreknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("gluraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("gldebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glsaldo")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("glinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("gluserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
                    Next
                End If

                'SIMPAN KE M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER JIKA SALDO AWAL ATAU MUTASI <> 0
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 And (saldoAwal <> 0 Or dtSMutasi.Rows.Count <> 0) Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_General_Ledger(idlogin, glnourut, glid, glkontak, glkontakkode, glkontaknama, gltgl, glnotransaksi, glnorek, glnoreknama, glmatauang, glkurs, gluraian, glcatatan, gldebit, glkredit, glsaldo, glinputtgl, idmsmq, gluserid, glcustomtext1, glcustomtext2, glcustomtext3, glcustomtext4, glcustomtext5, glcustomint1, glcustomint2, glcustomint3, glcustomint4, glcustomint5, glcustomdbl1, glcustomdbl2, glcustomdbl3, glcustomdbl4, glcustomdbl5, glcustomdate1, glcustomdate2, glcustomdate3, glcustomdate4, glcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing '" & currNorek & "' general ledger." : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If

                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtNorek.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currNorek & "' general ledger." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER PER NOREK -----------------
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_NeracaMutasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN NERACA MUTASI
        '- Akun L/R Tahun Berjalan dan Akun L/R Bulan Berjalan tidak perlu ditampilkan di Neraca Mutasi
        '- Akun L/R Ditahan buat Saldo Awal, Saldo Akhir, Mutasi diisi nol 
        '       : REALISASI AKUN +  (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String, saldoNol(5) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang, saldoNol

        Dim abc As String = param
        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = "", saldoNol As Integer = 0

        Dim norekLRBulan As String = "", norekLRTahun As String = "", norekLRDitahan As String = ""


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        'saldoNol(5) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(5)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(5)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'result(2) = "test param " & abc : GoTo selesai

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_NERACA_MUTASI ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2R_NERACA_MUTASI
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_neraca_mutasi WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace trial balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_NERACA_MUTASI -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------
        'AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiTahunBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRTahun = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Yearly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiDitahan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL SALDO L/R DITAHAN
        '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)
        Dim saldoDitahan As Double = 0
        Dim sqlDitahan As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0)) AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0)) AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0)) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0)) END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "') AND (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN (r.rtahun < YEAR('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "')) ELSE (r.rtahun < YEAR('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "') or (r.rtahun = YEAR('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "') AND r.rbulan <= MONTH('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "'))) END) ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim dtDitahan As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlDitahan, strCon)
        If dtDitahan.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            saldoDitahan = Double.Parse(dtDitahan.Rows(0)("pksaldo"))
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING -----------------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", ftJoinSA As String = "", ftJoinSM As String = ""

        'FILTER NOREK
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1') "
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        'AMBIL NOREK ANTARA NOREKAWAL DAN NOREK AKHIR
        Dim dtAmbilNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor FROM m1_coa " & Filter & " ORDER BY cnomor", strCon)
        Dim currNorek As String = "", currFilter As String = ""
        If dtAmbilNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtAmbilNorek.Rows
                stepKe = stepKe + 1 : strValue.Clear()

                currNorek = FxDB(dr("cnomor"), "")
                currFilter = Filter & " AND cnomor = '" & currNorek & "'"

                'FILTER JOIN SALDO AWAL
                ftJoinSA = "ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND (CASE c.cjenis WHEN 'P' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' WHEN 'B' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' ELSE t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' END) AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SQL SALDO AWAL
                sqlSA = "SELECT c.cnomor as sanorek, c.cnama as sanoreknama, c.cdc sacdc, c.ctipe satipe, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN s.snilai ELSE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) as samatauang, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) as sadebit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) END) as sakredit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) END) as sasaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t " & ftJoinSA & " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' " & currFilter & " GROUP BY c.cnomor"

                'FILTER JOIN SALDO MUTASI
                ftJoinSM = "ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SQL SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSM = "SELECT c.cnomor as smnorek, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) as smdebit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) END) as smkredit FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t " & ftJoinSM & " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' " & currFilter & " GROUP BY c.cnomor"

                'SORTING NOREK
                Sorting = " ORDER BY sa.sanorek"

                'GABUNGKAN SQL SALDO AWAL DAN SALDO MUTASI
                sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, sa.sanorek as nmnorek, sa.sanoreknama as nmnoreknama, sa.satipe as nmtipe, sa.samatauang as nmmatauang, 0 as nmkurs, '' as nmuraian, '' as nmcatatan, (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE sa.sasaldo END) as nmsaldoawal, (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN 0 ELSE sm.smdebit END) as nmdebit, (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN 0 ELSE sm.smkredit END) as nmkredit, (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE sa.sacdc WHEN 'D' THEN sa.sasaldo + sm.smdebit - sm.smkredit ELSE sa.sasaldo - sm.smdebit + sm.smkredit END) END) as nmsaldoakhir, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'  as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as nmuserid FROM "
                sql &= " (" & sqlSA & ") as sa "
                sql &= " JOIN "
                sql &= " (" & sqlSM & ") as sm "
                sql &= " ON sa.sanorek = sm.smnorek "
                sql &= " JOIN m1_coa mycoa "
                sql &= " ON sa.sanorek = mycoa.cnomor "
                sql &= Sorting
                'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------


                'AMBIL SALDO NOREK SESUAI SQL YANG TELAH DIBUAT
                Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

                'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2R_NERACA_MUTASI SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
                'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
                'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
                'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
                If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                    dtNorek = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtNorek, "nmsaldoawal <> '0' OR nmdebit <> '0' OR nmkredit <> '0' OR nmsaldoakhir <> '0'")
                End If

                'PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_NERACA_MUTASI -----------------------------------  
                If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT NERACA MUTASI
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                  idlogin,                            nmnorek,                             nmnoreknama,                  nmtipe,                           nmmatauang,                             nmkurs,                             nmuraian,                             nmcatatan,                             nmsaldoawal,                             nmdebit,                             nmkredit,                             nmsaldoakhir,                             idmsmq,                             nmuserid,                   nmcustomtext1,           nmcustomtext2,           nmcustomtext3,           nmcustomtext4,           nmcustomtext5,nmcustomint1,nmcustomint2,nmcustomint3,nmcustomint4,nmcustomint5, nmcustomdbl1,           nmcustomdbl2,           nmcustomdbl3,           nmcustomdbl4,           nmcustomdbl5,                                nmcustomdate1,                                      nmcustomdate2,                                      nmcustomdate3,                                      nmcustomdate4,                                      nmcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & dr1("idlogin") & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmnoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("nmtipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
                    Next

                    'SIMPAN KE M2R_NERACA_MUTASI
                    If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                        sql = "Insert into M2r_Neraca_Mutasi(idlogin, nmnorek, nmnoreknama, nmtipe, nmmatauang, nmkurs, nmuraian, nmcatatan, nmsaldoawal, nmdebit, nmkredit, nmsaldoakhir, idmsmq, nmuserid, nmcustomtext1, nmcustomtext2, nmcustomtext3, nmcustomtext4, nmcustomtext5, nmcustomint1, nmcustomint2, nmcustomint3, nmcustomint4, nmcustomint5, nmcustomdbl1, nmcustomdbl2, nmcustomdbl3, nmcustomdbl4, nmcustomdbl5, nmcustomdate1, nmcustomdate2, nmcustomdate3, nmcustomdate4, nmcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                            result(2) = "Failed processing report." & currNorek : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_NERACA_MUTASI ----------------------------


                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtAmbilNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtAmbilNorek.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currNorek & "'." : GoTo selesai
                End If

            Next
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_KasHarian_Global(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN KAS HARIAN GLOBAL

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String, saldoNol(5) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang, saldoNol

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = "", saldoNol As Integer = 0

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        'saldoNol(5) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(5)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(5)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_NERACA_MUTASI ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMQ DI M2R_NERACA_MUTASI
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_neraca_mutasi WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace daily cash report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_NERACA_MUTASI -----------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", ftJoinSA As String = "", ftJoinSM As String = ""

        'FILTER NOREK
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1' AND ctipe = '0') "
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        'FILTER JOIN SALDO AWAL
        ftJoinSA = "ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
        'SQL SALDO AWAL
        sqlSA = "SELECT c.cnomor as sanorek, c.cnama as sanoreknama, c.cdc sacdc, c.ctipe satipe, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN s.snilai ELSE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) as samatauang, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) as sadebit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) END) as sakredit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) END) as sasaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t " & ftJoinSA & " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' " & Filter & " GROUP BY c.cnomor"

        'FILTER JOIN SALDO MUTASI
        ftJoinSM = "ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
        'SQL SALDO MUTASI
        sqlSM = "SELECT c.cnomor as smnorek, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) as smdebit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) END) as smkredit FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t " & ftJoinSM & " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' " & Filter & " GROUP BY c.cnomor"

        'SORTING NOREK
        Sorting = " ORDER BY sa.sanorek"

        'GABUNGKAN SQL SALDO AWAL DAN SALDO MUTASI
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, sa.sanorek as nmnorek, sa.sanoreknama as nmnoreknama, sa.satipe as nmtipe, sa.samatauang as nmmatauang, 0 as nmkurs, '' as nmuraian, '' as nmcatatan, sa.sasaldo as nmsaldoawal, sm.smdebit as nmdebit, sm.smkredit as nmkredit, (CASE sa.sacdc WHEN 'D' THEN sa.sasaldo + sm.smdebit - sm.smkredit ELSE sa.sasaldo - sm.smdebit + sm.smkredit END) as nmsaldoakhir, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'  as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as nmuserid FROM "
        sql &= " (" & sqlSA & ") as sa "
        sql &= " JOIN "
        sql &= " (" & sqlSM & ") as sm "
        sql &= " ON sa.sanorek = sm.smnorek "
        sql &= Sorting
        'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL SALDO NOREK SESUAI SQL YANG TELAH DIBUAT
        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

        'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2R_NERACA_MUTASI SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
        'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
        'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
        'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
        If saldoNol <> 1 Then
            dtNorek = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtNorek, "nmsaldoawal <> '0' OR nmdebit <> '0' OR nmkredit <> '0' OR nmsaldoakhir <> '0'")
        End If

        'PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_NERACA_MUTASI -----------------------------------  
        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'BUAT QUERY INSERT NERACA MUTASI
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'mapping :                  idlogin,                            nmnorek,                             nmnoreknama,                  nmtipe,                           nmmatauang,                             nmkurs,                             nmuraian,                             nmcatatan,                             nmsaldoawal,                             nmdebit,                             nmkredit,                             nmsaldoakhir,                             idmsmq,                             nmuserid,                   nmcustomtext1,           nmcustomtext2,           nmcustomtext3,           nmcustomtext4,           nmcustomtext5,nmcustomint1,nmcustomint2,nmcustomint3,nmcustomint4,nmcustomint5, nmcustomdbl1,           nmcustomdbl2,           nmcustomdbl3,           nmcustomdbl4,           nmcustomdbl5,                                nmcustomdate1,                                      nmcustomdate2,                                      nmcustomdate3,                                      nmcustomdate4,                                      nmcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & dr1("idlogin") & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmnoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("nmtipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
            Next

            'SIMPAN KE M2R_NERACA_MUTASI
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Neraca_Mutasi(idlogin, nmnorek, nmnoreknama, nmtipe, nmmatauang, nmkurs, nmuraian, nmcatatan, nmsaldoawal, nmdebit, nmkredit, nmsaldoakhir, idmsmq, nmuserid, nmcustomtext1, nmcustomtext2, nmcustomtext3, nmcustomtext4, nmcustomtext5, nmcustomint1, nmcustomint2, nmcustomint3, nmcustomint4, nmcustomint5, nmcustomdbl1, nmcustomdbl2, nmcustomdbl3, nmcustomdbl4, nmcustomdbl5, nmcustomdate1, nmcustomdate2, nmcustomdate3, nmcustomdate4, nmcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
        End If
        'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_NERACA_MUTASI ----------------------------

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        'saldoNol(5) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(5)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(5)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_NERACA_MUTASI ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMQ DI M2R_NERACA_MUTASI
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_neraca_mutasi WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace daily bank report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_NERACA_MUTASI -----------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", ftJoinSA As String = "", ftJoinSM As String = ""

        'FILTER NOREK
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1' AND ctipe = '1') "
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER UNTUK AKUN GIRO
        Dim dtGiro As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND (skode = 'GiroMasuk' OR skode = 'GiroKeluar')", strCon)
        If dtGiro.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtGiro.Rows
                Filter &= " OR (cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(dr1("snilai")) & "') "
            Next
        End If

        'FILTER JOIN SALDO AWAL
        ftJoinSA = "ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
        'SQL SALDO AWAL
        sqlSA = "SELECT c.cnomor as sanorek, c.cnama as sanoreknama, c.cdc sacdc, c.ctipe satipe, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN s.snilai ELSE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) as samatauang, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) as sadebit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) END) as sakredit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) END) as sasaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t " & ftJoinSA & " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' " & Filter & " GROUP BY c.cnomor"

        'FILTER JOIN SALDO MUTASI
        ftJoinSM = "ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
        'SQL SALDO MUTASI
        sqlSM = "SELECT c.cnomor as smnorek, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) as smdebit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) END) as smkredit FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t " & ftJoinSM & " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' " & Filter & " GROUP BY c.cnomor"

        'SORTING NOREK
        Sorting = " ORDER BY sa.sanorek"

        'GABUNGKAN SQL SALDO AWAL DAN SALDO MUTASI
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, sa.sanorek as nmnorek, sa.sanoreknama as nmnoreknama, sa.satipe as nmtipe, sa.samatauang as nmmatauang, 0 as nmkurs, '' as nmuraian, '' as nmcatatan, sa.sasaldo as nmsaldoawal, sm.smdebit as nmdebit, sm.smkredit as nmkredit, (CASE sa.sacdc WHEN 'D' THEN sa.sasaldo + sm.smdebit - sm.smkredit ELSE sa.sasaldo - sm.smdebit + sm.smkredit END) as nmsaldoakhir, '" & idMsmq & "'  as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as nmuserid FROM "
        sql &= " (" & sqlSA & ") as sa "
        sql &= " JOIN "
        sql &= " (" & sqlSM & ") as sm "
        sql &= " ON sa.sanorek = sm.smnorek "
        sql &= Sorting
        'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL SALDO NOREK SESUAI SQL YANG TELAH DIBUAT
        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

        'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2R_NERACA_MUTASI SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
        'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
        'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
        'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
        If saldoNol <> 1 Then
            dtNorek = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtNorek, "nmsaldoawal <> '0' OR nmdebit <> '0' OR nmkredit <> '0' OR nmsaldoakhir <> '0'")
        End If

        'PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_NERACA_MUTASI -----------------------------------  
        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'BUAT QUERY INSERT NERACA MUTASI
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'mapping :                  idlogin,                            nmnorek,                             nmnoreknama,                  nmtipe,                           nmmatauang,                             nmkurs,                             nmuraian,                             nmcatatan,                             nmsaldoawal,                             nmdebit,                             nmkredit,                             nmsaldoakhir,                             idmsmq,                             nmuserid,                   nmcustomtext1,           nmcustomtext2,           nmcustomtext3,           nmcustomtext4,           nmcustomtext5,nmcustomint1,nmcustomint2,nmcustomint3,nmcustomint4,nmcustomint5, nmcustomdbl1,           nmcustomdbl2,           nmcustomdbl3,           nmcustomdbl4,           nmcustomdbl5,                                nmcustomdate1,                                      nmcustomdate2,                                      nmcustomdate3,                                      nmcustomdate4,                                      nmcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & dr1("idlogin") & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmnoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("nmtipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
            Next

            'SIMPAN KE M2R_NERACA_MUTASI
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Neraca_Mutasi(idlogin, nmnorek, nmnoreknama, nmtipe, nmmatauang, nmkurs, nmuraian, nmcatatan, nmsaldoawal, nmdebit, nmkredit, nmsaldoakhir, idmsmq, nmuserid, nmcustomtext1, nmcustomtext2, nmcustomtext3, nmcustomtext4, nmcustomtext5, nmcustomint1, nmcustomint2, nmcustomint3, nmcustomint4, nmcustomint5, nmcustomdbl1, nmcustomdbl2, nmcustomdbl3, nmcustomdbl4, nmcustomdbl5, nmcustomdate1, nmcustomdate2, nmcustomdate3, nmcustomdate4, nmcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
        End If
        'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_NERACA_MUTASI ----------------------------

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_KasHarian_AkunLawan(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN KAS HARIAN (AKUN LAWAN)

        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING

        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity

        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================

        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================

        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 5) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kasbank_Harian ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kasbank_Harian
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kasbank_Harian WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace general ledger data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kasbank_Harian -----------------------------

        'BUAT FILTER NOREK -------------------------------------------------------
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1' AND ctipe = '0') "
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER NOREK ------------------------------------------------

        'AMBIL NOREK ANTARA NOREK AWAL DAN NOREK AKHIR
        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor FROM m1_coa " & Filter & " ORDER BY cnomor", strCon)
        'AMBIL TGL DI TRANSAKSI ANTARA TGLAWAL DAN TGLAKHIR FILTER
        Dim dtTgl As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT t.ttgl as tgl FROM m2_transaction_journal t WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' GROUP BY t.ttgl ASC", strCon)

        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 And dtTgl.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2r_Kasbank_Harian SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
            Dim sqlSAwal As String = "", sqlSMutasi As String = "", sqlSAkhir As String = ""
            Dim SAwal As Double = 0, SMutasi As Double = 0, SAkhir As Double = 0
            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, currNorek As String = "", currTgl As String = ""


            'PERULANGAN INSERT M2r_Kasbank_Harian PER NOREK ------------------------
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
