                sqlSAwal = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldoawal FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSMutasi = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldomutasi FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SALDO AKHIR
                sqlSAkhir = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldoakhir FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'GABUNGKAN SQL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                sql = "SELECT (" & sqlSAwal & ") as saldoawal, (" & sqlSMutasi & ") as saldomutasi, (" & sqlSAkhir & ") as saldoakhir"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dtSAwal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAwal.Rows
                        'SET NILAI SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                        SAwal = FixDouble(dr1("saldoawal")) : SMutasi = FixDouble(dr1("saldomutasi")) : SAkhir = FixDouble(dr1("saldoakhir"))
                    Next
                Else
                    result(2) = "Failed Getting '" & currNorek & "' starting balance." : GoTo selesai
                End If

                'AMBIL TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK PERTANGGAL
                For Each drTgl As DataRow In dtTgl.Rows
                    strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                    'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET SALDO AWAL, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
                    currTgl = AsFormatTanggal(drTgl("tgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd")

                    sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, t1.tid as kbhid, t1.tkontak as kbhkontak, c.kkode as kbhkontakkode, c.knama as kbhkontaknama, t1.ttgl as kbhtgl, t1.tidtransaksi as kbhidtransaksi, t1.tsumber as kbhsumber, t1.tnotransaksi as kbhnotransaksi, t1.tmatauang as kbhmatauang, t1.tkurs as kbhkurs, t1.tnorek as kbhnorek, coa1.cnama as kbhnoreknama, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t1.tdebit ELSE t1.tdebitvalas END) as kbhdebit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t1.tkredit ELSE t1.tkreditvalas END) as kbhkredit, t2.tid as kbhidlawan, t2.tnorek as kbhnoreklawan, coa2.cnama as kbhnoreklawannama, (CASE WHEN OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t2.tdebit ELSE t2.tdebitvalas END) as kbhkreditlawan, t2.turaian as kbhuraian, t2.tcatatan as kbhcatatan, '" & FixDouble(SAwal) & "' as kbhsaldoawal, '" & FixDouble(SMutasi) & "' as kbhsaldomutasi, '" & FixDouble(SAkhir) & "' as kbhsaldoakhir, t2.tinputtgl as kbhinputtgl, '' as kbhnogiro, '' as kbhbank, '0' as kbhjumlah, '1900-01-01' as kbhtgljthtempo, '1900-01-01' as kbhtglcair, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as kbhuserid FROM m2_transaction_journal t1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t2 ON t1.tnotransaksi = t2.tnotransaksi AND t1.tid <> t2.tid JOIN m1_coa coa1 ON t1.tnorek = coa1.cnomor JOIN m1_coa coa2 ON t2.tnorek = coa2.cnomor JOIN m1_contact c ON t1.tkontak = c.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t1.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t1.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t1.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(currTgl) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(currTgl) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t1.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t1.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) ORDER BY t1.tnorek, t1.ttgl, t1.tnotransaksi, t2.turutan"
                    dtSMutasi = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

                    If dtSMutasi.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK

            Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count * dtTgl.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtNorek.Rows.Count * dtTgl.Rows.Count), 2) * stepKe)

        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER NOREK ------------------------------------------------

        'AMBIL NOREK ANTARA NOREK AWAL DAN NOREK AKHIR
        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor FROM m1_coa " & Filter & " ORDER BY cnomor", strCon)
        'AMBIL TGL DI TRANSAKSI ANTARA TGLAWAL DAN TGLAKHIR FILTER
        Dim dtTgl As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT t.ttgl as tgl FROM m2_transaction_journal t WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' GROUP BY t.ttgl ASC", strCon)

        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 And dtTgl.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2r_Kasbank_Harian SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
            Dim sqlSAwal As String = "", sqlSMutasi As String = "", sqlSAkhir As String = ""
            Dim SAwal As Double = 0, SMutasi As Double = 0, SAkhir As Double = 0
            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, currNorek As String = "", currTgl As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN INSERT M2r_Kasbank_Harian PER NOREK ------------------------
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
                currNorek = dr("cnomor") : strValue.Clear()

                'BUAT QUERY UNTUK AMBIL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAwal = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldoawal FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSMutasi = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldomutasi FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SALDO AKHIR
                sqlSAkhir = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldoakhir FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'GABUNGKAN SQL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                sql = "SELECT (" & sqlSAwal & ") as saldoawal, (" & sqlSMutasi & ") as saldomutasi, (" & sqlSAkhir & ") as saldoakhir"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dtSAwal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAwal.Rows
                        'SET NILAI SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                        SAwal = FixDouble(dr1("saldoawal")) : SMutasi = FixDouble(dr1("saldomutasi")) : SAkhir = FixDouble(dr1("saldoakhir"))
                    Next
                Else
                    result(2) = "Failed Getting '" & currNorek & "' starting balance." : GoTo selesai
                End If

                'AMBIL TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK PERTANGGAL
                For Each drTgl As DataRow In dtTgl.Rows
                    strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                    'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET SALDO AWAL, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
                    currTgl = AsFormatTanggal(drTgl("tgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd")

                    'AMBIL TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                    sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, t1.tid as kbhid, t1.tkontak as kbhkontak, c.kkode as kbhkontakkode, c.knama as kbhkontaknama, t1.ttgl as kbhtgl, t1.tidtransaksi as kbhidtransaksi, t1.tsumber as kbhsumber, t1.tnotransaksi as kbhnotransaksi, t1.tmatauang as kbhmatauang, t1.tkurs as kbhkurs, t1.tnorek as kbhnorek, coa1.cnama as kbhnoreknama, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t1.tdebit ELSE t1.tdebitvalas END) as kbhdebit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t1.tkredit ELSE t1.tkreditvalas END) as kbhkredit, t2.tid as kbhidlawan, t2.tnorek as kbhnoreklawan, coa2.cnama as kbhnoreklawannama, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t2.tkredit ELSE t2.tkreditvalas END) as kbhdebitlawan, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t2.tdebit ELSE t2.tdebitvalas END) as kbhkreditlawan, t2.turaian as kbhuraian, t2.tcatatan as kbhcatatan, '" & FixDouble(SAwal) & "' as kbhsaldoawal, '" & FixDouble(SMutasi) & "' as kbhsaldomutasi, '" & FixDouble(SAkhir) & "' as kbhsaldoakhir, t2.tinputtgl as kbhinputtgl, '' as kbhnogiro, '' as kbhbank, '0' as kbhjumlah, '1900-01-01' as kbhtgljthtempo, '1900-01-01' as kbhtglcair, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as kbhuserid FROM m2_transaction_journal t1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t2 ON t1.tnotransaksi = t2.tnotransaksi AND t1.tid <> t2.tid JOIN m1_coa coa1 ON t1.tnorek = coa1.cnomor JOIN m1_coa coa2 ON t2.tnorek = coa2.cnomor JOIN m1_contact c ON t1.tkontak = c.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t1.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t1.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t1.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(currTgl) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(currTgl) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t1.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t1.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) ORDER BY t1.tnorek, t1.ttgl, t1.tnotransaksi, t2.turutan"
                    dtSMutasi = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                    If dtSMutasi.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                        For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSMutasi.Rows
                            'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                            strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                            'mapping :                            idlogin,                             kbhid,                             kbhkontak,                             kbhkontakkode,                             kbhkontaknama,                                             kbhtgl,                              kbhidtransaksi                              kbhsumber                              kbhnotransaksi,                             kbhmatauang,                             kbhkurs,                             kbhnorek,                             kbhnoreknama,                             kbhdebit,                             kbhkredit,                             kbhidlawan,                             kbhnoreklawan,                             kbhnoreklawannama,                             kbhdebitlawan,                             kbhkreditlawan,                             kbhuraian,                             kbhcatatan,                             kbhsaldoawal,                             kbhsaldomutasi,                             kbhsaldoakhir,                                             kbhinputtgl,                                                     kbhnogiro,                             kbhbank,                             kbhjumlah,                                             kbhtgljthtempo,                                              kbhtglcair,                              idmsmq,                             kbhuserid,                  kbhcustomtext1,          kbhcustomtext2,          kbhcustomtext3,          kbhcustomtext4,          kbhcustomtext5,kbhcustomint1,kbhcustomint2,kbhcustomint3,kbhcustomint4,kbhcustomint5,kbhcustomdbl1,     kbhcustomdbl2,          kbhcustomdbl3,          kbhcustomdbl4,          kbhcustomdbl5,                                 kbhcustomdate1,                                     kbhcustomdate2,                                     kbhcustomdate3,                                     kbhcustomdate4,                                     kbhcustomdate5
                            strValue.Append("('" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhtgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhidtransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnoreknama")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhkredit")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhidlawan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnoreklawan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnoreklawannama")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhdebitlawan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhkreditlawan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhsaldomutasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnogiro")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhbank")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhjumlah")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhtgljthtempo"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhtglcair"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
                        Next
                    End If

                    'SIMPAN KE M2r_Kasbank_Harian
                    If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                        sql = "Insert into M2r_Kasbank_Harian(idlogin, kbhid, kbhkontak, kbhkontakkode, kbhkontaknama, kbhtgl, kbhidtransaksi, kbhsumber, kbhnotransaksi, kbhmatauang, kbhkurs, kbhnorek, kbhnoreknama, kbhdebit, kbhkredit, kbhidlawan, kbhnoreklawan, kbhnoreklawannama, kbhdebitlawan, kbhkreditlawan, kbhuraian, kbhcatatan, kbhsaldoawal, kbhsaldomutasi, kbhsaldoakhir, kbhinputtgl, kbhnogiro, kbhbank, kbhjumlah, kbhtgljthtempo, kbhtglcair, idmsmq, kbhuserid, kbhcustomtext1, kbhcustomtext2, kbhcustomtext3, kbhcustomtext4, kbhcustomtext5, kbhcustomint1, kbhcustomint2, kbhcustomint3, kbhcustomint4, kbhcustomint5, kbhcustomdbl1, kbhcustomdbl2, kbhcustomdbl3, kbhcustomdbl4, kbhcustomdbl5, kbhcustomdate1, kbhcustomdate2, kbhcustomdate3, kbhcustomdate4, kbhcustomdate5) values " & strValue.ToString & ""
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                            result(2) = "Failed processing '" & currNorek & "' daily cash report." : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If

                    'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                    Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count * dtTgl.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtNorek.Rows.Count * dtTgl.Rows.Count), 2) * stepKe)

                    'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                    sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currNorek & "' daily cash report." : GoTo selesai
                    End If

                Next

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT M2r_Kasbank_Harian PER NOREK -----------------

        Else

            'JIKA TIDAK ADA DATA MAKA LANGSUNG UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count * dtTgl.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtNorek.Rows.Count * dtTgl.Rows.Count), 2) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress 'No Data' daily cash report." : GoTo selesai
            End If

        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_BankHarian_AkunLawan(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN BANK HARIAN (AKUN LAWAN)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 5) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kasbank_Harian
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kasbank_Harian WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace general ledger data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kasbank_Harian -----------------------------

        'BUAT FILTER NOREK -------------------------------------------------------
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1' AND ctipe = '1') "
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER NOREK ------------------------------------------------

        'AMBIL NOREK ANTARA NOREK AWAL DAN NOREK AKHIR
        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor FROM m1_coa " & Filter & " ORDER BY cnomor", strCon)
        'AMBIL TGL DI TRANSAKSI ANTARA TGLAWAL DAN TGLAKHIR FILTER
        Dim dtTgl As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT t.ttgl as tgl FROM m2_transaction_journal t WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' GROUP BY t.ttgl ASC", strCon)

        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 And dtTgl.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2r_Kasbank_Harian SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
            Dim sqlSAwal As String = "", sqlSMutasi As String = "", sqlSAkhir As String = ""
            Dim SAwal As Double = 0, SMutasi As Double = 0, SAkhir As Double = 0
            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, currNorek As String = "", currTgl As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN INSERT M2r_Kasbank_Harian PER NOREK ------------------------
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows

                currNorek = dr("cnomor") : strValue.Clear()

                'BUAT QUERY UNTUK AMBIL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAwal = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldoawal FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"

                sqlSMutasi = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldomutasi FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SALDO AKHIR
                sqlSAkhir = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldoakhir FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'GABUNGKAN SQL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                sql = "SELECT (" & sqlSAwal & ") as saldoawal, (" & sqlSMutasi & ") as saldomutasi, (" & sqlSAkhir & ") as saldoakhir"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dtSAwal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAwal.Rows
                        'SET NILAI SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                        SAwal = FixDouble(dr1("saldoawal")) : SMutasi = FixDouble(dr1("saldomutasi")) : SAkhir = FixDouble(dr1("saldoakhir"))
                    Next
                Else
                    result(2) = "Failed Getting '" & currNorek & "' starting balance." : GoTo selesai
                End If

                'AMBIL TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK PERTANGGAL
                For Each drTgl As DataRow In dtTgl.Rows
                    strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                    'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET SALDO AWAL, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
                    currTgl = AsFormatTanggal(drTgl("tgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd")

                    'AMBIL TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                    sql = "SELECT gl.idlogin, gl.kbhid, gl.kbhkontak,gl.kbhkontakkode, gl.kbhkontaknama, gl.kbhtgl, gl.kbhidtransaksi, gl.kbhsumber, gl.kbhnotransaksi, gl.kbhmatauang, gl.kbhkurs, gl.kbhnorek, gl.kbhnoreknama, gl.kbhdebit, gl.kbhkredit, gl.kbhidlawan, gl.kbhnoreklawan, gl.kbhnoreklawannama, gl.kbhdebitlawan, gl.kbhkreditlawan, gl.kbhuraian, gl.kbhcatatan, gl.kbhsaldoawal, gl.kbhsaldomutasi, gl.kbhsaldoakhir, gl.kbhinputtgl, gl.kbhnogiro, gl.kbhbank, gl.kbhjumlah, gl.kbhtgljthtempo, gl.kbhtglcair, gl.idmsmq, gl.kbhuserid , (@saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(gl.kbhdebit,0) - IFNULL(gl.kbhkredit,0)) AS kbhcustomdbl1 FROM (SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, t1.tid as kbhid, t1.tkontak as kbhkontak, c.kkode as kbhkontakkode, c.knama as kbhkontaknama, t1.ttgl as kbhtgl, t1.tidtransaksi as kbhidtransaksi, t1.tsumber as kbhsumber, t1.tnotransaksi as kbhnotransaksi, t1.tmatauang as kbhmatauang, t1.tkurs as kbhkurs, t1.tnorek as kbhnorek, coa1.cnama as kbhnoreknama, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t1.tdebit ELSE t1.tdebitvalas END) as kbhdebit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t1.tkredit ELSE t1.tkreditvalas END) as kbhkredit,  t2.tid as kbhidlawan, t2.tnorek as kbhnoreklawan, coa2.cnama as kbhnoreklawannama, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai  THEN t2.tkredit ELSE t2.tkreditvalas END) as kbhdebitlawan, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai  THEN t2.tdebit ELSE t2.tdebitvalas END) as kbhkreditlawan, t2.turaian as kbhuraian, t2.tcatatan as kbhcatatan, '" & FixDouble(SAwal) & "' as kbhsaldoawal,  '" & FixDouble(SMutasi) & "' as kbhsaldomutasi, '" & FixDouble(SAkhir) & "' as kbhsaldoakhir, t2.tinputtgl as kbhinputtgl, '' as kbhnogiro, '' as kbhbank, '0' as kbhjumlah, '1900-01-01' as kbhtgljthtempo, '1900-01-01' as kbhtglcair, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as kbhuserid FROM m2_transaction_journal t1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t2 ON t1.tnotransaksi = t2.tnotransaksi AND t1.tid <> t2.tid JOIN m1_coa coa1 ON t1.tnorek = coa1.cnomor JOIN m1_coa coa2 ON t2.tnorek = coa2.cnomor JOIN m1_contact c ON t1.tkontak = c.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' , (SELECT @nourut := 1) AS variableInit1 WHERE t1.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t1.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t1.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(currTgl) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(currTgl) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t1.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t1.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) ORDER BY t1.tnorek, t1.ttgl, t1.tnotransaksi, t2.turutan, kbhdebitlawan, kbhkreditlawan) as gl, (SELECT @saldo := " & FixDouble(SAwal) & ") AS variableInit2 "
                    dtSMutasi = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                    If dtSMutasi.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                        For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSMutasi.Rows
                            'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                            strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                            'mapping :                            idlogin,                             kbhid,                             kbhkontak,                             kbhkontakkode,                             kbhkontaknama,                                             kbhtgl,                              kbhidtransaksi                              kbhsumber                              kbhnotransaksi,                             kbhmatauang,                             kbhkurs,                             kbhnorek,                             kbhnoreknama,                             kbhdebit,                             kbhkredit,                             kbhidlawan,                             kbhnoreklawan,                             kbhnoreklawannama,                             kbhdebitlawan,                             kbhkreditlawan,                             kbhuraian,                             kbhcatatan,                             kbhsaldoawal,                             kbhsaldomutasi,                             kbhsaldoakhir,                                             kbhinputtgl,                                                     kbhnogiro,                             kbhbank,                             kbhjumlah,                                             kbhtgljthtempo,                                              kbhtglcair,                              idmsmq,                             kbhuserid,                  kbhcustomtext1,          kbhcustomtext2,          kbhcustomtext3,          kbhcustomtext4,          kbhcustomtext5,kbhcustomint1,kbhcustomint2,kbhcustomint3,kbhcustomint4,kbhcustomint5,kbhcustomdbl1,     kbhcustomdbl2,          kbhcustomdbl3,          kbhcustomdbl4,          kbhcustomdbl5,                                 kbhcustomdate1,                                     kbhcustomdate2,                                     kbhcustomdate3,                                     kbhcustomdate4,                                     kbhcustomdate5
                            strValue.Append("('" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhtgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhidtransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnoreknama")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhkredit")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhidlawan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnoreklawan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnoreklawannama")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhdebitlawan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhkreditlawan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhsaldomutasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnogiro")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhbank")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhjumlah")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhtgljthtempo"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhtglcair"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhcustomdbl1")) & "' , '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
                        Next
                    End If

                    'SIMPAN KE M2r_Kasbank_Harian
                    If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                        sql = "Insert into M2r_Kasbank_Harian(idlogin, kbhid, kbhkontak, kbhkontakkode, kbhkontaknama, kbhtgl, kbhidtransaksi, kbhsumber, kbhnotransaksi, kbhmatauang, kbhkurs, kbhnorek, kbhnoreknama, kbhdebit, kbhkredit, kbhidlawan, kbhnoreklawan, kbhnoreklawannama, kbhdebitlawan, kbhkreditlawan, kbhuraian, kbhcatatan, kbhsaldoawal, kbhsaldomutasi, kbhsaldoakhir, kbhinputtgl, kbhnogiro, kbhbank, kbhjumlah, kbhtgljthtempo, kbhtglcair, idmsmq, kbhuserid, kbhcustomtext1, kbhcustomtext2, kbhcustomtext3, kbhcustomtext4, kbhcustomtext5, kbhcustomint1, kbhcustomint2, kbhcustomint3, kbhcustomint4, kbhcustomint5, kbhcustomdbl1, kbhcustomdbl2, kbhcustomdbl3, kbhcustomdbl4, kbhcustomdbl5, kbhcustomdate1, kbhcustomdate2, kbhcustomdate3, kbhcustomdate4, kbhcustomdate5) values " & strValue.ToString & ""
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                            result(2) = "Failed processing '" & currNorek & "' daily cash report." : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If

                    'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                    Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count * dtTgl.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtNorek.Rows.Count * dtTgl.Rows.Count), 2) * stepKe)

                    'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                    sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currNorek & "' daily cash report." : GoTo selesai
                    End If

                Next

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT M2r_Kasbank_Harian PER NOREK -----------------

        Else

            'JIKA TIDAK ADA DATA MAKA LANGSUNG UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count * dtTgl.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtNorek.Rows.Count * dtTgl.Rows.Count), 2) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress 'No Data' daily cash report." : GoTo selesai
            End If

        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_HitungRealisasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//HITUNG REALISASI NOAKUN (M2_REALIZATION)

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataUtama() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        Dim norekLR As String = "", strUpdate As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = ""

        Dim dt As New DataTable, vtahun As Integer = 0, vbulan As Integer = 0, vkodepa As Integer = 0, isActive As Integer = 0


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================

        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'tahun(0) As integer, bulan(1) As integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'tahun, bulan


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =======================================================
        'SPILIT PARAMETER DATA
        dataUtama = paramSplit(5).Split(sptField)

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA ==========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vtahun = Integer.Parse(dataUtama(0))
        End If

        'bulan(1) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(1)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vbulan = Integer.Parse(dataUtama(1))
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA ===================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =======================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'AMBIL KODE PA DARI M2_ACCOUNTING_PERIOD
        sql = "SELECT apkode, aptutupperiode FROM m2_accounting_period WHERE aptahun = '" & vtahun & "' AND apbulan = '" & vbulan & "'"
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            vkodepa = Integer.Parse(dt.Rows(0)("apkode"))
            isActive = Integer.Parse(dt.Rows(0)("aptutupperiode"))
        Else
            'result(2) = "Accounting Period not found." : GoTo selesai
            result(1) = 1 : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'JIKA PERIODE AKUNTANSI BLM TUTUP PERIODE MAKA DIHITUNG
        If isActive = 0 Then
            'AMBIL NOREK BULAN BERJALAN DARI SETTING
            Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
            If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                norekLR = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
            Else
                result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If

            'UPDATE REALISASI PADA M2_REALIZATION MENJADI 0
            sql = "UPDATE m2_realization SET rjmldebit = 0, rjmlkredit = 0 WHERE rkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data." : GoTo selesai
            End If

            'VARIABEL DATATABLE UNTUK NOAKUN LEVEL 1 SD 5

                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then

                sql = "SELECT IFNULL(SUM(tkredit) - SUM(tdebit),0) as saldo FROM m2_transaction_journal JOIN m1_coa ON tnorek = cnomor WHERE tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND (ctipe = 11 OR ctipe = 14) AND tkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"

                    Next
                    If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                        sql = "INSERT INTO m2_realization (rtahun, rbulan, rnorek, rjmldebit, rjmlkredit, ranggaran, rkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rjmldebit = VALUES(rjmldebit), rjmlkredit = VALUES(rjmlkredit)"
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                            result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 4." : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If

                    'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                    strUpdate = ""

                    'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 3
                    'AMBIL NOAKUN INDUK LEVEL 3 DARI M2_REALIZATION SESUAI KODEPA
                    sql = "SELECT c.clevel3 as norek, SUM(r.rjmldebit) as debit, SUM(r.rjmlkredit) as kredit FROM m2_realization r JOIN m1_coa c ON r.rnorek = c.cnomor WHERE r.rkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' AND c.clevel = 4 GROUP BY c.clevel3"
                    dt3 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                    If dt3.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                        'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 3
                        For Each dr3 As DataRow In dt3.Rows
                            strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                            'mapping :                                            rtahun,                      rbulan,                           rnorek,                            rjmldebit,                         rjmlkredit, ranggaran,            rkodepa
                            strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr3("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr3("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr3("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                        Next
                        If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                            sql = "INSERT INTO m2_realization (rtahun, rbulan, rnorek, rjmldebit, rjmlkredit, ranggaran, rkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rjmldebit = VALUES(rjmldebit), rjmlkredit = VALUES(rjmlkredit)"
                            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                                result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 3." : GoTo selesai
                            End If
                        End If

                        'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                        strUpdate = ""

                        'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 2
                        'AMBIL NOAKUN INDUK LEVEL 2 DARI M2_REALIZATION SESUAI KODEPA
                        sql = "SELECT c.clevel2 as norek, SUM(r.rjmldebit) as debit, SUM(r.rjmlkredit) as kredit FROM m2_realization r JOIN m1_coa c ON r.rnorek = c.cnomor WHERE r.rkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' AND c.clevel = 3 GROUP BY c.clevel2"
                        dt2 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                        If dt2.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                            'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 2
                            For Each dr2 As DataRow In dt2.Rows
                                strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                                'mapping :                                            rtahun,                      rbulan,                           rnorek,                            rjmldebit,                         rjmlkredit, ranggaran,            rkodepa
                                strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr2("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr2("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr2("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                            Next
                            If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                                sql = "INSERT INTO m2_realization (rtahun, rbulan, rnorek, rjmldebit, rjmlkredit, ranggaran, rkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rjmldebit = VALUES(rjmldebit), rjmlkredit = VALUES(rjmlkredit)"
                                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                                    result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 2." : GoTo selesai
                                End If
                            End If

                            'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                            strUpdate = ""

                            'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 1
                            'AMBIL NOAKUN INDUK LEVEL 1 DARI M2_REALIZATION SESUAI KODEPA
                            sql = "SELECT c.clevel1 as norek, SUM(r.rjmldebit) as debit, SUM(r.rjmlkredit) as kredit FROM m2_realization r JOIN m1_coa c ON r.rnorek = c.cnomor WHERE r.rkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' AND c.clevel = 2 GROUP BY c.clevel1"
                            dt1 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                            If dt2.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                                'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 1
                                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt1.Rows
                                    strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                                    'mapping :                                            rtahun,                      rbulan,                           rnorek,                            rjmldebit,                         rjmlkredit, ranggaran,            rkodepa
                                    strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                                Next
                                If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                                    sql = "INSERT INTO m2_realization (rtahun, rbulan, rnorek, rjmldebit, rjmlkredit, ranggaran, rkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rjmldebit = VALUES(rjmldebit), rjmlkredit = VALUES(rjmlkredit)"
                                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                                        result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 1." : GoTo selesai
                                    End If
                                End If

                                'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                                strUpdate = ""

                            End If

                        End If

                    End If

                End If

            End If
        End If
        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ================================================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_PosisiKeuangan(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN POSISI KEUANGAN (NERACA)

        '   2. L/R TAHUN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN AWAL TAHUN S.D. BULAN LALU)
        '   3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI        : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------

        'tahun(0) As Integer, bulan(1) As Integer, level(2) As Integer, saldoNol(3) As Integer, pembagiNominal(4) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail

        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = ""
        Dim stepTotal As Double = 8, stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim norekLRBulan As String = "", norekLRTahun As String = "", norekLRDitahan As String = ""

        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then

        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================

        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL

        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            tahun = dataDetail(0)
        End If

        'bulan(1) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            bulan = dataDetail(1)
        End If

        'level(2) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(2)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "level required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            level = dataDetail(2)
        End If

        'saldoNol(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(3)
        End If

        'pembagiNominal(4) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(4)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "pembagiNominal required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            pembagiNominal = dataDetail(4)
        End If

        'SET tahunLalu DAN bulanLalu
        'JIKA BULAN = 1 MAKA TAHUNLALU = TAHUN - 1 DAN BULANLALU = 12
        'JIKA BULAN <> 1 MAKA TAHUNLALU = TAHUN DAN BULANLALU = BULAN - 1
        If bulan = 1 Then
            tahunLalu = tahun - 1 : bulanLalu = 12
        Else
            tahunLalu = tahun : bulanLalu = bulan - 1
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()


        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Posisi_Keuangan ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2r_Posisi_Keuangan
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Posisi_Keuangan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace trial balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Posisi_Keuangan -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------
        'AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN

        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG REALISASI BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU ---------------------------------

        Dim rsHitungSplit() As String = rsHitung.Split(sptSubParam)

        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then

        Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG BULAN INI ===================
        stepKe = 2
        rsHitung = M0_HitungRealisasi(idLogin & "★M0_HitungRealisasi★0△0△△△dd/MM/yyyy△dd/MM/yyyy H:mm:ss★" & userid & "★0★" & tahun & sptField & bulan)
        rsHitungSplit = rsHitung.Split(sptSubParam)
        'FORMAT KEMBALIAN = NamaFungsi△isSuccess△errMessage△errStep△idtransaksi★0△0△0△0△0★ ----> M0_HitungRealisasi△1△△0△0★0△0△0△0△0★
        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then
            'JIKA ISSUCCESS <> 1 MAKA KIRIM INFORMASI PROSES GAGAL
