                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD1) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD2) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD3) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD4) & "'"
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, filterSaldo)
            End If

            'PERULANGAN BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU (M2r_Posisi_Keuangan)
            dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))

                If currLevel < level Then

                    'mapping :                                 idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                                                      pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5

                End If

                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'jika currLevel = level, maka saldo ditampilkan. jika currlevel <> level maka saldo diisi 0
                'mapping :                            idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                                                  pkdebit,                                                        pkkredit,                                                        pksaldo,                                                        pkdebitlalu,                                                        pkkreditlalu,                                                        pksaldolalu,                                                        pkdebitvariasi,                                                        pkkreditvariasi,                                                        pksaldovariasi,                                 idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5

                    urut += 1

            'INSERT TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
            sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
            sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pknorek, CONCAT('Total ', GROUP_CONCAT(s.pknoreknama ORDER BY s.pknorek SEPARATOR ' dan ')) as pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, SUM(s.pkdebit) as pkdebit, SUM(s.pkkredit) as pkkredit, SUM(s.pksaldo) as pksaldo, SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitlalu, SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditlalu, SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldolalu, SUM(s.pkdebit) - SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitvariasi, SUM(s.pkkredit) - SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditvariasi, SUM(s.pksaldo) - SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "

                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                    'increament urutan
                    urut += 1
                Next
            End If

            'SIMPAN KE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Posisi_Keuangan(pkurut, idlogin, pktahun, pkbulan, pknorek, pknoreknama, pktipe, pkgd, pkjenis, pklevel, pklevel1, pklevel2, pklevel3, pklevel4, pklevel5, pkgddata, pkleveldata, pkdebit, pkkredit, pksaldo, pkdebitlalu, pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu, pkdebitvariasi, pkkreditvariasi, pksaldovariasi, idmsmq, pkuserid, pkcustomtext1, pkcustomtext2, pkcustomtext3, pkcustomtext4, pkcustomtext5, pkcustomint1, pkcustomint2, pkcustomint3, pkcustomint4, pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1, pkcustomdbl2, pkcustomdbl3, pkcustomdbl4, pkcustomdbl5, pkcustomdate1, pkcustomdate2, pkcustomdate3, pkcustomdate4, pkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing balance sheet report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If


            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
            End If


            'PROSES PERHITUNGAN L/R -------------------------------------
            stepKe = 5

            '1. L/R BULAN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN L/R BULAN INI ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI REALISASI BULAN INI
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI REALISASI BULAN LALU
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')     WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA
            sql = "  SELECT s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql &= " JOIN "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                LBDebit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebit"), 0))
                LBKredit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkredit"), 0))
                LBSaldo = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldo"), 0))
                LBDebitlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitlalu"), 0))
                LBKreditlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditlalu"), 0))
                LBSaldolalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldolalu"), 0))
                LBDebitvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitvariasi"), 0))
                LBKreditvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditvariasi"), 0))
                LBSaldovariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldovariasi"), 0))
            End If

            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = " & FixDouble(LBKredit) & ","

            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = " & FixDouble(LBDebitlalu) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = " & FixDouble(LBKreditlalu) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = " & FixDouble(LBSaldolalu) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = " & FixDouble(LBDebitvariasi) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = " & FixDouble(LBKreditvariasi) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = " & FixDouble(LBSaldovariasi) & ""

            '2. L/R TAHUN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN AWAL TAHUN S.D. BULAN LALU) ^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN INI S.D. BULAN INI - 1
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN LALU S.D. BULAN LALU - 1
            'sqlBulanIni = " SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')     WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND ((r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') OR (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND ((r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') OR (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA
            sql = "  SELECT s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql &= " JOIN "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                LTDebit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebit"), 0))
                LTKredit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkredit"), 0))
                LTSaldo = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldo"), 0))
                LTDebitlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitlalu"), 0))
                LTKreditlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditlalu"), 0))
                LTSaldolalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldolalu"), 0))
                LTDebitvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitvariasi"), 0))
                LTKreditvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditvariasi"), 0))
                LTSaldovariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldovariasi"), 0))
            End If

            'UPDATE L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
            'sqlJadi = "  UPDATE m2r_posisi_keuangan pk"
            'sqlJadi &= " JOIN (" & sql & ") as saldo"
            'sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = pk.pkdebit + (" & FixDouble(LTDebit) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = pk.pkkredit + (" & FixDouble(LTKredit) & "),"

            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = pk.pksaldolalu + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldolalu) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = pk.pkdebitvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTDebitvariasi) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = pk.pkkreditvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTKreditvariasi) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = pk.pksaldovariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldovariasi) & ")"

            '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI        : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN INI - 1
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN LALU - 1
            'sqlBulanIni = " SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'    ) WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "') WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanIni = " SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND ((r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (r.rtahun <= '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "'     AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND ((r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (r.rtahun <= '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND ((r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (((r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "')      OR (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "'))     AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND ((r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (((r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' ) OR (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA
            sql = "  SELECT s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql &= " JOIN "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                LDDebit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebit"), 0))
                LDKredit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkredit"), 0))
                LDSaldo = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldo"), 0))
                LDDebitlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitlalu"), 0))
                LDKreditlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditlalu"), 0))
                LDSaldolalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldolalu"), 0))
                LDDebitvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitvariasi"), 0))
                LDKreditvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditvariasi"), 0))
                LDSaldovariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldovariasi"), 0))
            End If

            'UPDATE L/R DITAHAN
            'sqlJadi = "  UPDATE m2r_posisi_keuangan pk"
            'sqlJadi &= " JOIN (" & sql & ") as saldo"
            'sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = pk.pkdebit + (" & FixDouble(LDDebit) & "),"

            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = (" & FixDouble(LDKredit) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = (" & FixDouble(LDSaldo) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = (" & FixDouble(LDDebitlalu) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = (" & FixDouble(LDKreditlalu) & "),"

            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = (" & FixDouble(LDSaldovariasi) & ")"
            sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "'"
            sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed processing Retained Profit/Loss." : GoTo selesai
            End If


            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
            End If


            stepKe = 6

            'JIKA LEVEL >= 4 MAKA HITUNG L/R LEVEL 4
            If level >= 4 Then

                If LB4 = LT4 And LT4 = LD4 Then

                        result(2) = "Failed processing Level 4 Parent Profit/Loss Account. #1" : GoTo selesai
                    End If

            sql &= " FROM m2r_posisi_keuangan a"

            sql &= " ON a.idlogin = p.idlogin AND a.idmsmq = p.idmsmq AND a.pkurut = p.pkurut AND (p.pkjenis = 'H' OR p.pkjenis = 'M')"
            sql &= " WHERE a.pkjenis = 'A'"
            sql &= " AND a.idlogin = '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "'"
            sql &= " AND a.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

        Else
            'UPDATE URUTAN TERAKHIR AKTIVA MENJADI SAMA DENGAN URUTAN TRAKHIR PASIVA
            sql = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan SET pkurut = '" & JmlPasiva & "' "
            sql &= " WHERE idlogin = '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' AND idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            sql &= " AND (pkjenis = 'A')"
            sql &= " AND pkurut = '" & JmlAktiva & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed processing total T balance sheet report. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
            End If

            sql = "  SELECT p.idlogin as idlogin, p.idmsmq as idmsmq, p.pkuserid as userid, a.pkurut as aurut, a.pktahun as atahun, a.pkbulan as abulan, a.pknorek as anorek, a.pknoreknama as anoreknama, a.pktipe as atipe, a.pkgd as agd, a.pkjenis as ajenis, a.pklevel as alevel, a.pklevel1 as alevel1, a.pklevel2 as alevel2, a.pklevel3 as alevel3, a.pklevel4 as alevel4, a.pklevel5 as as asaldolalu, a.pkdebitvariasi as adebitvariasi, a.pkkreditvariasi as akreditvariasi, a.pksaldovariasi as asaldovariasi, a.pkcustomtext1 as acustomtext1, a.pkcustomtext2 as acustomtext2, p.pkurut as purut, p.pktahun as ptahun, p.pkbulan as pbulan, p.pknorek as pnorek, p.pknoreknama as pnoreknama, p.pktipe as ptipe, p.pkgd as pgd, p.pkjenis as pjenis, p.pklevel as plevel, p.pklevel1 as plevel1, p.pklevel2 as plevel2, p.pklevel3 as plevel3, p.pklevel4 as plevel4, p.pklevel5 as plevel5, p.pkgddata as pgddata, p.pkleveldata as pleveldata, p.pkdebit as pdebit, p.pkkredit as pkredit, p.pksaldo as psaldo, p.pkdebitlalu as pdebitlalu, p.pkkreditlalu as pkreditlalu, p.pksaldolalu as psaldolalu, p.pkdebitvariasi as pdebitvariasi, p.pkkreditvariasi as pkreditvariasi, p.pksaldovariasi as psaldovariasi, p.pkcustomtext1 as pcustomtext1, p.pkcustomtext2 as pcustomtext2, p.pkcustomtext3 as pcustomtext3, p.pkcustomtext4 as pcustomtext4, p.pkcustomtext5 as pcustomtext5, p.pkcustomint1 as pcustomint1, p.pkcustomint2 as pcustomint2, p.pkcustomint3 as pcustomint3, p.pkcustomint4 as pcustomint4, p.pkcustomint5 as pcustomint5, p.pkcustomdbl1 as pcustomdbl1, p.pkcustomdbl2 as pcustomdbl2, p.pkcustomdbl3 as pcustomdbl3, p.pkcustomdbl4 as pcustomdbl4, p.pkcustomdbl5 as pcustomdbl5, p.pkcustomdate1 as pcustomdate1, p.pkcustomdate2 as pcustomdate2, p.pkcustomdate3 as pcustomdate3, p.pkcustomdate4 as pcustomdate4, p.pkcustomdate5 as pcustomdate5"
            sql &= " FROM m2r_posisi_keuangan a"
            sql &= " RIGHT JOIN m2r_posisi_keuangan p"

        End If

            result(2) = "Failed processing T balance sheet report. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'END OF PROSES GABUNGKAN AKTIVA DAN PASIVA =================================

        result(1) = 1

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_PosisiKeuanganTahun(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN POSISI KEUANGAN (NERACA)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------

selesai:

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_LabaRugiAkumulasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN LABAR RUGI

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tahun(0) As Integer, bulan(1) As Integer, level(2) As Integer, saldoNol(3) As Integer, pembagiNominal(4) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan,

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABEL TOTAL STEP REPORT
        Dim totalStep As Double = 9

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity

        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID

        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        End If

        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Integer

            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai

        'SET tahunLalu DAN bulanLalu
        'JIKA BULAN = 1 MAKA TAHUNLALU = TAHUN - 1 DAN BULANLALU = 12

        If bulan = 1 Then
            tahunLalu = tahun - 1 : bulanLalu = 12
        Else
            tahunLalu = tahun : bulanLalu = bulan - 1
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================

        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Posisi_Keuangan ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2r_Posisi_Keuangan
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Posisi_Keuangan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace trial balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Posisi_Keuangan -----------------------------


        'HITUNG REALISASI BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU ---------------------------------
        'HITUNG BULAN LALU
        stepKe = 1
        Dim rsHitung As String = M0_HitungRealisasi(idLogin & "★M0_HitungRealisasi★0△0△△△dd/MM/yyyy△dd/MM/yyyy H:mm:ss★" & userid & "★0★" & tahunLalu & sptField & bulanLalu)
        Dim rsHitungSplit() As String = rsHitung.Split(sptSubParam)
        'FORMAT KEMBALIAN = NamaFungsi△isSuccess△errMessage△errStep△idtransaksi★0△0△0△0△0★ ----> M0_HitungRealisasi△1△△0△0★0△0△0△0△0★
        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then
            'JIKA ISSUCCESS <> 1 MAKA KIRIM INFORMASI PROSES GAGAL
            result(2) = rsHitungSplit(2) & " : " & tahunLalu & " - " & bulanLalu : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG BULAN INI
        stepKe = 2
        rsHitung = M0_HitungRealisasi(idLogin & "★M0_HitungRealisasi★0△0△△△dd/MM/yyyy△dd/MM/yyyy H:mm:ss★" & userid & "★0★" & tahun & sptField & bulan)
        rsHitungSplit = rsHitung.Split(sptSubParam)
        'FORMAT KEMBALIAN = NamaFungsi△isSuccess△errMessage△errStep△idtransaksi★0△0△0△0△0★ ----> M0_HitungRealisasi△1△△0△0★0△0△0△0△0★
        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then

        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HITUNG REALISASI BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU --------------------------

        Dim urut As Double = 1, labaKotor(2, 3) As Double
        'SET DEFAULT NILAI PENDAPATAN DAN HPP
        labaKotor(0, 0) = 0 : labaKotor(0, 1) = 0 : labaKotor(0, 2) = 0 'PENDAPATAN
        labaKotor(1, 0) = 0 : labaKotor(1, 1) = 0 : labaKotor(1, 2) = 0 'HPP

        'PENDAPATAN ----------------------------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 3

        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        Dim sqlBulanIni As String = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) WHERE (c.ctipe = '11') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim sqlBulanLalu As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) WHERE (c.ctipe = '11') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
        sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        Dim dt As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'DEKLARASI UNTUK SIMPAN LEVEL INDUK
            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0'")
            End If

            'PERULANGAN BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU (M2r_Posisi_Keuangan)
            dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If

                'JIKA LEVEL AKUN < LEVEL PARAMETER, MAKA SIMPAN AKUN UNTUK DITAMPILKAN SEBAGAI SUBTOTAL
                If currLevel < level Then
                    'tanda kurung diawal sengaja dikosongi, untuk mengisi urutan saat insert ke tabel
                    'mapping :                                 idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                                                      pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strInduk(currLevel) = "'" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & String.Concat("Total ", FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama"))) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')"
                End If

                'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'jika currLevel = level, maka saldo ditampilkan. jika currlevel <> level maka saldo diisi 0
                'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                                                  pkdebit,                                                        pkkredit,                                                        pksaldo,                                                        pkdebitlalu,                                                        pkkreditlalu,                                                        pksaldolalu,                                                        pkdebitvariasi,                                                        pkkreditvariasi,                                                        pksaldovariasi,                                 idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")), 0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                'JIKA LEVEL = 1 MAKA AMBIL SALDO, SALDOLALU, SALDOVARIASI UNTUK HITUNG LABA KOTOR
                If currLevel = 1 Then
                    labaKotor(0, 0) = Double.Parse(dr1("pksaldo")) : labaKotor(0, 1) = Double.Parse(dr1("pksaldolalu")) : labaKotor(0, 2) = Double.Parse(dr1("pksaldovariasi"))
                End If

                'increament urutan
                urut += 1

                'SET PREVIOUS LEVEL
                prevLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))
            Next

            'INSERT AKUN INDUK YANG TERSISA
            For i = 1 To level
                If Len(strInduk(level - i)) > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                    'increament urutan
                    urut += 1
                End If
            Next

            'SIMPAN KE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Posisi_Keuangan(pkurut, idlogin, pktahun, pkbulan, pknorek, pknoreknama, pktipe, pkgd, pkjenis, pklevel, pklevel1, pklevel2, pklevel3, pklevel4, pklevel5, pkgddata, pkleveldata, pkdebit, pkkredit, pksaldo, pkdebitlalu, pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu, pkdebitvariasi, pkkreditvariasi, pksaldovariasi, idmsmq, pkuserid, pkcustomtext1, pkcustomtext2, pkcustomtext3, pkcustomtext4, pkcustomtext5, pkcustomint1, pkcustomint2, pkcustomint3, pkcustomint4, pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1, pkcustomdbl2, pkcustomdbl3, pkcustomdbl4, pkcustomdbl5, pkcustomdate1, pkcustomdate2, pkcustomdate3, pkcustomdate4, pkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing balance sheet report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If

        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF PENDAPATAN ---------------------------------------------------------


        'HPP -----------------------------------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 4
        strValue.Clear()

        'AMBIL LEVEL TERKECIL DARI AKUN HPP
        Dim dtHpp As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT MIN(clevel), cparent FROM m1_coa WHERE ctipe = 12", strCon)
        Dim levelInduk As Integer = 0, parentHpp As String = ""
        If dtHpp.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            levelInduk = Integer.Parse(dtHpp.Rows(0)(0)) : parentHpp = dtHpp.Rows(0)(1)
        Else
            result(2) = "CoA for COGS not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        'JIKA LEVEL TERKECIL DARI AKUN HPP > 1 DAN LEVEL < LEVEL INDUK, MAKA FILTER LEVEL -->  c.clevel <= levelInduk
        sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) WHERE (c.ctipe = '12') AND c.clevel <= '" & IIf(levelInduk > 1 And level < levelInduk, FixDouble(levelInduk), FixDouble(level)) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) WHERE (c.ctipe = '12') AND c.clevel <= '" & IIf(levelInduk > 1 And level < levelInduk, FixDouble(levelInduk), FixDouble(level)) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
        sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'DEKLARASI UNTUK SIMPAN LEVEL INDUK
            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            If levelInduk > 1 And level > 1 Then

                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))

                        'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,           pklevel,                     pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                 pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,           pkdebit,    pkkredit,     pksaldo, pkdebitlalu,pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu,pkdebitvariasi,pkkreditvariasi,pksaldovariasi,              idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & i & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("G") & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If
            End If

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0'")
            End If

            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = IIf(level = 1, 1, Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel")))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If

                'JIKA LEVEL AKUN < LEVEL PARAMETER, MAKA SIMPAN AKUN UNTUK DITAMPILKAN SEBAGAI SUBTOTAL
                If currLevel < level Then
                    'tanda kurung diawal sengaja dikosongi, untuk mengisi urutan saat insert ke tabel
                    'mapping :                                 idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                                                      pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strInduk(currLevel) = "'" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & String.Concat("Total ", FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama"))) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')"
                End If

                'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                                    pklevel,                            pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                                                 pkgddata,                   pkleveldata,                                                  pkdebit,                                                        pkkredit,                                                        pksaldo,                                                        pkdebitlalu,                                                        pkkreditlalu,                                                        pksaldolalu,                                                        pkdebitvariasi,                                                        pkkreditvariasi,                                                        pksaldovariasi,                                 idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & IIf(level = 1, 1, dr1("pklevel")) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & IIf(level = 1, "D", FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata"))) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")), 0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                'JIKA LEVEL = LEVEL INDUK MAKA AMBIL SALDO DAN SALDOLALU UNTUK HITUNG LABA KOTOR
                If currLevel = levelInduk Then
                    labaKotor(1, 0) = Double.Parse(dr1("pksaldo")) : labaKotor(1, 1) = Double.Parse(dr1("pksaldolalu")) : labaKotor(1, 2) = Double.Parse(dr1("pksaldovariasi"))

            For i = 1 To level

                    'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu

            If levelInduk > 1 And level > 1 Then
                Dim dtInduk As DataTable = AsDataTableFilterLimit(dt, "pklevel = '" & levelInduk & "'", "pknorek", , 1)
                If dtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    Dim dr1 As DataRow = dtInduk.Rows(0)
                    For i = 1 To levelInduk - 1

                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'jika currLevel = level, maka saldo ditampilkan. jika currlevel <> level maka saldo diisi 0

                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & String.Concat("Total ", FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama"))) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & i & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("G") & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then

            End If

        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'PENDAPATAN LAIN -----------------------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 6
        strValue.Clear()

        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) WHERE (c.ctipe = '14') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) WHERE (c.ctipe = '14') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0'")
            End If
