                'SALDO AKHIR ========================================
                'QUERY SALDO AKHIR
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT 0 as arid, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, c.kid as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, '" & uangFungsional & "' as armatauang, '" & kursFungsional & "' as arkurs, 'Saldo Akhir' as aruraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as  arcatatan, 0 as arsaldoawal, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as ardebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as arkredit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "',' ','00:00:00') as arinputtgl, 1 as arisfungsional FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT 0 as arid, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, c.kid as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, t.tmatauang as armatauang, t.tkurs as arkurs, 'Saldo Akhir' as aruraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as  arcatatan, 0 as arsaldoawal, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as ardebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as arkredit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "',' ','00:00:00') as arinputtgl, 0 as arisfungsional FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & idLogin & "' as idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, arsaldoawal, ardebit, arkredit, arsaldoakhir, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as aruserid FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAkhir = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                If dtSAkhir.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    'URUTAN SALDO AKHIR
                    Dim urutSAkhir As Double = 1

                    'INSERT SALDO AKHIR KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAkhir.Rows
                        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL, DEBIT, KREDIT DARI DTSAWAL
                        saldoAwal = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "arsaldoakhir", "armatauang = '" & dr1("armatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoDebit = Double.Parse(dr1("ardebit")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "ardebit", "armatauang = '" & dr1("armatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoKredit = Double.Parse(dr1("arkredit")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "arkredit", "armatauang = '" & dr1("armatauang") & "'", 0))

                        If saldoAwal <> 0 Or saldoDebit <> 0 Or saldoKredit <> 0 Or Double.Parse(FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoakhir"))) <> 0 Then
                            'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                            strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                            'MAPPING :         arnourut,                          idlogin,                             arid,                                             artgl,                              arsumber,                             arnotransaksi,                             arkontak,                             arkontakkode,                             arkontaknama,                             aralamat1,                             aralamat2,                             aralamat3,                             aralamat4,                             aralamat5,                             arnotelp1,                             arnotelp2,                             arnorek,                             armatauang,                             arkurs,                             aruraian,                             arcatatan,                      arsaldoawal,                         ardebit,                         arkredit,                           arsaldoakhir,                             artgljatuhtempo,                                   arstatuslunas,                                           artgllunas,                                              arinputtgl,                                         arisfungsional,                 arissaldoakhir                           idmsmq,                             aruserid,                   arcustomtext1,           arcustomtext2,           arcustomtext3,           arcustomtext4,           arcustomtext5,arcustomint1,arcustomint2,arcustomint3,arcustomint4,arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1,           arcustomdbl2,           arcustomdbl3,           arcustomdbl4,           arcustomdbl5,                                      arcustomdate1,                                      arcustomdate2,                                      arcustomdate3,                                      arcustomdate4,                                      arcustomdate5
                            strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("armatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoDebit) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoKredit) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("arstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("arinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("arisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                            'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                            urutSAkhir += 1

                            'INCREMENT NOURUT
                            urut += 1

                        Else
                            sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ar_Card WHERE idlogin = '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "' AND arkontak = '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "' AND idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "' AND aruserid = '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruserid")) & "'"
                            GoTo deleteSaldoNol

                        End If

                    Next
                End If
                'END OF SALDO AKHIR =================================


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_Ar_Card(arnourut, idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, arsaldoawal, ardebit, arkredit, arsaldoakhir, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing AR Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                    sql = ""
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================

deleteSaldoNol:
                'DELETE JIKA SALDO NOL SEMUA ========================
                If Len(sql) > 0 Then
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed deleting AR Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF DELETE JIKA SALDO NOL SEMUA =================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtCustomer.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress AR Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER KONTAK +++++++++++++++++++

        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER KONTAK -------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_ARSummary(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REKAP PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 10) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_card ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ar_card
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_ar_card WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AR Summary data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_card -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN KARTU PIUTANG, UNTUK FILTER TRANSAKSI ------------------------
        'sql = "SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE (smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode = 'PiutangUsaha')"
        sql = "SELECT c.krekpiutang as snilai FROM m1_contact c WHERE c.kkategori = 'C' AND c.krekpiutang <> '' GROUP BY c.krekpiutang ASC"
        Dim ftAkunAR As String = ""
        Dim dtAkunAR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dtAkunAR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'BUAT FILTER AKUN PIUTANG PADA TRASAKSI
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtAkunAR.Rows
                ftAkunAR += IIf(Len(ftAkunAR) > 0, " OR ", "")
                ftAkunAR += " t.tnorek = '" & dr1("snilai") & "' "
            Next
            If Len(ftAkunAR) > 0 Then ftAkunAR = " AND (" & ftAkunAR & ") "
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting CoA for AR Summary not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN KARTU PIUTANG, UNTUK FILTER TRANSAKSI -----------------


        'AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI CUSTOMER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING KARTU PIUTANG
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'C') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) " & ftAkunAR & " "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & customerCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & customerAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        End If
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtCustomer As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_ARSummarySplit(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REKAP PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 10) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_card ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ar_card
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_ar_card WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AR Summary data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_card -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN KARTU PIUTANG, UNTUK FILTER TRANSAKSI ------------------------
        sql = "SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE (smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode = 'PiutangUsaha')"
        Dim ftAkunAR As String = ""
        Dim dtAkunAR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dtAkunAR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'BUAT FILTER AKUN PIUTANG PADA TRASAKSI
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtAkunAR.Rows
                ftAkunAR += IIf(Len(ftAkunAR) > 0, " OR ", "")
                ftAkunAR += " t.tnorek = '" & dr1("snilai") & "' "
            Next
            If Len(ftAkunAR) > 0 Then ftAkunAR = " AND (" & ftAkunAR & ") "
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting CoA for AR Summary not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN KARTU PIUTANG, UNTUK FILTER TRANSAKSI -----------------


        'AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI CUSTOMER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING KARTU PIUTANG
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'C') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) " & ftAkunAR & " "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & customerCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & customerAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        End If
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtCustomer As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------


        'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ----------------------------------
        Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
        Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
        If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
        If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0, urut As Double = 1
        'END OF AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ---------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER KONTAK --------------------------------------------
        If dtCustomer.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSMutasiTemp As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsional As String = "", sqlValas As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""
            Dim idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtCustomer.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO AWAL =========================================
                'QUERY SALDO AWAL
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT '" & uangFungsional & "' as armatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as arsaldoawal FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl < '" & tglAwal & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT t.tmatauang as armatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as arsaldoawal FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl < '" & tglAwal & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT armatauang, arsaldoawal FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO AWAL ==================================


                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT '" & uangFungsional & "' as armatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as ardebit, IFNULL(SUM((CASE t.tsumber WHEN 'SR' THEN t.tkredit ELSE 0 END)),0) as arkredit, IFNULL(SUM((CASE t.tsumber WHEN 'PV' THEN t.tkredit ELSE 0 END)),0) as arpv FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT t.tmatauang as armatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as ardebit, IFNULL(SUM((CASE t.tsumber WHEN 'SR' THEN t.tkreditvalas ELSE 0 END)),0) as arkredit, IFNULL(SUM((CASE t.tsumber WHEN 'PV' THEN t.tkreditvalas ELSE 0 END)),0) as arpv FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT armatauang, ardebit, arkredit, arpv FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO MUTASI
                dtSMutasi = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO MUTASI ================================


                'SALDO AKHIR ========================================
                Dim saldoAwal As Double = 0, saldoDebit As Double = 0, saldoKredit As Double = 0, saldoPv As Double = 0

                'QUERY SALDO AKHIR
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT 0 as arid, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, c.kid as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, '" & uangFungsional & "' as armatauang, '" & kursFungsional & "' as arkurs, 'Saldo Akhir' as aruraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as  arcatatan, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "',' ','00:00:00') as arinputtgl, 1 as arisfungsional FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT 0 as arid, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, c.kid as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, t.tmatauang as armatauang, t.tkurs as arkurs, 'Saldo Akhir' as aruraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as  arcatatan, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "',' ','00:00:00') as arinputtgl, 0 as arisfungsional FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & idLogin & "' as idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, arsaldoakhir, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as aruserid FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAkhir = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                If dtSAkhir.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                    'INSERT SALDO AKHIR KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAkhir.Rows

                        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL DARI DTSAWAL DAN MUTASI DARI DTSMUTASI
                        saldoAwal = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "arsaldoawal", "armatauang = '" & dr1("armatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoDebit = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSMutasi, "ardebit", "armatauang = '" & dr1("armatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoKredit = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSMutasi, "arkredit", "armatauang = '" & dr1("armatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoPv = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSMutasi, "arpv", "armatauang = '" & dr1("armatauang") & "'", 0))

                        If saldoAwal <> 0 Or saldoDebit <> 0 Or saldoKredit <> 0 Or saldoPv <> 0 Or Double.Parse(FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoakhir"))) <> 0 Then
                            'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                            strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                            'MAPPING :         arnourut,                          idlogin,                             arid,                                             artgl,                              arsumber,                             arnotransaksi,                             arkontak,                             arkontakkode,                             arkontaknama,                             aralamat1,                             aralamat2,                             aralamat3,                             aralamat4,                             aralamat5,                             arnotelp1,                             arnotelp2,                             arnorek,                             armatauang,                             arkurs,                             aruraian,                             arcatatan,                      arsaldoawal,                         ardebit,                         arkredit,                           arsaldoakhir,                                             artgljatuhtempo,                   arstatuslunas,                                           artgllunas,                                              arinputtgl,                                         arisfungsional,        arissaldoakhir,                          idmsmq,                             aruserid,                   arcustomtext1,           arcustomtext2,           arcustomtext3,           arcustomtext4,           arcustomtext5,arcustomint1,arcustomint2,arcustomint3,arcustomint4,arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1,           arcustomdbl2,           arcustomdbl3,           arcustomdbl4,           arcustomdbl5,                                      arcustomdate1,                                      arcustomdate2,                                      arcustomdate3,                                      arcustomdate4,                                      arcustomdate5
                            strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("armatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoDebit) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoKredit) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("arstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("arinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("arisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(0) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(saldoPv) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                            'INCREMENT NOURUT
                            urut += 1
                        End If

                    Next
                End If
                'END OF SALDO AKHIR =================================


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_Ar_Card(arnourut, idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, arsaldoawal, ardebit, arkredit, arsaldoakhir, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing AR Summary : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress AR Summary : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER KONTAK +++++++++++++++++++

        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER KONTAK -------------------------------------


        'HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA REKAP ------------------------------------------------
        'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
        strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

        'AMBIL TOTAL REKAP DARI TABEL PEMBANTU SESUAI IDMSMQ
        sql = "SELECT idlogin, 0 as arid, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, 0 as arkontak, '' as arkontakkode, '' as arkontaknama, '' as aralamat1, '' as aralamat2, '' as aralamat3, '' as aralamat4, '' as aralamat5, '' as arnotelp1, '' as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, 'Total' as aruraian, 'Total' as arcatatan, SUM(arsaldoawal) as arsaldoawal, SUM(ardebit) as ardebit, SUM(arkredit) as arkredit, SUM(arsaldoakhir) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "', ' 00:00:00') as arinputtgl, arisfungsional, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, SUM(arcustomdbl1) as arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5 FROM m2r_ar_card ar WHERE idlogin = '" & idLogin & "' AND idmsmq = '" & idMsmq & "' GROUP BY armatauang ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"
        Dim dtTotal As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dtTotal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'URUTAN SALDO AKHIR
            Dim urutSAkhir As Double = 1

            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtTotal.Rows
                'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'MAPPING :         arnourut,                          idlogin,                             arid,                                             artgl,                              arsumber,                             arnotransaksi,                             arkontak,                             arkontakkode,                             arkontaknama,                             aralamat1,                             aralamat2,                             aralamat3,                             aralamat4,                             aralamat5,                             arnotelp1,                             arnotelp2,                             arnorek,                             armatauang,                             arkurs,                             aruraian,                             arcatatan,                             arsaldoawal,                             ardebit,                             arkredit,                             arsaldoakhir,                                             artgljatuhtempo,                   arstatuslunas,                                           artgllunas,                                              arinputtgl,                                         arisfungsional,                 arissaldoakhir,                          idmsmq,                             aruserid,                   arcustomtext1,           arcustomtext2,           arcustomtext3,           arcustomtext4,           arcustomtext5,arcustomint1,arcustomint2,arcustomint3,arcustomint4,arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1,           arcustomdbl2,           arcustomdbl3,           arcustomdbl4,           arcustomdbl5,                                      arcustomdate1,                                      arcustomdate2,                                      arcustomdate3,                                      arcustomdate4,                                      arcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("armatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("ardebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("arstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("arinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("arisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("arcustomdbl1")) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                urutSAkhir += 1

                'INCREMENT NOURUT
                urut += 1
            Next

            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ar_Card(arnourut, idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, arsaldoawal, ardebit, arkredit, arsaldoakhir, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing AR Summary : Total Row." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If

        End If
        'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA REKAP -----------------------------------------


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress AR Summary : Total Row." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_ARVoucher(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN VOUCHER PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES)
        '//SUMBER SI(SALES INVOICE), SR(SALES RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer, tglJTAwal(11) As String, tglJTAkhir(12) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, tglJTAwal, tglJTAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", tglJTAwal As String = "", tglJTAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 13) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(10)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(10)
        End If

        'tglJTAwal(11) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(11)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(11)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(11))
            End If
        Else
            tglJTAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglJTAkhir(12) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(12)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(12)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else

                sqlFungsionalSR = " SELECT sr.srid as arid, sr.srtgl as artgl, sr.srsumber as arsumber, sr.srnotransaksi as arnotransaksi, sr.srcustomer as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, s.snilai as arnorek, '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as armatauang, '" & FixDouble(kursFungsional) & "' as arkurs, sr.sruraian as aruraian, sr.srcatatan as arcatatan, (sr.srtotaltransaksi * sr.srkurs * -1) as artotal, SUM((CASE sr.srmatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL((pvd.jmlbayar * -1),0) ELSE IFNULL((pvd.jmlbayarvalas * -1),0) * sr.srkurs END)) as arbayar, (sr.srtotaltransaksi * sr.srkurs * -1) - SUM((CASE sr.srmatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL((pvd.jmlbayar * -1),0) ELSE IFNULL((pvd.jmlbayarvalas * -1),0) * sr.srkurs END)) as arsisa, sr.srtgljatuhtempo as artgljatuhtempo, sr.srstatuslunas as arstatuslunas, sr.srtgllunas as artgllunas, sr.srinputtgl as arinputtgl, 1 as arisfungsional, 0 as arissaldoakhir, sr.srbagianpenjualan as arsalesman, c2.kkode as arsalesmankode, c2.knama as arsalesmannama "
