                sqlJadi = " SELECT armatauang, arsaldoawal FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO AWAL ==================================


                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT '" & uangFungsional & "' as armatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as ardebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as arkredit FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT t.tmatauang as armatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as ardebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as arkredit FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT armatauang, ardebit, arkredit FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO MUTASI
                dtSMutasi = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO MUTASI ================================


                'SALDO AKHIR ========================================
                Dim saldoAwal As Double = 0, saldoDebit As Double = 0, saldoKredit As Double = 0

                'QUERY SALDO AKHIR
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT 0 as arid, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, c.kid as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, '" & uangFungsional & "' as armatauang, '" & kursFungsional & "' as arkurs, 'Saldo Akhir' as aruraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as  arcatatan, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "',' ','00:00:00') as arinputtgl, 1 as arisfungsional FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT 0 as arid, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, c.kid as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, t.tmatauang as armatauang, t.tkurs as arkurs, 'Saldo Akhir' as aruraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as  arcatatan, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "',' ','00:00:00') as arinputtgl, 0 as arisfungsional FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & idLogin & "' as idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, arsaldoakhir, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as aruserid FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAkhir = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                If dtSAkhir.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                    'INSERT SALDO AKHIR KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAkhir.Rows
                        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL DARI DTSAWAL DAN MUTASI DARI DTSMUTASI
                        saldoAwal = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "arsaldoawal", "armatauang = '" & dr1("armatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoDebit = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSMutasi, "ardebit", "armatauang = '" & dr1("armatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoKredit = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSMutasi, "arkredit", "armatauang = '" & dr1("armatauang") & "'", 0))

                        If saldoAwal <> 0 Or saldoDebit <> 0 Or saldoKredit <> 0 Or Double.Parse(FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoakhir"))) <> 0 Then
                            'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                            strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                            'MAPPING :         arnourut,                          idlogin,                             arid,                                             artgl,                              arsumber,                             arnotransaksi,                             arkontak,                             arkontakkode,                             arkontaknama,                             aralamat1,                             aralamat2,                             aralamat3,                             aralamat4,                             aralamat5,                             arnotelp1,                             arnotelp2,                             arnorek,                             armatauang,                             arkurs,                             aruraian,                             arcatatan,                      arsaldoawal,                         ardebit,                         arkredit,                           arsaldoakhir,                                             artgljatuhtempo,                   arstatuslunas,                                           artgllunas,                                              arinputtgl,                                         arisfungsional,        arissaldoakhir,                          idmsmq,                             aruserid,                   arcustomtext1,           arcustomtext2,           arcustomtext3,           arcustomtext4,           arcustomtext5,arcustomint1,arcustomint2,arcustomint3,arcustomint4,arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1,           arcustomdbl2,           arcustomdbl3,           arcustomdbl4,           arcustomdbl5,                                      arcustomdate1,                                      arcustomdate2,                                      arcustomdate3,                                      arcustomdate4,                                      arcustomdate5
                            strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("armatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoDebit) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoKredit) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("arstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("arinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("arisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(0) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                            'INCREMENT NOURUT
                            urut += 1
                        End If

                    Next
                End If
                'END OF SALDO AKHIR =================================


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_Ip_Card(arnourut, idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, arsaldoawal, ardebit, arkredit, arsaldoakhir, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing Incoming Payment Summary : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Incoming Payment Summary : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER KONTAK +++++++++++++++++++

        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER KONTAK -------------------------------------


        'HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA REKAP ------------------------------------------------
        'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
        strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

        'AMBIL TOTAL REKAP DARI TABEL PEMBANTU SESUAI IDMSMQ
        sql = "SELECT idlogin, 0 as arid, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, 0 as arkontak, '' as arkontakkode, '' as arkontaknama, '' as aralamat1, '' as aralamat2, '' as aralamat3, '' as aralamat4, '' as aralamat5, '' as arnotelp1, '' as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, 'Total' as aruraian, 'Total' as arcatatan, SUM(arsaldoawal) as arsaldoawal, SUM(ardebit) as ardebit, SUM(arkredit) as arkredit, SUM(arsaldoakhir) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "', ' 00:00:00') as arinputtgl, arisfungsional, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5 FROM M2r_Ip_Card ar WHERE idlogin = '" & idLogin & "' AND idmsmq = '" & idMsmq & "' GROUP BY armatauang ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"
        Dim dtTotal As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dtTotal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'URUTAN SALDO AKHIR
            Dim urutSAkhir As Double = 1

            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtTotal.Rows
                'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'MAPPING :         arnourut,                          idlogin,                             arid,                                             artgl,                              arsumber,                             arnotransaksi,                             arkontak,                             arkontakkode,                             arkontaknama,                             aralamat1,                             aralamat2,                             aralamat3,                             aralamat4,                             aralamat5,                             arnotelp1,                             arnotelp2,                             arnorek,                             armatauang,                             arkurs,                             aruraian,                             arcatatan,                             arsaldoawal,                             ardebit,                             arkredit,                             arsaldoakhir,                                             artgljatuhtempo,                   arstatuslunas,                                           artgllunas,                                              arinputtgl,                                         arisfungsional,                 arissaldoakhir,                          idmsmq,                             aruserid,                   arcustomtext1,           arcustomtext2,           arcustomtext3,           arcustomtext4,           arcustomtext5,arcustomint1,arcustomint2,arcustomint3,arcustomint4,arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1,           arcustomdbl2,           arcustomdbl3,           arcustomdbl4,           arcustomdbl5,                                      arcustomdate1,                                      arcustomdate2,                                      arcustomdate3,                                      arcustomdate4,                                      arcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("armatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("ardebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("arstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("arinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("arisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                urutSAkhir += 1

                'INCREMENT NOURUT
                urut += 1
            Next

            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ip_Card(arnourut, idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, arsaldoawal, ardebit, arkredit, arsaldoakhir, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Incoming Payment Summary : Total Row." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
            'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================

        End If
        'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA REKAP -----------------------------------------


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Incoming Payment Summary : Total Row." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_IPVoucher(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN VOUCHER TERIMA PEMBAYARAN
        '//SUMBER IP(INCOMING PAYMENT)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 11) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(10)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(10)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ip_Voucher ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ip_Voucher
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ip_Voucher WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Incoming Payment Voucher data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ip_Voucher -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI CUSTOMER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING VOUCHER TERIMA PEMBAYARAN
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "
        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'C') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND (t.tsumber = 'IP') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & customerCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & customerAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        End If
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtCustomer As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN Voucher PER KONTAK --------------------------------------------
        If dtCustomer.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING
            Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
            Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
            If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
            If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If

            Dim dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSSubtotal As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsionalAS As String = "", sqlValasAS As String = ""
            Dim sqlFungsionalPV As String = "", sqlValasPV As String = ""
            Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSubtotal As String = ""
            Dim urut As Double = 1, urutSAkhir As Double = 1, idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG Voucher PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtCustomer.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL
                'AS FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsionalAS = "  SELECT ip.ipid as arid, ip.iptgl as artgl, ip.ipsumber as arsumber, ip.ipnotransaksi as arnotransaksi, ip.ipkontak as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, ip.ipnorek as arnorek, '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as armatauang, '" & FixDouble(kursFungsional) & "' as arkurs, ip.ipuraian as aruraian, ip.ipcatatan as arcatatan, (ip.ipjumlah) as artotal, (CASE ip.ipmatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(asp.jumlah), 0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(asp.jumlahvalas), 0) * ip.ipkurs END) as arbayar, (ip.ipjumlah) - (CASE ip.ipmatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(asp.jumlah), 0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(asp.jumlahvalas), 0) * ip.ipkurs END) as arsisa, ip.iptgljatuhtempo as artgljatuhtempo, ip.ipstatusbayar as arstatuslunas, ip.iptgllunas as artgllunas, ip.ipinputtgl as arinputtgl, 1 as arisfungsional, 0 as arissaldoakhir "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " FROM m5_as m5as "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " JOIN m5_as_pay asp ON m5as.asid = asp.idas AND m5as.asstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND m5as.astgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " RIGHT JOIN m5_ip ip ON asp.idip = ip.ipid "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON ip.ipkontak = c.kid "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " WHERE ip.ipstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " AND ip.ipkontak = '" & FixDouble(idkontak) & "' "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " AND ip.iptgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " AND (ip.ipstatusbayar <> 2 OR (ip.ipstatusbayar = 2 AND ip.iptgllunas > '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')) "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN ip.ipmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE ip.ipmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) "
                'statusJT, 0 = belum, 1 = sudah, 2 = semua
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " AND (CASE '" & FixDouble(statusJT) & "' WHEN 0 THEN ip.iptgljatuhtempo > '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' WHEN 1 THEN ip.iptgljatuhtempo <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' ELSE ip.iptgljatuhtempo LIKE '%' END) "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " GROUP BY ip.ipid "
                sqlFungsionalAS &= " ORDER BY ip.iptgl, ip.ipinputtgl, ip.ipid "

                'AS VALAS

            sqlSubtotal &= " FROM M2r_Ip_Voucher ar "
            sqlSubtotal &= " WHERE ar.idlogin = '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' "
            sqlSubtotal &= " AND ar.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' "
            sqlSubtotal &= " AND ar.arissaldoakhir = '" & FixDouble(0) & "' "
            sqlSubtotal &= " GROUP BY ar.armatauang "
            sqlSubtotal &= " ORDER BY ar.arisfungsional DESC, ar.armatauang "

            'AMBIL SALDO SUBTOTAL
            dtSSubtotal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSubtotal, strCon)
            If dtSSubtotal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                'URUTAN SALDO AKHIR
                urutSAkhir = 1

                'INSERT SALDO SUBTOTAL KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                'SORTING DATA TERLEBIH DAHULU
                dtSSubtotal = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtSSubtotal, "", "arisfungsional DESC, armatauang")
                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSSubtotal.Rows
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'MAPPING :         arnourut,                     idlogin,                           arid,                                             artgl,                              arsumber,                             arnotransaksi,                             arkontak,                             arkontakkode,                             arkontaknama,                             aralamat1,                             aralamat2,                             aralamat3,                             aralamat4,                             aralamat5,                             arnotelp1,                             arnotelp2,                             arnorek,                             armatauang,                             arkurs,                             aruraian,                             arcatatan,                             artotal,                             arbayar,                             arsisa,                                             artgljatuhtempo,                   arstatuslunas,                                           artgllunas,                                              arinputtgl,                                         arisfungsional,                 arissaldoakhir,                     idmsmq,                    aruserid,                 arcustomtext1,           arcustomtext2,           arcustomtext3,           arcustomtext4,           arcustomtext5,arcustomint1,arcustomint2,arcustomint3,arcustomint4,arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1,           arcustomdbl2,           arcustomdbl3,           arcustomdbl4,           arcustomdbl5,                                      arcustomdate1,                                      arcustomdate2,                                      arcustomdate3,                                      arcustomdate4,                                      arcustomdate5
                    strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("armatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("artotal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arbayar")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arsisa")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("arstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("arinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("arisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                    urutSAkhir += 1

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT
                    urut += 1
                Next
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL TOTAL VOUCHER SEMUA KONTAK ==============


            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            'SALDO TOTAL
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ip_Voucher(arnourut, idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, artotal, arbayar, arsisa, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Total Incoming Payment Voucher." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
            'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Total Incoming Payment Voucher." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================
            'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++


        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN Voucher PER KONTAK -------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_IPList(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN DAFTAR TERIMA PEMBAYARAN
        '//SUMBER IP(INCOMING PAYMENT)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 11) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(10)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(10)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ip_List ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ip_List
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ip_List WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Incoming Payment List data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ip_List -----------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA IP ---------------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlAS As String = "", sqlPV As String = "", sqlGabung As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""

        'AMBIL DATA DARI AS ###########################
        'MAPPING                                          idlogin,            ipid,                     ipnotransaksi,             iptgl,                ipkontak,             ipkontakkode,             ipkontaknama,                       iptgljatuhtempo,                ipuraian,                 ipcatatan,                  ipmatauang,              ipkurs,                ipjumlah,                     ipjumlahvalas,                     ipjumlahbayar,                          ipjumlahbayarvalas,                                   ipsisa,                                             ipsisavalas,                     ipstatusbayar,                  iptgllunas,                  pvsumber,              pvid,                      pviddetail,                       pvnotransaksi,               pvtgl,                  pvcustomer,             pvcustomerkode,             pvcustomernama,                  pvuraian,                   pvcatatan,                    pvmatauang,                pvkurs,               pvjumlahbayar,                    pvjumlahbayarvalas,                                idmsmq,                                ipuserid,       ipcustomtext1,      ipcustomtext2,       ipcustomtext3,       ipcustomtext4,       ipcustomtext5,      ipcustomint1,      ipcustomint2,      ipcustomint3,      ipcustomint4,      ipcustomint5,      ipcustomdbl1,      ipcustomdbl2,      ipcustomdbl3,      ipcustomdbl4,      ipcustomdbl5,                 ipcustomdate1,                 ipcustomdate2,                 ipcustomdate3,                 ipcustomdate4,                 ipcustomdate5
        sqlAS = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, ip.ipid as ipid, ip.ipnotransaksi as ipnotransaksi, ip.iptgl as iptgl, ip.ipkontak as ipkontak, c1.kkode as ipkontakkode, c1.knama as ipkontaknama, ip.iptgljatuhtempo as iptgljatuhtempo, ip.ipuraian as ipuraian, ip.ipcatatan as ipcatatan, ip.ipmatauang as ipmatauang, ip.ipkurs as ipkurs, ip.ipjumlah as ipjumlah, ip.ipjumlahvalas as ipjumlahvalas, ip.ipjumlahbayar as ipjumlahbayar, ip.ipjumlahbayarvalas as ipjumlahbayarvalas, ip.ipjumlah - ip.ipjumlahbayar as ipsisa, ip.ipjumlahvalas - ip.ipjumlahbayarvalas as ipsisavalas, ip.ipstatusbayar as ipstatusbayar, ip.iptgllunas as iptgllunas, m5as.assumber as pvsumber, m5as.asid as pvid, asp.idascarabayar as pviddetail, m5as.asnotransaksi as pvnotransaksi, m5as.astgl as pvtgl, m5as.askontak as pvcustomer, c3.kkode as pvcustomerkode, c3.knama as pvcustomernama, m5as.asuraian as pvuraian, m5as.ascatatan as pvcatatan, m5as.asmatauang as pvmatauang, m5as.askurs as pvkurs, asp.jumlah as pvjumlahbayar, asp.jumlahvalas as pvjumlahbayarvalas, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as ipuserid, '' as ipcustomtext1, ''as ipcustomtext2, '' as ipcustomtext3, '' as ipcustomtext4, '' as ipcustomtext5, 0 as ipcustomint1, 0 as ipcustomint2, 0 as ipcustomint3, 0 as ipcustomint4, 0 as ipcustomint5, 0 as ipcustomdbl1, 0 as ipcustomdbl2, 0 as ipcustomdbl3, 0 as ipcustomdbl4, 0 as ipcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as ipcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as ipcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as ipcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as ipcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as ipcustomdate5"
        sqlAS &= " FROM m5_as m5as"
        sqlAS &= " JOIN m5_as_pay asp ON m5as.asid = asp.idas AND m5as.asstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7)"
        sqlAS &= " RIGHT JOIN m5_ip ip ON asp.idip = ip.ipid"
        sqlAS &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c1 ON ip.ipkontak = c1.kid"
        sqlAS &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"
        sqlAS &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c3 ON m5as.askontak= c3.kid"
        sqlAS &= " WHERE"
        sqlAS &= " ip.ipstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"

        'FILTER TANGGAL
        sqlAS &= " AND (ip.iptgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"

        'FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sqlAS &= " AND (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')"

        'FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sqlAS &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCat) & "')"

        'FILTER CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sqlAS &= " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sqlAS &= " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sqlAS &= " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sqlAS &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCat) & "') "

        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sqlAS &= " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & FixQuotes(salesman) & "') "

        'FILTER UANG
        If Len(matauang) > 0 Then sqlAS &= " AND (ip.ipmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "')"

        'FILTER STATUS JT
        'statusJT, 0 = belum, 1 = sudah, 2 = semua
        If statusJT = 0 Then
            sqlAS &= " AND (ip.iptgljatuhtempo > DATE(NOW()))"
        ElseIf statusJT = 1 Then
            sqlAS &= " AND (ip.iptgljatuhtempo <= DATE(NOW()))"
        End If


        'AMBIL DATA DARI PV ###########################
        'MAPPING                                          idlogin,            ipid,                     ipnotransaksi,             iptgl,                ipkontak,             ipkontakkode,             ipkontaknama,                       iptgljatuhtempo,                ipuraian,                 ipcatatan,                  ipmatauang,              ipkurs,                ipjumlah,                     ipjumlahvalas,                     ipjumlahbayar,                          ipjumlahbayarvalas,                                   ipsisa,                                             ipsisavalas,                     ipstatusbayar,                  iptgllunas,                pvsumber,            pvid,                   pviddetail,                     pvnotransaksi,             pvtgl,                  pvcustomer,             pvcustomerkode,             pvcustomernama,                pvuraian,                 pvcatatan,                  pvmatauang,              pvkurs,                 pvjumlahbayar,                      pvjumlahbayarvalas,                                idmsmq,                                ipuserid,       ipcustomtext1,      ipcustomtext2,       ipcustomtext3,       ipcustomtext4,       ipcustomtext5,      ipcustomint1,      ipcustomint2,      ipcustomint3,      ipcustomint4,      ipcustomint5,      ipcustomdbl1,      ipcustomdbl2,      ipcustomdbl3,      ipcustomdbl4,      ipcustomdbl5,                 ipcustomdate1,                 ipcustomdate2,                 ipcustomdate3,                 ipcustomdate4,                 ipcustomdate5
        sqlPV = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, ip.ipid as ipid, ip.ipnotransaksi as ipnotransaksi, ip.iptgl as iptgl, ip.ipkontak as ipkontak, c1.kkode as ipkontakkode, c1.knama as ipkontaknama, ip.iptgljatuhtempo as iptgljatuhtempo, ip.ipuraian as ipuraian, ip.ipcatatan as ipcatatan, ip.ipmatauang as ipmatauang, ip.ipkurs as ipkurs, ip.ipjumlah as ipjumlah, ip.ipjumlahvalas as ipjumlahvalas, ip.ipjumlahbayar as ipjumlahbayar, ip.ipjumlahbayarvalas as ipjumlahbayarvalas, ip.ipjumlah - ip.ipjumlahbayar as ipsisa, ip.ipjumlahvalas - ip.ipjumlahbayarvalas as ipsisavalas, ip.ipstatusbayar as ipstatusbayar, ip.iptgllunas as iptgllunas, pv.pvsumber as pvsumber, pv.pvid as pvid, pvd.idpvdetail as pviddetail, pv.pvnotransaksi as pvnotransaksi, pv.pvtgl as pvtgl, pv.pvcustomer as pvcustomer, c3.kkode as pvcustomerkode, c3.knama as pvcustomernama, pv.pvuraian as pvuraian, pv.pvcatatan as pvcatatan, pv.pvmatauang as pvmatauang, pv.pvkurs as pvkurs, pvd.jmlbayar as pvjumlahbayar, pvd.jmlbayarvalas as pvjumlahbayarvalas, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as ipuserid, '' as ipcustomtext1, ''as ipcustomtext2, '' as ipcustomtext3, '' as ipcustomtext4, '' as ipcustomtext5, 0 as ipcustomint1, 0 as ipcustomint2, 0 as ipcustomint3, 0 as ipcustomint4, 0 as ipcustomint5, 0 as ipcustomdbl1, 0 as ipcustomdbl2, 0 as ipcustomdbl3, 0 as ipcustomdbl4, 0 as ipcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as ipcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as ipcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as ipcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as ipcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as ipcustomdate5"
        sqlPV &= " FROM m5_pv pv"
        sqlPV &= " JOIN m5_pv_detail pvd ON pv.pvid = pvd.idpv AND pv.pvstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
        sqlPV &= " JOIN m5_ip ip ON pvd.idtransaksi = ip.ipid AND pvd.sumber = ip.ipsumber"
        sqlPV &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c1 ON ip.ipkontak = c1.kid"
        sqlPV &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"
        sqlPV &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c3 ON pv.pvcustomer = c3.kid"
        sqlPV &= " WHERE"
        sqlPV &= " ip.ipstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"

        'FILTER TANGGAL
        sqlPV &= " AND (ip.iptgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"

        'FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sqlPV &= " AND (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')"

        'FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sqlPV &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCat) & "')"

        'FILTER CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sqlPV &= " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sqlPV &= " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sqlPV &= " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sqlPV &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCat) & "') "

        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sqlPV &= " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & FixQuotes(salesman) & "') "

        'FILTER UANG
        If Len(matauang) > 0 Then sqlPV &= " AND (ip.ipmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "')"

        'FILTER STATUS JT
        'statusJT, 0 = belum, 1 = sudah, 2 = semua
        If statusJT = 0 Then
            sqlPV &= " AND (ip.iptgljatuhtempo > DATE(NOW()))"
        ElseIf statusJT = 1 Then
            sqlPV &= " AND (ip.iptgljatuhtempo <= DATE(NOW()))"
        End If


        'GABUNGKAN DATA DARI AS DAN PV ################
        sqlGabung = "  SELECT * FROM "
        sqlGabung &= " ((" & sqlAS & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlPV & ")) as ip"
        sqlGabung &= " GROUP BY ip.ipid, ip.pvsumber, ip.pvid, ip.pviddetail"
        sqlGabung &= " ORDER BY ip.iptgl, ip.ipnotransaksi, ip.ipid, ip.pvtgl, ip.pvsumber, ip.pvnotransaksi, ip.pvid, ip.pviddetail"


        'INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU #####################
        sqlJadi = " INSERT INTO m2r_ip_list (" & sqlGabung & ")"
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA IP --------------------------------------------


        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Incoming Payment List." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
        progressPersen = 100

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Total Incoming Payment List." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_Bp_CostCenterSummary(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REKAP BUKU PEMBANTU COST CENTER

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama

        'Detail

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------

        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, 
        'costCenterAwal, costCenterAkhir, area, kontakCategory,
