        'salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang, orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = ""
        Dim costCenterAwal As String = "", costCenterAkhir As String = "", area As String = "", kontakCategory As String = ""
        Dim customerCategory As String = "", supplierCategory As String = "", kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCategory As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = ""


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'costCenterAwal(4) As String
        costCenterAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'costCenterAkhir(5) As String
        costCenterAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'area(6) As String
        area = dataDetail(6)

        'kontakCategory(7) As String
        kontakCategory = dataDetail(7)

        'customerCategory(8) As String
        customerCategory = dataDetail(8)

        'supplierCategory(9) As String
        supplierCategory = dataDetail(9)

        'kontakAwal(10) As String
        kontakAwal = dataDetail(10)

        'kontakAkhir(11) As String
        kontakAkhir = dataDetail(11)

        'salesmanCategory(12) As String
        salesmanCategory = dataDetail(12)

        'salesman(13) As String 
        salesman = dataDetail(13)

        'matauang(14) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(14)

        'orderBy(15) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(15).ToString <> "bpcostcenter" And dataDetail(15).ToString <> "bpcostcenternama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Bp_Card ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Bp_Card
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Bp_Card WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace BP Summary data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Bp_Card -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL NOREK SESUAI FILTER -----------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT t.tnorek, coa.cnama"
        sql &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON t.tcostcenter = cc.cckode"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"
        sql &= " WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"

        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'FILTER COSTCENTER
        If Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 And Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tcostcenter BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tcostcenter >= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tcostcenter <= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')"

        'FILTER CONTACT CATEGORY
        If Len(kontakCategory) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.kkategori = '" & FixQuotes(kontakCategory) & "')"

        'FILTER CUSTOMER CATEGORY
        If Len(customerCategory) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCategory) & "')"

        'FILTER SUPPLIER CATEGORY
        If Len(supplierCategory) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')"

        'FILTER CONTACT
        If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tkontak BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tkontak >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tkontak <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCategory) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCategory) & "') "

        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkode = '" & FixQuotes(salesman) & "') "

        'FILTER MATAUANG
        If Len(matauang) > 0 Then sql += " AND (t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') "

        sql &= " GROUP BY t.tnorek"
        sql &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek"

        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF  AMBIL NOREK SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------


        'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ----------------------------------
        Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
        Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
        If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
        If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0, urut As Double = 1
        'END OF AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ---------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER NOREK --------------------------------------------
        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSMutasiTemp As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsional As String = "", sqlValas As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""
            Dim norek As String = "", dtTotal As New DataTable

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER NOREK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'SET NOREK
                norek = dr("tnorek")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO AWAL =========================================
                'QUERY SALDO AWAL FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsional = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as bpmatauang, (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) as bpsaldoawal, cc.cckode as bpcostcenter, cc.ccnama as bpcostcenternama"
                sqlFungsional &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
                sqlFungsional &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'costCenterAwal(4) As String
        costCenterAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'costCenterAkhir(5) As String
        costCenterAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'area(6) As String
        area = dataDetail(6)

        'kontakCategory(7) As String
        kontakCategory = dataDetail(7)

        'customerCategory(8) As String
        customerCategory = dataDetail(8)

        'supplierCategory(9) As String
        supplierCategory = dataDetail(9)

        'kontakAwal(10) As String
        kontakAwal = dataDetail(10)

        'kontakAkhir(11) As String
        kontakAkhir = dataDetail(11)

        'salesmanCategory(12) As String
        salesmanCategory = dataDetail(12)

        'salesman(13) As String 
        salesman = dataDetail(13)

        'matauang(14) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(14)

        'orderBy(15) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(15).ToString <> "bpcostcenter" And dataDetail(15).ToString <> "bpcostcenternama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Bp_Card ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Bp_Card
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Bp_Card WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Cost Center Ledger data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Bp_Card -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL NOREK SESUAI FILTER -----------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT t.tnorek, coa.cnama, t.tcostcenter, cc.ccnama"
        sql &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON t.tcostcenter = cc.cckode"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"
        sql &= " WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"

        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'FILTER COSTCENTER
        If Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 And Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tcostcenter BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tcostcenter >= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tcostcenter <= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')"

        'FILTER CONTACT CATEGORY
        If Len(kontakCategory) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.kkategori = '" & FixQuotes(kontakCategory) & "')"

        'FILTER CUSTOMER CATEGORY
        If Len(customerCategory) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCategory) & "')"

        'FILTER SUPPLIER CATEGORY
        If Len(supplierCategory) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')"

        'FILTER CONTACT
        If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tkontak BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tkontak >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tkontak <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCategory) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCategory) & "') "

        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkode = '" & FixQuotes(salesman) & "') "

        'FILTER MATAUANG
        If Len(matauang) > 0 Then sql += " AND (t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') "

        sql &= " GROUP BY t.tnorek, t.tcostcenter"
        sql &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek, " & IIf(orderBy = "bpcostcenter", "cc.cckode", "cc.ccnama") & ""

        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF  AMBIL NOREK SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------


        'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ----------------------------------
        Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
        Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
        If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
        If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0, urut As Double = 1
        'END OF AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ---------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER NOREK --------------------------------------------
        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim norek As String = "", costcenter As String = "", dtTotal As New DataTable, dtUangValas As New DataTable

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER NOREK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'SET NOREK, COSTCENTER
                norek = dr("tnorek") : costcenter = dr("tcostcenter")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO AWAL =========================================
                'QUERY SALDO AWAL FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsional = "  SELECT 0 as bpid, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as bptgl, '' as bpsumber, '' as bpnotransaksi, 0 as bpkontak, '' as bpkontakkode, '' as bpkontaknama, '' as bpalamat1, '' as bpalamat2, '' as bpalamat3, '' as bpalamat4, '' as bpalamat5, '' as bpnotelp1, '' as bpnotelp2, coa.cnomor as bpnorek, coa.cnama as bpnoreknama, cc.cckode as bpcostcenter, cc.ccnama as bpcostcenternama, '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as bpmatauang, '" & FixDouble(kursFungsional) & "' as bpkurs, 'Saldo Awal' as bpuraian, 'Saldo Awal' as bpcatatan, 0 as bpsaldoawal, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as bpdebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as bpkredit, (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) as bpsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as bptgljatuhtempo, 0 as bpstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as bptgllunas, CONCAT('" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "',' ','00:00:00') as bpinputtgl, 1 as bpisfungsional"
                sqlFungsional &= " FROM m1_coa coa"
                sqlFungsional &= " JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON coa.cnomor = t.tnorek"
                sqlFungsional &= " AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"

                sqlFungsional &= " AND t.tcostcenter = '" & FixQuotes(costcenter) & "'"

                sqlFungsional &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
                sqlFungsional &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"

                Filter = ""

                If Len(area) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')")
                'FILTER CONTACT CATEGORY

                'FILTER CUSTOMER CATEGORY
                If Len(customerCategory) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCategory) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCategory) & "')")
                'FILTER SUPPLIER CATEGORY
                If Len(supplierCategory) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')")
                'FILTER CONTACT

                    IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (t.tkontak BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (t.tkontak BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')")
                ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
                    IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (t.tkontak >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (t.tkontak >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')")
                ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (t.tkontak <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (t.tkontak <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')")
                End If

                sqlFungsional &= Filter
                sqlFungsional &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek, t.tcostcenter"

        bpstatuslunas,                                           bptgllunas,                                              bpinputtgl,                                         bpisfungsional,          bpissaldoakhir,                        idmsmq,                             bpuserid,                   bpcustomtext1,           bpcustomtext2,           bpcustomtext3,           bpcustomtext4,           bpcustomtext5,bpcustomint1,bpcustomint2,bpcustomint3,bpcustomint4,bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1,           bpcustomdbl2,           bpcustomdbl3,           bpcustomdbl4,           bpcustomdbl5,                                      bpcustomdate1,                                      bpcustomdate2,                                      bpcustomdate3,                                      bpcustomdate4,                                      bpcustomdate5

                ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then

                If Len(area) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')")
                'FILTER CONTACT CATEGORY
                If Len(kontakCategory) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c1.kkategori = '" & FixQuotes(kontakCategory) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (c1.kkategori = '" & FixQuotes(kontakCategory) & "')")
                'FILTER CUSTOMER CATEGORY
                If Len(customerCategory) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCategory) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCategory) & "')")
                'FILTER SUPPLIER CATEGORY
                If Len(supplierCategory) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')")
                'FILTER CONTACT
                If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (t.tkontak BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (t.tkontak BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')")
                ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
                    IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (t.tkontak >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (t.tkontak >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')")
                ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (t.tkontak <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (t.tkontak <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')")
                End If
                'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
                If Len(salesmanCategory) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCategory) & "') ", Filter = Filter & " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCategory) & "') ")
                'FILTER SALESMAN
                If Len(salesman) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c2.kkode = '" & FixQuotes(salesman) & "') ", Filter = Filter & " AND (c2.kkode = '" & FixQuotes(salesman) & "') ")
                sqlValas &= Filter
                sqlValas &= " GROUP BY t.tnorek, t.tcostcenter, t.tmatauang"
                sqlValas &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek, t.tcostcenter"

                sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & idLogin & "' as idlogin, bpid, bptgl, bpsumber, bpnotransaksi, bpkontak, bpkontakkode, bpkontaknama, bpalamat1, bpalamat2, bpalamat3, bpalamat4, bpalamat5, bpnotelp1, bpnotelp2, bpnorek, bpnoreknama, bpcostcenter, bpcostcenternama, bpmatauang, bpkurs, bpuraian, bpcatatan, bpsaldoawal, bpdebit, bpkredit, bpsaldoakhir, bptgljatuhtempo, bpstatuslunas, bptgllunas, bpinputtgl, bpisfungsional, '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as bpuserid"
                sqlJadi &= " FROM ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi &= " ORDER BY " & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ", bpmatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, bpmatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAkhir = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                If dtSAkhir.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    'URUTAN SALDO AKHIR
                    Dim urutSAkhir As Double = 1

                    'INSERT SALDO AKHIR KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAkhir.Rows
                        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL DARI DTSAWAL DAN MUTASI DARI DTSMUTASI
                        saldoAwal = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "bpsaldoakhir", "bpcostcenter = '" & dr1("bpcostcenter") & "' AND bpmatauang = '" & dr1("bpmatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoDebit = Double.Parse(dr1("bpdebit")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "bpdebit", "bpcostcenter = '" & dr1("bpcostcenter") & "' AND bpmatauang = '" & dr1("bpmatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoKredit = Double.Parse(dr1("bpkredit")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "bpkredit", "bpcostcenter = '" & dr1("bpcostcenter") & "' AND bpmatauang = '" & dr1("bpmatauang") & "'", 0))

                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'MAPPING :         bpnourut,                          idlogin,                             bpid,                                             bptgl,                              bpsumber,                             bpnotransaksi,                             bpkontak,                             bpkontakkode,                             bpkontaknama,                             bpalamat1,                             bpalamat2,                             bpalamat3,                             bpalamat4,                             bpalamat5,                             bpnotelp1,                             bpnotelp2,                             bpnorek,                             bpnoreknama,                             bpcostcenter,                             bpcostcenternama,                             bpmatauang,                             bpkurs,                             bpuraian,                             bpcatatan,                      bpsaldoawal,                         bpdebit,                         bpkredit,                           bpsaldoakhir,                                             bptgljatuhtempo,                   bpstatuslunas,                                           bptgllunas,                                              bpinputtgl,                                         bpisfungsional,                 bpissaldoakhir,                        idmsmq,                             bpuserid,                   bpcustomtext1,           bpcustomtext2,           bpcustomtext3,           bpcustomtext4,           bpcustomtext5,bpcustomint1,bpcustomint2,bpcustomint3,bpcustomint4,bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1,           bpcustomdbl2,           bpcustomdbl3,           bpcustomdbl4,           bpcustomdbl5,                                      bpcustomdate1,                                      bpcustomdate2,                                      bpcustomdate3,                                      bpcustomdate4,                                      bpcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("bptgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpalamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpalamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpalamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpalamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpalamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpnoreknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpcostcenter")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpcostcenternama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpmatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoDebit) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoKredit) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("bpsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("bptgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("bpstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("bptgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("bpinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("bpisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                        'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                        urutSAkhir += 1

                        'INCREMENT NOURUT
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If
                'END OF SALDO AKHIR =================================


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_Bp_Card(bpnourut, idlogin, bpid, bptgl, bpsumber, bpnotransaksi, bpkontak, bpkontakkode, bpkontaknama, bpalamat1, bpalamat2, bpalamat3, bpalamat4, bpalamat5, bpnotelp1, bpnotelp2, bpnorek, bpnoreknama, bpcostcenter, bpcostcenternama, bpmatauang, bpkurs, bpuraian, bpcatatan, bpsaldoawal, bpdebit, bpkredit, bpsaldoakhir, bptgljatuhtempo, bpstatuslunas, bptgllunas, bpinputtgl, bpisfungsional, bpissaldoakhir, idmsmq, bpuserid, bpcustomtext1, bpcustomtext2, bpcustomtext3, bpcustomtext4, bpcustomtext5, bpcustomint1, bpcustomint2, bpcustomint3, bpcustomint4, bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1, bpcustomdbl2, bpcustomdbl3, bpcustomdbl4, bpcustomdbl5, bpcustomdate1, bpcustomdate2, bpcustomdate3, bpcustomdate4, bpcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing Cost Center Ledger : " & norek : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtNorek.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Cost Center Ledger : " & norek : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER NOREK +++++++++++++++++++

        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER NOREK -------------------------------------


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_PersediaanPerGudang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN PERSEDIAAN PER GUDANG

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 5) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)


        'orderBy(4) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(4)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(4)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        'Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " AND i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Persediaan ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Persediaan
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Persediaan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Inventory Balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Persediaan -----------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlSAMasuk As String = "", sqlSAKeluar As String = "", sqlSMMasuk As String = "", sqlSMKeluar As String = ""
        Dim sqlGabung As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""

        'QUERY SALDO AWAL MASUK ###########################
        sqlSAMasuk = "  SELECT i.bkategori as kategori, ic.icnama as kategorinama, it.gudang as gudang, w.wnama as gudangnama, SUM(it.jmlbarang * it.hpp) as samasuk, 0 as sakeluar, 0 as masuk, 0 as keluar"
        sqlSAMasuk &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it"
        sqlSAMasuk &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid " & Filter
        sqlSAMasuk &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
        sqlSAMasuk &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
        sqlSAMasuk &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse w ON it.gudang = w.wkode"
        sqlSAMasuk &= " WHERE it.jenismutasi = 1"
        sqlSAMasuk &= " AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        sqlSAMasuk &= " GROUP BY i.bkategori, it.gudang"

        'QUERY SALDO AWAL KELUAR ##########################
        sqlSAKeluar = "  SELECT i.bkategori as kategori, ic.icnama as kategorinama, it.gudang as gudang, w.wnama as gudangnama, 0 as samasuk, SUM(it.jmlbarang * it.hpp) as sakeluar, 0 as masuk, 0 as keluar"
        sqlSAKeluar &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it"
        sqlSAKeluar &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid " & Filter
        sqlSAKeluar &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
        sqlSAKeluar &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
        sqlSAKeluar &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse w ON it.gudang = w.wkode"
        sqlSAKeluar &= " WHERE it.jenismutasi = 0"
        sqlSAKeluar &= " AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        sqlSAKeluar &= " GROUP BY i.bkategori, it.gudang"

        'QUERY SALDO MUTASI MASUK #########################
        sqlSMMasuk = "  SELECT i.bkategori as kategori, ic.icnama as kategorinama, it.gudang as gudang, w.wnama as gudangnama, 0 as samasuk, 0 as sakeluar, SUM(it.jmlbarang * it.hpp) as masuk, 0 as keluar"
        sqlSMMasuk &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it"
        sqlSMMasuk &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid " & Filter
        sqlSMMasuk &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
        sqlSMMasuk &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
        sqlSMMasuk &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse w ON it.gudang = w.wkode"
        sqlSMMasuk &= " WHERE it.jenismutasi = 1"
        sqlSMMasuk &= " AND it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        sqlSMMasuk &= " GROUP BY i.bkategori, it.gudang"

        'QUERY SALDO MUTASI KELUAR ########################
        sqlSMKeluar = "  SELECT i.bkategori as kategori, ic.icnama as kategorinama, it.gudang as gudang, w.wnama as gudangnama, 0 as samasuk, 0 as sakeluar, 0 as masuk, SUM(it.jmlbarang * it.hpp) as keluar"
        sqlSMKeluar &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it"
        sqlSMKeluar &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid " & Filter
        sqlSMKeluar &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
        sqlSMKeluar &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
        sqlSMKeluar &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse w ON it.gudang = w.wkode"
        sqlSMKeluar &= " WHERE it.jenismutasi = 0"
        sqlSMKeluar &= " AND it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        sqlSMKeluar &= " GROUP BY i.bkategori, it.gudang"

        'GABUNGKAN SQL SEMUA SALDO ########################
        'MAPPING :                                            idlogin,               pkategori,                   pkategorinama,             pgudang,                 pgudangnama,                                     psaldoawal,                 pmasuk,                  pkeluar,                                                                    psaldoakhir,                                idmsmq,                                puserid,       pcustomtext1,      pcustomtext2,       pcustomtext3,       pcustomtext4,       pcustomtext5,      pcustomint1,      pcustomint2,      pcustomint3,      pcustomint4,      pcustomint5,      pcustomdbl1,      pcustomdbl2,      pcustomdbl3,      pcustomdbl4,      pcustomdbl5,                 pcustomdate1,                 pcustomdate2,                 pcustomdate3,                 pcustomdate4,                 pcustomdate5
        sqlGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, p.kategori as pkategori, p.kategorinama as pkategorinama, p.gudang as pgudang, p.gudangnama as pgudangnama, SUM(p.samasuk) - SUM(p.sakeluar) as psaldoawal, SUM(p.masuk) as pmasuk, SUM(p.keluar) as pkeluar, SUM(p.samasuk) - SUM(p.sakeluar) + SUM(p.masuk) - SUM(p.keluar) as psaldoakhir, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as puserid, '' as pcustomtext1, ''as pcustomtext2, '' as pcustomtext3, '' as pcustomtext4, '' as pcustomtext5, 0 as pcustomint1, 0 as pcustomint2, 0 as pcustomint3, 0 as pcustomint4, 0 as pcustomint5, 0 as pcustomdbl1, 0 as pcustomdbl2, 0 as pcustomdbl3, 0 as pcustomdbl4, 0 as pcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as pcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as pcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as pcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as pcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as pcustomdate5"
        sqlGabung &= " FROM ((" & sqlSAMasuk & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlSAKeluar & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlSMMasuk & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlSMKeluar & ")) as p"
        sqlGabung &= " GROUP BY p.kategori, p.gudang"

        'INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU #########################
        sqlJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Persediaan (" & sqlGabung & ")"
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------


        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
        progressPersen = 100

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_MutasiStok(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN MUTASI STOK

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String
        'gudangAwal(4) As String, gudangAkhir(5) As String, orderBy(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'gudangAwal, gudangAkhir, orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim gudangAwal As String = "", gudangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 7) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)


        'gudangAwal(4) As String
        gudangAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'gudangAkhir(5) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'orderBy(6) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(6)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(6).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(6).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(6)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Mutasi_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Mutasi_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Mutasi_Stok WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Mutasi_Stok -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama, it.gudang"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang"

        'FILTER GUDANG
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL DAN GUDANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= GUDANG AWAL
            Filter &= " it.gudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= GUDANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.gudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid, it.gudang"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ", it.gudang"

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = "", gudang As String = "", dtSA As New DataTable, saldoawal As Double = 0
            Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", sqlSAGabung As String = "", sqlSMGabung As String = ""
            Dim sqlSAJadi As String = "", sqlSMJadi As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                idbarang = dr1("bid") : gudang = dr1("gudang")

                'QUERY SALDO AWAL ###########################
                sqlSA = "  SELECT IFNULL(it.id,0) as msid, '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' as msgudang, w.wnama as msgudangnama, i.bid as msidbarang, i.bkode as mskodebarang, i.btipe as mstipebarang, i.bnama as msnamabarang, i.bsatuan as mssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as mstgl, '' as mssumber, '' as msnotransaksi, 0 as mskontak,  '' as mskontakkode,  '' as mskontaknama, 'Saldo Awal' as msuraian, 'Saldo Awal' as mscatatan, 'Saldo Awal' as mscatatandetail, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as msjmlmasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as msjmlkeluar, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as msinputtgl, it.customtext1 as mscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as mscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as mscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as mscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as mscustomtext5, 0 as mscustomint1, 0 as mscustomint2, 0 as mscustomint3, 0 as mscustomint4, 0 as mscustomint5, 0 as mscustomdbl1, 0 as mscustomdbl2, 0 as mscustomdbl3, 0 as mscustomdbl4, 0 as mscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as mscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as mscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as mscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as mscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as mscustomdate5"
                sqlSA &= " FROM m1_item i"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse w ON w.wkode = '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.gudang = w.wkode AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "'"

                sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 1 as msnourut, ms.msid, ms.msgudang, ms.msgudangnama, ms.msidbarang, ms.mskodebarang, ms.mstipebarang, ms.msnamabarang, ms.mssatuanbarang, ms.mstgl, ms.mssumber, ms.msnotransaksi, ms.mskontak,  ms.mskontakkode,  ms.mskontaknama,  ms.msuraian, ms.mscatatan, ms.mscatatandetail, 0 as msjmlmasuk, 0 as msjmlkeluar, SUM(ms.msjmlmasuk - ms.msjmlkeluar) as mssaldo, ms.msinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as msuserid, ms.mscustomtext1, ms.mscustomtext2, ms.mscustomtext3, ms.mscustomtext4, ms.mscustomtext5, ms.mscustomint1, ms.mscustomint2, ms.mscustomint3, ms.mscustomint4, ms.mscustomint5, ms.mscustomdbl1, ms.mscustomdbl2, ms.mscustomdbl3, ms.mscustomdbl4, ms.mscustomdbl5, ms.mscustomdate1, ms.mscustomdate2, ms.mscustomdate3, ms.mscustomdate4, ms.mscustomdate5"
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM ( " & sqlSA & " ) as ms"
                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY ms.msgudang, ms.msidbarang"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                dtSA = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSAGabung, strCon)
                If dtSA.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    saldoawal = Double.Parse(dtSA.Rows(0)("mssaldo"))
                Else
                    saldoawal = 0
                End If

                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI #########################
                sqlSM = "  SELECT it.id as msid, it.gudang as msgudang, w.wnama as msgudangnama, it.idbarang as msidbarang, i.bkode as mskodebarang, it.tipebarang as mstipebarang, it.namabarang as msnamabarang, it.satuanbarang as mssatuanbarang, it.tgl as mstgl, it.sumber as mssumber, it.notransaksi as msnotransaksi, it.kontak as mskontak,  c.kkode as mskontakkode, c.knama as mskontaknama,  it.uraian as msuraian, it.catatan as mscatatan, it.catatandetail as mscatatandetail, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as msjmlmasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as msjmlkeluar, it.inputtgl as msinputtgl, it.customtext1 as mscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as mscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as mscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as mscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as mscustomtext5, it.customint1 as mscustomint1, it.customint2 as mscustomint2, it.customint3 as mscustomint3, it.customint4 as mscustomint4, it.customint5 as mscustomint5, it.customdbl1 as mscustomdbl1, it.customdbl2 as mscustomdbl2, it.customdbl3 as mscustomdbl3, it.customdbl4 as mscustomdbl4, it.customdbl5 as mscustomdbl5, it.customdate1 as mscustomdate1, it.customdate2 as mscustomdate2, it.customdate3 as mscustomdate3, it.customdate4 as mscustomdate4, it.customdate5 as mscustomdate5"
                sqlSM &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it"
                sqlSM &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid"
                sqlSM &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON it.gudang = w.wkode"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON it.kontak = c.kid"
                sqlSM &= " WHERE it.gudang = '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "'"
                sqlSM &= " AND it.idbarang = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlSM &= " AND it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixDouble(tglAkhir) & "'"
                sqlSM &= " ORDER BY it.tgl, it.inputtgl, it.id"

                sqlSMGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as msnourut, ms.msid, ms.msgudang, ms.msgudangnama, ms.msidbarang, ms.mskodebarang, ms.mstipebarang, ms.msnamabarang, ms.mssatuanbarang, ms.mstgl, ms.mssumber, ms.msnotransaksi, ms.mskontak,  ms.mskontakkode,  ms.mskontaknama,  ms.msuraian, ms.mscatatan, ms.mscatatandetail, ms.msjmlmasuk, ms.msjmlkeluar, @saldo := @saldo + ms.msjmlmasuk - ms.msjmlkeluar as mssaldo, ms.msinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as msuserid, ms.mscustomtext1, ms.mscustomtext2, ms.mscustomtext3, ms.mscustomtext4, ms.mscustomtext5, ms.mscustomint1, ms.mscustomint2, ms.mscustomint3, ms.mscustomint4, ms.mscustomint5, ms.mscustomdbl1, ms.mscustomdbl2, ms.mscustomdbl3, ms.mscustomdbl4, ms.mscustomdbl5, ms.mscustomdate1, ms.mscustomdate2, ms.mscustomdate3, ms.mscustomdate4, ms.mscustomdate5"
                sqlSMGabung &= " FROM ( " & sqlSM & " ) as ms"
                sqlSMGabung &= " , (SELECT @nourut := 1) AS variableInit1"
                sqlSMGabung &= " , (SELECT @saldo := " & FixDouble(saldoawal) & ") AS variableInit2"

                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Mutasi_Stok (" & sqlSAGabung & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    'result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                    result(2) = sqlSAGabung : GoTo selesai
                End If

                'SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSMJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Mutasi_Stok (" & sqlSMGabung & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSMJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    'result(2) = "Failed proccessing Data Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                    result(2) = sqlSMGabung : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
