                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report 'Nothing' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_KartuStok_Average(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN KARTU STOK AVERAGE

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 5) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)


        'orderBy(4) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(4)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(4)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kartu_Stok WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang"
        sql &= " WHERE i.bhpp = 'R'"

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        'Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" AND", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = ""
            Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", sqlSMGabung As String = ""
            Dim sqlSAJadi As String = "", sqlSMJadi As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                idbarang = dr1("bid")

                'QUERY SALDO AWAL ###########################
                sqlSA = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 1 as ksnourut,IFNULL(it.id, 0) as ksid, '' as ksgudang, '' as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as kstgl, 'Saldo Awal' as kssumber, 'Saldo Awal' as ksnotransaksi, 0 as kskontak, '' as kskontakkode, '' as kskontaknama, 'Saldo Awal' as ksuraian, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatan, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatandetail, s.snilai as ksmatauang, '1' as kskurs, 0 as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as ksjmlmasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as kshargamasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as ksnilaimasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as ksjmlkeluar, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as kshargakeluar, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as ksnilaikeluar, IFNULL(it.saldojml, 0) as kssaldojml, IFNULL(it.saldohpp, 0) as kssaldohpp, IFNULL(it.saldonilai, 0) as kssaldonilai, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as kspostingtgl, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"
                sqlSA &= " FROM m1_item i"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional'"
                sqlSA &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " ORDER BY it.tgl DESC, it.inputtgl DESC, it.customint10 DESC, it.jenismutasi DESC, it.idutama DESC, it.iddetail DESC"
                sqlSA &= " LIMIT 1"


                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI #########################
                sqlSM = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, it.id as ksid, it.gudang as ksgudang, w.wnama as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, it.tgl as kstgl, it.sumber as kssumber, it.notransaksi as ksnotransaksi, it.kontak as kskontak, c.kkode as kskontakkode, c.knama as kskontaknama, it.uraian as ksuraian, it.catatan as kscatatan, it.catatandetail as kscatatandetail,  it.matauang as ksmatauang, it.kurs as kskurs, it.harga as ksharga, it.diskon as ksdiskon, it.jmldiskon as ksjmldiskon, it.jenismutasi as ksjenismutasi, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as ksjmlmasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as kshargamasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as ksnilaimasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as ksjmlkeluar, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as kshargakeluar, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as ksnilaikeluar, it.saldojml as kssaldojml, it.saldohpp as kssaldohpp, it.saldonilai as kssaldonilai, it.postingtgl as kspostingtgl, it.inputtgl as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"
                sqlSM &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it"
                sqlSM &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid"
                sqlSM &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse w ON it.gudang = w.wkode"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON it.kontak = c.kid"
                sqlSM &= " WHERE it.idbarang = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlSM &= " AND it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
                sqlSM &= " ORDER BY it.tgl ASC, it.inputtgl ASC, it.customint10 ASC, it.jenismutasi ASC, it.idutama ASC, it.iddetail ASC"

                sqlSMGabung = "  SELECT ks.idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as ksnourut, ks.ksid, ks.ksgudang, ks.ksgudangnama, ks.kskategoribarang, ks.kskategoribarangnama, ks.ksidbarang, ks.kskodebarang, ks.kstipebarang, ks.ksnamabarang, ks.kssatuanbarang, ks.kstgl, ks.kssumber, ks.ksnotransaksi, ks.kskontak, ks.kskontakkode, ks.kskontaknama, ks.ksuraian, ks.kscatatan, ks.kscatatandetail, ks.ksmatauang, ks.kskurs, ks.ksharga, ks.ksdiskon, ks.ksjmldiskon, ks.ksjenismutasi, ks.ksjmlmasuk, ks.kshargamasuk, ks.ksnilaimasuk, ks.ksjmlkeluar, ks.kshargakeluar, ks.ksnilaikeluar, ks.kssaldojml, ks.kssaldohpp, ks.kssaldonilai, ks.kspostingtgl, ks.ksinputtgl, ks.idmsmq, ks.ksuserid, ks.kscustomtext1, ks.kscustomtext2, ks.kscustomtext3, ks.kscustomtext4, ks.kscustomtext5, ks.kscustomint1, ks.kscustomint2, ks.kscustomint3, ks.kscustomint4, ks.kscustomint5, ks.kscustomdbl1, ks.kscustomdbl2, ks.kscustomdbl3, ks.kscustomdbl4, ks.kscustomdbl5, ks.kscustomdate1, ks.kscustomdate2, ks.kscustomdate3, ks.kscustomdate4, ks.kscustomdate5"
                sqlSMGabung &= " FROM ( " & sqlSM & " ) as ks"
                sqlSMGabung &= " , (SELECT @nourut := 1) AS variableInit1"


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Kartu_Stok (" & sqlSA & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If

                'SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSMJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Kartu_Stok (" & sqlSMGabung & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSMJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_KartuStok_Fifo1(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN KARTU STOK FIFO

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, katbarangAwal(5) As String, katbarangAkhir(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'orderBy, katbarangAwal, katbarangAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""
        Dim katbarangAwal As String = "", katbarangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 7) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)


        'orderBy(4) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(4)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(4)
        End If

        'katbarangAwal(5) As String
        katbarangAwal = dataDetail(5)

        'katbarangAkhir(6) As String
        katbarangAkhir = dataDetail(6)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kartu_Stok WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang"
        sql &= " WHERE i.bhpp = 'F'"

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 Or Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
                Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
                Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
                Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
            End If
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KATEGORI)
        If Len(katbarangAwal) > 0 Or Len(katbarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            If Len(katbarangAwal) > 0 And Len(katbarangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
                Filter &= " i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAkhir) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(katbarangAwal) > 0 Then
                'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
                Filter &= " i.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAwal) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(katbarangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
                Filter &= " i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAkhir) & "'"
            End If
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" AND", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i.bkategori, i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = ""
            Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", sqlSMGabung As String = ""
            Dim sqlSAJadi As String = "", sqlSMJadi As String = ""
            Dim dtSaldo As New DataTable, vSaldoNilai As Double = 0, vSaldoJml As Double = 0

            Dim idTbMin As String = 0, idTbMax As String = 0
            Dim sqlIdTb As String = ""
            Dim dtIdTb As New DataTable

            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                idbarang = dr1("bid")

                'AMBIL ID TRANSAKSI BARANG TERBESAR < TANGGAL AWAL
                sqlIdTb = "  SELECT it.id "
                sqlIdTb &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it "
                sqlIdTb &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "
                sqlIdTb &= " WHERE it.idbarang = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "' AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' "
                sqlIdTb &= " ORDER BY it.id DESC "
                sqlIdTb &= " LIMIT 1 "
                dtIdTb = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlIdTb, strCon)
                If dtIdTb.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    If Len(dtIdTb.Rows(0)("id")) > 0 Then
                        idTbMin = Double.Parse(dtIdTb.Rows(0)("id"))
                    Else
                        idTbMin = 0
                    End If
                End If


                'AMBIL ID TRANSAKSI BARANG TERBESAR <= TANGGAL AKHIR
                sqlIdTb = "  SELECT it.id "
                sqlIdTb &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it "
                sqlIdTb &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "
                sqlIdTb &= " WHERE it.idbarang = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "' AND it.tgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlIdTb &= " ORDER BY it.id DESC "
                sqlIdTb &= " LIMIT 1 "
                dtIdTb = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlIdTb, strCon)
                If dtIdTb.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    If Len(dtIdTb.Rows(0)("id")) > 0 Then
                        idTbMax = Double.Parse(dtIdTb.Rows(0)("id"))
                    Else
                        idTbMax = 0
                    End If
                End If


                'QUERY SALDO AWAL ###########################
                'sqlSA = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 1 as ksnourut,IFNULL(it.id, 0) as ksid, '' as ksgudang, '' as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as kstgl, 'Saldo Awal' as kssumber, 'Saldo Awal' as ksnotransaksi, 0 as kskontak, '' as kskontakkode, '' as kskontaknama, 'Saldo Awal' as ksuraian, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatan, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatandetail, s.snilai as ksmatauang, '1' as kskurs, 0 as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as ksjmlmasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as kshargamasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as ksnilaimasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as ksjmlkeluar, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as kshargakeluar, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as ksnilaikeluar, IFNULL(it.saldojml, 0) as kssaldojml, IFNULL(it.saldohpp, 0) as kssaldohpp, IFNULL(it.saldonilai, 0) as kssaldonilai, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as kspostingtgl, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"
                'sqlSA = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 1 as ksnourut,IFNULL(it.id, 0) as ksid, '' as ksgudang, '' as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as kstgl, 'Saldo Awal' as kssumber, 'Saldo Awal' as ksnotransaksi, 0 as kskontak, '' as kskontakkode, '' as kskontaknama, 'Saldo Awal' as ksuraian, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatan, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatandetail, s.snilai as ksmatauang, '1' as kskurs, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as ksjmlmasuk, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kshargamasuk, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0) as ksnilaimasuk, 0 as ksjmlkeluar, 0 as kshargakeluar, 0 as ksnilaikeluar, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldohpp, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldonilai, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as kspostingtgl, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"
                sqlSA = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 1 as ksnourut,IFNULL(it.id, 0) as ksid, '' as ksgudang, '' as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as kstgl, 'Saldo Awal' as kssumber, 'Saldo Awal' as ksnotransaksi, 0 as kskontak, '' as kskontakkode, '' as kskontaknama, 'Saldo Awal' as ksuraian, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatan, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatandetail, s.snilai as ksmatauang, '1' as kskurs, (CASE IFNULL(it.saldojml,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(it.saldohpp,0) END) as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, (CASE IFNULL(it.saldojml,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(it.saldojml,0) END) as ksjmlmasuk, (CASE IFNULL(it.saldojml,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(it.saldohpp,0) END) as kshargamasuk, (CASE IFNULL(it.saldojml,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(it.saldonilai,0) END) as ksnilaimasuk, 0 as ksjmlkeluar, 0 as kshargakeluar, 0 as ksnilaikeluar, (CASE IFNULL(it.saldojml,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(it.saldojml,0) END) as kssaldojml, (CASE IFNULL(it.saldojml,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(it.saldohpp,0) END) as kssaldohpp, (CASE IFNULL(it.saldojml,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(it.saldonilai,0) END) as kssaldonilai, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as kspostingtgl, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5 "
                sqlSA &= " FROM m1_item i"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.id = " & FixDouble(idTbMin) & ""
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional'"
                sqlSA &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " ORDER BY it.id DESC"
                sqlSA &= " LIMIT 1"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                dtSaldo = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSA, strCon)
                If dtSaldo.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    If Len(dtSaldo.Rows(0)("kssaldonilai")) > 0 Then
                        'SALDO NILAI
                        vSaldoNilai = Double.Parse(dtSaldo.Rows(0)("kssaldonilai"))
                        'SALDO JUMLAH
                        vSaldoJml = Double.Parse(dtSaldo.Rows(0)("kssaldojml"))
                    Else
                        vSaldoNilai = 0 : vSaldoJml = 0
                    End If
                Else
                    vSaldoNilai = 0 : vSaldoJml = 0
                End If


                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI #########################
                sqlSM = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, it.id as ksid, it.gudang as ksgudang, w.wnama as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, it.tgl as kstgl, it.sumber as kssumber, it.notransaksi as ksnotransaksi, it.kontak as kskontak, c.kkode as kskontakkode, c.knama as kskontaknama, it.uraian as ksuraian, it.catatan as kscatatan, it.catatandetail as kscatatandetail,  it.matauang as ksmatauang, it.kurs as kskurs, it.harga as ksharga, it.diskon as ksdiskon, it.jmldiskon as ksjmldiskon, it.jenismutasi as ksjenismutasi, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as ksjmlmasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as kshargamasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as ksnilaimasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as ksjmlkeluar, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as kshargakeluar, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as ksnilaikeluar, it.saldojml as kssaldojml, it.saldohpp as kssaldohpp, it.saldonilai as kssaldonilai, it.postingtgl as kspostingtgl, it.inputtgl as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"
                sqlSM &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it"
                sqlSM &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid"
                sqlSM &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse w ON it.gudang = w.wkode"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON it.kontak = c.kid"
                sqlSM &= " WHERE it.idbarang = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlSM &= " AND it.id > " & FixDouble(idTbMin) & " AND it.id <= " & FixDouble(idTbMax) & ""
                sqlSM &= " ORDER BY it.id ASC"

                'sqlSMGabung = "  SELECT ks.idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as ksnourut, ks.ksid, ks.ksgudang, ks.ksgudangnama, ks.kskategoribarang, ks.kskategoribarangnama, ks.ksidbarang, ks.kskodebarang, ks.kstipebarang, ks.ksnamabarang, ks.kssatuanbarang, ks.kstgl, ks.kssumber, ks.ksnotransaksi, ks.kskontak, ks.kskontakkode, ks.kskontaknama, ks.ksuraian, ks.kscatatan, ks.kscatatandetail, ks.ksmatauang, ks.kskurs, ks.ksharga, ks.ksdiskon, ks.ksjmldiskon, ks.ksjenismutasi, ks.ksjmlmasuk, ks.kshargamasuk, ks.ksnilaimasuk, ks.ksjmlkeluar, ks.kshargakeluar, ks.ksnilaikeluar, ks.kssaldojml, ks.kssaldohpp, ks.kssaldonilai, ks.kspostingtgl, ks.ksinputtgl, ks.idmsmq, ks.ksuserid, ks.kscustomtext1, ks.kscustomtext2, ks.kscustomtext3, ks.kscustomtext4, ks.kscustomtext5, ks.kscustomint1, ks.kscustomint2, ks.kscustomint3, ks.kscustomint4, ks.kscustomint5, ks.kscustomdbl1, ks.kscustomdbl2, ks.kscustomdbl3, ks.kscustomdbl4, ks.kscustomdbl5, ks.kscustomdate1, ks.kscustomdate2, ks.kscustomdate3, ks.kscustomdate4, ks.kscustomdate5"
                'sqlSMGabung = "  SELECT ks.idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as ksnourut, ks.ksid, ks.ksgudang, ks.ksgudangnama, ks.kskategoribarang, ks.kskategoribarangnama, ks.ksidbarang, ks.kskodebarang, ks.kstipebarang, ks.ksnamabarang, ks.kssatuanbarang, ks.kstgl, ks.kssumber, ks.ksnotransaksi, ks.kskontak, ks.kskontakkode, ks.kskontaknama, ks.ksuraian, ks.kscatatan, ks.kscatatandetail, ks.ksmatauang, ks.kskurs, ks.ksharga, ks.ksdiskon, ks.ksjmldiskon, ks.ksjenismutasi, ks.ksjmlmasuk, ks.kshargamasuk, ks.ksnilaimasuk, ks.ksjmlkeluar, ks.kshargakeluar, ks.ksnilaikeluar, ks.kssaldojml, (CASE ks.kssaldojml WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (@saldonilai + ks.ksnilaimasuk - ks.ksnilaikeluar) / ks.kssaldojml END) as kssaldohpp, @saldonilai := (@saldonilai + ks.ksnilaimasuk - ks.ksnilaikeluar) as kssaldonilai, ks.kspostingtgl, ks.ksinputtgl, ks.idmsmq, ks.ksuserid, ks.kscustomtext1, ks.kscustomtext2, ks.kscustomtext3, ks.kscustomtext4, ks.kscustomtext5, ks.kscustomint1, ks.kscustomint2, ks.kscustomint3, ks.kscustomint4, ks.kscustomint5, ks.kscustomdbl1, ks.kscustomdbl2, ks.kscustomdbl3, ks.kscustomdbl4, ks.kscustomdbl5, ks.kscustomdate1, ks.kscustomdate2, ks.kscustomdate3, ks.kscustomdate4, ks.kscustomdate5"
                sqlSMGabung = "  SELECT ks.idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as ksnourut, ks.ksid, ks.ksgudang, ks.ksgudangnama, ks.kskategoribarang, ks.kskategoribarangnama, ks.ksidbarang, ks.kskodebarang, ks.kstipebarang, ks.ksnamabarang, ks.kssatuanbarang, ks.kstgl, ks.kssumber, ks.ksnotransaksi, ks.kskontak, ks.kskontakkode, ks.kskontaknama, ks.ksuraian, ks.kscatatan, ks.kscatatandetail, ks.ksmatauang, ks.kskurs, ks.ksharga, ks.ksdiskon, ks.ksjmldiskon, ks.ksjenismutasi, ks.ksjmlmasuk, ks.kshargamasuk, ks.ksnilaimasuk, ks.ksjmlkeluar, ks.kshargakeluar, ks.ksnilaikeluar, @saldojml := (@saldojml + ks.ksjmlmasuk - ks.ksjmlkeluar) as kssaldojml, (CASE CAST(@saldojml as DECIMAL(65,9)) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (@saldonilai + ks.ksnilaimasuk - ks.ksnilaikeluar) / CAST(@saldojml as DECIMAL(65,9)) END) as kssaldohpp, @saldonilai := (@saldonilai + ks.ksnilaimasuk - ks.ksnilaikeluar) as kssaldonilai, ks.kspostingtgl, ks.ksinputtgl, ks.idmsmq, ks.ksuserid, ks.kscustomtext1, ks.kscustomtext2, ks.kscustomtext3, ks.kscustomtext4, ks.kscustomtext5, ks.kscustomint1, ks.kscustomint2, ks.kscustomint3, ks.kscustomint4, ks.kscustomint5, ks.kscustomdbl1, ks.kscustomdbl2, ks.kscustomdbl3, ks.kscustomdbl4, ks.kscustomdbl5, ks.kscustomdate1, ks.kscustomdate2, ks.kscustomdate3, ks.kscustomdate4, ks.kscustomdate5"
                sqlSMGabung &= " FROM ( " & sqlSM & " ) as ks"
                sqlSMGabung &= " , (SELECT @nourut := 1) AS variableInit1"
                sqlSMGabung &= " , (SELECT @saldonilai := " & vSaldoNilai & ") AS variableInit2"
                sqlSMGabung &= " , (SELECT @saldojml := " & vSaldoJml & ") AS variableInit3"


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Kartu_Stok (" & sqlSA & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If

                'SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSMJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Kartu_Stok (" & sqlSMGabung & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSMJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_KartuStok_Fifo(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN KARTU STOK FIFO

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, katbarangAwal(5) As String, katbarangAkhir(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'orderBy, katbarangAwal, katbarangAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""
        Dim katbarangAwal As String = "", katbarangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 7) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        If Len(dataDetail(4)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(4)
        End If

        'katbarangAwal(5) As String
        katbarangAwal = dataDetail(5)

        'katbarangAkhir(6) As String
        katbarangAkhir = dataDetail(6)

        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kartu_Stok WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang"
        sql &= " WHERE i.bhpp = 'F'"

            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
                Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
                Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
                Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
            End If
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KATEGORI)
        If Len(katbarangAwal) > 0 Or Len(katbarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            If Len(katbarangAwal) > 0 And Len(katbarangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
                Filter &= " i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAkhir) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(katbarangAwal) > 0 Then
                'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
                Filter &= " i.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAwal) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(katbarangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
                Filter &= " i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAkhir) & "'"
            End If
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" AND", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i.bkategori, i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""
