                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG

                idbarang = dr1("bid")

                'QUERY SALDO AWAL ###########################
                'sqlSA = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 1 as ksnourut,IFNULL(it.id, 0) as ksid, '' as ksgudang, '' as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as kstgl, 'Saldo Awal' as kssumber, 'Saldo Awal' as ksnotransaksi, 0 as kskontak, '' as kskontakkode, '' as kskontaknama, 'Saldo Awal' as ksuraian, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatan, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatandetail, s.snilai as ksmatauang, '1' as kskurs, 0 as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as ksjmlmasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as kshargamasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as ksnilaimasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as ksjmlkeluar, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as kshargakeluar, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE 0 END)as ksnilaikeluar, IFNULL(it.saldojml, 0) as kssaldojml, IFNULL(it.saldohpp, 0) as kssaldohpp, IFNULL(it.saldonilai, 0) as kssaldonilai, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as kspostingtgl, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"
                sqlSA = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, " & FixDouble(stepKe) & " as ksnourut,IFNULL(it.id, 0) as ksid, '' as ksgudang, '' as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as kstgl, 'Saldo Awal' as kssumber, 'Saldo Awal' as ksnotransaksi, 0 as kskontak, '' as kskontakkode, '' as kskontaknama, 'Saldo Awal' as ksuraian, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatan, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatandetail, s.snilai as ksmatauang, '1' as kskurs, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as ksjmlmasuk, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kshargamasuk, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0) as ksnilaimasuk, 0 as ksjmlkeluar, 0 as kshargakeluar, 0 as ksnilaikeluar, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldohpp, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldonilai, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as kspostingtgl, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"
                sqlSA &= " FROM m1_item i"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional'"
                sqlSA &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " HAVING kssaldojml <> 0"
                sqlSA &= " ORDER BY it.id DESC"
                sqlSA &= " LIMIT 1"



                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Kartu_Stok (" & sqlSA & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

                'QUERY SALDO AWAL ###########################

                sqlSA = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, " & FixDouble(stepKe) & " as ksnourut,IFNULL(it.id, 0) as ksid, '' as ksgudang, '' as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as kstgl, 'Saldo Awal' as kssumber, 'Saldo Awal' as ksnotransaksi, 0 as kskontak, '' as kskontakkode, '' as kskontaknama, 'Saldo Awal' as ksuraian, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatan, 'Saldo Awal' as kscatatandetail, s.snilai as ksmatauang, '1' as kskurs, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as ksjmlmasuk, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kshargamasuk, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0) as ksnilaimasuk, 0 as ksjmlkeluar, 0 as kshargakeluar, 0 as ksnilaikeluar, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldohpp, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldonilai, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as kspostingtgl, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"
                sqlSA &= " FROM m1_item i"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional'"
                sqlSA &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " HAVING kssaldojml <> 0"
                sqlSA &= " ORDER BY it.id DESC"
                sqlSA &= " LIMIT 1"

                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Kartu_Stok (" & sqlSA & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_NilaiPersediaanGudangDetailMifta(ByVal param As String) As String

            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai

        End If

        'gudangAwal(5) As String

        'gudangAkhir(6) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(6)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kartu_Stok WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then

        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama, it.gudang"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"

        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER GUDANG

            Filter &= " it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= GUDANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)

        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then

            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)

        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        'sql &= " GROUP BY it.gudang, i.bid"
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid"

        'ORDER BY
        'sql &= " ORDER BY it.gudang, i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""
        sql &= " ORDER BY i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------

        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = "" ', gudang As String = ""

                sqlHppAwal &= " FROM m1_item i"
                'sqlHppAwal &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
                sqlHppAwal &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
                sqlHppAwal &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
                'sqlHppAwal &= " WHERE (it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' and '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') and  (i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "') and (it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "')"
                sqlHppAwal &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlHppAwal &= " HAVING kssaldojml <> 0"
                sqlHppAwal &= " ORDER BY it.id DESC"
                sqlHppAwal &= " LIMIT 1"

                dtHpp = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlHppAwal, strCon)
                If dtHpp.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    If Len(FxDB(dtHpp.Rows(0)("kssaldohpp"), "")) > 0 Then
                        HppAwal = Double.Parse(dtHpp.Rows(0)("kssaldohpp"))
                    Else
                        GoTo HppAwalNol
                    End If
                Else
HppAwalNol:
                    HppAwal = 0
                End If


                'AMBIL HPP GLOBAL PER TANGGAL AKHIR
                sqlHppAkhir = "  SELECT IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldohpp, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldonilai"
                sqlHppAkhir &= " FROM m1_item i"
                'sqlHppAkhir &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
                sqlHppAkhir &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
                sqlHppAkhir &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"
                'sqlHppAkhir &= " WHERE (it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' and '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') and  (i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "') and (it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "')"
                sqlHppAkhir &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlHppAkhir &= " HAVING kssaldojml <> 0"
                sqlHppAkhir &= " ORDER BY it.id DESC"

                dtHpp = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlHppAkhir, strCon)
                If dtHpp.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    If Len(FxDB(dtHpp.Rows(0)("kssaldohpp"), "")) > 0 Then
                        HppAkhir = Double.Parse(dtHpp.Rows(0)("kssaldohpp"))
                    Else
                        GoTo HppAkhirNol
                    End If
                Else
HppAkhirNol:
                    HppAkhir = 0
                End If


                'QUERY SALDO AKHIR ###########################
                sqlSAk = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, " & FixDouble(stepKe) & " as ksnourut,IFNULL(it.id, 0) as ksid, it.gudang as ksgudang, wh.wnama as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' as kstgl, 'Saldo Akhir' as kssumber, 'Saldo Akhir' as ksnotransaksi, 0 as kskontak, '' as kskontakkode, '' as kskontaknama, 'Saldo Akhir' as ksuraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as kscatatan, 'Saldo Akhir' as kscatatandetail, s.snilai as ksmatauang, '1' as kskurs, 0 as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, 0 as ksjmlmasuk, 0 as kshargamasuk, 0 as ksnilaimasuk, 0 as ksjmlkeluar, 0 as kshargakeluar, 0 as ksnilaikeluar, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml, '" & FixDouble(HppAkhir) & "' as kssaldohpp, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) * " & FixDouble(HppAkhir) & " as kssaldonilai, '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & " 00:00:00' as kspostingtgl, '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & " 00:00:00' as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"
                sqlSAk &= " FROM m1_item i"
                sqlSAk &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
                sqlSAk &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
                sqlSAk &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel"
                sqlSAk &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional'"
                sqlSAk &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse wh ON it.gudang = wh.wkode"
                'sqlSAk &= " WHERE (it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' and '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') and  (i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "') and (it.gudang BETWEEN  '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "')"
                sqlSAk &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlSAk &= " GROUP BY it.gudang ASC, i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""
                'sqlSAk &= " HAVING kssaldojml <> 0"
                sqlSAk &= " ORDER BY it.gudang ASC, i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""
                'sqlSAk &= " LIMIT 1"


                'QUERY SALDO AWAL ###########################
                sqlSA = "  SELECT it.gudang as ksgudang, i.bid as ksidbarang, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml, '" & FixDouble(HppAwal) & "' as kssaldohpp, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) * " & FixDouble(HppAwal) & " as kssaldonilai"
                sqlSA &= " FROM m1_item i"
                'sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel"
                'sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional'"
                'sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse wh ON it.gudang = wh.wkode"
                'sqlSA &= " WHERE (it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' and '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') and  (i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "') and (it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND  '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "')"
                sqlSA &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " GROUP BY it.gudang ASC, i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""
                'sqlSA &= " HAVING kssaldojml <> 0"
                sqlSA &= " ORDER BY it.gudang ASC, i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""
                'sqlSA &= " LIMIT 1"


                'GABUNGKAN SALDO AWAL DAN SALDO AKHIR
                sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT SAk.idlogin, SAk.ksnourut, SAk.ksid, SAk.ksgudang, SAk.ksgudangnama, SAk.kskategoribarang, SAk.kskategoribarangnama, SAk.ksidbarang, SAk.kskodebarang, SAk.kstipebarang, SAk.ksnamabarang, SAk.kssatuanbarang, SAk.kstgl, SAk.kssumber, SAk.ksnotransaksi, SAk.kskontak, SAk.kskontakkode, SAk.kskontaknama, SAk.ksuraian, SAk.kscatatan, SAk.kscatatandetail, SAk.ksmatauang, SAk.kskurs, 0 as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, IFNULL(SA.kssaldojml,0) as ksjmlmasuk, IFNULL(SA.kssaldohpp,0) as kshargamasuk, IFNULL(SA.kssaldonilai,0) as ksnilaimasuk, SAk.kssaldojml - IFNULL(SA.kssaldojml,0) as ksjmlkeluar, (CASE (SAk.kssaldojml - IFNULL(SA.kssaldojml,0)) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SAk.kssaldonilai - IFNULL(SA.kssaldonilai,0)) / (SAk.kssaldojml - IFNULL(SA.kssaldojml,0)) END) as kshargakeluar, SAk.kssaldonilai - IFNULL(SA.kssaldonilai,0) as ksnilaikeluar, SAk.kssaldojml, SAk.kssaldohpp, SAk.kssaldonilai, SAk.kspostingtgl, SAk.ksinputtgl, SAk.idmsmq, SAk.ksuserid, SAk.kscustomtext1, SAk.kscustomtext2, SAk.kscustomtext3, SAk.kscustomtext4, SAk.kscustomtext5, SAk.kscustomint1, SAk.kscustomint2, SAk.kscustomint3, SAk.kscustomint4, SAk.kscustomint5, SAk.kscustomdbl1, SAk.kscustomdbl2, SAk.kscustomdbl3, SAk.kscustomdbl4, SAk.kscustomdbl5, SAk.kscustomdate1, SAk.kscustomdate2, SAk.kscustomdate3, SAk.kscustomdate4, SAk.kscustomdate5"
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM (" & sqlSAk & ") as SAk "
                sqlSAGabung &= " LEFT JOIN (" & sqlSA & ") as SA ON SAk.ksidbarang = SA.ksidbarang AND SAk.ksgudang = SA.ksgudang "
                sqlSAGabung &= " WHERE (SAk.kstgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' and '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') and  (SAk.ksidbarang = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "') and (SAk.ksgudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND  '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "')"

                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Kartu_Stok (" & sqlSAGabung & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    'result(2) = "Failed proccessing Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                    result(2) = sqlSAJadi : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_NilaiPersediaanGudangDetailNew1(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN NILAI PERSEDIAAN PERTANGGAL

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, gudangAwal(5) As String, gudangAkhir(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'orderBy, gudangAwal, gudangAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""
        Dim gudangAwal As String = "", gudangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 7) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)


        'orderBy(4) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(4)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(4)
        End If

        'gudangAwal(5) As String
        gudangAwal = dataDetail(5)

        'gudangAkhir(6) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(6)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kartu_Stok WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama, it.gudang"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang"
        'sql &= " WHERE i.bhpp = 'F'"

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER GUDANG
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL DAN GUDANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then

            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " it.gudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        'sql &= " GROUP BY it.gudang, i.bid"
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid"

        'sql &= " ORDER BY it.gudang, i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""
        sql &= " ORDER BY i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ""

                        sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' "


                        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                        'SALDO AWAL
                        sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Kartu_Stok (" & sqlSAGabung & ")"
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", currGudangNama & " - " & dr1("bkode"), currGudangNama & " - " & dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================

                    Next


                    'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                    'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                    progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                    'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                    sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

                    End If
                    'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

                Next

            Else
                GoTo dataKosong

            End If

        Else

dataKosong:
            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

                    sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, " & FixDouble(stepKe) & " as ksnourut, 0 as ksid, w.wkode as ksgudang, w.wnama as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' kstgl, 'SA' as kssumber, 'SA' as ksnotransaksi, 0 as kskontak, '' as kskontakkode, '' as kskontaknama, 'Saldo Akhir' as ksuraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as kscatatan, 'Saldo Akhir' as kscatatandetail, s.snilai as ksmatauang, 1 as kskurs, 0 as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAwal, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) & "' as ksjmlmasuk, '" & FixDouble(HppAwal) & "' as kshargamasuk, '" & FixDouble(FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAwal, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) * HppAwal) & "' as ksnilaimasuk, '" & FixDouble(FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAkhir, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) - FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAwal, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0))) & "' as ksjmlkeluar, (CASE " & FixDouble(FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAkhir, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) - FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAwal, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0))) & " WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (" & (FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAkhir, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) * HppAkhir) - (FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAwal, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) * HppAwal) & ") / (" & FixDouble(FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAkhir, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) - FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAwal, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0))) & ") END) as kshargakeluar, '" & FixDouble((FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAkhir, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) * HppAkhir) - (FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAwal, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) * HppAwal)) & "' as ksnilaikeluar, '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAkhir, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) & "' as kssaldojml, '" & FixDouble(HppAkhir) & "' as kssaldohpp, '" & FixDouble(FixDouble(AsDataTableDLookup(dtMutasiAkhir, "kssaldojml", "gudang = '" & currGudang & "'", 0)) * HppAkhir) & "' as kssaldonilai, '1971-01-01 00:00:00' as kspostingtgl, NOW() as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as ksuserid, '' as kscustomtext1, '' as kscustomtext2, '' as kscustomtext3, '' as kscustomtext4, '' as kscustomtext5, '0' as kscustomint1, '0' as kscustomint2, '0' as kscustomint3, '0' as kscustomint4, '0' as kscustomint5, '0' as kscustomdbl1, '0' as kscustomdbl2, '0' as kscustomdbl3, '0' as kscustomdbl4, '0' as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"
                    sqlSAGabung &= " FROM m1_item i "
                    sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode AND i.bid = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "' "
                    sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON w.wkode = '" & FixQuotes(currGudang) & "' "
                    sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' "

                Next

                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Kartu_Stok (" & sqlSAGabung & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If

                sqlSAGabung = ""
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================

                'Next


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

            'Else
            '    GoTo dataKosong

            'End If

        Else

dataKosong:
            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)


        'orderBy(4) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(4)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(4)
        End If

        'gudangAwal(5) As String

        'gudangAkhir(6) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(6)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kartu_Stok WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama, it.gudang"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang"
        'sql &= " WHERE i.bjenis = 'P'"

        Filter &= " i.bjenis = 'P'"

            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        ''FILTER GUDANG
        'If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG

        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------

        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = "" ', gudang As String = ""
            Dim sqlHppAwal As String = "", sqlHppAkhir As String = ""

            Dim sqlSAGabung As String = "", sqlSAJadi As String = ""
            Dim dtInsert As New DataTable


            'AMBIL HPP GLOBAL PER TANGGAL AWAL
            sqlHppAwal = "  SELECT i.bid, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldohpp"
            sqlHppAwal &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlHppAwal &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' "

            'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)

                'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
                sqlHppAwal &= " WHERE i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
                sqlHppAwal &= " WHERE i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
                sqlHppAwal &= " WHERE i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
            End If
            sqlHppAwal &= " GROUP BY i.bid "
            dtHppAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlHppAwal, strCon)


            'AMBIL HPP GLOBAL PER TANGGAL AKHIR
            sqlHppAkhir = "  SELECT i.bid, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldohpp"
            sqlHppAkhir &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlHppAkhir &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
            sqlHppAkhir &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "
            'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
            If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
                sqlHppAkhir &= " WHERE i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
                sqlHppAkhir &= " WHERE i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
            ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
                sqlHppAkhir &= " WHERE i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
            End If
            sqlHppAkhir &= " GROUP BY i.bid "
            dtHppAkhir = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlHppAkhir, strCon)


            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                idbarang = FxDB(dr1("bid"), 0)

                'AMBIL HPP AWAL
                HppAwal = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtHppAwal, "kssaldohpp", "bid = '" & idbarang & "'", 0))
                'AMBIL HPP AKHIR
                HppAkhir = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtHppAkhir, "kssaldohpp", "bid = '" & idbarang & "'", 0))


                'QUERY SALDO AKHIR ###########################
                sqlSAk = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, " & FixDouble(stepKe) & " as ksnourut,IFNULL(it.id, 0) as ksid, it.gudang as ksgudang, wh.wnama as ksgudangnama, i.bkategori as kskategoribarang, ic.icnama as kskategoribarangnama, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bkode as kskodebarang, i.btipe as kstipebarang, i.bnama as ksnamabarang, i.bsatuan as kssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' as kstgl, 'Saldo Akhir' as kssumber, 'Saldo Akhir' as ksnotransaksi, 0 as kskontak, '' as kskontakkode, '' as kskontaknama, 'Saldo Akhir' as ksuraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as kscatatan, 'Saldo Akhir' as kscatatandetail, s.snilai as ksmatauang, '1' as kskurs, 0 as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, 0 as ksjmlmasuk, 0 as kshargamasuk, 0 as ksnilaimasuk, 0 as ksjmlkeluar, 0 as kshargakeluar, 0 as ksnilaikeluar, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml, '" & FixDouble(HppAkhir) & "' as kssaldohpp, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) * " & FixDouble(HppAkhir) & " as kssaldonilai, '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & " 00:00:00' as kspostingtgl, '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & " 00:00:00' as ksinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' ksuserid, it.customtext1 as kscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as kscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as kscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as kscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as kscustomtext5, 0 as kscustomint1, 0 as kscustomint2, 0 as kscustomint3, 0 as kscustomint4, 0 as kscustomint5, 0 as kscustomdbl1, 0 as kscustomdbl2, 0 as kscustomdbl3, 0 as kscustomdbl4, 0 as kscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as kscustomdate5"

                'GABUNGKAN SALDO AWAL DAN SALDO AKHIR
                sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT SAk.idlogin, SAk.ksnourut, SAk.ksid, SAk.ksgudang, SAk.ksgudangnama, SAk.kskategoribarang, SAk.kskategoribarangnama, SAk.ksidbarang, SAk.kskodebarang, SAk.kstipebarang, SAk.ksnamabarang, SAk.kssatuanbarang, SAk.kstgl, SAk.kssumber, SAk.ksnotransaksi, SAk.kskontak, SAk.kskontakkode, SAk.kskontaknama, SAk.ksuraian, SAk.kscatatan, SAk.kscatatandetail, SAk.ksmatauang, SAk.kskurs, 0 as ksharga, 0 as ksdiskon, 0 as ksjmldiskon, 1 as ksjenismutasi, IFNULL(SA.kssaldojml,0) as ksjmlmasuk, IFNULL(SA.kssaldohpp,0) as kshargamasuk, IFNULL(SA.kssaldonilai,0) as ksnilaimasuk, SAk.kssaldojml - IFNULL(SA.kssaldojml,0) as ksjmlkeluar, (CASE (SAk.kssaldojml - IFNULL(SA.kssaldojml,0)) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SAk.kssaldonilai - IFNULL(SA.kssaldonilai,0)) / (SAk.kssaldojml - IFNULL(SA.kssaldojml,0)) END) as kshargakeluar, SAk.kssaldonilai - IFNULL(SA.kssaldonilai,0) as ksnilaikeluar, SAk.kssaldojml, SAk.kssaldohpp, SAk.kssaldonilai, SAk.kspostingtgl, SAk.ksinputtgl, SAk.idmsmq, SAk.ksuserid, SAk.kscustomtext1, SAk.kscustomtext2, SAk.kscustomtext3, SAk.kscustomtext4, SAk.kscustomtext5, SAk.kscustomint1, SAk.kscustomint2, SAk.kscustomint3, SAk.kscustomint4, SAk.kscustomint5, SAk.kscustomdbl1, SAk.kscustomdbl2, SAk.kscustomdbl3, SAk.kscustomdbl4, SAk.kscustomdbl5, SAk.kscustomdate1, SAk.kscustomdate2, SAk.kscustomdate3, SAk.kscustomdate4, SAk.kscustomdate5"
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM (" & sqlSAk & ") as SAk "
                sqlSAGabung &= " LEFT JOIN (" & sqlSA & ") as SA ON SAk.ksidbarang = SA.ksidbarang AND SAk.ksgudang = SA.ksgudang "
                'sqlSAGabung &= " WHERE ( IFNULL(SA.kssaldojml,0) <> 0 OR IFNULL(SA.kssaldonilai,0) <> 0 OR SAk.kssaldojml - IFNULL(SA.kssaldojml,0) <> 0 OR SAk.kssaldonilai - IFNULL(SA.kssaldonilai,0) <> 0 OR SAk.kssaldojml <> 0 OR SAk.kssaldonilai <> 0)"
                'FILTER GUDANG 
                'If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
                '    sqlSAGabung &= " WHERE SAk.ksgudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
                'ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
                '    'JIKA GUDANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= GUDANG AWAL
                '    sqlSAGabung &= " WHERE SAk.ksgudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
                'ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
                '    'JIKA GUDANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= GUDANG AKHIR
                '    sqlSAGabung &= " WHERE SAk.ksgudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
                'End If
                sqlSAGabung &= " WHERE SAk.ksgudang IN ('RI', 'RJ', 'BPJS', 'G')"

                               ksnamabarang,                                               kssatuanbarang,                                                         kstgl,                                                          kssumber,                                           ksnotransaksi,                                          kskontak,                                           kskontakkode,                                            kskontaknama,                                              ksuraian,                                           kscatatan,                                          kscatatandetail,                                            ksmatauang,                                             kskurs,                                             ksharga,                                         ksdiskon,                                          ksjmldiskon,                                            ksjenismutasi,                                              ksjmlmasuk,                                         kshargamasuk,                                           ksnilaimasuk,                                           ksjmlkeluar,                                            kshargakeluar,                                          ksnilaikeluar,                                          kssaldojml,                                             kssaldohpp,                                         kssaldonilai,                                                           kspostingtgl,                                                                                                        ksinputtgl,                                                                                    idmsmq,                                             ksuserid,                                           kscustomtext1,                                          kscustomtext2,                                              kscustomtext3,                                              kscustomtext4,                                kscustomdbl2,                                               kscustomdbl3,                                       kscustomdbl4,                                            kscustomdate3,                                                                      kscustomdate4,                                                                          kscustomdate5
                        strInsert.Append("('" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idlogin"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("ksnourut"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("ksid"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("ksgudang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("ksgudangnama"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("kskategoribarang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("kstgl"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("kssumber"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("ksnotransaksi"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("kscustomdate5"), "1900-01-01"))) & "')")
                    Next
                End If

                ''INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                ''SALDO AWAL
                'sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Kartu_Stok (" & sqlSAGabung & ")"

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================

            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_NilaiPersediaanGudangDetail(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN NILAI PERSEDIAAN PERTANGGAL

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, gudangAwal(5) As String, gudangAkhir(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'orderBy, gudangAwal, gudangAkhir, kategoriAwal, kategoriAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
