    Public Function M0_ContactGeneralLedger(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN BUKU BESAR PER KONTAK

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String, perTanggal(5) As Integer,
        'kontakAwal(6) As String, kontakAkhir(7) As String, OrderBy(8) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang, perTanggal,
        'kontakAwal, kontakAkhir, OrderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = "", perTanggal As Integer = 0
        Dim kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 9) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        'perTanggal(5) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(5)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "perTanggal required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            perTanggal = dataDetail(5)
        End If

        'kontakAwal(6) As String
        kontakAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'kontakAkhir(7) As String
        kontakAkhir = dataDetail(7)

        'orderBy(8) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(8)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(8).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(8).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(8)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMQ DI M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_general_ledger WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace general ledger data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER -----------------------------

        'BUAT FILTER NOREK -------------------------------------------------------
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1') "
        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'FILTER KONTAK
        If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (" & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (" & orderBy & " >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (" & orderBy & " <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER NOREK ------------------------------------------------

        'AMBIL NOREK ANTARA NOREKAWAL DAN NOREK AKHIR
        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor, kid FROM m1_coa JOIN m2_transaction_journal ON cnomor = tnorek AND tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) JOIN m1_contact ON tkontak = kid " & Filter & " GROUP BY tkontak, cnomor ORDER BY " & orderBy & ", cnomor", strCon)

        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, currNorek As String = "", saldoAwal As Double = 0, idKontak As Double = 0

            'PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER PER NOREK ------------------------
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET SALDO AWAL, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
                currNorek = FxDB(dr("cnomor"), "") : saldoAwal = 0 : idKontak = Double.Parse(FxDB(dr("kid"), 0)) : strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL NOREK
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 1 as glnourut, 0 as glid, " & FixDouble(idKontak) & " as glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as gltgl, '' as glnotransaksi, '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' as glnorek, coa.cnama as glnoreknama, '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' as glmatauang, 0 as glkurs, 'Saldo Awal' as gluraian, 'Saldo Awal' as glcatatan, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END)as gldebit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) END) as glkredit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) ELSE (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) END) as glsaldo, CONCAT('" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "',' 00:00:00') as glinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as gluserid FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor AND t.tkontak = '" & FixDouble(idKontak) & "' JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND (CASE coa.cjenis WHEN 'P' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' WHEN 'B' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' ELSE t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' END) AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)", strCon)
                If dtSAwal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT SALDO AWAL NOREK DAN AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAwal.Rows
                        'JIKA SALDO AWAL = 0 MAKA AMBIL NAMA AKUN DARI M1_COA
                        Dim norekNama As String = ""
                        If Double.Parse(FxDB(dr1("glsaldo"), 0)) = 0 Then
                            Dim dtCoa As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnama FROM m1_coa WHERE cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "'", strCon)
                            If dtCoa.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                                norekNama = FxDB(dtCoa.Rows(0)("cnama"), "")
                            End If
                        Else
                            norekNama = FxDB(dr1("glnoreknama"), "")
                        End If

                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SALDO AWAL
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                            idlogin,                                  glnourut,                                      glid,                                      glkontak,                                      glkontakkode,                                       glkontaknama,                                                       gltgl,                                        glnotransaksi,                                       glnorek,                           glnoreknama,                                glmatauang,                                       glkurs,                                      gluraian,                                       glcatatan,                                       gldebit,                                      glkredit,                                      glsaldo,                                                      glinputtgl,                                                              idmsmq,                                       gluserid,                   glcustomtext1,           glcustomtext2,           glcustomtext3,           glcustomtext4,           glcustomtext5,glcustomint1,glcustomint2,glcustomint3,glcustomint4,glcustomint5, glcustomdbl1,           glcustomdbl2,           glcustomdbl3,           glcustomdbl4,           glcustomdbl5,                                 glcustomdate1,                                      glcustomdate2,                                      glcustomdate3,                                      glcustomdate4,                                      glcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("glnourut"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("glid"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("glkontak"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("glkontakkode"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("glkontaknama"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(dr1("gltgl"), ""))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("glnotransaksi"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("glnorek"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(norekNama) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("glmatauang"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(dr1("glkurs"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("gluraian"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("glcatatan"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(dr1("gldebit"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(dr1("glkredit"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(dr1("glsaldo"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(dr1("glinputtgl"), ""), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("idmsmq"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr1("gluserid"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                        saldoAwal = saldoAwal + Double.Parse(FixDouble(dr1("glsaldo")))
                    Next
                Else
                    result(2) = "Failed Getting '" & currNorek & "' starting balance." : GoTo selesai
                End If

                'JIKA PERTANGGAL MAKA DIGRUPKAN PERTANGGAL, JIKA TIDAK MAKA TIDAK DIGRUPKAN
                If perTanggal = 1 Then
                    GroupBy = " GROUP BY t.ttgl"
                    sql = "SELECT gl.idlogin, gl.glnourut, gl.glid, gl.glkontak, gl.glkontakkode, gl.glkontaknama, gl.gltgl, gl.glnotransaksi, gl.glnorek, gl.glnoreknama, gl.glmatauang, gl.glkurs, gl.gluraian, gl.glcatatan, gl.gldebit, gl.glkredit, (CASE gl.glcdc WHEN 'D' THEN @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(gl.gldebit,0) - IFNULL(gl.glkredit,0) ELSE @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(gl.glkredit,0) - IFNULL(gl.gldebit,0) END) as glsaldo, gl.glinputtgl, gl.idmsmq, gl.gluserid FROM (SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as glnourut, t.tid as glid, t.tkontak as glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, t.ttgl as gltgl, t.tnotransaksi as glnotransaksi, t.tnorek as glnorek, coa.cnama as glnoreknama,coa.cdc as glcdc, t.tmatauang as glmatauang, t.tkurs as glkurs, 'Mutasi' as gluraian, 'Mutasi' as glcatatan, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) as gldebit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as glkredit, t.tinputtgl as glinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as gluserid FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid AND t.tkontak = '" & FixDouble(idKontak) & "' LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional', (SELECT @nourut := 1) AS variableInit1 WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) " & GroupBy & " ORDER BY t.ttgl, t.tinputtgl, t.tid) as gl, (SELECT @saldo := " & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & ") AS variableInit2 "
                Else
                    GroupBy = ""
                    sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as glnourut, t.tid as glid, t.tkontak as glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, t.ttgl as gltgl, t.tnotransaksi as glnotransaksi, t.tnorek as glnorek, coa.cnama as glnoreknama, t.tmatauang as glmatauang, t.tkurs as glkurs, t.turaian as gluraian, t.tcatatan as glcatatan, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(t.tdebit,0) ELSE IFNULL(t.tdebitvalas,0) END) as gldebit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(t.tkredit,0) ELSE IFNULL(t.tkreditvalas,0) END) as glkredit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(t.tdebit,0) - IFNULL(t.tkredit,0) ELSE @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(t.tkredit,0) - IFNULL(t.tdebit,0) END) ELSE (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(t.tdebitvalas,0) - IFNULL(t.tkreditvalas,0) ELSE @saldo := @saldo + IFNULL(t.tkreditvalas,0) - IFNULL(t.tdebitvalas,0) END) END) as glsaldo, t.tinputtgl as glinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as gluserid FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid AND t.tkontak = '" & FixDouble(idKontak) & "' LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional', (SELECT @nourut := 1) AS variableInit1, (SELECT @saldo := " & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & ") AS variableInit2 WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) " & GroupBy & " ORDER BY t.ttgl, t.tinputtgl, t.tid"
                End If

                'AMBIL SALDO MUTASI NOREK
                dtSMutasi = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dtSMutasi.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT SALDO MUTASI NOREK
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSMutasi.Rows
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SALDO AWAL
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                            idlogin,                             glnourut,                             glid,                             glkontak,                             glkontakkode,                             glkontaknama,                                             gltgl,                              glnotransaksi,                             glnorek,                             glnoreknama,                             glmatauang,                             glkurs,                             gluraian,                             glcatatan,                             gldebit,                             glkredit,                             glsaldo,                                             glinputtgl,                                                     idmsmq,                             gluserid,                   glcustomtext1,           glcustomtext2,           glcustomtext3,           glcustomtext4,           glcustomtext5,glcustomint1,glcustomint2,glcustomint3,glcustomint4,glcustomint5, glcustomdbl1,           glcustomdbl2,           glcustomdbl3,           glcustomdbl4,           glcustomdbl5,                                 glcustomdate1,                                      glcustomdate2,                                      glcustomdate3,                                      glcustomdate4,                                      glcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnourut")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("gltgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glnoreknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("gluraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("gldebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glsaldo")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("glinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("gluserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
                    Next
                End If

                'SIMPAN KE M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER JIKA SALDO AWAL ATAU MUTASI <> 0
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 And (saldoAwal <> 0 Or dtSMutasi.Rows.Count <> 0) Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_General_Ledger(idlogin, glnourut, glid, glkontak, glkontakkode, glkontaknama, gltgl, glnotransaksi, glnorek, glnoreknama, glmatauang, glkurs, gluraian, glcatatan, gldebit, glkredit, glsaldo, glinputtgl, idmsmq, gluserid, glcustomtext1, glcustomtext2, glcustomtext3, glcustomtext4, glcustomtext5, glcustomint1, glcustomint2, glcustomint3, glcustomint4, glcustomint5, glcustomdbl1, glcustomdbl2, glcustomdbl3, glcustomdbl4, glcustomdbl5, glcustomdate1, glcustomdate2, glcustomdate3, glcustomdate4, glcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing '" & currNorek & "' general ledger." : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If

                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtNorek.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currNorek & "' general ledger." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER PER NOREK -----------------
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_ContactSummary(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REKAP BUKU PEMBANTU KONTAK

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, 
        'costCenterAwal(4) As String, costCenterAkhir(5) As String, area(6) As String, kontakCategory(7) As String, 
        'customerCategory(8) As String, supplierCategory(9) As String, kontakAwal(10) As String, kontakAkhir(11) As String, 
        'salesmanCategory(12) As String, salesman(13) As String, matauang(14) As String, orderBy(15) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, 
        'costCenterAwal, costCenterAkhir, area, kontakCategory, 
        'customerCategory, supplierCategory, kontakAwal, kontakAkhir, 
        'salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang, orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = ""
        Dim costCenterAwal As String = "", costCenterAkhir As String = "", area As String = "", kontakCategory As String = ""
        Dim customerCategory As String = "", supplierCategory As String = "", kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCategory As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = ""


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey

        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai

        'ModuleId(0) As Integer

        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String

            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If

        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")

        'tglAkhir(1) As String

            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then

            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))

        matauang = dataDetail(14)

        'orderBy(15) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(15)) = 0 Then

        ElseIf dataDetail(15).ToString <> "bpkontakkode" And dataDetail(15).ToString <> "bpkontaknama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Bp_Card ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Bp_Card
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Bp_Card WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Contact Summary data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Bp_Card -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL NOREK SESUAI FILTER -----------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT t.tnorek, coa.cnama"
        sql &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON t.tcostcenter = cc.cckode"
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"
        sql &= " WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"

        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'FILTER COSTCENTER
        If Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 And Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tcostcenter BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tcostcenter >= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tcostcenter <= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')"

        'FILTER CONTACT CATEGORY
        If Len(kontakCategory) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.kkategori = '" & FixQuotes(kontakCategory) & "')"

        'FILTER CUSTOMER CATEGORY
        If Len(customerCategory) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCategory) & "')"

        'FILTER SUPPLIER CATEGORY
        If Len(supplierCategory) > 0 Then sql &= " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')"

        'FILTER CONTACT
        If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c1.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c1.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"

        'FILTER SALESMAN

        sql &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek"

        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF  AMBIL NOREK SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------

        Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
        Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
        If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai

        Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")

            result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

            Dim sqlFungsional As String = "", sqlValas As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""
            Dim norek As String = "", dtTotal As New DataTable

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER NOREK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'SET NOREK

                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO AWAL =========================================
                'QUERY SALDO AWAL FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsional = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as bpmatauang, (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) as bpsaldoawal, t.tkontak as bpkontak, c1.kkode as bpkontakkode"
                sqlFungsional &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
                sqlFungsional &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"
                sqlFungsional &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
                sqlFungsional &= " LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON t.tcostcenter = cc.cckode"
                sqlFungsional &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"
                sqlFungsional &= " WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
                sqlFungsional &= " AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(norek) & "'"
                sqlFungsional &= " AND (CASE coa.cjenis WHEN 'P' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' WHEN 'B' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' ELSE t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' END)"
                sqlFungsional &= " AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'FILTER COSTCENTER
                If Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 And Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (t.tcostcenter BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (t.tcostcenter >= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (t.tcostcenter <= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"

                'FILTER AREA

                'FILTER CONTACT

                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN

                'FILTER SALESMAN

                sqlValas = "  SELECT t.tmatauang as bpmatauang, (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) as bpsaldoawal, t.tkontak as bpkontak, c1.kkode as bpkontakkode"
                sqlValas &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
                sqlValas &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"
                sqlValas &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
                sqlValas &= " LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON t.tcostcenter = cc.cckode"
                sqlValas &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"

                sqlValas &= " AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'FILTER COSTCENTER
                If Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 And Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (t.tcostcenter BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (t.tcostcenter >= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (t.tcostcenter <= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER AREA
                If Len(area) > 0 Then sqlValas &= " AND (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')"
                'FILTER CONTACT CATEGORY
                If Len(kontakCategory) > 0 Then sqlValas &= " AND (c1.kkategori = '" & FixQuotes(kontakCategory) & "')"
                'FILTER CUSTOMER CATEGORY
                If Len(customerCategory) > 0 Then sqlValas &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCategory) & "')"
                'FILTER SUPPLIER CATEGORY
                If Len(supplierCategory) > 0 Then sqlValas &= " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')"
                'FILTER CONTACT

                    sqlValas &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"

                sqlValas &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek, t.tkontak, t.tmatauang"

                sqlJadi = "  SELECT bpmatauang, bpsaldoawal, bpkontak, bpkontakkode"
                sqlJadi &= " FROM ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi &= " ORDER BY bpmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' DESC, bpmatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO AWAL ==================================

                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsional = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as bpmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as bpdebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as bpkredit, t.tkontak as bpkontak, c1.kkode as bpkontakkode"
                sqlFungsional &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
                sqlFungsional &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"
                sqlFungsional &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
                sqlFungsional &= " LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON t.tcostcenter = cc.cckode"
                sqlFungsional &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"
                sqlFungsional &= " WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
                sqlFungsional &= " AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(norek) & "'"
                sqlFungsional &= " AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
                sqlFungsional &= " AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"

                If Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 And Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (t.tcostcenter BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(costCenterAwal) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (t.tcostcenter >= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAwal) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(costCenterAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (t.tcostcenter <= '" & FixQuotes(costCenterAkhir) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER AREA
                If Len(area) > 0 Then sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.karea = '" & FixQuotes(area) & "')"
                'FILTER CONTACT CATEGORY
                If Len(kontakCategory) > 0 Then sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkategori = '" & FixQuotes(kontakCategory) & "')"
                'FILTER CUSTOMER CATEGORY
                If Len(customerCategory) > 0 Then sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & FixQuotes(customerCategory) & "')"
                'FILTER SUPPLIER CATEGORY
                If Len(supplierCategory) > 0 Then sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')"
                'FILTER CONTACT
                If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
                If Len(salesmanCategory) > 0 Then sqlFungsional += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCategory) & "') "
                'FILTER SALESMAN
                If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sqlFungsional += " AND (c2.kkode = '" & FixQuotes(salesman) & "') "

                sqlFungsional &= " GROUP BY t.tnorek, t.tkontak"
                sqlFungsional &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek, t.tkontak"

                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI VALAS
                sqlValas = "  SELECT t.tmatauang as bpmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as bpdebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as bpkredit, t.tkontak as bpkontak, c1.kkode as bpkontakkode"
                sqlValas &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
                sqlValas &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"
                sqlValas &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
                sqlValas &= " LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON t.tcostcenter = cc.cckode"
                sqlValas &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"
                sqlValas &= " WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
                sqlValas &= " AND t.tmatauang <> '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "'"

FixDouble(dr1("bpsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("bpdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("bpkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("bpsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("bptgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("bpstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("bptgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("bpinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("bpisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                        'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                        urutSAkhir += 1

                        'INCREMENT NOURUT
                        urut += 1
                    Next

                    'INSERT KE DATABASE
                    If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                        sql = "Insert into M2r_Bp_Card(bpnourut, idlogin, bpid, bptgl, bpsumber, bpnotransaksi, bpkontak, bpkontakkode, bpkontaknama, bpalamat1, bpalamat2, bpalamat3, bpalamat4, bpalamat5, bpnotelp1, bpnotelp2, bpnorek, bpnoreknama, bpcostcenter, bpcostcenternama, bpmatauang, bpkurs, bpuraian, bpcatatan, bpsaldoawal, bpdebit, bpkredit, bpsaldoakhir, bptgljatuhtempo, bpstatuslunas, bptgllunas, bpinputtgl, bpisfungsional, bpissaldoakhir, idmsmq, bpuserid, bpcustomtext1, bpcustomtext2, bpcustomtext3, bpcustomtext4, bpcustomtext5, bpcustomint1, bpcustomint2, bpcustomint3, bpcustomint4, bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1, bpcustomdbl2, bpcustomdbl3, bpcustomdbl4, bpcustomdbl5, bpcustomdate1, bpcustomdate2, bpcustomdate3, bpcustomdate4, bpcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Total BP Summary : " & norek : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If

                End If
                'END OF PROSES HITUNG TOTAL PER NOREK ===============


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / dtNorek.Rows.Count, 2) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress BP Summary : " & norek : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER NOREK +++++++++++++++++++

        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER NOREK -------------------------------------


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_PerincianBiaya(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN PERINCIAN BIAYA

        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================

        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'SET tahunLalu DAN bulanLalu

        End If

        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)

        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2r_Perincian_Biaya
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_perincian_biaya WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then

        End If

        stepKe = 1

        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then

        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG BULAN INI ===================
        stepKe = 2
        rsHitung = M0_HitungRealisasi(idLogin & "★M0_HitungRealisasi★0△0△△△dd/MM/yyyy△dd/MM/yyyy H:mm:ss★" & userid & "★0★" & tahun & sptField & bulan)
        rsHitungSplit = rsHitung.Split(sptSubParam)
        'FORMAT KEMBALIAN = NamaFungsi△isSuccess△errMessage△errStep△idtransaksi★0△0△0△0△0★ ----> M0_HitungRealisasi△1△△0△0★0△0△0△0△0★
        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then
            'JIKA ISSUCCESS <> 1 MAKA KIRIM INFORMASI PROSES GAGAL

        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HITUNG REALISASI BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU --------------------------

        Dim urut As Integer = 1

        'PROSES AKTIVA =============================================================
        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        stepKe = 3
        Dim sqlBulanIni As String = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "') WHERE (c.cjenis='B') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim sqlBulanLalu As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) WHERE (c.cjenis='B') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim sqlAwalBulan As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldoawalbulan, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN ((IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & "))/" & FixDouble(bulan) & " ELSE ((IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & "))/" & FixDouble(bulan) & " END) AS pksaldoratarata FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "') WHERE (c.cjenis='B') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, (IFNULL((((s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu) / k.pksaldolalu) * 100),0)) as pksaldovariasipersen,q.pksaldoawalbulan,q.pksaldoratarata, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlAwalBulan & ") as q "
        sql += " ON q.pknorek = s.pknorek "
        sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "
        'result(2) = sql : GoTo selesai
        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        Dim dt As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'DEKLARASI UNTUK SIMPAN LEVEL INDUK
            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0' OR pksaldoawalbulan <> '0' OR pksaldoratarata <> '0'")
            End If

            'PERULANGAN BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU (M2r_Posisi_Keuangan)
            dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL

                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))

                        urut += 1

    Public Function M0_ARVoucher_Aging(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES)
        '//SUMBER SI(SALES INVOICE), SR(SALES RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else

    Public Function M0_APVoucher_Aging(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER HUTANG (ACCOUNT PAYABLES)
        '//SUMBER RI(RECEIVE INVOICE), PRT(PURCHASE RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, supplierCategory(3) As String, 
        'supplierAwal(4) As String, supplierAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, supplierCategory, 
        'supplierAwal, supplierAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", supplierCat As String = "", supplierAwal As String = "", supplierAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))

        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "

        ElseIf Len(supplierAwal) > 0 Then

        ElseIf Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then

        End If

        'If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "

            Dim dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSSubtotal As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable

                sqlFungsionalRI = "  SELECT t.apid, t.aptgl, t.apsumber, t.apnotransaksi, t.apkontak, t.apkontakkode, t.apkontaknama, t.apalamat1, t.apalamat2, t.apalamat3, t.apalamat4, t.apalamat5, t.apnotelp1, t.apnotelp2, t.apnorek, t.apmatauang, t.apkurs, t.apuraian, t.apcatatan, t.aptotal, SUM(t.apbayar) as apbayar, t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) as apsisa, t.aptgljatuhtempo, t.apstatuslunas, t.aptgllunas, t.apinputtgl, t.apisfungsional, t.apissaldoakhir, "

                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur2) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur2) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur1) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) ELSE 0 END) as apumur1, "

                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur3) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur3) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur2) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) ELSE 0 END) as apumur2, "

                'UMUR4          : JIKA UMUR4 = 0 DAN UMUR5 = 0 MAKA 0,                                               JIKA UMUR4 = 0 DAN UMUR5 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR5 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                         JIKA UMUR4 <> 0 DAN UMUR5 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR5 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR4 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur5) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur5) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur4) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) ELSE 0 END) as apumur4, "
                'UMUR5          : JIKA UMUR5 = 0 DAN TGLJT < 0 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                            JIKA UMUR5 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < 0 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR5 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA 
                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur5) & " = 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < 0 THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur5) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) ELSE 0 END) as apumur5, "

                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur6) & " = 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) >= 0 THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur6) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) <= " & FixDouble(umur6) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) ELSE 0 END) as apumur6, "
