                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur7) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur6) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) > " & FixDouble(umur6) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur7) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) > " & FixDouble(umur6) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) <= " & FixDouble(umur7) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) ELSE 0 END) as apumur7, "

                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur8) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur7) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) > " & FixDouble(umur7) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur8) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) > " & FixDouble(umur7) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) <= " & FixDouble(umur8) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) ELSE 0 END) as apumur8, "

    Public Function M0_ARSummary_Aging_backup(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES)
        '//SUMBER SI(SALES INVOICE), SR(SALES RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If

    Public Function M0_ARSummary_Aging(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES)
        '//SUMBER SI(SALES INVOICE), SR(SALES RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,

                sqlFungsionalSI = "  SELECT t.arid, t.artgl, t.arsumber, t.arnotransaksi, t.arkontak, t.arkontakkode, t.arkontaknama, t.aralamat1, t.aralamat2, t.aralamat3, t.aralamat4, t.aralamat5, t.arnotelp1, t.arnotelp2, t.arnorek, t.armatauang, t.arkurs, t.aruraian, t.arcatatan, t.artotal, SUM(t.arbayar) as arbayar, t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) as arsisa, t.artgljatuhtempo, t.arstatuslunas, t.artgllunas, t.arinputtgl, t.arisfungsional, t.arissaldoakhir, "

                'UMUR_1         : JIKA UMUR1 = 0 MAKA 0, JIKA TGLJT < UMUR1 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur1) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) ELSE 0 END) as arumur_1, "
                'UMUR1          : JIKA UMUR1 = 0 DAN UMUR2 = 0 MAKA 0,                                              JIKA UMUR1 = 0 DAN UMUR2 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR2 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                          JIKA UMUR1 <> 0 DAN UMUR2 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR2 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR1 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur2) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur2) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur1) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) ELSE 0 END) as arumur1, "
                'UMUR2          : JIKA UMUR2 = 0 DAN UMUR3 = 0 MAKA 0,                                               JIKA UMUR2 = 0 DAN UMUR3 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR3 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                         JIKA UMUR2 <> 0 DAN UMUR3 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR3 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR2 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur3) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur3) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur2) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) ELSE 0 END) as arumur2, "
                'UMUR3          : JIKA UMUR3 = 0 DAN UMUR4 = 0 MAKA 0,                                               JIKA UMUR3 = 0 DAN UMUR4 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR4 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                         JIKA UMUR3 <> 0 DAN UMUR4 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR4 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR3 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur4) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur4) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur4) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur4) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur3) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) ELSE 0 END) as arumur3, "
                'UMUR4          : JIKA UMUR4 = 0 DAN UMUR5 = 0 MAKA 0,                                               JIKA UMUR4 = 0 DAN UMUR5 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR5 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                         JIKA UMUR4 <> 0 DAN UMUR5 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR5 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR4 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur5) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur5) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur4) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) ELSE 0 END) as arumur4, "
                'UMUR5          : JIKA UMUR5 = 0 DAN TGLJT < 0 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                            JIKA UMUR5 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < 0 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR5 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA 
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur5) & " = 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < 0 THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) < 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur5) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) ELSE 0 END) as arumur5, "
                'UMUR POSITIF +++++++++++++++++++++++
                'UMUR6          : JIKA UMUR6 = 0 DAN TGLJT >= 0 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                            JIKA UMUR6 <> 0 DAN TGLJT >= 0 DAN TGLJT <= UMUR6 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur6) & " = 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) >= 0 THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur6) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.artgljatuhtempo) <= " & FixDouble(umur6) & " THEN t.artotal - SUM(t.arbayar) ELSE 0 END) as arumur6, "

                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ar_Voucher_Aging(arnourut, idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, artotal, arbayar, arsisa, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, arumur_1, arumur1, arumur2, arumur3, arumur4, arumur5, arumur6, arumur7, arumur8, arumur9, arumur10, arumur_10, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Total AR Voucher." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
            'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Total AR Voucher." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================
            'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++


        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN Voucher PER KONTAK -------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_APSummary_Aging(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER HUTANG (ACCOUNT PAYABLES)

        End If

        'area(2) As String
        'area = dataDetail(2)
        area = ""

        'supplierAwal(4) As String
        supplierAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'supplierAkhir(5) As String
        supplierAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)
        salesmanCat = ""

        'salesman(7) As String

        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String

            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai

        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================

        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then

        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "
        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'S') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND (t.tsumber = 'RI' OR t.tsumber = 'PRT') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        'If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "

        If Len(supplierCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & supplierCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(supplierAwal) > 0 And Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & supplierAwal & "' AND '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & supplierAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        End If
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtSupplier As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA SUPPLIER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN VOUCHER PER KONTAK --------------------------------------------
        If dtSupplier.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING
            Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
            Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
            If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
            If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If


            'AMBIL SETTING UMUR ----------------------------------------------------
            Dim umur1 As Double = 0, umur2 As Double = 0, umur3 As Double = 0, umur4 As Double = 0, umur5 As Double = 0
            Dim umur6 As Double = 0, umur7 As Double = 0, umur8 As Double = 0, umur9 As Double = 0, umur10 As Double = 0
            sql = "  SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting'"
            sql &= " AND (skode = 'UmurHutang1' OR skode = 'UmurHutang2' OR skode = 'UmurHutang3' OR skode = 'UmurHutang4'"
            sql &= " OR skode = 'UmurHutang5' OR skode = 'UmurHutang6' OR skode = 'UmurHutang7' OR skode = 'UmurHutang8'"
            sql &= " OR skode = 'UmurHutang9' OR skode = 'UmurHutang10')"
            Dim DtUmur As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If DtUmur.Rows.Count >= 10 Then
                umur1 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang1'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur1) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 1 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur2 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang2'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur2) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 2 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur3 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang3'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur3) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 3 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur4 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang4'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur4) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 4 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur5 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang5'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur5) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 5 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur6 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang6'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur6) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 6 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur7 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang7'", Double.NaN))

                If Double.IsNaN(umur8) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 8 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur9 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang9'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur9) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 9 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur10 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang10'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur10) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 10 setting value." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                result(2) = "Setting AP Aging not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL SETTING UMUR ---------------------------------------------


            Dim dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSSubtotal As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsionalRI As String = "", sqlValasRI As String = ""
            Dim sqlFungsionalPRT As String = "", sqlValasPRT As String = ""
            Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSubtotal As String = ""
            Dim urut As Double = 1, urutSAkhir As Double = 1, idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG VOUCHER PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtSupplier.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL
                'RI FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsionalRI = "  SELECT t.apid, t.aptgl, t.apsumber, t.apnotransaksi, t.apkontak, t.apkontakkode, t.apkontaknama, t.apalamat1, t.apalamat2, t.apalamat3, t.apalamat4, t.apalamat5, t.apnotelp1, t.apnotelp2, t.apnorek, t.apmatauang, t.apkurs, t.apuraian, t.apcatatan, t.aptotal, SUM(t.apbayar) as apbayar, t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) as apsisa, t.aptgljatuhtempo, t.apstatuslunas, t.aptgllunas, t.apinputtgl, t.apisfungsional, t.apissaldoakhir, "

                'UMUR NEGATIF +++++++++++++++++++++++
                'UMUR_1         : JIKA UMUR1 = 0 MAKA 0, JIKA TGLJT < UMUR1 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur1) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) ELSE 0 END) as apumur_1, "
                'UMUR1          : JIKA UMUR1 = 0 DAN UMUR2 = 0 MAKA 0,                                              JIKA UMUR1 = 0 DAN UMUR2 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR2 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                          JIKA UMUR1 <> 0 DAN UMUR2 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR2 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR1 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur2) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur2) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur1) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) ELSE 0 END) as apumur1, "
                'UMUR2          : JIKA UMUR2 = 0 DAN UMUR3 = 0 MAKA 0,                                               JIKA UMUR2 = 0 DAN UMUR3 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR3 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                         JIKA UMUR2 <> 0 DAN UMUR3 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR3 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR2 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur3) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur3) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',t.aptgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur2) & " THEN t.aptotal - SUM(t.apbayar) ELSE 0 END) as apumur2, "

                    strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgl"))) & "', '" &                     'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                    urutSAkhir += 1

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT
                    urut += 1
                Next
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL TOTAL VOUCHER SEMUA KONTAK ==============


            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            'SALDO TOTAL
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging(apnourut, idlogin, apid, aptgl, apsumber, apnotransaksi, apkontak, apkontakkode, apkontaknama, apalamat1, apalamat2, apalamat3, apalamat4, apalamat5, apnotelp1, apnotelp2, apnorek, apmatauang, apkurs, apuraian, apcatatan, aptotal, apbayar, apsisa, aptgljatuhtempo, apstatuslunas, aptgllunas, apinputtgl, apisfungsional, apissaldoakhir, apumur_1, apumur1, apumur2, apumur3, apumur4, apumur5, apumur6, apumur7, apumur8, apumur9, apumur10, apumur_10, idmsmq, apuserid, apcustomtext1, apcustomtext2, apcustomtext3, apcustomtext4, apcustomtext5, apcustomint1, apcustomint2, apcustomint3, apcustomint4, apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1, apcustomdbl2, apcustomdbl3, apcustomdbl4, apcustomdbl5, apcustomdate1, apcustomdate2, apcustomdate3, apcustomdate4, apcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

selesai:

        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_GiroVoucher(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN GIRO PERTANGGAL

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, tglJTAwal(2) As String, tglJTAkhir(3) As String, 
        'kontakAwal(4) As String, kontakAkhir(5) As String, bankAwal(6) As String, bankAkhir(7) As String, 
        'nogiroAwal(8) As String, nogiroAkhir(9) As String, norekAwal(10) As String, norekAkhir(11) As String, 
        'matauang(12) As String, status(13) As Integer, statusJT(14) As Integer, jenisGiro(15) As Integer


        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, tglJTAwal, tglJTAkhir, 
        'kontakAwal, kontakAkhir, bankAwal, bankAkhir, 
        'nogiroAwal, nogiroAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, 
        'matauang, status, statusJT, jenisGiro

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", tglJTAwal As String = "", tglJTAkhir As String = ""
        Dim kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = "", bankAwal As String = "", bankAkhir As String = ""
        Dim nogiroAwal As String = "", nogiroAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = ""
        Dim matauang As String = "", status As Integer = 0, statusJT As Integer = 0, jenisGiro As Integer = 0

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'tglJTAwal(2) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(2)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(2)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(2))
            End If
        End If

        'tglJTAkhir(3) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(3)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(3)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(3))
            End If
        End If

        'kontakAwal(4) As String
        kontakAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'kontakAkhir(5) As String
        kontakAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'bankAwal(6) As String
        bankAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'bankAkhir(7) As String
        bankAkhir = dataDetail(7)

        'nogiroAwal(8) As String
        nogiroAwal = dataDetail(8)

        'nogiroAkhir(9) As String
        nogiroAkhir = dataDetail(9)

        'norekAwal(10) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(10)

        'norekAkhir(11) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(11)

        'matauang(12) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(12)

        'status(13) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(13)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "status required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            status = dataDetail(13)
        End If

        'statusJT(14) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(14)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(14)
        End If

        'jenisGiro(15) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(15)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "jenisGiro required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            jenisGiro = dataDetail(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Giro_Voucher ---------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Giro_Voucher
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Giro_Voucher WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Giro report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Giro_Voucher --------------------------------


        Dim sqlCair As String = "", sqlTolak As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""

        'BUAT SQL SESUAI JENIS GIRO ------------------------------------------------
        'BUAT FILTER GIRO
        'JENIS GIRO
        Filter &= " WHERE gl.gljenis = '" & FixDouble(jenisGiro) & "'"
        'TANGGAL
        Filter &= " AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        'TANGGAL JT
        If Len(tglJTAwal) > 0 And Len(tglJTAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TANGGAL JT AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND gl.gltgljthtempo BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglJTAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TANGGAL JT AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER TANGGAL JT >= TANGGAL JT AWAL
            Filter &= " AND gl.gltgljthtempo >= '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglJTAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TANGGAL JT AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER TANGGAL JT <= TANGGAL JT AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND gl.gltgljthtempo <= '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'KONTAK
        If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KONTAK AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND c.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KONTAK AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= KONTAK AWAL
            Filter &= " AND c.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KONTAK AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= KONTAK AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND c.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'BANK
        If Len(bankAwal) > 0 And Len(bankAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BANK AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND gl.glbank BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(bankAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(bankAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(bankAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BANK AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER BANK >= BANK AWAL
            Filter &= " AND gl.glbank >= '" & FixQuotes(bankAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(bankAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BANK AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BANK <= BANK AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND gl.glbank <= '" & FixQuotes(bankAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'NOGIRO
        If Len(nogiroAwal) > 0 And Len(nogiroAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOGIRO AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND gl.glnogiro BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(nogiroAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(nogiroAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(nogiroAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOGIRO AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER NOGIRO >= NOGIRO AWAL
            Filter &= " AND gl.glnogiro >= '" & FixQuotes(nogiroAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(nogiroAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOGIRO AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER NOGIRO <= NOGIRO AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND gl.glnogiro <= '" & FixQuotes(nogiroAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOREK AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND gl.glrekbank BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOREK AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER NOREK >= NOREK AWAL
            Filter &= " AND gl.glrekbank >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOREK AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER NOREK <= NOREK AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND gl.glrekbank <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'MATAUANG
        If Len(matauang) > 0 Then
            Filter &= " AND gl.glmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "'"
        End If
        'STATUS JT, 0 = belum, 1 = sudah, 2 = semua
        Filter &= " AND (CASE '" & FixDouble(statusJT) & "' WHEN 0 THEN gl.gltgljthtempo > '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' WHEN 1 THEN gl.gltgljthtempo <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' ELSE gl.gltgljthtempo LIKE '%' END) "


        'BUAT QUERY
        If jenisGiro = 0 Then
            'JIKA JENIS = 0, MAKA GIRO MASUK : AMBIL DARI M2_RG DAN M2_RGC
            'M2_RG
            sqlCair = "  SELECT gl.glnogiro, gl.glsumber, gl.glidtransaksi, gl.glnotransaksi, t.ttgl as gltgl, gl.glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, gl.glrekbank, coa1.cnama as glrekbanknama, gl.glrekgiro, coa2.cnama as glrekgironama, gl.gljenis, gl.glbank, b.bnama as glbanknama, gl.glnoacbank, gl.glmatauang, gl.glkurs, gl.gljumlah, gl.gljumlahvalas, gl.gltgljthtempo, gl.gltglcair, gl.glstatus, gl.glstatussebelumnya, gl.glurutan, rg.rgsumber as gltrans, 1 as gljenistrans, rg.rgnotransaksi as glnotrans, rg.rgtgl as gltgltrans, rg.rginputtgl as glinputtgltrans, rg.rgmodifikasitgl as glmodifikasitgltrans "
            sqlCair &= " FROM m2_rg_detail rgd"
            sqlCair &= " JOIN m2_rg rg ON rgd.idrg = rg.rgid AND rg.rgstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND rg.rgtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
            sqlCair &= " RIGHT JOIN m2_giro_list gl ON rgd.nogiro = gl.glnogiro"
            sqlCair &= " JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON gl.glnotransaksi = t.tnotransaksi"
            sqlCair &= " JOIN m1_contact c ON gl.glkontak = c.kid"
            sqlCair &= " JOIN m1_coa coa1 ON gl.glrekbank = coa1.cnomor"
            sqlCair &= " JOIN m1_coa coa2 ON gl.glrekgiro = coa2.cnomor"
            sqlCair &= " LEFT JOIN m1_bank b ON gl.glbank = b.bkode"
            'FILTER
            sqlCair &= Filter
            'GROUP BY
            sqlCair &= " GROUP BY gl.glnogiro"

            'M2_RGC
            sqlTolak = "  SELECT gl.glnogiro, gl.glsumber, gl.glidtransaksi, gl.glnotransaksi, t.ttgl as gltgl, gl.glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, gl.glrekbank, coa1.cnama as glrekbanknama, gl.glrekgiro, coa2.cnama as glrekgironama, gl.gljenis, gl.glbank, b.bnama as glbanknama, gl.glnoacbank, gl.glmatauang, gl.glkurs, gl.gljumlah, gl.gljumlahvalas, gl.gltgljthtempo, gl.gltglcair, gl.glstatus, gl.glstatussebelumnya, gl.glurutan, rgc.rgcsumber as gltrans, rgc.rgcjenis as gljenistrans, rgc.rgcnotransaksi as glnotrans, rgc.rgctgl as gltgltrans, rgc.rgcinputtgl as glinputtgltrans, rgc.rgcmodifikasitgl as glmodifikasitgltrans "
            sqlTolak &= " FROM m2_rgc_detail rgcd"
            sqlTolak &= " JOIN m2_rgc rgc ON rgcd.idrgc = rgc.rgcid AND rgc.rgcstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND rgc.rgctgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
            sqlTolak &= " RIGHT JOIN m2_giro_list gl ON rgcd.nogiro = gl.glnogiro"
            sqlTolak &= " JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON gl.glnotransaksi = t.tnotransaksi"
            sqlTolak &= " JOIN m1_contact c ON gl.glkontak = c.kid"
            sqlTolak &= " JOIN m1_coa coa1 ON gl.glrekbank = coa1.cnomor"
            sqlTolak &= " JOIN m1_coa coa2 ON gl.glrekgiro = coa2.cnomor"
            sqlTolak &= " LEFT JOIN m1_bank b ON gl.glbank = b.bkode"
            'FILTER
            sqlTolak &= Filter
            'GROUP BY
            sqlTolak &= " GROUP BY gl.glnogiro"

        Else
            'JIKA JENIS <> 0, MAKA GIRO KELUAR : AMBIL DARI M2_SG DAN M2_SGC
            'M2_SG
            sqlCair = "  SELECT gl.glnogiro, gl.glsumber, gl.glidtransaksi, gl.glnotransaksi, t.ttgl as gltgl, gl.glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, gl.glrekbank, coa1.cnama as glrekbanknama, gl.glrekgiro, coa2.cnama as glrekgironama, gl.gljenis, gl.glbank, b.bnama as glbanknama, gl.glnoacbank, gl.glmatauang, gl.glkurs, gl.gljumlah, gl.gljumlahvalas, gl.gltgljthtempo, gl.gltglcair, gl.glstatus, gl.glstatussebelumnya, gl.glurutan, sg.sgsumber as gltrans, 1 as gljenistrans, sg.sgnotransaksi as glnotrans, sg.sgtgl as gltgltrans, sg.sginputtgl as glinputtgltrans, sg.sgmodifikasitgl as glmodifikasitgltrans "
            sqlCair &= " FROM m2_sg_detail sgd"
            sqlCair &= " JOIN m2_sg sg ON sgd.idsg = sg.sgid AND sg.sgstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND sg.sgtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
            sqlCair &= " RIGHT JOIN m2_giro_list gl ON sgd.nogiro = gl.glnogiro"
            sqlCair &= " JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON gl.glnotransaksi = t.tnotransaksi"
            sqlCair &= " JOIN m1_contact c ON gl.glkontak = c.kid"
            sqlCair &= " JOIN m1_coa coa1 ON gl.glrekbank = coa1.cnomor"
            sqlCair &= " JOIN m1_coa coa2 ON gl.glrekgiro = coa2.cnomor"
            sqlCair &= " LEFT JOIN m1_bank b ON gl.glbank = b.bkode"
            'FILTER
            sqlCair &= Filter
            'GROUP BY
            sqlCair &= " GROUP BY gl.glnogiro"

            'M2_SGC
            sqlTolak = "  SELECT gl.glnogiro, gl.glsumber, gl.glidtransaksi, gl.glnotransaksi, t.ttgl as gltgl, gl.glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, gl.glrekbank, coa1.cnama as glrekbanknama, gl.glrekgiro, coa2.cnama as glrekgironama, gl.gljenis, gl.glbank, b.bnama as glbanknama, gl.glnoacbank, gl.glmatauang, gl.glkurs, gl.gljumlah, gl.gljumlahvalas, gl.gltgljthtempo, gl.gltglcair, gl.glstatus, gl.glstatussebelumnya, gl.glurutan, sgc.sgcsumber as gltrans, sgc.sgcjenis as gljenistrans, sgc.sgcnotransaksi as glnotrans, sgc.sgctgl as gltgltrans, sgc.sgcinputtgl as glinputtgltrans, sgc.sgcmodifikasitgl as glmodifikasitgltrans "
            sqlTolak &= " FROM m2_sgc_detail sgcd"
            sqlTolak &= " JOIN m2_sgc sgc ON sgcd.idsgc = sgc.sgcid AND sgc.sgcstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND sgc.sgctgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
            sqlTolak &= " RIGHT JOIN m2_giro_list gl ON sgcd.nogiro = gl.glnogiro"
            sqlTolak &= " JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON gl.glnotransaksi = t.tnotransaksi"
            sqlTolak &= " JOIN m1_contact c ON gl.glkontak = c.kid"
            sqlTolak &= " JOIN m1_coa coa1 ON gl.glrekbank = coa1.cnomor"
            sqlTolak &= " JOIN m1_coa coa2 ON gl.glrekgiro = coa2.cnomor"
            sqlTolak &= " LEFT JOIN m1_bank b ON gl.glbank = b.bkode"
            'FILTER
            sqlTolak &= Filter
            'GROUP BY
            sqlTolak &= " GROUP BY gl.glnogiro"

        End If

        'GABUNGKAN QUERY
        sqlJadi = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, mygiro.*, (CASE WHEN mygiro.gltrans IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN mygiro.gljenistrans = 1 AND LENGTH(mygiro.glnotrans) THEN 1 WHEN mygiro.gljenistrans = 2 AND LENGTH(mygiro.glnotrans) THEN 2 WHEN mygiro.gljenistrans = 3 AND LENGTH(mygiro.glnotrans) THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) as glcairtrans, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as gluserid, '' as glcustomtext1, '' as glcustomtext2, '' as glcustomtext3, '' as glcustomtext4, '' as glcustomtext5, 0 as glcustomint1, 0 as glcustomint2, 0 as glcustomint3, 0 as glcustomint4, 0 as glcustomint5, 0 as glcustomdbl1, 0 as glcustomdbl2, 0 as glcustomdbl3, 0 as glcustomdbl4, 0 as glcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as glcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as glcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as glcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as glcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as glcustomdate5 FROM ("
        sqlJadi &= " SELECT * FROM ("
        sqlJadi &= " " & sqlCair & " UNION ALL " & sqlTolak
        sqlJadi &= " ) as giro"
        sqlJadi &= " ORDER BY giro.glnogiro ASC, giro.gltgltrans DESC, giro.glmodifikasitgltrans DESC, giro.glinputtgltrans DESC"
        sqlJadi &= " ) as mygiro"
        sqlJadi &= " GROUP BY mygiro.glnogiro"
        'FILTER STATUS : 0 = BELUM CAIR, 1 = SUDAH CAIR, 2 = TOLAKAN, 3 = BATAL, 4 = SEMUA
        If status = 0 Then
            sqlJadi &= " HAVING mygiro.gltrans IS NULL"
        ElseIf status = 1 Then
            sqlJadi &= " HAVING mygiro.gljenistrans = 1 AND LENGTH(mygiro.glnotrans) > 0"
        ElseIf status = 2 Then
            sqlJadi &= " HAVING mygiro.gljenistrans = 2 AND LENGTH(mygiro.glnotrans) > 0"
        ElseIf status = 3 Then
            sqlJadi &= " HAVING mygiro.gljenistrans = 3 AND LENGTH(mygiro.glnotrans) > 0"
        End If
        'END OF BUAT SQL SESUAI JENIS GIRO -----------------------------------------


        'INSERT DATA KE TABEL PEMBANTU REPORT
        sql = "INSERT INTO M2r_Giro_Voucher (" & sqlJadi & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Giro data." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '100' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Giro data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_GiroVoucher_PerBank(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN GIRO PERTANGGAL

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, tglJTAwal(2) As String, tglJTAkhir(3) As String, 
        'kontakAwal(4) As String, kontakAkhir(5) As String, bankAwal(6) As String, bankAkhir(7) As String, 
        'nogiroAwal(8) As String, nogiroAkhir(9) As String, norekAwal(10) As String, norekAkhir(11) As String, 
        'matauang(12) As String, status(13) As Integer, statusJT(14) As Integer, jenisGiro(15) As Integer, orderBy(16) As String


        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, tglJTAwal, tglJTAkhir, 
        'kontakAwal, kontakAkhir, bankAwal, bankAkhir, 
        'nogiroAwal, nogiroAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, 
        'matauang, status, statusJT, jenisGiro, orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", tglJTAwal As String = "", tglJTAkhir As String = ""
        Dim kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = "", bankAwal As String = "", bankAkhir As String = ""
        Dim nogiroAwal As String = "", nogiroAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = ""
        Dim matauang As String = "", status As Integer = 0, statusJT As Integer = 0, jenisGiro As Integer = 0
        Dim orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 17) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'tglJTAwal(2) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(2)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(2)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(2))
            End If
        End If

        'tglJTAkhir(3) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(3)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(3)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(3))
            End If
        End If

        'kontakAwal(4) As String
        kontakAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'kontakAkhir(5) As String
        kontakAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'bankAwal(6) As String
        bankAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'bankAkhir(7) As String
        bankAkhir = dataDetail(7)

        'nogiroAwal(8) As String
        nogiroAwal = dataDetail(8)

        'nogiroAkhir(9) As String
        nogiroAkhir = dataDetail(9)

        'norekAwal(10) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(10)

        'norekAkhir(11) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(11)

        'matauang(12) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(12)

        'status(13) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(13)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "status required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            status = dataDetail(13)
        End If

        'statusJT(14) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(14)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else

        End If

        'jenisGiro(15) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(15)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "jenisGiro required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            jenisGiro = dataDetail(15)
        End If

        'orderBy(16) As String
        orderBy = dataDetail(16)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Giro_Voucher ---------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Giro_Voucher
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Giro_Voucher WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Giro report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Giro_Voucher --------------------------------


        Dim dtBank As New DataTable, dtGiro As New DataTable, sqlBank As String = "", bank As String = ""
        Dim sqlCair As String = "", sqlTolak As String = "", sqlCairValas As String = "", sqlTolakValas As String = ""
        Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlJadiValas As String = "", sqlGabung As String = ""
        Dim urut As Double = 1, urutSAkhir As Double = 1
        Dim sqlSubtotal As String = "", dtSubtotal As New DataTable


        'BUAT FILTER GIRO ----------------------------------------------------------
        'JENIS GIRO
        Filter &= " WHERE gl.gljenis = '" & FixDouble(jenisGiro) & "'"
        'TANGGAL
        Filter &= " AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        'TANGGAL JT
        If Len(tglJTAwal) > 0 And Len(tglJTAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TANGGAL JT AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND gl.gltgljthtempo BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglJTAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TANGGAL JT AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER TANGGAL JT >= TANGGAL JT AWAL
            Filter &= " AND gl.gltgljthtempo >= '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglJTAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TANGGAL JT AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER TANGGAL JT <= TANGGAL JT AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND gl.gltgljthtempo <= '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'KONTAK
        If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KONTAK AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND c.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KONTAK AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= KONTAK AWAL
            Filter &= " AND c.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KONTAK AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= KONTAK AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND c.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'BANK
        If Len(bankAwal) > 0 And Len(bankAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BANK AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND gl.glbank BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(bankAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(bankAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(bankAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BANK AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER BANK >= BANK AWAL
            Filter &= " AND gl.glbank >= '" & FixQuotes(bankAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(bankAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BANK AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BANK <= BANK AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND gl.glbank <= '" & FixQuotes(bankAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'NOGIRO
        If Len(nogiroAwal) > 0 And Len(nogiroAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOGIRO AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND gl.glnogiro BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(nogiroAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(nogiroAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(nogiroAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOGIRO AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER NOGIRO >= NOGIRO AWAL
            Filter &= " AND gl.glnogiro >= '" & FixQuotes(nogiroAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(nogiroAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOGIRO AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER NOGIRO <= NOGIRO AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND gl.glnogiro <= '" & FixQuotes(nogiroAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOREK AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND gl.glrekbank BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOREK AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER NOREK >= NOREK AWAL
            Filter &= " AND gl.glrekbank >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA NOREK AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER NOREK <= NOREK AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND gl.glrekbank <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'MATAUANG
        If Len(matauang) > 0 Then
            Filter &= " AND gl.glmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "'"
        End If
        'STATUS JT, 0 = belum, 1 = sudah, 2 = semua
        Filter &= " AND (CASE '" & FixDouble(statusJT) & "' WHEN 0 THEN gl.gltgljthtempo > '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' WHEN 1 THEN gl.gltgljthtempo <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' ELSE gl.gltgljthtempo LIKE '%' END) "
        'END OF BUAT FILTER GIRO ---------------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL DATA BANK -----------------------------------------------------------
        sqlBank = "  SELECT gl.glbank"
        sqlBank &= " FROM m2_giro_list gl"
        sqlBank &= " JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON gl.glnotransaksi = t.tnotransaksi"
        sqlBank &= " JOIN m1_contact c ON gl.glkontak = c.kid"
        'FILTER
        sqlBank &= Filter
        'GROUP BY
        sqlBank &= " GROUP BY gl.glbank"
        'ORDER BY
        sqlBank &= " ORDER BY gl.glbank"

        dtBank = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlBank, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA BANK ----------------------------------------------------


        'BUAT SQL SESUAI JENIS GIRO ------------------------------------------------
        If dtBank.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ------------------------------------
            Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
            Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
            If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
            If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING -----------------------------

            For Each dr As DataRow In dtBank.Rows
                'SET BANK
                bank = dr("glbank")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                If jenisGiro = 0 Then
                    'JIKA JENIS = 0, MAKA GIRO MASUK : AMBIL DARI M2_RG DAN M2_RGC
                    'M2_RG FUNGSIONAL
                    sqlCair = "  SELECT gl.glnogiro, gl.glsumber, gl.glidtransaksi, gl.glnotransaksi, t.ttgl as gltgl, gl.glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, gl.glrekbank, coa1.cnama as glrekbanknama, gl.glrekgiro, coa2.cnama as glrekgironama, gl.gljenis, gl.glbank, b.bnama as glbanknama, gl.glnoacbank, '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as glmatauang, '" & FixDouble(kursFungsional) & "' as glkurs, gl.gljumlah, gl.gljumlahvalas, gl.gltgljthtempo, gl.gltglcair, gl.glstatus, gl.glstatussebelumnya, gl.glurutan, rg.rgsumber as gltrans, 1 as gljenistrans, rg.rgnotransaksi as glnotrans, rg.rgtgl as gltgltrans, rg.rginputtgl as glinputtgltrans, rg.rgmodifikasitgl as glmodifikasitgltrans "
                    sqlCair &= " FROM m2_rg_detail rgd"

                'GABUNGKAN QUERY FUNGSIONAL
                sqlJadi = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, mygiro.*, (CASE WHEN mygiro.gltrans IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN mygiro.gljenistrans = 1 AND LENGTH(mygiro.glnotrans) THEN 1 WHEN mygiro.gljenistrans = 2 AND LENGTH(mygiro.glnotrans) THEN 2 WHEN mygiro.gljenistrans = 3 AND LENGTH(mygiro.glnotrans) THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) as glcairtrans, (CASE mygiro.glmatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as glisfungsional, 0 as glissaldoakhir, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as gluserid, '' as glcustomtext1, '' as glcustomtext2, '' as glcustomtext3, '' as glcustomtext4, '' as glcustomtext5, 0 as glcustomint1, 0 as glcustomint2, 0 as glcustomint3, 0 as glcustomint4, 0 as glcustomint5, 0 as glcustomdbl1, 0 as glcustomdbl2, 0 as glcustomdbl3, 0 as glcustomdbl4, 0 as glcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as glcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as glcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as glcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as glcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as glcustomdate5 FROM ("

                ElseIf status = 2 Then
                    sqlJadi &= " HAVING mygiro.gljenistrans = 2 AND LENGTH(mygiro.glnotrans) > 0"
                ElseIf status = 3 Then

FixQuotes(dr1("glcustomtext4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("glcustomtext5")) & "', " & dr1("glcustomint1") & ", " & dr1("glcustomint2") & ", " & dr1("glcustomint3") & ", " & dr1("glcustomint4") & ", " & dr1("glcustomint5") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("glcustomdbl1")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glcustomdbl2")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glcustomdbl3")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glcustomdbl4")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("glcustomdbl5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("glcustomdate1"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("glcustomdate2"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("glcustomdate3"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("glcustomdate4"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("glcustomdate5"))) & "')")

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                    urutSAkhir += 1

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT
                    urut += 1
                Next
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL TOTAL VOUCHER SEMUA BANK ==============


            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            'INSERT DATA KE TABEL PEMBANTU REPORT
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "INSERT INTO M2r_Giro_Voucher (idlogin, glnourut, glnogiro, glsumber, glidtransaksi, glnotransaksi, gltgl, glkontak, glkontakkode, glkontaknama, glrekbank, glrekbanknama, glrekgiro, glrekgironama, gljenis, glbank, glbanknama, glnoacbank, glmatauang, glkurs, gljumlah, gljumlahvalas, gltgljthtempo, gltglcair, glstatus, glstatussebelumnya, glurutan, gltrans, gljenistrans, glnotrans, gltgltrans, glinputtgltrans, glmodifikasitgltrans, glcairtrans, glisfungsional, glissaldoakhir, idmsmq, gluserid, glcustomtext1, glcustomtext2, glcustomtext3, glcustomtext4, glcustomtext5, glcustomint1, glcustomint2, glcustomint3, glcustomint4, glcustomint5, glcustomdbl1, glcustomdbl2, glcustomdbl3, glcustomdbl4, glcustomdbl5, glcustomdate1, glcustomdate2, glcustomdate3, glcustomdate4, glcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing total Giro." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
            'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBank.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtBank.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Total Giro." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================
            'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA GIRO ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++


        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String

            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai

                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))

        End If

            End If

        'kontakAwal(4) As String

        kontakAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        bankAwal = dataDetail(6)

        bankAkhir = dataDetail(7)
