        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG BULAN INI ===================
        stepKe = 2
        rsHitung = M0_HitungRealisasi(idLogin & "★M0_HitungRealisasi★0△0△△△dd/MM/yyyy△dd/MM/yyyy H:mm:ss★" & userid & "★0★" & tahun & sptField & bulan)
        rsHitungSplit = rsHitung.Split(sptSubParam)
        'FORMAT KEMBALIAN = NamaFungsi△isSuccess△errMessage△errStep△idtransaksi★0△0△0△0△0★ ----> M0_HitungRealisasi△1△△0△0★0△0△0△0△0★
        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then
            'JIKA ISSUCCESS <> 1 MAKA KIRIM INFORMASI PROSES GAGAL
            result(2) = rsHitungSplit(2) & " : " & tahun & " - " & bulan : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HITUNG REALISASI BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU --------------------------


        'PROSES AKTIVA =============================================================
        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        stepKe = 3
        Dim sqlBulanIni As String = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim sqlBulanLalu As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
        sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        Dim dt As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'DEKLARASI UNTUK SIMPAN LEVEL INDUK
            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim urut As Integer = 1, currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0'")
            End If

            'PERULANGAN BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU (M2r_Posisi_Keuangan)
            dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If

                'JIKA LEVEL AKUN < LEVEL PARAMETER, MAKA SIMPAN AKUN UNTUK DITAMPILKAN SEBAGAI SUBTOTAL
                If currLevel < level Then
                    'tanda kurung diawal sengaja dikosongi, untuk mengisi urutan saat insert ke tabel
                    'mapping :                                 idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                                                      pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strInduk(currLevel) = "'" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & String.Concat("Total ", FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama"))) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')"
                End If

                'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'jika currLevel = level, maka saldo ditampilkan. jika currlevel <> level maka saldo diisi 0
                'mapping :                            idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                                                  pkdebit,                                                        pkkredit,                                                        pksaldo,                                                        pkdebitlalu,                                                        pkkreditlalu,                                                        pksaldolalu,                                                        pkdebitvariasi,                                                        pkkreditvariasi,                                                        pksaldovariasi,                                 idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")), 0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                'increament urutan
                urut += 1

                'SET PREVIOUS LEVEL
                prevLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))
            Next

            'INSERT AKUN INDUK YANG TERSISA
            For i = 1 To level
                If Len(strInduk(level - i)) > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                    'increament urutan
                    urut += 1
                End If
            Next

            If level = 1 Then
                'INSERT TOTAL ASET
                sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
                sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
                'QUERY AMBIL DATA TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
                sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pknorek, CONCAT('Total ', GROUP_CONCAT(s.pknoreknama ORDER BY s.pknorek SEPARATOR ' dan ')) as pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, SUM(s.pkdebit) as pkdebit, SUM(s.pkkredit) as pkkredit, SUM(s.pksaldo) as pksaldo, SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitlalu, SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditlalu, SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldolalu, SUM(s.pkdebit) - SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitvariasi, SUM(s.pkkredit) - SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditvariasi, SUM(s.pksaldo) - SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
                sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
                sql += " JOIN "
                sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
                sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
                sql += " GROUP BY s.pklevel "
                sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

                dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If
            End If

            'SIMPAN KE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Posisi_Keuangan(pkurut, idlogin, pktahun, pkbulan, pknorek, pknoreknama, pktipe, pkgd, pkjenis, pklevel, pklevel1, pklevel2, pklevel3, pklevel4, pklevel5, pkgddata, pkleveldata, pkdebit, pkkredit, pksaldo, pkdebitlalu, pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu, pkdebitvariasi, pkkreditvariasi, pksaldovariasi, idmsmq, pkuserid, pkcustomtext1, pkcustomtext2, pkcustomtext3, pkcustomtext4, pkcustomtext5, pkcustomint1, pkcustomint2, pkcustomint3, pkcustomint4, pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1, pkcustomdbl2, pkcustomdbl3, pkcustomdbl4, pkcustomdbl5, pkcustomdate1, pkcustomdate2, pkcustomdate3, pkcustomdate4, pkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing balance sheet report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If

        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF PROSES AKTIVA ======================================================

        strValue.Clear()


        'VARIABEL L/R -----------------------------------------------
        Dim LB1 As String = "", LB2 As String = "", LB3 As String = "", LB4 As String = ""
        Dim LT1 As String = "", LT2 As String = "", LT3 As String = "", LT4 As String = ""
        Dim LD1 As String = "", LD2 As String = "", LD3 As String = "", LD4 As String = ""

        Dim LBDebit As Double = 0, LBKredit As Double = 0, LBSaldo As Double = 0, LBDebitlalu As Double = 0, LBKreditlalu As Double = 0
        Dim LBSaldolalu As Double = 0, LBDebitvariasi As Double = 0, LBKreditvariasi As Double = 0, LBSaldovariasi As Double = 0

        Dim LTDebit As Double = 0, LTKredit As Double = 0, LTSaldo As Double = 0, LTDebitlalu As Double = 0, LTKreditlalu As Double = 0
        Dim LTSaldolalu As Double = 0, LTDebitvariasi As Double = 0, LTKreditvariasi As Double = 0, LTSaldovariasi As Double = 0

        Dim LDDebit As Double = 0, LDKredit As Double = 0, LDSaldo As Double = 0, LDDebitlalu As Double = 0, LDKreditlalu As Double = 0
        Dim LDSaldolalu As Double = 0, LDDebitvariasi As Double = 0, LDKreditvariasi As Double = 0, LDSaldovariasi As Double = 0

        Dim sqlJadi As String = ""

        'AMBIL INDUK AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        sql = "SELECT clevel1, clevel2, clevel3, clevel4 FROM m1_coa WHERE cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "'"
        Dim DtInduk As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If DtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            LB1 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel1"), "")
            LB2 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel2"), "")
            LB3 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel3"), "")
            LB4 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel4"), "")
        Else
            result(2) = "CoA Parent for Monthly Profit/Loss not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL INDUK AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        sql = "SELECT clevel1, clevel2, clevel3, clevel4 FROM m1_coa WHERE cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "'"
        DtInduk = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If DtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            LT1 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel1"), "")
            LT2 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel2"), "")
            LT3 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel3"), "")
            LT4 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel4"), "")
        Else
            result(2) = "CoA Parent for Yearly Profit/Loss not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL INDUK AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        sql = "SELECT clevel1, clevel2, clevel3, clevel4 FROM m1_coa WHERE cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "'"
        DtInduk = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If DtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            LD1 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel1"), "")
            LD2 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel2"), "")
            LD3 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel3"), "")
            LD4 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel4"), "")
        Else
            result(2) = "CoA Parent for Retained Profit/Loss not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VARIABEL L/R ----------------------------------------


        'PROSES PASIVA =============================================================
        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        stepKe = 4
        sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
        sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'DEKLARASI UNTUK SIMPAN LEVEL INDUK
            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim urut As Integer = 1, currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                Dim filterSaldo As String = ""
                filterSaldo = "  (pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0')"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "'"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB1) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB2) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB3) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB4) & "'"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT1) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT2) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT3) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT4) & "'"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD1) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD2) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD3) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD4) & "'"
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, filterSaldo)
            End If

            'PERULANGAN BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU (M2r_Posisi_Keuangan)
            dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If

                'JIKA LEVEL AKUN < LEVEL PARAMETER, MAKA SIMPAN AKUN UNTUK DITAMPILKAN SEBAGAI SUBTOTAL
                If currLevel < level Then
                    'tanda kurung diawal sengaja dikosongi, untuk mengisi urutan saat insert ke tabel
                    'mapping :                                 idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                                                      pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strInduk(currLevel) = "'" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & String.Concat("Total ", FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama"))) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')"
                End If

                'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'jika currLevel = level, maka saldo ditampilkan. jika currlevel <> level maka saldo diisi 0
                'mapping :                            idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                                                  pkdebit,                                                        pkkredit,                                                        pksaldo,                                                        pkdebitlalu,                                                        pkkreditlalu,                                                        pksaldolalu,                                                        pkdebitvariasi,                                                        pkkreditvariasi,                                                        pksaldovariasi,                                 idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")), 0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                'increament urutan
                urut += 1

                'SET PREVIOUS LEVEL
                prevLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))
            Next

            'INSERT AKUN INDUK YANG TERSISA
            For i = 1 To level
                If Len(strInduk(level - i)) > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                    'increament urutan
                    urut += 1
                End If
            Next

            'INSERT TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
            sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'QUERY AMBIL DATA TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
            sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pknorek, CONCAT('Total ', GROUP_CONCAT(s.pknoreknama ORDER BY s.pknorek SEPARATOR ' dan ')) as pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, SUM(s.pkdebit) as pkdebit, SUM(s.pkkredit) as pkkredit, SUM(s.pksaldo) as pksaldo, SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitlalu, SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditlalu, SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldolalu, SUM(s.pkdebit) - SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitvariasi, SUM(s.pkkredit) - SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditvariasi, SUM(s.pksaldo) - SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
            sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql += " JOIN "
            sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
            sql += " GROUP BY s.pklevel "
            sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                    'increament urutan
                    urut += 1
                Next
            End If

            'SIMPAN KE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Posisi_Keuangan(pkurut, idlogin, pktahun, pkbulan, pknorek, pknoreknama, pktipe, pkgd, pkjenis, pklevel, pklevel1, pklevel2, pklevel3, pklevel4, pklevel5, pkgddata, pkleveldata, pkdebit, pkkredit, pksaldo, pkdebitlalu, pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu, pkdebitvariasi, pkkreditvariasi, pksaldovariasi, idmsmq, pkuserid, pkcustomtext1, pkcustomtext2, pkcustomtext3, pkcustomtext4, pkcustomtext5, pkcustomint1, pkcustomint2, pkcustomint3, pkcustomint4, pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1, pkcustomdbl2, pkcustomdbl3, pkcustomdbl4, pkcustomdbl5, pkcustomdate1, pkcustomdate2, pkcustomdate3, pkcustomdate4, pkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing balance sheet report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If


            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
            End If


            'PROSES PERHITUNGAN L/R -------------------------------------
            stepKe = 5

            '1. L/R BULAN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN L/R BULAN INI ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI REALISASI BULAN INI
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI REALISASI BULAN LALU
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')     WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA
            sql = "  SELECT s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql &= " JOIN "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            '2. L/R TAHUN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN AWAL TAHUN S.D. BULAN LALU) ^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN INI S.D. BULAN INI - 1

            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND ((r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') OR (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
            End If


            stepKe = 6

            'JIKA LEVEL >= 4 MAKA HITUNG L/R LEVEL 4
            If level >= 4 Then

                If LB4 = LT4 And LT4 = LD4 Then

                    sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' WHERE c.clevel = '5' AND c.clevel4 = '" & FixDouble(LB4) & "' ORDER BY c.cnomor"

                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = saldo.pkdebitvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LDDebitvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = saldo.pkkreditvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LDKreditvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = saldo.pksaldovariasi + (" & FixDouble(LDSaldovariasi) & ")"
                    sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD4) & "'"
                    sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

                        result(2) = "Failed processing Level 4 Parent Profit/Loss Account. #7" : GoTo selesai
                    End If

                End If

            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = saldo.pkkreditlalu + (" & FixDouble(LTKreditlalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = saldo.pksaldolalu + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldolalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = saldo.pkdebitvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTDebitvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = saldo.pkkreditvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTKreditvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = saldo.pksaldovariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldovariasi) & ")"
                    sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT2) & "'"
                    sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

                    'UPDATE INDUK LEVEL 2
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing Level 2 Parent Profit/Loss Account. #6" : GoTo selesai
                    End If


                    'AKUN INDUK LEVEL 2 L/R DITAHAN
                    sqlBulanIni = " SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "'))     AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' WHERE c.clevel = '5' AND c.clevel2 = '" & FixDouble(LD2) & "' ORDER BY c.cnomor"
                    sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND (r.rtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' WHERE c.clevel = '5' AND c.clevel2 = '" & FixDouble(LD2) & "' ORDER BY c.cnomor"

                    'QUERY AMBIL DATA
                    sql = "  SELECT s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
                    sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
                    sql &= " JOIN "
                    sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
                    sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

                    sqlJadi = "  UPDATE m2r_posisi_keuangan pk"
                    sqlJadi &= " JOIN (" & sql & ") as saldo"
                    sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = saldo.pkdebit + (" & FixDouble(LDDebit) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = saldo.pkkredit + (" & FixDouble(LDKredit) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = saldo.pksaldo + (" & FixDouble(LDSaldo) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = saldo.pkdebitlalu + (" & FixDouble(LDDebitlalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = saldo.pkkreditlalu + (" & FixDouble(LDKreditlalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = saldo.pksaldolalu + (" & FixDouble(LDSaldolalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = saldo.pkdebitvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LDDebitvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = saldo.pkkreditvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LDKreditvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = saldo.pksaldovariasi + (" & FixDouble(LDSaldovariasi) & ")"
                    sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD2) & "'"
                    sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

                    'UPDATE INDUK LEVEL 2
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing Level 2 Parent Profit/Loss Account. #7" : GoTo selesai
                    End If

                End If

            End If
            'END OF PROSES PERHITUNGAN L/R ------------------------------

        End If


        ''CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
        ''JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
        ''JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
        'If saldoNol <> 1 Then
        '    sql = "  DELETE FROM m2r_posisi_keuangan"
        '    sql &= " WHERE pkgddata = 'D' AND pksaldo = '0' AND pksaldolalu = '0'"
        '    sql &= " AND idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        '    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql,strcon) = False Then
        '        result(2) = "Failed filtering zero balance." : GoTo selesai
        '    End If
        'End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF PROSES PASIVA ======================================================


        'PROSES INSERT ARUS KAS ====================================================
        stepKe = 9

        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL AKUN KAS DAN SETARA KAS
        Dim saldoKas As Double = 0
        sql = "SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pksaldolalu),0) as saldokas FROM m2r_posisi_keuangan"
        sql &= " WHERE pktipe IN(0,1) AND pkgd = 'D'"
        sql &= " AND idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        Dim dtSaldoKas As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dtSaldoKas.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            saldoKas = Double.Parse(dtSaldoKas.Rows(0)("saldokas"))
        End If

        'BUAT QUERY ARUS KAS
        sql = "  SELECT pk.idlogin, (CASE WHEN pk.pktipe IN(2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8) OR pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' THEN 0 WHEN pk.pktipe IN(5) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) as pktipearuskas, pk.pktahun, pk.pkbulan, pk.pknorek, pk.pknoreknama, pk.pktipe, pk.pkgd, pk.pkjenis, pk.pklevel, pk.pksaldo, pk.pksaldolalu, pk.pksaldovariasi, (CASE pk.pkjenis WHEN 'A' THEN (CASE pk.pksaldovariasi WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE pk.pksaldovariasi * (-1) END) ELSE pk.pksaldovariasi END) as pksaldoaruskas, '" & FixDouble(saldoKas) & "' as pksaldoawalkas, pk.idmsmq, pk.pkuserid, pk.pkcustomtext1, pk.pkcustomtext2, pk.pkcustomtext3, pk.pkcustomtext4, pk.pkcustomtext5, pk.pkcustomint1, pk.pkcustomint2, pk.pkcustomint3, pk.pkcustomint4, pk.pkcustomint5, pk.pkcustomdbl1, pk.pkcustomdbl2, pk.pkcustomdbl3, pk.pkcustomdbl4, pk.pkcustomdbl5, pk.pkcustomdate1, pk.pkcustomdate2, pk.pkcustomdate3, pk.pkcustomdate4, pk.pkcustomdate5 "
        sql &= " FROM m2r_posisi_keuangan pk "
        sql &= " WHERE pk.pkgd = 'D' "
        sql &= " AND pk.pktipe IN(2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10) "
        sql &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' "
        'FILTER SALDO NOL
        If saldoNol = 0 Then
            sql &= " HAVING pksaldoaruskas <> '0' "
        End If
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' DESC, "
        sql &= " pk.pktipe = 6 DESC, pk.pktipe = 2 DESC, pk.pktipe = 3 DESC, pk.pktipe = 4 DESC, pk.pktipe = 7 DESC, "
        sql &= " pk.pktipe = 8 DESC, pk.pktipe = 5 DESC, pk.pktipe = 9 DESC, pk.pktipe = 10 DESC, pk.pknorek "


        'QUEY INSERT M2r_ArusKas
        Dim sqlInsert As String = "INSERT INTO M2r_ArusKas"
        sqlInsert &= "(" & sql & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlInsert, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed processing cash flow report. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF PROSES INSERT ARUS KAS =============================================


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_GeneralLedger_Detail(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN BUKU BESAR DETAIL (CABANG, LOKASI, COST CENTER, DIVISI, SUBDIVISI, PROYEK)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String,

        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, 
        'cabangAwal(4) As String, cabangAkhir(5) As String, lokasiAwal(6) As String, lokasiAkhir(7) As String, 
        'costCenterAwal(8) As String, costCenterAkhir(9) As String, divisiAwal(10) As String, divisiAkhir(11) As String, 
        'subdivisiAwal(12) As String, subdivisiAkhir(13) As String, proyekAwal(14) As String, proyekAkhir(15) As String, 
        'area(16) As String, kontakCategory(17) As String, customerCategory(18) As String, supplierCategory(19) As String, 
        'kontakAwal(20) As String, kontakAkhir(21) As String, salesmanCategory(22) As String, salesman(23) As String, 
        'matauang(24) As String, orderBy(25) As String, jenisGrup(26) As String, pertanggal(27) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, 
        'cabangAwal, cabangAkhir, lokasiAwal, lokasiAkhir,
        'costCenterAwal, costCenterAkhir, divisiAwal, divisiAkhir,
        'subdivisiAwal, subdivisiAkhir, proyekAwal, proyekAkhir,
        'area, kontakCategory, customerCategory, supplierCategory, 
        'kontakAwal, kontakAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, 
        'matauang, orderBy, jenisGrup, pertanggal

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)

        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = ""
        Dim cabangAwal As String = "", cabangAkhir As String = "", lokasiAwal As String = "", lokasiAkhir As String = ""
        Dim costCenterAwal As String = "", costCenterAkhir As String = "", divisiAwal As String = "", divisiAkhir As String = ""
        Dim subdivisiAwal As String = "", subdivisiAkhir As String = "", proyekAwal As String = "", proyekAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", kontakCategory As String = "", customerCategory As String = "", supplierCategory As String = ""
        Dim kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = "", salesmanCategory As String = "", salesman As String = ""
        Dim matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", jenisGrup As String = "", pertanggal As Integer = 0


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity

        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================

        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA

            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================

        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 28) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String

        costCenterAwal = dataDetail(8)

        'costCenterAkhir(9) As String

        'divisiAwal(10) As String
        divisiAwal = dataDetail(10)

        'divisiAkhir(11) As String

        'subdivisiAwal(12) As String
        subdivisiAwal = dataDetail(12)

        'subdivisiAkhir(13) As String

        'proyekAwal(14) As String
        proyekAwal = dataDetail(14)

        'proyekAkhir(15) As String
        proyekAkhir = dataDetail(15)

        'area(16) As String
        area = dataDetail(16)

        'kontakCategory(17) As String
        kontakCategory = dataDetail(17)

        'customerCategory(18) As String
        customerCategory = dataDetail(18)

        'supplierCategory(19) As String
        supplierCategory = dataDetail(19)

        'kontakAwal(20) As String
        kontakAwal = dataDetail(20)

        'kontakAkhir(21) As String
        kontakAkhir = dataDetail(21)

        'salesmanCategory(22) As String
        salesmanCategory = dataDetail(22)

        'salesman(23) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(23)

        'matauang(24) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(24)

        'jenisGrup(26) As String
        jenisGrup = dataDetail(26)
        If Len(jenisGrup) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "jenisGrup can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf jenisGrup.ToLower <> "tcabang" And jenisGrup.ToLower <> "tlokasi" And jenisGrup.ToLower <> "tcostcenter" _
                And jenisGrup.ToLower <> "tdivisi" And jenisGrup.ToLower <> "tsubdivisi" And jenisGrup.ToLower <> "tproyek" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid jenisGrup criteria." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'orderBy(25) As String
        orderBy = dataDetail(25)
        If Len(orderBy) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf jenisGrup.ToLower = "tcabang" Then
            If orderBy.ToLower <> "br.bkode" And orderBy.ToLower <> "br.bnama" Then
                result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
            End If
        ElseIf jenisGrup.ToLower = "tlokasi" Then
            If orderBy.ToLower <> "lc.lkode" And orderBy.ToLower <> "lc.lnama" Then
                result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
            End If
        ElseIf jenisGrup.ToLower = "tcostcenter" Then
            If orderBy.ToLower <> "cc.cckode" And orderBy.ToLower <> "cc.ccnama" Then
                result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
            End If
        ElseIf jenisGrup.ToLower = "tdivisi" Then
            If orderBy.ToLower <> "d.dkode" And orderBy.ToLower <> "d.dnama" Then
                result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
            End If
        ElseIf jenisGrup.ToLower = "tsubdivisi" Then
            If orderBy.ToLower <> "sd.sdkode" And orderBy.ToLower <> "sd.sdnama" Then
                result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
            End If
        ElseIf jenisGrup.ToLower = "tproyek" Then
            If orderBy.ToLower <> "p.pkode" And orderBy.ToLower <> "p.pnama" Then
                result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
            End If
        End If

        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(27)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "pertanggal required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            pertanggal = dataDetail(27)
        End If
