                If Len(supplierCategory) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & FixQuotes(supplierCategory) & "')")

                'FILTER CONTACT
                If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (t.tkontak BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (t.tkontak BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')")
                ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
                    IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (t.tkontak >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (t.tkontak >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')")
                ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (t.tkontak <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')", Filter = Filter & " AND (t.tkontak <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')")
                End If

                'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
                If Len(salesmanCategory) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCategory) & "') ", Filter = Filter & " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCategory) & "') ")

                'FILTER SALESMAN
                If Len(salesman) > 0 Then IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, Filter = Filter & " WHERE (c2.kkode = '" & FixQuotes(salesman) & "') ", Filter = Filter & " AND (c2.kkode = '" & FixQuotes(salesman) & "') ")
                sqlValas &= Filter
                sqlValas &= " GROUP BY t.tnorek, t." & jenisGrup & ", t.tmatauang"
                sqlValas &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek, t." & jenisGrup & ""

                sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & idLogin & "' as idlogin, bpid, bptgl, bpsumber, bpnotransaksi, bpkontak, bpkontakkode, bpkontaknama, bpalamat1, bpalamat2, bpalamat3, bpalamat4, bpalamat5, bpnotelp1, bpnotelp2, bpnorek, bpnoreknama, bpcabang, bpcabangnama, bplokasi, bplokasinama, bpcostcenter, bpcostcenternama, bpdivisi, bpdivisinama, bpsubdivisi, bpsubdivisinama, bpproyek, bpproyeknama, bpmatauang, bpkurs, bpuraian, bpcatatan, bpsaldoawal, bpdebit, bpkredit, bpsaldoakhir, bptgljatuhtempo, bpstatuslunas, bptgllunas, bpinputtgl, bpisfungsional, '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as bpuserid"
                sqlJadi &= " FROM ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi &= " ORDER BY bpmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' DESC, bpmatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAkhir = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                If dtSAkhir.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    'URUTAN SALDO AKHIR
                    Dim urutSAkhir As Double = 1

                    'INSERT SALDO AKHIR KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAkhir.Rows
                        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL DARI DTSAWAL DAN MUTASI DARI DTSMUTASI
                        saldoAwal = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "bpsaldoakhir", "bp" & jenisGrup.Substring(1) & " = '" & dr1("bp" & jenisGrup.Substring(1) & "") & "' AND bpmatauang = '" & dr1("bpmatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoDebit = Double.Parse(dr1("bpdebit")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "bpdebit", "bp" & jenisGrup.Substring(1) & " = '" & dr1("bp" & jenisGrup.Substring(1) & "") & "' AND bpmatauang = '" & dr1("bpmatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoKredit = Double.Parse(dr1("bpkredit")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "bpkredit", "bp" & jenisGrup.Substring(1) & " = '" & dr1("bp" & jenisGrup.Substring(1) & "") & "' AND bpmatauang = '" & dr1("bpmatauang") & "'", 0))

                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'MAPPING :         bpnourut,                          idlogin,                             bpid,                                             bptgl,                              bpsumber,                             bpnotransaksi,                             bpkontak,                             bpkontakkode,                             bpkontaknama, bpcabangnama,                             bplokasi,                             bplokasinama,                             bpcostcenter,                             bpcostcenternama,                             bpdivisi,                             bpdivisinama,                             bpsubdivisi,                             bpsubdivisinama,                             bpproyek,                             bpproyeknama,                             bpmatauang,                             bpkurs,                             bpuraian,                             bpcatatan,                      bpsaldoawal,                         bpdebit,                         bpkredit,                           bpsaldoakhir,                                             bptgljatuhtempo,                   bpstatuslunas,                                           bptgllunas,                                              bpinputtgl,                                         bpisfungsional,                 bpissaldoakhir,                        idmsmq,                             bpuserid,                   bpcustomtext1,           bpcustomtext2,           bpcustomtext3,           bpcustomtext4,           bpcustomtext5,bpcustomint1,bpcustomint2,bpcustomint3,bpcustomint4,bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1,           bpcustomdbl2,           bpcustomdbl3,           bpcustomdbl4,           bpcustomdbl5,                                      bpcustomdate1,                                      bpcustomdate2,                                      bpcustomdate3,                                      bpcustomdate4,                                      bpcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("bptgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpalamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpalamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpalamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpalamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpalamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpnoreknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpcabang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpcabangnama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bplokasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bplokasinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpcostcenter")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpcostcenternama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpdivisi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpdivisinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpsubdivisi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpsubdivisinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoDebit) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoKredit) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("bpsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("bpisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bpuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" &                         'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                        urutSAkhir += 1

                        'INCREMENT NOURUT
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If
                'END OF SALDO AKHIR =================================


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_General_Ledger_Detail(bpnourut, idlogin, bpid, bptgl, bpsumber, bpnotransaksi, bpkontak, bpkontakkode, bpkontaknama, bpalamat1, bpalamat2, bpalamat3, bpalamat4, bpalamat5, bpnotelp1, bpnotelp2, bpnorek, bpnoreknama, bpcabang, bpcabangnama, bplokasi, bplokasinama, bpcostcenter, bpcostcenternama, bpdivisi, bpdivisinama, bpsubdivisi, bpsubdivisinama, bpproyek, bpproyeknama, bpmatauang, bpkurs, bpuraian, bpcatatan, bpsaldoawal, bpdebit, bpkredit, bpsaldoakhir, bptgljatuhtempo, bpstatuslunas, bptgllunas, bpinputtgl, bpisfungsional, bpissaldoakhir, idmsmq, bpuserid, bpcustomtext1, bpcustomtext2, bpcustomtext3, bpcustomtext4, bpcustomtext5, bpcustomint1, bpcustomint2, bpcustomint3, bpcustomint4, bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1, bpcustomdbl2, bpcustomdbl3, bpcustomdbl4, bpcustomdbl5, bpcustomdate1, bpcustomdate2, bpcustomdate3, bpcustomdate4, bpcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing General Ledger : " & currGrup & " - " & norek : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtNorek.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress General Ledger : " & norek : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER NOREK +++++++++++++++++++

        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER NOREK -------------------------------------


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_HitungRealisasiCabang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//HITUNG REALISASI CABANG (M2_Realization_Branch)

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataUtama() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        Dim norekLR As String = "", strUpdate As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", vcabang As String = ""

        Dim dt As New DataTable, vtahun As Integer = 0, vbulan As Integer = 0, vkodepa As Integer = 0, isActive As Integer = 0


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================

        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'tahun(0) As integer, bulan(1) As integer, cabang(2) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'tahun, bulan, cabang


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =======================================================
        'SPILIT PARAMETER DATA
        dataUtama = paramSplit(5).Split(sptField)

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 3) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA ==========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vtahun = Integer.Parse(dataUtama(0))
        End If

        'bulan(1) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(1)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vbulan = Integer.Parse(dataUtama(1))
        End If

        'cabang(2) As String
        If (Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "cabang can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vcabang = dataUtama(2)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA ===================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =======================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'AMBIL KODE PA DARI M2_ACCOUNTING_PERIOD
        sql = "SELECT apkode, aptutupperiode FROM m2_accounting_period WHERE aptahun = '" & vtahun & "' AND apbulan = '" & vbulan & "'"
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            vkodepa = Integer.Parse(dt.Rows(0)("apkode"))
            isActive = Integer.Parse(dt.Rows(0)("aptutupperiode"))
        Else
            'result(2) = "Accounting Period not found." : GoTo selesai
            result(1) = 1 : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'JIKA PERIODE AKUNTANSI BLM TUTUP PERIODE MAKA DIHITUNG
        If isActive = 0 Then
            'AMBIL NOREK BULAN BERJALAN DARI SETTING
            Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
            If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                norekLR = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
            Else
                result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If

            'UPDATE REALISASI PADA M2_Realization_Branch MENJADI 0
            sql = "UPDATE M2_Realization_Branch SET rwjmldebit = 0, rwjmlkredit = 0 WHERE rwcabang = '" & vcabang & "' AND rwkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data." : GoTo selesai
            End If

            'VARIABEL DATATABLE UNTUK NOAKUN LEVEL 1 SD 5
            Dim dt1 As New DataTable, dt2 As New DataTable, dt3 As New DataTable, dt4 As New DataTable, dt5 As New DataTable

            'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 5
            'AMBIL NOAKUN LEVEL 5 DARI M2_TRANSACTION_JOURNAL SESUAI KODEPA
            sql = "SELECT tnorek as norek, SUM(tdebit) as debit, SUM(tkredit) as kredit FROM m2_transaction_journal WHERE tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND tcabang = '" & vcabang & "' AND tkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' GROUP BY tnorek"
            dt5 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt5.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 5
                For Each dr5 As DataRow In dt5.Rows
                    strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                    'mapping :                                            rwtahun,                      rwbulan,                 rwcabang,                           rwnorek,                            rwjmldebit,                         rwjmlkredit, rwanggaran,            rwkodepa
                    strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vcabang) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr5("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr5("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr5("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                Next
                If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                    sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Branch (rwtahun, rwbulan, rwcabang, rwnorek, rwjmldebit, rwjmlkredit, rwanggaran, rwkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rwjmldebit = VALUES(rwjmldebit), rwjmlkredit = VALUES(rwjmlkredit)"
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 5." : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If

                'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                strUpdate = ""

                'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 5 UNTUK AKUN LABARUGI BULAN BERJALAN
                'HITUNG LABARUGI PERBULAN
                'TOTAL PENDAPATAN - TOTAL BIAYA = (PENDAPATAN + PENDAPATAN LAIN) - (BIAYA + BIAYA LAIN)
                sql = "SELECT IFNULL(SUM(tkredit) - SUM(tdebit),0) as saldo FROM m2_transaction_journal JOIN m1_coa ON tnorek = cnomor WHERE tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND (ctipe = 11 OR ctipe = 14) AND tcabang = '" & vcabang & "' AND tkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"
                Dim dtPend As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                sql = "SELECT IFNULL(SUM(tdebit) - SUM(tkredit),0) as saldo FROM m2_transaction_journal JOIN m1_coa ON tnorek = cnomor WHERE tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND (ctipe = 12 OR ctipe = 13 OR ctipe = 15) AND tcabang = '" & vcabang & "' AND tkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"
                Dim dtBiaya As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

                'SET PENDAPATAN DAN BIAYA
                Dim pend As Double = 0, biaya As Double = 0
                If dtPend.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    pend = Double.Parse(dtPend.Rows(0)(0))
                End If
                If dtBiaya.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    biaya = Double.Parse(dtBiaya.Rows(0)(0))
                End If

                'BUAT QUERY HITUNG LABARUGI PERBULAN
                strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                'mapping :                                            rwtahun,                      rwbulan,                   rwcabang,                           rwnorek,                              rwjmldebit,                                                              rwjmlkredit,                             rwanggaran,            rwkodepa
                strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vcabang) & "', '" & FixQuotes(norekLR) & "', '" & IIf(pend - biaya < 0, FixDouble(Math.Abs(pend - biaya)), 0) & "', '" & IIf(pend - biaya >= 0, FixDouble(Math.Abs(pend - biaya)), 0) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")

                'UPDATE KE DATABASE AKUN LABARUGI PERBULAN
                If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                    sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Branch (rwtahun, rwbulan, rwcabang, rwnorek, rwjmldebit, rwjmlkredit, rwanggaran, rwkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rwjmldebit = rwjmldebit + VALUES(rwjmldebit), rwjmlkredit = rwjmlkredit + VALUES(rwjmlkredit)"
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data Monthly Profit/Loss." : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If

                'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                strUpdate = ""

                'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 4
                'AMBIL NOAKUN INDUK LEVEL 4 DARI M2_Realization_Branch SESUAI KODEPA
                sql = "SELECT c.clevel4 as norek, SUM(r.rwjmldebit) as debit, SUM(r.rwjmlkredit) as kredit FROM M2_Realization_Branch r JOIN m1_coa c ON r.rwnorek = c.cnomor WHERE r.rwkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' AND r.rwcabang = '" & vcabang & "' AND c.clevel = 5 GROUP BY c.clevel4"
                dt4 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dt4.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                    'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 4
                    For Each dr4 As DataRow In dt4.Rows
                        strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                        'mapping :                                            rwtahun,                      rwbulan,                    rwcabang,                           rwnorek,                            rwjmldebit,                         rwjmlkredit, rwanggaran,            rwkodepa

                    Next

                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                            result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 4." : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If

                    strUpdate = ""

                            Next
                            If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                                sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Branch (rwtahun, rwbulan, rwcabang, rwnorek, rwjmldebit, rwjmlkredit, rwanggaran, rwkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rwjmldebit = VALUES(rwjmldebit), rwjmlkredit = VALUES(rwjmlkredit)"

                            dt1 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                            If dt2.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                                'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 1
                                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt1.Rows
                                    strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")

                                Next
                                If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                                    sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Branch (rwtahun, rwbulan, rwcabang, rwnorek, rwjmldebit, rwjmlkredit, rwanggaran, rwkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rwjmldebit = VALUES(rwjmldebit), rwjmlkredit = VALUES(rwjmlkredit)"
                                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then

                                    End If
                                End If

                                'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                                strUpdate = ""

                            End If

                        End If

                    End If

                End If

            End If
        End If
        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ================================================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_HitungRealisasiLokasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//HITUNG REALISASI Lokasi (M2_Realization_Location)

        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", vLokasi As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================

        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey

        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        End If

                sql = "SELECT IFNULL(SUM(tkredit) - SUM(tdebit),0) as saldo FROM m2_transaction_journal JOIN m1_coa ON tnorek = cnomor WHERE tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND (ctipe = 11 OR ctipe = 14) AND tLokasi = '" & vLokasi & "' AND tkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"

                                    strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                                    'mapping :                                            rltahun,                      rlbulan,                      rllokasi,                           rlnorek,                            rljmldebit,                         rljmlkredit, rlanggaran,            rlkodepa
                                    strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vLokasi) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                                Next
                                If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                                    sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Location (rltahun, rlbulan, rllokasi, rlnorek, rljmldebit, rljmlkredit, rlanggaran, rlkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rljmldebit = VALUES(rljmldebit), rljmlkredit = VALUES(rljmlkredit)"
                                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                                        result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 1." : GoTo selesai
                                    End If
                                End If

                                'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                                strUpdate = ""

                            End If

                        End If

                    End If

                End If

            End If
        End If
        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ================================================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        '//HITUNG REALISASI Cost Center (M2_Realization_Cost_Center)

        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai

        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey

        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        End If

        'tahun(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then

            vtahun = Integer.Parse(dataUtama(0))
        End If

        'bulan(1) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(1)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vbulan = Integer.Parse(dataUtama(1))
        End If

        End If

        sql = "SELECT apkode, aptutupperiode FROM m2_accounting_period WHERE aptahun = '" & vtahun & "' AND apbulan = '" & vbulan & "'"
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            vkodepa = Integer.Parse(dt.Rows(0)("apkode"))
            isActive = Integer.Parse(dt.Rows(0)("aptutupperiode"))

            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then

                Next

                'HITUNG LABARUGI PERBULAN
                'TOTAL PENDAPATAN - TOTAL BIAYA = (PENDAPATAN + PENDAPATAN LAIN) - (BIAYA + BIAYA LAIN)
                sql = "SELECT IFNULL(SUM(tkredit) - SUM(tdebit),0) as saldo FROM m2_transaction_journal JOIN m1_coa ON tnorek = cnomor WHERE tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND (ctipe = 11 OR ctipe = 14) AND tCostCenter = '" & vCostCenter & "' AND tkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"

                sql = "SELECT IFNULL(SUM(tdebit) - SUM(tkredit),0) as saldo FROM m2_transaction_journal JOIN m1_coa ON tnorek = cnomor WHERE tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND (ctipe = 12 OR ctipe = 13 OR ctipe = 15 OR ctipe = 16) AND tCostCenter = '" & vCostCenter & "' AND tkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"
                Dim dtBiaya As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

                End If
                If dtBiaya.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    biaya = Double.Parse(dtBiaya.Rows(0)(0))
                End If

                'BUAT QUERY HITUNG LABARUGI PERBULAN
                strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                'mapping :                                            rcctahun,                      rccbulan,                   rcccostcenter,                           rccnorek,                              rccjmldebit,                                                              rccjmlkredit,                             rccanggaran,            rcckodepa

                    Next

        dataUtama = paramSplit(5).Split(sptField)

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 3) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA ==========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vtahun = Integer.Parse(dataUtama(0))
        End If

        'bulan(1) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(1)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vbulan = Integer.Parse(dataUtama(1))
        End If

        'CostCenter(2) As String
        If (Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "CostCenter can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vCostCenter = dataUtama(2)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA ===================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =======================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'AMBIL KODE PA DARI M2_ACCOUNTING_PERIOD
        sql = "SELECT apkode, aptutupperiode FROM m2_accounting_period WHERE aptahun = '" & vtahun & "' AND apbulan = '" & vbulan & "'"
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            vkodepa = Integer.Parse(dt.Rows(0)("apkode"))
            isActive = Integer.Parse(dt.Rows(0)("aptutupperiode"))
        Else
            'result(2) = "Accounting Period not found." : GoTo selesai
            result(1) = 1 : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'JIKA PERIODE AKUNTANSI BLM TUTUP PERIODE MAKA DIHITUNG
        If isActive = 0 Then
            'AMBIL NOREK BULAN BERJALAN DARI SETTING
            Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
            If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                norekLR = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
            Else
                result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If

            'UPDATE REALISASI PADA M2_Realization_Cost_Center MENJADI 0
            sql = "UPDATE M2_Realization_Cost_Center SET rccjmldebit = 0, rccjmlkredit = 0 WHERE rcccostcenter = '" & vCostCenter & "' AND rcckodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data." : GoTo selesai
            End If

            'VARIABEL DATATABLE UNTUK NOAKUN LEVEL 1 SD 5
            Dim dt1 As New DataTable, dt2 As New DataTable, dt3 As New DataTable, dt4 As New DataTable, dt5 As New DataTable

            'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 5
            'AMBIL NOAKUN LEVEL 5 DARI M2_TRANSACTION_JOURNAL SESUAI KODEPA
            sql = "SELECT tnorek as norek, SUM(tdebit) as debit, SUM(tkredit) as kredit FROM m2_transaction_journal WHERE tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND tCostCenter = '" & vCostCenter & "' AND tkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' GROUP BY tnorek"
            dt5 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt5.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 5
                For Each dr5 As DataRow In dt5.Rows
                    strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                    'mapping :                                            rcctahun,                      rccbulan,                 rcccostcenter,                           rccnorek,                            rccjmldebit,                         rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran,            rcckodepa
                    strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vCostCenter) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr5("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr5("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr5("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                Next
                If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                    sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Cost_Center (rcctahun, rccbulan, rcccostcenter, rccnorek, rccjmldebit, rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran, rcckodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rccjmldebit = VALUES(rccjmldebit), rccjmlkredit = VALUES(rccjmlkredit)"
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 5." : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If

                'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                strUpdate = ""

                'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 5 UNTUK AKUN LABARUGI BULAN BERJALAN
                'HITUNG LABARUGI PERBULAN
                'TOTAL PENDAPATAN - TOTAL BIAYA = (PENDAPATAN + PENDAPATAN LAIN) - (BIAYA + BIAYA LAIN)
                sql = "SELECT IFNULL(SUM(tkredit) - SUM(tdebit),0) as saldo FROM m2_transaction_journal JOIN m1_coa ON tnorek = cnomor WHERE tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND (ctipe = 11 OR ctipe = 14) AND tCostCenter = '" & vCostCenter & "' AND tkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"
                Dim dtPend As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                sql = "SELECT IFNULL(SUM(tdebit) - SUM(tkredit),0) as saldo FROM m2_transaction_journal JOIN m1_coa ON tnorek = cnomor WHERE tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND (ctipe = 12 OR ctipe = 13 OR ctipe = 15) AND tCostCenter = '" & vCostCenter & "' AND tkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "'"
                Dim dtBiaya As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

                'SET PENDAPATAN DAN BIAYA
                Dim pend As Double = 0, biaya As Double = 0
                If dtPend.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    pend = Double.Parse(dtPend.Rows(0)(0))
                End If
                If dtBiaya.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    biaya = Double.Parse(dtBiaya.Rows(0)(0))
                End If

                'BUAT QUERY HITUNG LABARUGI PERBULAN
                strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                'mapping :                                            rcctahun,                      rccbulan,                   rcccostcenter,                           rccnorek,                              rccjmldebit,                                                              rccjmlkredit,                             rccanggaran,            rcckodepa
                strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vCostCenter) & "', '" & FixQuotes(norekLR) & "', '" & IIf(pend - biaya < 0, FixDouble(Math.Abs(pend - biaya)), 0) & "', '" & IIf(pend - biaya >= 0, FixDouble(Math.Abs(pend - biaya)), 0) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")

                'UPDATE KE DATABASE AKUN LABARUGI PERBULAN
                If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                    sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Cost_Center (rcctahun, rccbulan, rcccostcenter, rccnorek, rccjmldebit, rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran, rcckodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rccjmldebit = rccjmldebit + VALUES(rccjmldebit), rccjmlkredit = rccjmlkredit + VALUES(rccjmlkredit)"
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data Monthly Profit/Loss." : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If

                'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                strUpdate = ""

                'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 4
                'AMBIL NOAKUN INDUK LEVEL 4 DARI M2_Realization_Cost_Center SESUAI KODEPA
                sql = "SELECT c.clevel4 as norek, SUM(r.rccjmldebit) as debit, SUM(r.rccjmlkredit) as kredit FROM M2_Realization_Cost_Center r JOIN m1_coa c ON r.rccnorek = c.cnomor WHERE r.rcckodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & vCostCenter & "' AND c.clevel = 5 GROUP BY c.clevel4"
                dt4 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dt4.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                    'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 4
                    For Each dr4 As DataRow In dt4.Rows
                        strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                        'mapping :                                            rcctahun,                      rccbulan,                    rcccostcenter,                           rccnorek,                            rccjmldebit,                         rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran,            rcckodepa
                        strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vCostCenter) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr4("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr4("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr4("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                    Next
                    If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                        sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Cost_Center (rcctahun, rccbulan, rcccostcenter, rccnorek, rccjmldebit, rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran, rcckodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rccjmldebit = VALUES(rccjmldebit), rccjmlkredit = VALUES(rccjmlkredit)"
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                            result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 4." : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If

                    'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                    strUpdate = ""

                    'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 3
                    'AMBIL NOAKUN INDUK LEVEL 3 DARI M2_Realization_Cost_Center SESUAI KODEPA
                    sql = "SELECT c.clevel3 as norek, SUM(r.rccjmldebit) as debit, SUM(r.rccjmlkredit) as kredit FROM M2_Realization_Cost_Center r JOIN m1_coa c ON r.rccnorek = c.cnomor WHERE r.rcckodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & vCostCenter & "' AND c.clevel = 4 GROUP BY c.clevel3"
                    dt3 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                    If dt3.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                        'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 3
                        For Each dr3 As DataRow In dt3.Rows
                            strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                            'mapping :                                            rcctahun,                      rccbulan,                      rcccostcenter,                           rccnorek,                            rccjmldebit,                         rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran,            rcckodepa
                            strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vCostCenter) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr3("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr3("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr3("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                        Next
                        If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                            sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Cost_Center (rcctahun, rccbulan, rcccostcenter, rccnorek, rccjmldebit, rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran, rcckodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rccjmldebit = VALUES(rccjmldebit), rccjmlkredit = VALUES(rccjmlkredit)"
                            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                                result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 3." : GoTo selesai
                            End If
                        End If

                        'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                        strUpdate = ""

                        'AMBIL NOAKUN INDUK LEVEL 2 DARI M2_Realization_Cost_Center SESUAI KODEPA
                        sql = "SELECT c.clevel2 as norek, SUM(r.rccjmldebit) as debit, SUM(r.rccjmlkredit) as kredit FROM M2_Realization_Cost_Center r JOIN m1_coa c ON r.rccnorek = c.cnomor WHERE r.rcckodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & vCostCenter & "' AND c.clevel = 3 GROUP BY c.clevel2"
                        dt2 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                        If dt2.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                            'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 2
                            For Each dr2 As DataRow In dt2.Rows
                                strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                                'mapping :                                            rcctahun,                      rccbulan,                      rcccostcenter,                           rccnorek,                            rccjmldebit,                         rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran,            rcckodepa
                                strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vCostCenter) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr2("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr2("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr2("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                            Next
                            If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                                sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Cost_Center (rcctahun, rccbulan, rcccostcenter, rccnorek, rccjmldebit, rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran, rcckodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rccjmldebit = VALUES(rccjmldebit), rccjmlkredit = VALUES(rccjmlkredit)"
                                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                                    result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 2." : GoTo selesai
                                End If
                            End If

                            'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                            strUpdate = ""

                            'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 1
                            'AMBIL NOAKUN INDUK LEVEL 1 DARI M2_Realization_Cost_Center SESUAI KODEPA

                            dt1 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                            If dt2.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                                'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 1
                                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt1.Rows
                                    strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                                    'mapping :                                            rcctahun,                      rccbulan,                      rcccostcenter,                           rccnorek,                            rccjmldebit,                         rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran,            rcckodepa
                                    strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vCostCenter) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                                Next
                                If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                                    sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Cost_Center (rcctahun, rccbulan, rcccostcenter, rccnorek, rccjmldebit, rccjmlkredit, rccanggaran, rcckodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rccjmldebit = VALUES(rccjmldebit), rccjmlkredit = VALUES(rccjmlkredit)"
                                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                                        result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 1." : GoTo selesai
                                    End If
                                End If

                                'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                                strUpdate = ""

                            End If

                        End If

                    End If

                End If

            End If
        End If
        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ================================================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

                If dtBiaya.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                End If

                                Next

                                    sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Division (rdtahun, rdbulan, rddivisi, rdnorek, rdjmldebit, rdjmlkredit, rdanggaran, rdkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rdjmldebit = VALUES(rdjmldebit), rdjmlkredit = VALUES(rdjmlkredit)"

                                strUpdate = ""

                            End If

            End If
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

                        If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                            sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Project (rptahun, rpbulan, rpproyek, rpnorek, rpjmldebit, rpjmlkredit, rpanggaran, rpkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rpjmldebit = VALUES(rpjmldebit), rpjmlkredit = VALUES(rpjmlkredit)"
                            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                                result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 3." : GoTo selesai
                            End If
                        End If

                        'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                        strUpdate = ""

                        'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 2
                        'AMBIL NOAKUN INDUK LEVEL 2 DARI M2_Realization_Project SESUAI KODEPA
                        sql = "SELECT c.clevel2 as norek, SUM(r.rpjmldebit) as debit, SUM(r.rpjmlkredit) as kredit FROM M2_Realization_Project r JOIN m1_coa c ON r.rpnorek = c.cnomor WHERE r.rpkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' AND r.rpproyek = '" & vProyek & "' AND c.clevel = 3 GROUP BY c.clevel2"
                        dt2 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                        If dt2.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                            'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 2
                            For Each dr2 As DataRow In dt2.Rows
                                strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                                'mapping :                                            rptahun,                      rpbulan,                      rpproyek,                           rpnorek,                            rpjmldebit,                         rpjmlkredit, rpanggaran,            rpkodepa
                                strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr2("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr2("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr2("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                            Next
                            If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                                sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Project (rptahun, rpbulan, rpproyek, rpnorek, rpjmldebit, rpjmlkredit, rpanggaran, rpkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rpjmldebit = VALUES(rpjmldebit), rpjmlkredit = VALUES(rpjmlkredit)"
                                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                                    result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 2." : GoTo selesai
                                End If
                            End If

                            'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                            strUpdate = ""

                            'REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 1
                            'AMBIL NOAKUN INDUK LEVEL 1 DARI M2_Realization_Project SESUAI KODEPA
                            sql = "SELECT c.clevel1 as norek, SUM(r.rpjmldebit) as debit, SUM(r.rpjmlkredit) as kredit FROM M2_Realization_Project r JOIN m1_coa c ON r.rpnorek = c.cnomor WHERE r.rpkodepa = '" & vkodepa & "' AND r.rpproyek = '" & vProyek & "' AND c.clevel = 2 GROUP BY c.clevel1"
                            dt1 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                            If dt2.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                                'UPDATE REALISASI AKUN LEVEL 1
                                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt1.Rows
                                    strUpdate = IIf(Len(strUpdate.ToString) = 0, "", strUpdate & ", ")
                                    'mapping :                                            rptahun,                      rpbulan,                      rpproyek,                           rpnorek,                            rpjmldebit,                         rpjmlkredit, rpanggaran,            rpkodepa
                                    strUpdate = String.Concat(strUpdate, "('" & FixDouble(vtahun) & "', '" & FixDouble(vbulan) & "', '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("norek")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("debit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kredit")) & "', 0, '" & FixDouble(vkodepa) & "')")
                                Next
                                If Len(strUpdate) > 0 Then
                                    sql = "INSERT INTO M2_Realization_Project (rptahun, rpbulan, rpproyek, rpnorek, rpjmldebit, rpjmlkredit, rpanggaran, rpkodepa) VALUES " & strUpdate & " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rpjmldebit = VALUES(rpjmldebit), rpjmlkredit = VALUES(rpjmlkredit)"
                                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                                        result(2) = "Failed Updating realization data level 1." : GoTo selesai
                                    End If
                                End If

                                'RESET VARIABLE UPDATE
                                strUpdate = ""

                            End If

                        End If

                    End If

                End If

            End If
        End If
        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ================================================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ

        'END OF HITUNG REALISASI BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU --------------------------

        labaKotor(1, 0) = 0 : labaKotor(1, 1) = 0 : labaKotor(1, 2) = 0 'HPP

        'PENDAPATAN ----------------------------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 3
        strValue.Clear()

        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        Dim sqlBulanIni As String = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' as pkcabang, IFNULL(br.bnama,'') as pkcabangnama, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN M2_Realization_Branch r ON c.cnomor = r.rwnorek AND r.rwcabang = '" & FixDouble(vCabang) & "' AND (r.rwtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rwbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = '" & FixDouble(vCabang) & "' WHERE (c.ctipe = '11') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim sqlBulanLalu As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN M2_Realization_Branch r ON c.cnomor = r.rwnorek AND r.rwcabang = '" & FixDouble(vCabang) & "' AND (r.rwtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rwbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = '" & FixDouble(vCabang) & "' WHERE (c.ctipe = '11') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pkcabang, s.pkcabangnama, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
        sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        Dim dt As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'DEKLARASI UNTUK SIMPAN LEVEL INDUK
            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0'")
            End If

            'PERULANGAN BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU (M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail)
            dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If

                'JIKA LEVEL AKUN < LEVEL PARAMETER, MAKA SIMPAN AKUN UNTUK DITAMPILKAN SEBAGAI SUBTOTAL
                If currLevel < level Then
                    'tanda kurung diawal sengaja dikosongi, untuk mengisi urutan saat insert ke tabel
                    'mapping :                                 idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkcabang,                             pkcabangnama,                             pknorek,                                                      pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strInduk(currLevel) = "'" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcabang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcabangnama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & String.Concat("Total ", FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama"))) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')"
                End If

                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'jika currLevel = level, maka saldo ditampilkan. jika currlevel <> level maka saldo diisi 0
                'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkcabang,                             pkcabangnama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                                                  pkdebit,                                                        pkkredit,                                                        pksaldo,                                                        pkdebitlalu,                                                        pkkreditlalu,                                                        pksaldolalu,                                                        pkdebitvariasi,                                                        pkkreditvariasi,                                                        pksaldovariasi,                                 idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcabang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcabangnama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")), 0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                If currLevel = 1 Then

                End If

                urut += 1

                'SET PREVIOUS LEVEL
                prevLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))
            Next

            For i = 1 To level
                If Len(strInduk(level - i)) > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                    'increament urutan
                    urut += 1
                End If

            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail(pkurut, idlogin, pktahun, pkbulan, pkcabang, pkcabangnama, pknorek, pknoreknama, pktipe, pkgd, pkjenis, pklevel, pklevel1, pklevel2, pklevel3, pklevel4, pklevel5, pkgddata, pkleveldata, pkdebit, pkkredit, pksaldo, pkdebitlalu, pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu, pkdebitvariasi, pkkreditvariasi, pksaldovariasi, idmsmq, pkuserid, pkcustomtext1, pkcustomtext2, pkcustomtext3, pkcustomtext4, pkcustomtext5, pkcustomint1, pkcustomint2, pkcustomint3, pkcustomint4, pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1, pkcustomdbl2, pkcustomdbl3, pkcustomdbl4, pkcustomdbl5, pkcustomdate1, pkcustomdate2, pkcustomdate3, pkcustomdate4, pkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""

                    result(2) = "Failed processing balance sheet report." : GoTo selesai
                End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        stepKe = 4
        strValue.Clear()

        'AMBIL LEVEL TERKECIL DARI AKUN HPP
        Dim dtHpp As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT MIN(clevel), cparent FROM m1_coa WHERE ctipe = 12", strCon)
        Dim levelInduk As Integer = 0, parentHpp As String = ""
        If IsDBNull(dtHpp.Rows(0)(0)) = False Then
            levelInduk = Integer.Parse(dtHpp.Rows(0)(0)) : parentHpp = dtHpp.Rows(0)(1)

            'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
            'JIKA LEVEL TERKECIL DARI AKUN HPP > 1 DAN LEVEL < LEVEL INDUK, MAKA FILTER LEVEL -->  c.clevel <= levelInduk
            sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' as pkcabang, IFNULL(br.bnama,'') as pkcabangnama, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN M2_Realization_Branch r ON c.cnomor = r.rwnorek AND r.rwcabang = '" & FixDouble(vCabang) & "' AND (r.rwtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rwbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = '" & FixDouble(vCabang) & "' WHERE (c.ctipe = '12') AND c.clevel <= '" & IIf(levelInduk > 1 And level < levelInduk, FixDouble(levelInduk), FixDouble(level)) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN M2_Realization_Branch r ON c.cnomor = r.rwnorek AND r.rwcabang = '" & FixDouble(vCabang) & "' AND (r.rwtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rwbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = '" & FixDouble(vCabang) & "' WHERE (c.ctipe = '12') AND c.clevel <= '" & IIf(levelInduk > 1 And level < levelInduk, FixDouble(levelInduk), FixDouble(level)) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA
            sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pkcabang, s.pkcabangnama, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
            sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "

            sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

                            'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkcabang,                             pkcabangnama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,           pklevel,                     pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                 pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,           pkdebit,    pkkredit,     pksaldo, pkdebitlalu,pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu,pkdebitvariasi,pkkreditvariasi,pksaldovariasi,              idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                            strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcabang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcabangnama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & i & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("G") & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & 0 & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                            'increament urutan

                'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
                If saldoNol <> 1 Then

                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows

                    currLevel = IIf(level = 1, 1, Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel")))

                    'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                    If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                        'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                        For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                            'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                            strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
