                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkdivisi,                             pkdivisinama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkdivisi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkdivisinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If
            End If

            'SIMPAN KE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail(pkurut, idlogin, pktahun, pkbulan, pkdivisi, pkdivisinama, pknorek, pknoreknama, pktipe, pkgd, pkjenis, pklevel, pklevel1, pklevel2, pklevel3, pklevel4, pklevel5, pkgddata, pkleveldata, pkdebit, pkkredit, pksaldo, pkdebitlalu, pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu, pkdebitvariasi, pkkreditvariasi, pksaldovariasi, idmsmq, pkuserid, pkcustomtext1, pkcustomtext2, pkcustomtext3, pkcustomtext4, pkcustomtext5, pkcustomint1, pkcustomint2, pkcustomint3, pkcustomint4, pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1, pkcustomdbl2, pkcustomdbl3, pkcustomdbl4, pkcustomdbl5, pkcustomdate1, pkcustomdate2, pkcustomdate3, pkcustomdate4, pkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing balance sheet report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If

        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF PROSES AKTIVA ======================================================

        strValue.Clear()


        'VARIABEL L/R -----------------------------------------------
        Dim LB1 As String = "", LB2 As String = "", LB3 As String = "", LB4 As String = ""
        Dim LT1 As String = "", LT2 As String = "", LT3 As String = "", LT4 As String = ""
        Dim LD1 As String = "", LD2 As String = "", LD3 As String = "", LD4 As String = ""

        Dim LBDebit As Double = 0, LBKredit As Double = 0, LBSaldo As Double = 0, LBDebitlalu As Double = 0, LBKreditlalu As Double = 0
        Dim LBSaldolalu As Double = 0, LBDebitvariasi As Double = 0, LBKreditvariasi As Double = 0, LBSaldovariasi As Double = 0

        Dim LTDebit As Double = 0, LTKredit As Double = 0, LTSaldo As Double = 0, LTDebitlalu As Double = 0, LTKreditlalu As Double = 0
        Dim LTSaldolalu As Double = 0, LTDebitvariasi As Double = 0, LTKreditvariasi As Double = 0, LTSaldovariasi As Double = 0

        Dim LDDebit As Double = 0, LDKredit As Double = 0, LDSaldo As Double = 0, LDDebitlalu As Double = 0, LDKreditlalu As Double = 0
        Dim LDSaldolalu As Double = 0, LDDebitvariasi As Double = 0, LDKreditvariasi As Double = 0, LDSaldovariasi As Double = 0

        Dim sqlJadi As String = ""

        'AMBIL INDUK AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        sql = "SELECT clevel1, clevel2, clevel3, clevel4 FROM m1_coa WHERE cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "'"
        Dim DtInduk As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If DtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            LB1 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel1"), "")
            LB2 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel2"), "")
            LB3 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel3"), "")
            LB4 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel4"), "")
        Else
            result(2) = "CoA Parent for Monthly Profit/Loss not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL INDUK AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        sql = "SELECT clevel1, clevel2, clevel3, clevel4 FROM m1_coa WHERE cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "'"
        DtInduk = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If DtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            LT1 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel1"), "")
            LT2 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel2"), "")
            LT3 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel3"), "")
            LT4 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel4"), "")
        Else
            result(2) = "CoA Parent for Yearly Profit/Loss not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL INDUK AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        sql = "SELECT clevel1, clevel2, clevel3, clevel4 FROM m1_coa WHERE cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "'"
        DtInduk = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If DtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            LD1 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel1"), "")
            LD2 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel2"), "")
            LD3 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel3"), "")
            LD4 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel4"), "")
        Else
            result(2) = "CoA Parent for Retained Profit/Loss not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VARIABEL L/R ----------------------------------------


        'PROSES PASIVA =============================================================
        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        stepKe = 4
        sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vDivisi) & "' as pkdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as pkdivisinama, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pkdivisi, s.pkdivisinama, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
        sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'DEKLARASI UNTUK SIMPAN LEVEL INDUK
            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim urut As Integer = 1, currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                Dim filterSaldo As String = ""
                filterSaldo = "  (pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0')"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "'"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB1) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB2) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB3) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB4) & "'"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT1) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT2) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT3) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT4) & "'"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD1) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD2) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD3) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD4) & "'"
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, filterSaldo)
            End If

            'PERULANGAN BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU (M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail)
            dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If

                'JIKA LEVEL AKUN < LEVEL PARAMETER, MAKA SIMPAN AKUN UNTUK DITAMPILKAN SEBAGAI SUBTOTAL
                If currLevel < level Then
                    'tanda kurung diawal sengaja dikosongi, untuk mengisi urutan saat insert ke tabel
                    'mapping :                                 idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkdivisi,                             pkdivisinama,                             pknorek,                                                      pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strInduk(currLevel) = "'" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkdivisi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkdivisinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & String.Concat("Total ", FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama"))) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')"
                End If

                'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'jika currLevel = level, maka saldo ditampilkan. jika currlevel <> level maka saldo diisi 0
                'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkdivisi,                             pkdivisinama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                                                  pkdebit,                                                        pkkredit,                                                        pksaldo,                                                        pkdebitlalu,                                                        pkkreditlalu,                                                        pksaldolalu,                                                        pkdebitvariasi,                                                        pkkreditvariasi,                                                        pksaldovariasi,                                 idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkdivisi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkdivisinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")), 0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                'increament urutan
                urut += 1

                'SET PREVIOUS LEVEL
                prevLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))
            Next

            'INSERT AKUN INDUK YANG TERSISA
            For i = 1 To level
                If Len(strInduk(level - i)) > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                    'increament urutan
                    urut += 1
                End If
            Next


            'INSERT TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
            sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vDivisi) & "' as pkdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as pkdivisinama, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
            sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pkdivisi, s.pkdivisinama, s.pknorek, CONCAT('Total ', GROUP_CONCAT(s.pknoreknama ORDER BY s.pknorek SEPARATOR ' dan ')) as pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, SUM(s.pkdebit) as pkdebit, SUM(s.pkkredit) as pkkredit, SUM(s.pksaldo) as pksaldo, SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitlalu, SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditlalu, SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldolalu, SUM(s.pkdebit) - SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitvariasi, SUM(s.pkkredit) - SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditvariasi, SUM(s.pksaldo) - SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "

            sql += " JOIN "
            sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
            sql += " GROUP BY s.pklevel "
            sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkdivisi,                             pkdivisinama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkdivisi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkdivisinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail(pkurut, idlogin, pktahun, pkbulan, pkdivisi, pkdivisinama, pknorek, pknoreknama, pktipe, pkgd, pkjenis, pklevel, pklevel1, pklevel2, pklevel3, pklevel4, pklevel5, pkgddata, pkleveldata, pkdebit, pkkredit, pksaldo, pkdebitlalu, pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu, pkdebitvariasi, pkkreditvariasi, pksaldovariasi, idmsmq, pkuserid, pkcustomtext1, pkcustomtext2, pkcustomtext3, pkcustomtext4, pkcustomtext5, pkcustomint1, pkcustomint2, pkcustomint3, pkcustomint4, pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1, pkcustomdbl2, pkcustomdbl3, pkcustomdbl4, pkcustomdbl5, pkcustomdate1, pkcustomdate2, pkcustomdate3, pkcustomdate4, pkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing balance sheet report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If


            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
            End If

            stepKe = 5

            '1. L/R BULAN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN L/R BULAN INI ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI REALISASI BULAN INI
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI REALISASI BULAN LALU
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vDivisi) & "' as pkdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as pkdivisinama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rdbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rdbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            sql = "  SELECT s.pkdivisi, s.pkdivisinama, s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "

                LBKredit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkredit"), 0))
                LBSaldo = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldo"), 0))
                LBDebitlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitlalu"), 0))
                LBKreditlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditlalu"), 0))

                LBKreditvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditvariasi"), 0))

            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = " & FixDouble(LBDebitlalu) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = " & FixDouble(LBKreditlalu) & ","

            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = " & FixDouble(LBKreditvariasi) & ","

            'sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vDivisi) & "' as pkdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as pkdivisinama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rdbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rdbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vDivisi) & "' as pkdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as pkdivisinama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND ((r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rdbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') OR (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER    BY  c. cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND ((r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rdbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') OR (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            sql = "  SELECT s.pkdivisi, s.pkdivisinama, s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql &= " JOIN "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                LTDebit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebit"), 0))
                LTKredit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkredit"), 0))
                LTSaldo = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldo"), 0))
                LTDebitlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitlalu"), 0))
                LTKreditlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditlalu"), 0))
                LTSaldolalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldolalu"), 0))
                LTDebitvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitvariasi"), 0))
                LTKreditvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditvariasi"), 0))

            'sqlJadi = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail pk"
            'sqlJadi &= " JOIN (" & sql & ") as saldo"
            'sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = pk.pkdebit + (" & FixDouble(LTDebit) & "),"

            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = pk.pkdebitvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTDebitvariasi) & "),"

            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = pk.pksaldovariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldovariasi) & ")"
            'sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "'"
            'sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            sqlJadi = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail pk"
            sqlJadi &= " JOIN (" & sql & ") as saldo"
            sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = (" & FixDouble(LTDebit) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = (" & FixDouble(LTKredit) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = (" & FixDouble(LTSaldo) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = (" & FixDouble(LTDebitlalu) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = (" & FixDouble(LTKreditlalu) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = (" & FixDouble(LTSaldolalu) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = (" & FixDouble(LTDebitvariasi) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = (" & FixDouble(LTKreditvariasi) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = (" & FixDouble(LTSaldovariasi) & ")"
            sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "'"
            sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed processing Yearly Profit/Loss." : GoTo selesai
            End If


            '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI        : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN INI - 1
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN LALU - 1
            'sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vDivisi) & "' as pkdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as pkdivisinama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vDivisi) & "' as pkdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as pkdivisinama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND ((r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'    AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (r.rdtahun <= '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND ((r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (r.rdtahun <= '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vDivisi) & "' as pkdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as pkdivisinama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND ((r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (((r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "')     OR (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "'))     AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT                                                                               c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND ((r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (((r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "') OR (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA
            sql = "  SELECT s.pkdivisi, s.pkdivisinama, s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql &= " JOIN "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                LDDebit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebit"), 0))
                LDKredit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkredit"), 0))
                LDSaldo = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldo"), 0))
                LDDebitlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitlalu"), 0))
                LDKreditlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditlalu"), 0))
                LDSaldolalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldolalu"), 0))

                LDSaldovariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldovariasi"), 0))
            End If

            'UPDATE L/R DITAHAN
            'sqlJadi = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail pk"

            'sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = pk.pkdebit + (" & FixDouble(LDDebit) & "),"

            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = pk.pksaldo + (" & FixDouble(LDSaldo) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = pk.pkdebitlalu + (" & FixDouble(LDDebitlalu) & "),"

            'sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            sqlJadi = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail pk"
            sqlJadi &= " JOIN (" & sql & ") as saldo"
            sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = (" & FixDouble(LDDebit) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = (" & FixDouble(LDKredit) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = (" & FixDouble(LDSaldo) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = (" & FixDouble(LDDebitlalu) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = (" & FixDouble(LDKreditlalu) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = (" & FixDouble(LDSaldolalu) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = (" & FixDouble(LDDebitvariasi) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = (" & FixDouble(LDKreditvariasi) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = (" & FixDouble(LDSaldovariasi) & ")"
            sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "'"
            sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed processing Retained Profit/Loss." : GoTo selesai
            End If


            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
            End If


            stepKe = 6

            'JIKA LEVEL >= 4 MAKA HITUNG L/R LEVEL 4
            If level >= 4 Then

                If LB4 = LT4 And LT4 = LD4 Then
                    'JIKA AKUN INDUK LEVEL 4 L/R BULAN = AKUN INDUK LEVEL 4 L/R TAHUN = AKUN INDUK LEVEL 4 L/R DITAHAN
                    sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vDivisi) & "' as pkdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as pkdivisinama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE c.clevel = '5' AND c.clevel4 = '" & FixDouble(LB4) & "' ORDER BY c.cnomor"
                    sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' AND (r.rdtahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rdtahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rdbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixDouble(vDivisi) & "' WHERE c.clevel = '5' AND c.clevel4 = '" & FixDouble(LB4) & "' ORDER BY c.cnomor"

                    sql = "  SELECT s.pkdivisi, s.pkdivisinama, s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
                    sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
                    sql &= " JOIN "
                    sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
                    sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

                    sqlJadi = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail pk"
                    sqlJadi &= " JOIN (" & sql & ") as saldo"

                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = saldo.pkkreditlalu + (" & FixDouble(LBKreditlalu) & ") + (" & FixDouble(LTKreditlalu) & ") + (" & FixDouble(LDKreditlalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = saldo.pksaldolalu + (" & FixDouble(LBSaldolalu) & ") + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldolalu) & ") + (" & FixDouble(LDSaldolalu) & "),"

                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = saldo.pkkreditvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LBKreditvariasi) & ") + (" & FixDouble(LTKreditvariasi) & ") + (" & FixDouble(LDKreditvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = saldo.pksaldovariasi + (" & FixDouble(LBSaldovariasi) & ") + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldovariasi) & ") + (" & FixDouble(LDSaldovariasi) & ")"
                    sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB4) & "'"
                    sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

                    'UPDATE INDUK LEVEL 4
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing Level 4 Parent Profit/Loss Account. #1" : GoTo selesai
                    End If

                ElseIf LB4 = LT4 Then

pcustomint3, p.pkcustomint4 as pcustomint4, p.pkcustomint5 as pcustomint5, p.pkcustomdbl1 as pcustomdbl1, p.pkcustomdbl2 as pcustomdbl2, p.pkcustomdbl3 as pcustomdbl3, p.pkcustomdbl4 as pcustomdbl4, p.pkcustomdbl5 as pcustomdbl5, p.pkcustomdate1 as pcustomdate1, p.pkcustomdate2 as pcustomdate2, p.pkcustomdate3 as pcustomdate3, p.pkcustomdate4 as pcustomdate4, p.pkcustomdate5 as pcustomdate5"
            sql &= " FROM M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail a"
            sql &= " RIGHT JOIN M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail p"
            sql &= " ON a.idlogin = p.idlogin AND a.idmsmq = p.idmsmq AND a.pkurut = p.pkurut AND a.pkjenis = 'A'"
            sql &= " WHERE (p.pkjenis = 'H' OR p.pkjenis = 'M')"
            sql &= " AND p.idlogin = '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "'"
            sql &= " AND p.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

        End If

        'QUEY INSERT M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_T_Detail
        Dim sqlInsert As String = "INSERT INTO M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_T_Detail"
        sqlInsert &= "(" & sql & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlInsert, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed finishing T balance sheet report. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF PROSES GABUNGKAN AKTIVA DAN PASIVA =================================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        '//LAPORAN POSISI KEUANGAN (NERACA T) PROYEK

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------

        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""

        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        End If

        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity

        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then

        Else

        End If

            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            bulan = dataDetail(1)
        End If

        'level(2) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(2)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "level required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            level = dataDetail(2)
        End If

        'saldoNol(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(3)
        End If

        'pembagiNominal(4) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(4)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "pembagiNominal required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            pembagiNominal = dataDetail(4)
        End If

        'SET tahunLalu DAN bulanLalu
        'JIKA BULAN = 1 MAKA TAHUNLALU = TAHUN - 1 DAN BULANLALU = 12
        'JIKA BULAN <> 1 MAKA TAHUNLALU = TAHUN DAN BULANLALU = BULAN - 1
        If bulan = 1 Then
            tahunLalu = tahun - 1 : bulanLalu = 12
        Else
            tahunLalu = tahun : bulanLalu = bulan - 1
        End If

        'proyek(5) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(5)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "proyek can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vProyek = dataDetail(5)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace trial balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_T_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_T_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace trial balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------

        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiTahunBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRTahun = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Yearly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiDitahan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING -----------------------------------


        'HITUNG REALISASI BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU ---------------------------------
        'HITUNG BULAN LALU ==================
        stepKe = 1
        Dim rsHitung As String = M0_HitungRealisasiProyek(idLogin & "★M0_HitungRealisasiProyek★0△0△△△dd/MM/yyyy△dd/MM/yyyy H:mm:ss★" & userid & "★0★" & tahunLalu & sptField & bulanLalu & sptField & vProyek)
        Dim rsHitungSplit() As String = rsHitung.Split(sptSubParam)
        'FORMAT KEMBALIAN = NamaFungsi△isSuccess△errMessage△errStep△idtransaksi★0△0△0△0△0★ ----> M0_HitungRealisasi△1△△0△0★0△0△0△0△0★
        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then
            'JIKA ISSUCCESS <> 1 MAKA KIRIM INFORMASI PROSES GAGAL
            result(2) = rsHitungSplit(2) & " : " & tahunLalu & " - " & bulanLalu : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG BULAN INI ===================
        stepKe = 2
        rsHitung = M0_HitungRealisasiProyek(idLogin & "★M0_HitungRealisasiProyek★0△0△△△dd/MM/yyyy△dd/MM/yyyy H:mm:ss★" & userid & "★0★" & tahun & sptField & bulan & sptField & vProyek)
        rsHitungSplit = rsHitung.Split(sptSubParam)
        'FORMAT KEMBALIAN = NamaFungsi△isSuccess△errMessage△errStep△idtransaksi★0△0△0△0△0★ ----> M0_HitungRealisasi△1△△0△0★0△0△0△0△0★
        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then
            'JIKA ISSUCCESS <> 1 MAKA KIRIM INFORMASI PROSES GAGAL
            result(2) = rsHitungSplit(2) & " : " & tahun & " - " & bulan : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HITUNG REALISASI BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU --------------------------


        'PROSES AKTIVA =============================================================
        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        stepKe = 3
        Dim sqlBulanIni As String = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vProyek) & "' as pkproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as pkproyeknama, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND (r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim sqlBulanLalu As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND (r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pkproyek, s.pkproyeknama, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
        sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        Dim dt As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'DEKLARASI UNTUK SIMPAN LEVEL INDUK
            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim urut As Integer = 1, currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0'")
            End If

            'PERULANGAN BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU (M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail)
            dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If

                'JIKA LEVEL AKUN < LEVEL PARAMETER, MAKA SIMPAN AKUN UNTUK DITAMPILKAN SEBAGAI SUBTOTAL
                If currLevel < level Then
                    'tanda kurung diawal sengaja dikosongi, untuk mengisi urutan saat insert ke tabel
                    'mapping :                                 idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkproyek,                             pkproyeknama,                             pknorek,                                                      pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strInduk(currLevel) = "'" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkproyek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkproyeknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & String.Concat("Total ", FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama"))) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')"
                End If

                'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'jika currLevel = level, maka saldo ditampilkan. jika currlevel <> level maka saldo diisi 0
                'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkproyek,                             pkproyeknama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                                                  pkdebit,                                                        pkkredit,                                                        pksaldo,                                                        pkdebitlalu,                                                        pkkreditlalu,                                                        pksaldolalu,                                                        pkdebitvariasi,                                                        pkkreditvariasi,                                                        pksaldovariasi,                                 idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5

                urut += 1

                prevLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))
            Next

            For i = 1 To level

                    'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
