                sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND (r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

                'QUERY AMBIL DATA TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
                sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pkproyek, s.pkproyeknama, s.pknorek, CONCAT('Total ', GROUP_CONCAT(s.pknoreknama ORDER BY s.pknorek SEPARATOR ' dan ')) as pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, SUM(s.pkdebit) as pkdebit, SUM(s.pkkredit) as pkkredit, SUM(s.pksaldo) as pksaldo, SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitlalu, SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditlalu, SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldolalu, SUM(s.pkdebit) - SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitvariasi, SUM(s.pkkredit) - SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditvariasi, SUM(s.pksaldo) - SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
                sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
                sql += " JOIN "
                sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
                sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
                sql += " GROUP BY s.pklevel "
                sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

                dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkproyek,                             pkproyeknama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkproyek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkproyeknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

            'SIMPAN KE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail(pkurut, idlogin, pktahun, pkbulan, pkproyek, pkproyeknama, pknorek, pknoreknama, pktipe, pkgd, pkjenis, pklevel, pklevel1, pklevel2, pklevel3, pklevel4, pklevel5, pkgddata, pkleveldata, pkdebit, pkkredit, pksaldo, pkdebitlalu, pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu, pkdebitvariasi, pkkreditvariasi, pksaldovariasi, idmsmq, pkuserid, pkcustomtext1, pkcustomtext2, pkcustomtext3, pkcustomtext4, pkcustomtext5, pkcustomint1, pkcustomint2, pkcustomint3, pkcustomint4, pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1, pkcustomdbl2, pkcustomdbl3, pkcustomdbl4, pkcustomdbl5, pkcustomdate1, pkcustomdate2, pkcustomdate3, pkcustomdate4, pkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing balance sheet report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If

        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai

        strValue.Clear()


        'VARIABEL L/R -----------------------------------------------
        Dim LB1 As String = "", LB2 As String = "", LB3 As String = "", LB4 As String = ""
        Dim LT1 As String = "", LT2 As String = "", LT3 As String = "", LT4 As String = ""
        Dim LD1 As String = "", LD2 As String = "", LD3 As String = "", LD4 As String = ""

        Dim LBDebit As Double = 0, LBKredit As Double = 0, LBSaldo As Double = 0, LBDebitlalu As Double = 0, LBKreditlalu As Double = 0
        Dim LBSaldolalu As Double = 0, LBDebitvariasi As Double = 0, LBKreditvariasi As Double = 0, LBSaldovariasi As Double = 0

        Dim DtInduk As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If DtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            LB2 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel2"), "")

        'PROSES PASIVA =============================================================
        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        stepKe = 4
        sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vProyek) & "' as pkproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as pkproyeknama, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND (r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            Dim urut As Integer = 1, currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            'PROSES PERHITUNGAN L/R -------------------------------------
            stepKe = 5

            '1. L/R BULAN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN L/R BULAN INI ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI REALISASI BULAN INI
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI REALISASI BULAN LALU
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vProyek) & "' as pkproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as pkproyeknama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rpbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rpbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA
            sql = "  SELECT s.pkproyek, s.pkproyeknama, s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql &= " JOIN "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                LBDebit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebit"), 0))
                LBKredit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkredit"), 0))
                LBSaldo = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldo"), 0))
                LBDebitlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitlalu"), 0))
                LBKreditlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditlalu"), 0))
                LBSaldolalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldolalu"), 0))
                LBDebitvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitvariasi"), 0))
                LBKreditvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditvariasi"), 0))
                LBSaldovariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldovariasi"), 0))
            End If

            'UPDATE L/R BULAN BERJALAN
            sqlJadi = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail pk"
            sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = " & FixDouble(LBDebit) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = " & FixDouble(LBKredit) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = " & FixDouble(LBSaldo) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = " & FixDouble(LBDebitlalu) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = " & FixDouble(LBKreditlalu) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = " & FixDouble(LBSaldolalu) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = " & FixDouble(LBDebitvariasi) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = " & FixDouble(LBKreditvariasi) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = " & FixDouble(LBSaldovariasi) & ""
            sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "'"
            sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed processing Monthly Profit/Loss." : GoTo selesai
            End If


            '2. L/R TAHUN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN AWAL TAHUN S.D. BULAN LALU) ^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN INI S.D. BULAN INI - 1
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN LALU S.D. BULAN LALU - 1
            'sqlBulanIni = " select '" & FixQuotes(vProyek) & "' as pkproyek, ifnull(p.pnama,'') as pkproyeknama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") as pkdebit, (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") as pkkredit, (case c.cdc when 'd' then (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") else (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") end) as pksaldo from m1_coa c left join m2_realization_project r on c.cnomor = r.rpnorek and r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' and (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' and r.rpbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "') left join m1_project p on p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' where (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') group by c.cnomor order by c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanLalu = "select c.cnomor as pknorek, (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") as pkdebitlalu, (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") as pkkreditlalu, (case c.cdc when 'd' then (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") else (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (ifnull(sum(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") end) as pksaldolalu from m1_coa c left join m2_realization_project r on c.cnomor = r.rpnorek and r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' and (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' and r.rpbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') left join m1_project p on p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' where (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') group by c.cnomor order by c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vProyek) & "' as pkproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as pkproyeknama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND ((r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rpbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') OR (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND ((r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rpbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') OR (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA
            sql = "  SELECT s.pkproyek, s.pkproyeknama, s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql &= " JOIN "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                LTDebit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebit"), 0))
                LTKredit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkredit"), 0))
                LTSaldo = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldo"), 0))
                LTDebitlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitlalu"), 0))
                LTKreditlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditlalu"), 0))
                LTSaldolalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldolalu"), 0))
                LTDebitvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitvariasi"), 0))
                LTKreditvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditvariasi"), 0))
                LTSaldovariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldovariasi"), 0))
            End If

            'UPDATE L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
            'sqlJadi = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail pk"
            'sqlJadi &= " JOIN (" & sql & ") as saldo"
            'sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = pk.pkdebit + (" & FixDouble(LTDebit) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = pk.pkkredit + (" & FixDouble(LTKredit) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = pk.pksaldo + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldo) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = pk.pkdebitlalu + (" & FixDouble(LTDebitlalu) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = pk.pkkreditlalu + (" & FixDouble(LTKreditlalu) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = pk.pksaldolalu + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldolalu) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = pk.pkdebitvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTDebitvariasi) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = pk.pkkreditvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTKreditvariasi) & "),"
            'sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = pk.pksaldovariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldovariasi) & ")"
            'sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "'"
            'sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            sqlJadi = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail pk"
            sqlJadi &= " JOIN (" & sql & ") as saldo"
            sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = (" & FixDouble(LTDebit) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = (" & FixDouble(LTKredit) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = (" & FixDouble(LTSaldo) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = (" & FixDouble(LTDebitlalu) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = (" & FixDouble(LTKreditlalu) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = (" & FixDouble(LTSaldolalu) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = (" & FixDouble(LTDebitvariasi) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = (" & FixDouble(LTKreditvariasi) & "),"
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = (" & FixDouble(LTSaldovariasi) & ")"
            sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "'"
            sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed processing Yearly Profit/Loss." : GoTo selesai
            End If


            '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI        : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN INI - 1
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN LALU - 1
            'sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vProyek) & "' as pkproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as pkproyeknama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND (r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND (r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vProyek) & "' as pkproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as pkproyeknama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND ((r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'    AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (r.rptahun <= '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND ((r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (r.rptahun <= '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vProyek) & "' as pkproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as pkproyeknama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit,     (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit,     (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo     FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND ((r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) OR (((r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "')     OR (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "'))     AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            End If

            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
            End If


            stepKe = 8

                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = saldo.pkkredit + (" & FixDouble(LTKredit) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = saldo.pksaldo + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldo) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = saldo.pkdebitlalu + (" & FixDouble(LTDebitlalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = saldo.pkkreditlalu + (" & FixDouble(LTKreditlalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = saldo.pksaldolalu + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldolalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = saldo.pkdebitvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTDebitvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = saldo.pkkreditvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTKreditvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = saldo.pksaldovariasi + (" & FixDouble(LTSaldovariasi) & ")"
                    sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT2) & "'"
                    sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

                    'UPDATE INDUK LEVEL 2
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing Level 2 Parent Profit/Loss Account. #6" : GoTo selesai
                    End If


                    'AKUN INDUK LEVEL 2 L/R DITAHAN
                    sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vProyek) & "' as pkproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as pkproyeknama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND (r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE c.clevel = '5' AND c.clevel2 = '" & FixDouble(LD2) & "' ORDER BY c.cnomor"
                    sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' AND (r.rptahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rptahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rpbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) AND c.cnomor <> '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixDouble(vProyek) & "' WHERE c.clevel = '5' AND c.clevel2 = '" & FixDouble(LD2) & "' ORDER BY c.cnomor"

                    sql = "  SELECT s.pkproyek, s.pkproyeknama, s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
                    sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
                    sql &= " JOIN "
                    sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
                    sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

                    sqlJadi = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail pk"
                    sqlJadi &= " JOIN (" & sql & ") as saldo"
                    sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = saldo.pkdebit + (" & FixDouble(LDDebit) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = saldo.pkkredit + (" & FixDouble(LDKredit) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = saldo.pksaldo + (" & FixDouble(LDSaldo) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = saldo.pkdebitlalu + (" & FixDouble(LDDebitlalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = saldo.pkkreditlalu + (" & FixDouble(LDKreditlalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = saldo.pksaldolalu + (" & FixDouble(LDSaldolalu) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = saldo.pkdebitvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LDDebitvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = saldo.pkkreditvariasi + (" & FixDouble(LDKreditvariasi) & "),"
                    sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = saldo.pksaldovariasi + (" & FixDouble(LDSaldovariasi) & ")"
                    sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD2) & "'"
                    sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

                    'UPDATE INDUK LEVEL 2
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing Level 2 Parent Profit/Loss Account. #7" : GoTo selesai
                    End If

        'If saldoNol <> 1 Then

        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_PosisiKeuanganT_Costcenter(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN POSISI KEUANGAN (NERACA T) COSTCENTER
        '//ATURAN :
        '   1. L/R BULAN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN L/R BULAN INI
        '   2. L/R TAHUN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN AWAL TAHUN S.D. BULAN LALU)
        '   3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI        : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tahun(0) As Integer, bulan(1) As Integer, level(2) As Integer, saldoNol(3) As Integer, pembagiNominal(4) As Integer, costcenter(5) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tahun, bulan, level, saldoNol, pembagiNominal, costcenter


        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""

        stepKe = 1
        Dim rsHitung As String = M0_HitungRealisasiCostCenter(idLogin & "★M0_HitungRealisasiCostcenter★0△0△△△dd/MM/yyyy△dd/MM/yyyy H:mm:ss★" & userid & "★0★" & tahunLalu & sptField & bulanLalu & sptField & vCostcenter)

        If rsHitungSplit(1) <> 1 Then

        Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
