        stepKe = 3
        Dim sqlBulanIni As String = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vCostcenter) & "' as pkcostcenter, IFNULL(cc.ccnama,'') as pkcostcenternama, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rccbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim sqlBulanLalu As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rccbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pkcostcenter, s.pkcostcenternama, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
        sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        Dim dt As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'DEKLARASI UNTUK SIMPAN LEVEL INDUK
            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim urut As Integer = 1, currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0'")
            End If

            'PERULANGAN BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU (M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail)
            dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If

                'JIKA LEVEL AKUN < LEVEL PARAMETER, MAKA SIMPAN AKUN UNTUK DITAMPILKAN SEBAGAI SUBTOTAL
                If currLevel < level Then
                    'tanda kurung diawal sengaja dikosongi, untuk mengisi urutan saat insert ke tabel
                    'mapping :                                 idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkcostcenter,                             pkcostcenternama,                             pknorek,                                                      pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strInduk(currLevel) = "'" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenter")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenternama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & String.Concat("Total ", FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama"))) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')"
                End If

                'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'jika currLevel = level, maka saldo ditampilkan. jika currlevel <> level maka saldo diisi 0
                'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkcostcenter,                             pkcostcenternama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                                                  pkdebit,                                                        pkkredit,                                                        pksaldo,                                                        pkdebitlalu,                                                        pkkreditlalu,                                                        pksaldolalu,                                                        pkdebitvariasi,                                                        pkkreditvariasi,                                                        pksaldovariasi,                                 idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenter")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenternama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")), 0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                'increament urutan
                urut += 1

                'SET PREVIOUS LEVEL
                prevLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))
            Next

            'INSERT AKUN INDUK YANG TERSISA
            For i = 1 To level
                If Len(strInduk(level - i)) > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                    'increament urutan
                    urut += 1
                End If
            Next

            If level = 1 Then
                'INSERT TOTAL ASET
                sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vCostcenter) & "' as pkcostcenter, IFNULL(cc.ccnama,'') as pkcostcenternama, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rccbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
                sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rccbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='A') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

                'QUERY AMBIL DATA TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
                sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pkcostcenter, s.pkcostcenternama, s.pknorek, CONCAT('Total ', GROUP_CONCAT(s.pknoreknama ORDER BY s.pknorek SEPARATOR ' dan ')) as pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, SUM(s.pkdebit) as pkdebit, SUM(s.pkkredit) as pkkredit, SUM(s.pksaldo) as pksaldo, SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitlalu, SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditlalu, SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldolalu, SUM(s.pkdebit) - SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitvariasi, SUM(s.pkkredit) - SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditvariasi, SUM(s.pksaldo) - SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
                sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
                sql += " JOIN "
                sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
                sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
                sql += " GROUP BY s.pklevel "
                sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

                dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkcostcenter,                             pkcostcenternama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenter")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenternama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If
            End If

            'SIMPAN KE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail(pkurut, idlogin, pktahun, pkbulan, pkcostcenter, pkcostcenternama, pknorek, pknoreknama, pktipe, pkgd, pkjenis, pklevel, pklevel1, pklevel2, pklevel3, pklevel4, pklevel5, pkgddata, pkleveldata, pkdebit, pkkredit, pksaldo, pkdebitlalu, pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu, pkdebitvariasi, pkkreditvariasi, pksaldovariasi, idmsmq, pkuserid, pkcustomtext1, pkcustomtext2, pkcustomtext3, pkcustomtext4, pkcustomtext5, pkcustomint1, pkcustomint2, pkcustomint3, pkcustomint4, pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1, pkcustomdbl2, pkcustomdbl3, pkcustomdbl4, pkcustomdbl5, pkcustomdate1, pkcustomdate2, pkcustomdate3, pkcustomdate4, pkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing balance sheet report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If

        End If

        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF PROSES AKTIVA ======================================================

        strValue.Clear()


        'VARIABEL L/R -----------------------------------------------
        Dim LB1 As String = "", LB2 As String = "", LB3 As String = "", LB4 As String = ""
        Dim LT1 As String = "", LT2 As String = "", LT3 As String = "", LT4 As String = ""
        Dim LD1 As String = "", LD2 As String = "", LD3 As String = "", LD4 As String = ""

        Dim LBDebit As Double = 0, LBKredit As Double = 0, LBSaldo As Double = 0, LBDebitlalu As Double = 0, LBKreditlalu As Double = 0
        Dim LBSaldolalu As Double = 0, LBDebitvariasi As Double = 0, LBKreditvariasi As Double = 0, LBSaldovariasi As Double = 0

        Dim LTDebit As Double = 0, LTKredit As Double = 0, LTSaldo As Double = 0, LTDebitlalu As Double = 0, LTKreditlalu As Double = 0
        Dim LTSaldolalu As Double = 0, LTDebitvariasi As Double = 0, LTKreditvariasi As Double = 0, LTSaldovariasi As Double = 0

        Dim LDDebit As Double = 0, LDKredit As Double = 0, LDSaldo As Double = 0, LDDebitlalu As Double = 0, LDKreditlalu As Double = 0
        Dim LDSaldolalu As Double = 0, LDDebitvariasi As Double = 0, LDKreditvariasi As Double = 0, LDSaldovariasi As Double = 0

        Dim sqlJadi As String = ""

        'AMBIL INDUK AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        sql = "SELECT clevel1, clevel2, clevel3, clevel4 FROM m1_coa WHERE cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "'"
        Dim DtInduk As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If DtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            LB1 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel1"), "")
            LB2 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel2"), "")
            LB3 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel3"), "")
            LB4 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel4"), "")
        Else
            result(2) = "CoA Parent for Monthly Profit/Loss not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL INDUK AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        sql = "SELECT clevel1, clevel2, clevel3, clevel4 FROM m1_coa WHERE cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "'"
        DtInduk = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If DtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            LT1 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel1"), "")
            LT2 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel2"), "")
            LT3 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel3"), "")
            LT4 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel4"), "")
        Else
            result(2) = "CoA Parent for Yearly Profit/Loss not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL INDUK AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        sql = "SELECT clevel1, clevel2, clevel3, clevel4 FROM m1_coa WHERE cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "'"
        DtInduk = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If DtInduk.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            LD1 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel1"), "")
            LD2 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel2"), "")
            LD3 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel3"), "")
            LD4 = FxDB(DtInduk.Rows(0)("clevel4"), "")
        Else
            result(2) = "CoA Parent for Retained Profit/Loss not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VARIABEL L/R ----------------------------------------


        'PROSES PASIVA =============================================================
        'BUAT SQL AMBIL DATA BULAN INI DAN BULAN LALU
        stepKe = 4
        sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vCostcenter) & "' as pkcostcenter, IFNULL(cc.ccnama,'') as pkcostcenternama, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rccbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rccbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel <= '" & FixDouble(level) & "' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

        'QUERY AMBIL DATA
        sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pkcostcenter, s.pkcostcenternama, s.pknorek, s.pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
        sql += " JOIN "
        sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
        sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
        sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

        'AMBIL DATA KE DATABASE
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'DEKLARASI UNTUK SIMPAN LEVEL INDUK
            Dim strInduk(level) As String
            Dim urut As Integer = 1, currLevel As Integer = 0, prevLevel As Integer = 0

            'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
            'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
            'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
            If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                Dim filterSaldo As String = ""
                filterSaldo = "  (pksaldo <> '0' OR pksaldolalu <> '0')"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "'"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB1) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB2) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB3) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LB4) & "'"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT1) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT2) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT3) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LT4) & "'"
                filterSaldo &= " OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD1) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD2) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD3) & "' OR pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(LD4) & "'"
                dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, filterSaldo)
            End If

            'PERULANGAN BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU (M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail)
            dt = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dt, "", "pknorek")
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                'SET CURRENT LEVEL
                currLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))

                'CEK PERVIOUS LEVEL UNTUK MENAMPILKAN SUBTOTAL
                If prevLevel > currLevel Then
                    'JIKA PREVIOUS LEVEL > CURRENT LEVEL MAKA PERULANGAN MEMBUAT ROW SUBTOTAL
                    For i = 1 To prevLevel - currLevel
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                        'increament urutan
                        urut += 1
                    Next
                End If

                'JIKA LEVEL AKUN < LEVEL PARAMETER, MAKA SIMPAN AKUN UNTUK DITAMPILKAN SEBAGAI SUBTOTAL
                If currLevel < level Then
                    'tanda kurung diawal sengaja dikosongi, untuk mengisi urutan saat insert ke tabel
                    'mapping :                                 idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkcostcenter,                             pkcostcenternama,                             pknorek,                                                      pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strInduk(currLevel) = "'" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenter")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenternama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & String.Concat("Total ", FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama"))) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')"
                End If

                'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'jika currLevel = level, maka saldo ditampilkan. jika currlevel <> level maka saldo diisi 0
                'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkcostcenter,                             pkcostcenternama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                                                  pkdebit,                                                        pkkredit,                                                        pksaldo,                                                        pkdebitlalu,                                                        pkkreditlalu,                                                        pksaldolalu,                                                        pkdebitvariasi,                                                        pkkreditvariasi,                                                        pksaldovariasi,                                 idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenter")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenternama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")), 0) & "', '" & IIf(currLevel = level, FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")), 0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                'increament urutan
                urut += 1

                'SET PREVIOUS LEVEL
                prevLevel = Integer.Parse(dr1("pklevel"))
            Next

            'INSERT AKUN INDUK YANG TERSISA
            For i = 1 To level
                If Len(strInduk(level - i)) > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT SUBTOTAL 
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'ditambahkan urutan terlebih dahulu
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "'," & strInduk(level - i))
                    'increament urutan
                    urut += 1
                End If
            Next


            'INSERT TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
            sqlBulanIni = "SELECT '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as pktahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as pkbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vCostcenter) & "' as pkcostcenter, IFNULL(cc.ccnama,'') as pkcostcenternama, c.cnomor as pknorek, c.cnama as pknoreknama, c.ctipe as pktipe, c.cgd as pkgd, c.cjenis as pkjenis, c.clevel as pklevel, c.clevel1 as pklevel1, c.clevel2 as pklevel2, c.clevel3 as pklevel3, c.clevel4 as pklevel4, c.clevel5 as pklevel5, (CASE c.clevel WHEN '" & FixDouble(level) & "' THEN 'D' ELSE 'G' END) AS pkgddata, '" & FixDouble(level) & "' as pkleveldata, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun < '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' or (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rccbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun < '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' or (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rccbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cjenis='H' OR c.cjenis='M') AND c.clevel = '1' GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
            sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.pktahun, s.pkbulan, s.pkcostcenter, s.pkcostcenternama, s.pknorek, CONCAT('Total ', GROUP_CONCAT(s.pknoreknama ORDER BY s.pknorek SEPARATOR ' dan ')) as pknoreknama, s.pktipe, s.pkgd, s.pkjenis, s.pklevel, s.pklevel1, s.pklevel2, s.pklevel3, s.pklevel4, s.pklevel5, s.pkgddata, s.pkleveldata, SUM(s.pkdebit) as pkdebit, SUM(s.pkkredit) as pkkredit, SUM(s.pksaldo) as pksaldo, SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitlalu, SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditlalu, SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldolalu, SUM(s.pkdebit) - SUM(k.pkdebitlalu) as pkdebitvariasi, SUM(s.pkkredit) - SUM(k.pkkreditlalu) as pkkreditvariasi, SUM(s.pksaldo) - SUM(k.pksaldolalu) as pksaldovariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as pkuserid FROM "
            sql += " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql += " JOIN "
            sql += " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql += " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "
            sql += " GROUP BY s.pklevel "
            sql += " ORDER BY s.pknorek ASC "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dt.Rows
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT TOTAL HUTANG + MODAL
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'mapping :                                                      idlogin,                             pktahun,                             pkbulan,                             pkcostcenter,                             pkcostcenternama,                             pknorek,                             pknoreknama,                  pktipe,                           pkgd,                             pkjenis,                  pklevel,                           pklevel1,                             pklevel2,                             pklevel3,                             pklevel4,                             pklevel5,                             pkgddata,                  pkleveldata,                           pkdebit,                             pkkredit,                             pksaldo,                             pkdebitlalu,                             pkkreditlalu,                             pksaldolalu,                             pkdebitvariasi,                             pkkreditvariasi,                             pksaldovariasi,                             idmsmq,                             pkuserid,                   pkcustomtext1,           pkcustomtext2,           pkcustomtext3,           pkcustomtext4,           pkcustomtext5,pkcustomint1,pkcustomint2,pkcustomint3,pkcustomint4,pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1,           pkcustomdbl2,           pkcustomdbl3,           pkcustomdbl4,           pkcustomdbl5,                                 pkcustomdate1,                                      pkcustomdate2,                                      pkcustomdate3,                                      pkcustomdate4,                                      pkcustomdate5
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixDouble(urut) & "','" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pktahun")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkbulan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenter")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkcostcenternama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pknoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("pktipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgd")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkjenis")) & "', " & dr1("pklevel") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pklevel5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkgddata")) & "', " & dr1("pkleveldata") & ", '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldo")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditlalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldolalu")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkdebitvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pkkreditvariasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("pksaldovariasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("pkuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                    'increament urutan
                    urut += 1
                Next
            End If

            'SIMPAN KE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail(pkurut, idlogin, pktahun, pkbulan, pkcostcenter, pkcostcenternama, pknorek, pknoreknama, pktipe, pkgd, pkjenis, pklevel, pklevel1, pklevel2, pklevel3, pklevel4, pklevel5, pkgddata, pkleveldata, pkdebit, pkkredit, pksaldo, pkdebitlalu, pkkreditlalu, pksaldolalu, pkdebitvariasi, pkkreditvariasi, pksaldovariasi, idmsmq, pkuserid, pkcustomtext1, pkcustomtext2, pkcustomtext3, pkcustomtext4, pkcustomtext5, pkcustomint1, pkcustomint2, pkcustomint3, pkcustomint4, pkcustomint5, pkcustomdbl1, pkcustomdbl2, pkcustomdbl3, pkcustomdbl4, pkcustomdbl5, pkcustomdate1, pkcustomdate2, pkcustomdate3, pkcustomdate4, pkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing balance sheet report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If


            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
            End If


            'PROSES PERHITUNGAN L/R -------------------------------------
            stepKe = 5

            '1. L/R BULAN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN L/R BULAN INI ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI REALISASI BULAN INI
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI REALISASI BULAN LALU
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vCostcenter) & "' as pkcostcenter, IFNULL(cc.ccnama,'') as pkcostcenternama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rccbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rccbulan = '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            'QUERY AMBIL DATA
            sql = "  SELECT s.pkcostcenter, s.pkcostcenternama, s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanIni & ") as s "
            sql &= " JOIN "
            sql &= " (" & sqlBulanLalu & ") as k "
            sql &= " ON s.pknorek = k.pknorek "

            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                LBDebit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebit"), 0))
                LBKredit = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkredit"), 0))
                LBSaldo = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldo"), 0))
                LBDebitlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitlalu"), 0))
                LBKreditlalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditlalu"), 0))
                LBSaldolalu = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldolalu"), 0))
                LBDebitvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkdebitvariasi"), 0))
                LBKreditvariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pkkreditvariasi"), 0))
                LBSaldovariasi = Double.Parse(FxDB(dt.Rows(0)("pksaldovariasi"), 0))
            End If

            'UPDATE L/R BULAN BERJALAN
            sqlJadi = "  UPDATE M2r_Posisi_Keuangan_Detail pk"
            sqlJadi &= " SET pk.pkdebit = " & FixDouble(LBDebit) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkredit = " & FixDouble(LBKredit) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldo = " & FixDouble(LBSaldo) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitlalu = " & FixDouble(LBDebitlalu) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditlalu = " & FixDouble(LBKreditlalu) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldolalu = " & FixDouble(LBSaldolalu) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkdebitvariasi = " & FixDouble(LBDebitvariasi) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pkkreditvariasi = " & FixDouble(LBKreditvariasi) & ","
            sqlJadi &= " pk.pksaldovariasi = " & FixDouble(LBSaldovariasi) & ""
            sqlJadi &= " WHERE pk.pknorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "'"
            sqlJadi &= " AND pk.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed processing Monthly Profit/Loss." : GoTo selesai
            End If


            '2. L/R TAHUN BERJALAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN AWAL TAHUN S.D. BULAN LALU) ^^^^^^^^^
            '- BULAN INI    : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN INI S.D. BULAN INI - 1
            '- BULAN LALU   : AMBIL DARI AWAL TAHUN LALU S.D. BULAN LALU - 1
            'sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vCostcenter) & "' as pkcostcenter, IFNULL(cc.ccnama,'') as pkcostcenternama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' AND r.rccbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            'sqlBulanLalu = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebitlalu, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkreditlalu, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldolalu FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahunLalu) & "' AND r.rccbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulanLalu) & "') LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') GROUP BY c.cnomor ORDER BY c.cnomor"
            sqlBulanIni = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(vCostcenter) & "' as pkcostcenter, IFNULL(cc.ccnama,'') as pkcostcenternama, c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0) / " & FixDouble(pembagiNominal) & ") END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_cost_center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' AND ((r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rccbulan < '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "') OR (r.rcctahun = '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "'     AND r.rccbulan <= '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' AND c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "')) LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixDouble(vCostcenter) & "' WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "') ORDER BY c.cnomor"

            sql = "  SELECT s.pkcostcenter, s.pkcostcenternama, s.pknorek, s.pkdebit, s.pkkredit, s.pksaldo, k.pkdebitlalu, k.pkkreditlalu, k.pksaldolalu, s.pkdebit - k.pkdebitlalu as pkdebitvariasi, s.pkkredit - k.pkkreditlalu as pkkreditvariasi, s.pksaldo - k.pksaldolalu as pksaldovariasi FROM "

            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = stepTotal, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / stepTotal, 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress balance sheet. #" & stepKe : GoTo selesai
            End If


            stepKe = 6

            If level >= 4 Then

                If LB4 = LT4 And LT4 = LD4 Then

        Return wsResult

    Public Function M0_ARCard_Cabang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN KARTU PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES) CABANG

        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan,

        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, cabang

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)

        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""

        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""

        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'cabang(10) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(10)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "cabang can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vCabang = dataDetail(10)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Card_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ar_Card_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ar_Card_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AR Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        sql = "SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE (smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode = 'PiutangUsaha')"
        Dim ftAkunAR As String = ""

        End If

        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "

        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then

            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & customerAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        End If
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "

        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""
