            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ar_Card_Detail(arnourut, idlogin, arid, arcabang, arcabangnama, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, arsaldoawal, ardebit, arkredit, arsaldoakhir, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing AR Summary : Total Row." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
            'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================

        End If
        'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA REKAP -----------------------------------------


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress AR Summary : Total Row." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_ARSummary_Lokasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REKAP PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES) LOKASI

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, lokasi(10) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, lokasi

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = ""
        Dim vLokasi As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 11) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'lokasi(10) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(10)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "lokasi can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vLokasi = dataDetail(10)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Card_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ar_Card_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ar_Card_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AR Summary data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Card_Detail -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN KARTU PIUTANG, UNTUK FILTER TRANSAKSI ------------------------
        sql = "SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE (smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode = 'PiutangUsaha')"
        Dim ftAkunAR As String = ""
        Dim dtAkunAR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dtAkunAR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'BUAT FILTER AKUN PIUTANG PADA TRASAKSI
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtAkunAR.Rows
                ftAkunAR += IIf(Len(ftAkunAR) > 0, " OR ", "")
                ftAkunAR += " t.tnorek = '" & dr1("snilai") & "' "
            Next
            If Len(ftAkunAR) > 0 Then ftAkunAR = " AND (" & ftAkunAR & ") "
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting CoA for AR Summary not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN KARTU PIUTANG, UNTUK FILTER TRANSAKSI -----------------


        'AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI CUSTOMER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING KARTU PIUTANG
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'C') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' " & ftAkunAR & " "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & customerCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & customerAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        End If
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtCustomer As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------


        'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ----------------------------------
        Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
        Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
        If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
        If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0, urut As Double = 1
        'END OF AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ---------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER KONTAK --------------------------------------------
        If dtCustomer.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSMutasiTemp As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsional As String = "", sqlValas As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""
            Dim idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtCustomer.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO AWAL =========================================
                'QUERY SALDO AWAL
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT '" & uangFungsional & "' as armatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as arsaldoawal FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & tglAwal & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT t.tmatauang as armatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as arsaldoawal FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & tglAwal & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT armatauang, arsaldoawal FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO AWAL ==================================


                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT '" & uangFungsional & "' as armatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as ardebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as arkredit FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT t.tmatauang as armatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as ardebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as arkredit FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT armatauang, ardebit, arkredit FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO MUTASI
                dtSMutasi = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO MUTASI ================================


                'SALDO AKHIR ========================================
                Dim saldoAwal As Double = 0, saldoDebit As Double = 0, saldoKredit As Double = 0

                'QUERY SALDO AKHIR
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT 0 as arid, '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' as arlokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as arlokasinama, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, c.kid as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, '" & uangFungsional & "' as armatauang, '" & kursFungsional & "' as arkurs, 'Saldo Akhir' as aruraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as  arcatatan, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "',' ','00:00:00') as arinputtgl, 1 as arisfungsional FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT 0 as arid, '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' as arlokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as arlokasinama, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, c.kid as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, t.tmatauang as armatauang, t.tkurs as arkurs, 'Saldo Akhir' as aruraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as  arcatatan, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "',' ','00:00:00') as arinputtgl, 0 as arisfungsional FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAR & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"

                'AMBIL SALDO AKHIR

                            strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arlokasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arlokasinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("armatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoDebit) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoKredit) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("arstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("arinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("arisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(0) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                End If
                'END OF SALDO AKHIR =================================


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_Ar_Card_Detail(arnourut, idlogin, arid, arlokasi, arlokasinama, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, arsaldoawal, ardebit, arkredit, arsaldoakhir, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing AR Summary : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

                End If

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER KONTAK +++++++++++++++++++

        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER KONTAK -------------------------------------


        'HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA REKAP ------------------------------------------------
        'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
        strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

        'AMBIL TOTAL REKAP DARI TABEL PEMBANTU SESUAI IDMSMQ
        sql = "SELECT idlogin, 0 as arid, arlokasi, arlokasinama, '" & tglAkhir & "' as artgl, '' as arsumber, '' as arnotransaksi, 0 as arkontak, '' as arkontakkode, '' as arkontaknama, '' as aralamat1, '' as aralamat2, '' as aralamat3, '' as aralamat4, '' as aralamat5, '' as arnotelp1, '' as arnotelp2, '' as arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, 'Total' as aruraian, 'Total' as arcatatan, SUM(arsaldoawal) as arsaldoawal, SUM(ardebit) as ardebit, SUM(arkredit) as arkredit, SUM(arsaldoakhir) as arsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as artgljatuhtempo, 0 as arstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as artgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "', ' 00:00:00') as arinputtgl, arisfungsional, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5 FROM M2r_Ar_Card_Detail ar WHERE idlogin = '" & idLogin & "' AND idmsmq = '" & idMsmq & "' GROUP BY armatauang ORDER BY armatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, armatauang ASC"
        Dim dtTotal As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dtTotal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'URUTAN SALDO AKHIR
            Dim urutSAkhir As Double = 1

            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtTotal.Rows
                'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'MAPPING :         arnourut,                          idlogin,                             arid,                             arlokasi,                             arlokasinama,                                             artgl,                              arsumber,                             arnotransaksi,                             arkontak,                             arkontakkode,                             arkontaknama,                             aralamat1,                             aralamat2,                             aralamat3, ardebit,                             arkredit,                             arsaldoakhir,                                             artgljatuhtempo,                   arstatuslunas,                                           artgllunas,                                              arinputtgl,                                         arisfungsional,                 arissaldoakhir,                          idmsmq,                             aruserid,                   arcustomtext1,           arcustomtext2,           arcustomtext3,           arcustomtext4,           arcustomtext5,arcustomint1,arcustomint2,arcustomint3,arcustomint4,arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1,           arcustomdbl2,           arcustomdbl3,           arcustomdbl4,           arcustomdbl5,                                      arcustomdate1,                                      arcustomdate2,                                      arcustomdate3,                                      arcustomdate4,                                      arcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arlokasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arlokasinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnorek")) & "', '" & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("arinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("arisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', "             If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then

selesai:

        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_ARVoucher_Cabang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN VOUCHER PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES) CABANG
        '//SUMBER SI(SALES INVOICE), SR(SALES RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer, cabang(11) As String, tglJTAwal(12) As String, tglJTAkhir(13) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, cabang, tglJTAwal, tglJTAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", tglJTAwal As String = "", tglJTAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0
        Dim vCabang As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 14) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(10)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(10)
        End If

        'cabang(11) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(11)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "cabang can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vCabang = dataDetail(11)
        End If

        'tglJTAwal(12) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(12)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(12)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(12))
            End If
        Else
            tglJTAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglJTAkhir(13) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(13)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(13)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(13))
            End If
        Else
            tglJTAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Voucher_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ar_Voucher_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ar_Voucher_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AR Voucher data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Voucher_Detail -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI CUSTOMER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING Voucher PIUTANG
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "
        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'C') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND (t.tsumber = 'SI' OR t.tsumber = 'SR') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & customerCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & customerAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        End If
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtCustomer As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

            Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
            If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
            If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If

            Dim dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSSubtotal As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable

            Dim sqlFungsionalSR As String = "", sqlValasSR As String = ""
            Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSubtotal As String = ""
            Dim urut As Double = 1, urutSAkhir As Double = 1, idkontak As String = ""

            For Each dr As DataRow In dtCustomer.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL

                sqlFungsionalSI &= " FROM m5_pv pv "

                sqlValasSI &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid "
                sqlValasSI &= " LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "'"
                sqlValasSI &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode = 'PiutangUsaha' "

        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_ARVoucher_Lokasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN VOUCHER PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES) LOKASI
        '//SUMBER SI(SALES INVOICE), SR(SALES RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer, lokasi(11) As String, tglJTAwal(12) As String, tglJTAkhir(13) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, lokasi, tglJTAwal, tglJTAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", tglJTAwal As String = "", tglJTAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0
        Dim vLokasi As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 14) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(10)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(10)
        End If

        'lokasi(11) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(11)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "lokasi can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vLokasi = dataDetail(11)
        End If

        'tglJTAwal(12) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(12)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(12)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(12))
            End If
        Else
            tglJTAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglJTAkhir(13) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(13)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(13)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(13))
            End If
        Else
            tglJTAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Voucher_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ar_Voucher_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ar_Voucher_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AR Voucher data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Voucher_Detail -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI CUSTOMER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING Voucher PIUTANG
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "
        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'C') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND (t.tsumber = 'SI' OR t.tsumber = 'SR') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & customerCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & customerAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        End If
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtCustomer As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN Voucher PER KONTAK --------------------------------------------
        If dtCustomer.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING
            Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
            Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
            If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
            If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If

            Dim dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSSubtotal As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsionalSI As String = "", sqlValasSI As String = ""
            Dim sqlFungsionalSR As String = "", sqlValasSR As String = ""
            Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSubtotal As String = ""
            Dim urut As Double = 1, urutSAkhir As Double = 1, idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG Voucher PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtCustomer.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL
                'SI FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsionalSI = "SELECT si.siid as arid, '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' as arlokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as arlokasinama, si.sitgl as artgl, si.sisumber as arsumber, si.sinotransaksi as arnotransaksi, si.sicustomer as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, s.snilai as arnorek, '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as armatauang, '" & FixDouble(kursFungsional) & "' as arkurs, si.siuraian as aruraian, si.sicatatan as arcatatan, (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) as artotal, (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) + IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs) + IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) END) as arbayar, (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) as arsisa, si.sitgljatuhtempo as artgljatuhtempo, si.sistatuslunas as arstatuslunas, si.sitgllunas as artgllunas, si.siinputtgl as arinputtgl, 1 as arisfungsional, 0 as arissaldoakhir "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " FROM m5_pv pv "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " JOIN m5_pv_detail pvd ON pv.pvid = pvd.idpv AND pv.pvstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND pv.pvtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " RIGHT JOIN m5_si si ON pvd.idtransaksi = si.siid AND pvd.sumber = si.sisumber "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " LEFT JOIN m5_sr sr ON si.siid = sr.sridsi AND sr.srstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND sr.srjenis = 1 AND sr.srtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " LEFT JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "'"
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode = 'PiutangUsaha' "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " WHERE si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND si.sicarabayar = 1 "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " AND si.silokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " AND si.sicustomer = '" & FixDouble(idkontak) & "' "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " AND si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " AND (si.sistatuslunas <> 2 OR (si.sistatuslunas = 2 AND si.sitgllunas > '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')) "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN si.simatauang LIKE '%' ELSE si.simatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) "
                'statusJT, 0 = belum, 1 = sudah, 2 = semua
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " AND (CASE '" & FixDouble(statusJT) & "' WHEN 0 THEN si.sitgljatuhtempo > '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' WHEN 1 THEN si.sitgljatuhtempo <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' ELSE si.sitgljatuhtempo LIKE '%' END) "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " AND si.sitgljatuhtempo BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAkhir) & "' "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " GROUP BY si.siid "
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " ORDER BY si.sitgl, si.siinputtgl, si.siid "

                'SI VALAS
                sqlValasSI = "SELECT si.siid as arid, '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' as arlokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as arlokasinama, si.sitgl as artgl, si.sisumber as arsumber, si.sinotransaksi as arnotransaksi, si.sicustomer as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, s.snilai as arnorek, si.simatauang as armatauang, si.sikurs as arkurs, si.siuraian as aruraian, si.sicatatan as arcatatan, si.sitotaltransaksi as artotal, (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) + IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) + IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) END) as arbayar, (si.sitotaltransaksi) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) as arsisa, si.sitgljatuhtempo as artgljatuhtempo, si.sistatuslunas as arstatuslunas, si.sitgllunas as artgllunas, si.siinputtgl as arinputtgl, 0 as arisfungsional, 0 as arissaldoakhir "
                sqlValasSI &= " FROM m5_pv pv "
                sqlValasSI &= " JOIN m5_pv_detail pvd ON pv.pvid = pvd.idpv AND pv.pvstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND pv.pvtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlValasSI &= " RIGHT JOIN m5_si si ON pvd.idtransaksi = si.siid AND pvd.sumber = si.sisumber "
                sqlValasSI &= " LEFT JOIN m5_sr sr ON si.siid = sr.sridsi AND sr.srstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND sr.srjenis = 1 AND sr.srtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlValasSI &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid "
                sqlValasSI &= " LEFT JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "'"
                sqlValasSI &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode = 'PiutangUsaha' "
                sqlValasSI &= " WHERE si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND si.sicarabayar = 1 "
                sqlValasSI &= " AND si.silokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' "
                sqlValasSI &= " AND si.sicustomer = '" & FixDouble(idkontak) & "' "
                sqlValasSI &= " AND si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlValasSI &= " AND si.simatauang <> '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' "
                sqlValasSI &= " AND (si.sistatuslunas <> 2 OR (si.sistatuslunas = 2 AND si.sitgllunas > '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')) "
                sqlValasSI &= " AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN si.simatauang LIKE '%' ELSE si.simatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) "
                'statusJT, 0 = belum, 1 = sudah, 2 = semua
                sqlValasSI &= " AND (CASE '" & FixDouble(statusJT) & "' WHEN 0 THEN si.sitgljatuhtempo > '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' WHEN 1 THEN si.sitgljatuhtempo <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' ELSE si.sitgljatuhtempo LIKE '%' END) "
                sqlValasSI &= " AND si.sitgljatuhtempo BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglJTAkhir) & "' "
                sqlValasSI &= " GROUP BY si.siid "
                sqlValasSI &= " ORDER BY si.sitgl, si.siinputtgl, si.siid "

                'SR FUNGSIONAL
