                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'MAPPING :         arnourut,                     idlogin,                           arid,                             arlokasi,                             arlokasinama,                                             artgl,                              arsumber,                             arnotransaksi,                             arkontak,                             arkontakkode,                             arkontaknama,                             aralamat1,                             aralamat2,                             aralamat3,                             aralamat4,                             aralamat5,                             arnotelp1,                             arnotelp2,                             arnorek,                             armatauang,                             arkurs,                             aruraian,                             arcatatan,                             artotal,                             arbayar,                             arsisa,                                             artgljatuhtempo,                   arstatuslunas,                                           artgllunas,                                              arinputtgl,                                         arisfungsional,                 arissaldoakhir,                     idmsmq,                    aruserid,                 arcustomtext1,           arcustomtext2,           arcustomtext3,           arcustomtext4,           arcustomtext5,arcustomint1,arcustomint2,arcustomint3,arcustomint4,arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1,           arcustomdbl2,           arcustomdbl3,           arcustomdbl4,           arcustomdbl5,                                      arcustomdate1,                                      arcustomdate2,                                      arcustomdate3,                                      arcustomdate4,                                      arcustomdate5
                    strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arlokasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arlokasinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aralamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("armatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aruraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("artotal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arbayar")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("arsisa")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("arstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("arinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("arisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                    urutSAkhir += 1

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT
                    urut += 1
                Next
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL TOTAL VOUCHER SEMUA KONTAK ==============


            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            'SALDO TOTAL
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ar_Voucher_Detail(arnourut, idlogin, arid, arlokasi, arlokasinama, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, artotal, arbayar, arsisa, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Total AR Voucher." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
            'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Total AR Voucher." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================
            'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++


        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN Voucher PER KONTAK -------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_ARVoucher_Aging_Cabang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES) CABANG
        '//SUMBER SI(SALES INVOICE), SR(SALES RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer, cabang(11) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, cabang

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0
        Dim vCabang As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        If (dataDetail.Length <> 12) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(10)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(10)
        End If

        'cabang(11) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(11)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "cabang can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vCabang = dataDetail(11)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Voucher_Aging_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ar_Voucher_Aging_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ar_Voucher_Aging_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AR Voucher data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Voucher_Aging_Detail -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI CUSTOMER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING Voucher PIUTANG
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "
        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'C') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND (t.tsumber = 'SI' OR t.tsumber = 'SR') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & customerCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & customerAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        End If
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtCustomer As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------

        If dtCustomer.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING
            Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)

            End If
            Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
            If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If


            'AMBIL SETTING UMUR ----------------------------------------------------
            Dim umur1 As Double = 0, umur2 As Double = 0, umur3 As Double = 0, umur4 As Double = 0, umur5 As Double = 0

            sql = "  SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting'"
            sql &= " AND (skode = 'UmurPiutang1' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang2' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang3' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang4'"
            sql &= " OR skode = 'UmurPiutang5' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang6' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang7' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang8'"
            sql &= " OR skode = 'UmurPiutang9' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang10')"
            Dim DtUmur As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If DtUmur.Rows.Count >= 10 Then
                umur1 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang1'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur1) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 1 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur2 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang2'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur2) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 2 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur3 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang3'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur3) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 3 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur4 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang4'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur4) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 4 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur5 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang5'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur5) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 5 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur6 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang6'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur6) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 6 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur7 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang7'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur7) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 7 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur8 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang8'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur8) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 8 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur9 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang9'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur9) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 9 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur10 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang10'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur10) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 10 setting value." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                result(2) = "Setting AR Aging not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL SETTING UMUR ---------------------------------------------


            Dim dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSSubtotal As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsionalSI As String = "", sqlValasSI As String = ""
            Dim sqlFungsionalSR As String = "", sqlValasSR As String = ""
            Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSubtotal As String = ""
            Dim urut As Double = 1, urutSAkhir As Double = 1, idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG Voucher PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtCustomer.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then

            sqlSubtotal &= " AND ar.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' "
            sqlSubtotal &= " AND ar.arissaldoakhir = '" & FixDouble(0) & "' "
            sqlSubtotal &= " GROUP BY ar.armatauang "
            sqlSubtotal &= " ORDER BY ar.arisfungsional DESC, ar.armatauang "

            'AMBIL SALDO SUBTOTAL
            dtSSubtotal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSubtotal, strCon)
            If dtSSubtotal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                'URUTAN SALDO AKHIR
                urutSAkhir = 1

                dtSSubtotal = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtSSubtotal, "", "arisfungsional DESC, armatauang")
                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSSubtotal.Rows
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU

                          arsisa,                                             artgljatuhtempo,                   arstatuslunas,                                           artgllunas,                                              arinputtgl,                                         arisfungsional,                 arissaldoakhir,                         arumur_1,                           arumur1,                           arumur2,                           arumur3,                           arumur4,                           arumur5,                           arumur6,                     strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arcabang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arcabangnama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("artgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("arkontak")) & "', '" &     Public Function M0_ARVoucher_Aging_Lokasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES) LOKASI
        '//SUMBER SI(SALES INVOICE), SR(SALES RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer, lokasi(11) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, lokasi

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0
        Dim vLokasi As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 12) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(10)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(10)
        End If

        'lokasi(11) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(11)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "lokasi can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vLokasi = dataDetail(11)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Voucher_Aging_Detail ------------------------------------------

            result(2) = "Failed replace AR Voucher data." : GoTo selesai

        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "

        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & customerCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then

            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & customerAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        End If

        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

    Public Function M0_ARSummary_Aging_Cabang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES) CABANG
        '//SUMBER SI(SALES INVOICE), SR(SALES RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, customerCategory(3) As String, 
        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer, cabang(11) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, cabang

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0
        Dim vCabang As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 12) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        area = dataDetail(2)

        'customerCategory(3) As String
        customerCat = dataDetail(3)

        'customerAwal(4) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'customerAkhir(5) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)

        'salesman(7) As String
        salesman = dataDetail(7)

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(10)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(10)
        End If

        'cabang(11) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(11)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "cabang can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vCabang = dataDetail(11)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Voucher_Aging_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ar_Voucher_Aging_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ar_Voucher_Aging_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AR Voucher data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ar_Voucher_Aging_Detail -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI CUSTOMER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING Voucher PIUTANG
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "
        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'C') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND (t.tsumber = 'SI' OR t.tsumber = 'SR') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer = '" & customerCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & customerAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CUSTOMER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= CUSTOMER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
        End If
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtCustomer As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA CUSTOMER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------

        If dtCustomer.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
            If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
            If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If


            'AMBIL SETTING UMUR ----------------------------------------------------
            Dim umur1 As Double = 0, umur2 As Double = 0, umur3 As Double = 0, umur4 As Double = 0, umur5 As Double = 0
            Dim umur6 As Double = 0, umur7 As Double = 0, umur8 As Double = 0, umur9 As Double = 0, umur10 As Double = 0
            sql = "  SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting'"
            sql &= " AND (skode = 'UmurPiutang1' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang2' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang3' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang4'"
            sql &= " OR skode = 'UmurPiutang5' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang6' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang7' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang8'"
            sql &= " OR skode = 'UmurPiutang9' OR skode = 'UmurPiutang10')"
            Dim DtUmur As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If DtUmur.Rows.Count >= 10 Then
                umur1 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang1'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur1) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 1 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur2 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang2'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur2) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 2 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur3 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang3'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur3) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 3 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur4 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang4'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur4) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 4 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur5 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang5'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur5) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 5 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur6 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang6'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur6) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 6 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur7 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang7'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur7) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 7 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur8 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang8'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur8) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 8 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur9 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang9'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur9) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 9 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur10 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurPiutang10'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur10) Then result(2) = "Invalid AR Aging 10 setting value." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                result(2) = "Setting AR Aging not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL SETTING UMUR ---------------------------------------------


            Dim dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSSubtotal As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsionalSI As String = "", sqlValasSI As String = ""
            Dim sqlFungsionalSR As String = "", sqlValasSR As String = ""
            Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSubtotal As String = ""
            Dim urut As Double = 1, urutSAkhir As Double = 1, idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG Voucher PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtCustomer.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL
                'SI FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsionalSI = "SELECT si.siid as arid, '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' as arcabang, IFNULL(br.bnama,'') as arcabangnama, si.sitgl as artgl, si.sisumber as arsumber, si.sinotransaksi as arnotransaksi, si.sicustomer as arkontak, c.kkode as arkontakkode, c.knama as arkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as aralamat1, c.k1alamat2 as aralamat2, c.k1alamat3 as aralamat3, c.k1alamat4 as aralamat4, c.k1alamat5 as aralamat5, c.k1notelp1 as arnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as arnotelp2, s.snilai as arnorek, '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as armatauang, '" & FixDouble(kursFungsional) & "' as arkurs, si.siuraian as aruraian, si.sicatatan as arcatatan, (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) as artotal, (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) + IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs) + IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) END) as arbayar, (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) as arsisa, si.sitgljatuhtempo as artgljatuhtempo, si.sistatuslunas as arstatuslunas, si.sitgllunas as artgllunas, si.siinputtgl as arinputtgl, 1 as arisfungsional, 0 as arissaldoakhir, "

                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur1) & " THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as arumur_1, "
                'UMUR1          : JIKA UMUR1 = 0 DAN UMUR2 = 0 MAKA 0,                                               JIKA UMUR1 = 0 DAN UMUR2 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR2 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        JIKA UMUR1 <> 0 DAN UMUR2 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR2 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR1 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur2) & " THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur2) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur1) & " THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as arumur1, "
                'UMUR2          : JIKA UMUR2 = 0 DAN UMUR3 = 0 MAKA 0,                                               JIKA UMUR2 = 0 DAN UMUR3 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR3 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        JIKA UMUR2 <> 0 DAN UMUR3 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR3 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR2 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur3) & " THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur3) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur2) & " THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as arumur2, "
                'UMUR3          : JIKA UMUR3 = 0 DAN UMUR4 = 0 MAKA 0,                                               JIKA UMUR3 = 0 DAN UMUR4 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR4 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        JIKA UMUR3 <> 0 DAN UMUR4 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR4 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR3 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur4) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur4) & " THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur4) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur4) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur3) & " THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as arumur3, "
                'UMUR4          : JIKA UMUR4 = 0 DAN UMUR5 = 0 MAKA 0,                                               JIKA UMUR4 = 0 DAN UMUR5 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR5 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        JIKA UMUR4 <> 0 DAN UMUR5 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR5 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR4 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur5) & " THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur5) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur4) & " THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as arumur4, "
                'UMUR5          : JIKA UMUR5 = 0 DAN TGLJT < 0 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           JIKA UMUR5 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < 0 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR5 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA 
                sqlFungsionalSI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur5) & " = 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < 0 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) < 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',si.sitgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur5) & " THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - (CASE si.simatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(pvd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * si.sikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as arumur5, "

            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_ARSummary_Aging_Lokasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER PIUTANG (ACCOUNT RECEIVABLES) LOKASI
        '//SUMBER SI(SALES INVOICE), SR(SALES RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail

        'customerAwal(4) As String, customerAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------

        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, customerCategory, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, lokasi

        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", customerCat As String = "", customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0
        Dim vLokasi As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai

        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        rp5 = dataUtama(14)
