                        If saldoAwal <> 0 Or saldoDebit <> 0 Or saldoKredit <> 0 Or Double.Parse(FixDouble(dr1("apsaldoakhir"))) <> 0 Then
                            'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                            strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                            'MAPPING :         apnourut,                          idlogin,                             apid,                             aplokasi,                             aplokasinama,                                             aptgl,                              apsumber,                             apnotransaksi,                             apkontak,                             apkontakkode,                             apkontaknama,                             apalamat1,                             apalamat2,                             apalamat3,                             apalamat4,                             apalamat5,                             apnotelp1,                             apnotelp2,                             apnorek,                             apmatauang,                             apkurs,                             apuraian,                             apcatatan,                      apsaldoawal,                         apdebit,                         apkredit,                           apsaldoakhir,                             aptgljatuhtempo,                                   apstatuslunas,                                           aptgllunas,                                              apinputtgl,                                          apisfungsional,                    apissaldoakhir,                      idmsmq,                             apuserid,                   apcustomtext1,           apcustomtext2,           apcustomtext3,           apcustomtext4,           apcustomtext5,apcustomint1,apcustomint2,apcustomint3,apcustomint4,apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1,           apcustomdbl2,           apcustomdbl3,           apcustomdbl4,           apcustomdbl5,                                      apcustomdate1,                                      apcustomdate2,                                      apcustomdate3,                                      apcustomdate4,                                      apcustomdate5
                            strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aplokasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aplokasinama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apmatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoDebit) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoKredit) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("apsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("apstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("apinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("apisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                            'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                            urutSAkhir += 1

                            'INCREMENT NOURUT
                            urut += 1

                        Else
                            sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ap_Card_Detail WHERE idlogin = '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "' AND apkontak = '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontak")) & "' AND idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "' AND apuserid = '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apuserid")) & "'"
                            GoTo deleteSaldoNol

                        End If

                    Next
                End If
                'END OF SALDO AKHIR =================================


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_Ap_Card_Detail(apnourut, idlogin, apid, aplokasi, aplokasinama, aptgl, apsumber, apnotransaksi, apkontak, apkontakkode, apkontaknama, apalamat1, apalamat2, apalamat3, apalamat4, apalamat5, apnotelp1, apnotelp2, apnorek, apmatauang, apkurs, apuraian, apcatatan, apsaldoawal, apdebit, apkredit, apsaldoakhir, aptgljatuhtempo, apstatuslunas, aptgllunas, apinputtgl, apisfungsional, apissaldoakhir, idmsmq, apuserid, apcustomtext1, apcustomtext2, apcustomtext3, apcustomtext4, apcustomtext5, apcustomint1, apcustomint2, apcustomint3, apcustomint4, apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1, apcustomdbl2, apcustomdbl3, apcustomdbl4, apcustomdbl5, apcustomdate1, apcustomdate2, apcustomdate3, apcustomdate4, apcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing AP Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                    sql = ""
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


deleteSaldoNol:
                'DELETE JIKA SALDO NOL SEMUA ========================
                If Len(sql) > 0 Then
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed deleting AP Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF DELETE JIKA SALDO NOL SEMUA =================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA SUPPLIER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtSupplier.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtSupplier.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress AP Card : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER KONTAK +++++++++++++++++++

        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER KONTAK -------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_APSummary_Cabang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REKAP HUTANG (ACCOUNT PAYABLES) CABANG

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, supplierCategory(3) As String, 
        'supplierAwal(4) As String, supplierAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, cabang(10) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, supplierCategory, 
        'supplierAwal, supplierAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, cabang

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", supplierCat As String = "", supplierAwal As String = "", supplierAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = ""
        Dim vCabang As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 11) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        'area = dataDetail(2)
        area = ""

        'supplierCategory(3) As String
        supplierCat = dataDetail(3)

        'supplierAwal(4) As String
        supplierAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'supplierAkhir(5) As String
        supplierAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        'salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)
        salesmanCat = ""

        'salesman(7) As String
        'salesman = dataDetail(7)
        salesman = ""

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'cabang(10) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(10)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "cabang can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vCabang = dataDetail(10)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ap_Card_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ap_Card_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ap_Card_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AP Summary data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ap_Card_Detail -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN KARTU HUTANG, UNTUK FILTER TRANSAKSI ------------------------
        sql = "SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE (smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode = 'HutangUsaha')"
        Dim ftAkunAP As String = ""
        Dim dtAkunAP As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dtAkunAP.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'BUAT FILTER AKUN HUTANG PADA TRASAKSI
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtAkunAP.Rows
                ftAkunAP += IIf(Len(ftAkunAP) > 0, " OR ", "")
                ftAkunAP += " t.tnorek = '" & dr1("snilai") & "' "
            Next
            If Len(ftAkunAP) > 0 Then ftAkunAP = " AND (" & ftAkunAP & ") "
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting CoA for AP Summary not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN KARTU HUTANG, UNTUK FILTER TRANSAKSI -----------------


        'AMBIL DATA SUPPLIER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI SUPPLIER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING KARTU HUTANG
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'S') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' " & ftAkunAP & " "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        'If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(supplierCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & supplierCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(supplierAwal) > 0 And Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & supplierAwal & "' AND '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & supplierAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        End If
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtSupplier As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA SUPPLIER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------


        'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ----------------------------------
        Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
        Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
        If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
        If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0, urut As Double = 1
        'END OF AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ---------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER KONTAK --------------------------------------------
        If dtSupplier.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSMutasiTemp As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsional As String = "", sqlValas As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""
            Dim idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtSupplier.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO AWAL =========================================
                'QUERY SALDO AWAL
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT '" & uangFungsional & "' as apmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as apsaldoawal FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & tglAwal & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAP & " JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT t.tmatauang as apmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as apsaldoawal FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & tglAwal & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAP & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT apmatauang, apsaldoawal FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY apmatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, apmatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO AWAL ==================================


                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT '" & uangFungsional & "' as apmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as apdebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as apkredit FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAP & " JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT t.tmatauang as apmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as apdebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as apkredit FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAP & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT apmatauang, apdebit, apkredit FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY apmatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, apmatauang ASC"

                            strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apcabang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apcabangnama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat4")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat5")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apnotelp1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apnotelp2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apmatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoAwal) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoDebit) & "', '" & FixDouble(saldoKredit) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("apsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("apstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("apinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("apisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(0) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                            'INCREMENT NOURUT

                        End If

                End If
                'END OF SALDO AKHIR =================================

                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_Ap_Card_Detail(apnourut, idlogin, apid, apcabang, apcabangnama, aptgl, apsumber, apnotransaksi, apkontak, apkontakkode, apkontaknama, apalamat1, apalamat2, apalamat3, apalamat4, apalamat5, apnotelp1, apnotelp2, apnorek, apmatauang, apkurs, apuraian, apcatatan, apsaldoawal, apdebit, apkredit, apsaldoakhir, aptgljatuhtempo, apstatuslunas, aptgllunas, apinputtgl, apisfungsional, apissaldoakhir, idmsmq, apuserid, apcustomtext1, apcustomtext2, apcustomtext3, apcustomtext4, apcustomtext5, apcustomint1, apcustomint2, apcustomint3, apcustomint4, apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1, apcustomdbl2, apcustomdbl3, apcustomdbl4, apcustomdbl5, apcustomdate1, apcustomdate2, apcustomdate3, apcustomdate4, apcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing AP Summary : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

                End If

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER KONTAK +++++++++++++++++++

        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER KONTAK -------------------------------------


        'HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA REKAP ------------------------------------------------
        'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
        strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

        'AMBIL TOTAL REKAP DARI TABEL PEMBANTU SESUAI IDMSMQ
        sql = "SELECT idlogin, 0 as apid, apcabang, apcabangnama, '" & tglAkhir & "' as aptgl, '' as apsumber, '' as apnotransaksi, 0 as apkontak, '' as apkontakkode, '' as apkontaknama, '' as apalamat1, '' as apalamat2, '' as apalamat3, '' as apalamat4, '' as apalamat5, '' as apnotelp1, '' as apnotelp2, '' as apnorek, apmatauang, apkurs, 'Total' as apuraian, 'Total' as apcatatan, SUM(apsaldoawal) as apsaldoawal, SUM(apdebit) as apdebit, SUM(apkredit) as apkredit, SUM(apsaldoakhir) as apsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as aptgljatuhtempo, 0 as apstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as aptgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "', ' 00:00:00') as apinputtgl, apisfungsional, idmsmq, apuserid, apcustomtext1, apcustomtext2, apcustomtext3, apcustomtext4, apcustomtext5, apcustomint1, apcustomint2, apcustomint3, apcustomint4, apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1, apcustomdbl2, apcustomdbl3, apcustomdbl4, apcustomdbl5, apcustomdate1, apcustomdate2, apcustomdate3, apcustomdate4, apcustomdate5 FROM M2r_Ap_Card_Detail ap WHERE idlogin = '" & idLogin & "' AND idmsmq = '" & idMsmq & "' GROUP BY apmatauang ORDER BY apmatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, apmatauang ASC"

            Dim urutSAkhir As Double = 1

                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))

                        aptgllunas,                                              apinputtgl,                                         apisfungsional,                   apissaldoakhir,                        idmsmq,                             apuserid,                   apcustomtext1,           apcustomtext2,           apcustomtext3,           apcustomtext4,                           apcustomdate1,                                      apcustomdate2,                                      apcustomdate3,                                      apcustomdate4,                                      apcustomdate5
                strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apcabang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apcabangnama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat3")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apmatauang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("apsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("apdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("apkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("apsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgljatuhtempo"))) & "', " & dr1("apstatuslunas") & ", '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgllunas"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("apinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', " & dr1("apisfungsional") & ", " & FixDouble(urutSAkhir) & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                urutSAkhir += 1

                'INCREMENT NOURUT
                urut += 1
            Next

            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ap_Card_Detail(apnourut, idlogin, apid, apcabang, apcabangnama, aptgl, apsumber, apnotransaksi, apkontak, apkontakkode, apkontaknama, apalamat1, apalamat2, apalamat3, apalamat4, apalamat5, apnotelp1, apnotelp2, apnorek, apmatauang, apkurs, apuraian, apcatatan, apsaldoawal, apdebit, apkredit, apsaldoakhir, aptgljatuhtempo, apstatuslunas, aptgllunas, apinputtgl, apisfungsional,  apissaldoakhir, idmsmq, apuserid, apcustomtext1, apcustomtext2, apcustomtext3, apcustomtext4, apcustomtext5, apcustomint1, apcustomint2, apcustomint3, apcustomint4, apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1, apcustomdbl2, apcustomdbl3, apcustomdbl4, apcustomdbl5, apcustomdate1, apcustomdate2, apcustomdate3, apcustomdate4, apcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""

        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_APSummary_Lokasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REKAP HUTANG (ACCOUNT PAYABLES) LOKASI

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, supplierCategory(3) As String, 
        'supplierAwal(4) As String, supplierAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, lokasi(10) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, supplierCategory, 
        'supplierAwal, supplierAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, lokasi

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================

        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity

        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID

        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then

        End If

        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then

        'ModuleId(0) As Integer

            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai

        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 11) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area = dataDetail(2)
        area = ""

        supplierCat = dataDetail(3)

        'supplierAwal(4) As String
        supplierAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'supplierAkhir(5) As String
        supplierAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        'salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)
        salesmanCat = ""

        'salesman(7) As String
        'salesman = dataDetail(7)
        salesman = ""

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'lokasi(10) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(10)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "lokasi can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vLokasi = dataDetail(10)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ap_Card_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ap_Card_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ap_Card_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AP Summary data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ap_Card_Detail -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN KARTU HUTANG, UNTUK FILTER TRANSAKSI ------------------------
        sql = "SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE (smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode = 'HutangUsaha')"
        Dim ftAkunAP As String = ""
        Dim dtAkunAP As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dtAkunAP.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'BUAT FILTER AKUN HUTANG PADA TRASAKSI
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtAkunAP.Rows
                ftAkunAP += IIf(Len(ftAkunAP) > 0, " OR ", "")
                ftAkunAP += " t.tnorek = '" & dr1("snilai") & "' "
            Next
            If Len(ftAkunAP) > 0 Then ftAkunAP = " AND (" & ftAkunAP & ") "
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting CoA for AP Summary not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN KARTU HUTANG, UNTUK FILTER TRANSAKSI -----------------


        'AMBIL DATA SUPPLIER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI SUPPLIER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING KARTU HUTANG
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'S') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' " & ftAkunAP & " "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        'If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(supplierCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & supplierCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(supplierAwal) > 0 And Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & supplierAwal & "' AND '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & supplierAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        End If
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtSupplier As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA SUPPLIER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------


        'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ----------------------------------
        Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
        Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
        If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
        If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0, urut As Double = 1
        'END OF AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ---------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER KONTAK --------------------------------------------
        If dtSupplier.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSMutasiTemp As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsional As String = "", sqlValas As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""
            Dim idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtSupplier.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO AWAL =========================================
                'QUERY SALDO AWAL
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT '" & uangFungsional & "' as apmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as apsaldoawal FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & tglAwal & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAP & " JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT t.tmatauang as apmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as apsaldoawal FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & tglAwal & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAP & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT apmatauang, apsaldoawal FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY apmatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, apmatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO AWAL ==================================


                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT '" & uangFungsional & "' as apmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as apdebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as apkredit FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAP & " JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT t.tmatauang as apmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as apdebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) as apkredit FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAP & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT apmatauang, apdebit, apkredit FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY apmatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, apmatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO MUTASI
                dtSMutasi = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO MUTASI ================================


                'SALDO AKHIR ========================================
                Dim saldoAwal As Double = 0, saldoDebit As Double = 0, saldoKredit As Double = 0

                'QUERY SALDO AKHIR
                sqlFungsional = " SELECT 0 as apid, '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' as aplokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as aplokasinama, '" & tglAkhir & "' as aptgl, '' as apsumber, '' as apnotransaksi, c.kid as apkontak, c.kkode as apkontakkode, c.knama as apkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as apalamat1, c.k1alamat2 as apalamat2, c.k1alamat3 as apalamat3, c.k1alamat4 as apalamat4, c.k1alamat5 as apalamat5, c.k1notelp1 as apnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as apnotelp2, '' as apnorek, '" & uangFungsional & "' as apmatauang, '" & kursFungsional & "' as apkurs, 'Saldo Akhir' as apuraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as  apcatatan, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as apsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as aptgljatuhtempo, 0 as apstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as aptgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "',' ','00:00:00') as apinputtgl, 1 as apisfungsional FROM m1_contact c JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.kid = t.tkontak AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAP & " JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "'"
                sqlValas = " SELECT 0 as apid, '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' as aplokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as aplokasinama, '" & tglAkhir & "' as aptgl, '' as apsumber, '' as apnotransaksi, c.kid as apkontak, c.kkode as apkontakkode, c.knama as apkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as apalamat1, c.k1alamat2 as apalamat2, c.k1alamat3 as apalamat3, c.k1alamat4 as apalamat4, c.k1alamat5 as apalamat5, c.k1notelp1 as apnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as apnotelp2, '' as apnorek, t.tmatauang as apmatauang, t.tkurs as apkurs, 'Saldo Akhir' as apuraian, 'Saldo Akhir' as  apcatatan, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) as apsaldoakhir, '1900-01-01' as aptgljatuhtempo, 0 as apstatuslunas, '1900-01-01' as aptgllunas, CONCAT('" & tglAkhir & "',' ','00:00:00') as apinputtgl, 0 as apisfungsional FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' WHERE c.kid = '" & idkontak & "' AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' AND t.tmatauang <> '" & uangFungsional & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & matauang & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & matauang & "' END) " & ftAkunAP & " GROUP BY t.tmatauang"
                sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & idLogin & "' as idlogin, apid, aplokasi, aplokasinama, aptgl, apsumber, apnotransaksi, apkontak, apkontakkode, apkontaknama, apalamat1, apalamat2, apalamat3, apalamat4, apalamat5, apnotelp1, apnotelp2, apnorek, apmatauang, apkurs, apuraian, apcatatan, apsaldoakhir, aptgljatuhtempo, apstatuslunas, aptgllunas, apinputtgl, apisfungsional, '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as apuserid FROM "
                sqlJadi += " ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi += " ORDER BY apmatauang = '" & uangFungsional & "' DESC, apmatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAkhir = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                If dtSAkhir.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    'INSERT SALDO AKHIR KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAkhir.Rows
                        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL DARI DTSAWAL DAN MUTASI DARI DTSMUTASI
                        saldoAwal = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSAwal, "apsaldoawal", "apmatauang = '" & dr1("apmatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoDebit = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSMutasi, "apdebit", "apmatauang = '" & dr1("apmatauang") & "'", 0))
                        saldoKredit = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSMutasi, "apkredit", "apmatauang = '" & dr1("apmatauang") & "'", 0))

                        If saldoAwal <> 0 Or saldoDebit <> 0 Or saldoKredit <> 0 Or Double.Parse(FixDouble(dr1("apsaldoakhir"))) <> 0 Then
                            'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                            strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                            'MAPPING :         apnourut,                          idlogin,                             apid,                             aplokasi,                             aplokasinama,                                             aptgl,                              apsumber,                             apnotransaksi,                             apkontak,                             apkontakkode,                             apkontaknama,                             apalamat1,                             apalamat2,                             apalamat3,                             apalamat4,                             apalamat5,                             apnotelp1,                             apnotelp2,                             apnorek,                             apmatauang,                             apkurs,                             apuraian,                             apcatatan,                      apsaldoawal,                         apdebit,                         apkredit,                           apsaldoakhir,                                             aptgljatuhtempo,                   apstatuslunas,                                           aptgllunas,                                              apinputtgl,                                          apisfungsional,          apissaldoakhir,                       idmsmq,                             apuserid,                   apcustomtext1,           apcustomtext2,           apcustomtext3,           apcustomtext4,           apcustomtext5,apcustomint1,apcustomint2,apcustomint3,apcustomint4,apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1,           apcustomdbl2,           apcustomdbl3,           apcustomdbl4,           apcustomdbl5,                                      apcustomdate1,                                      apcustomdate2,                                      apcustomdate3,                                      apcustomdate4,                                      apcustomdate5

        Dim dtTotal As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dtTotal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'URUTAN SALDO AKHIR
            Dim urutSAkhir As Double = 1

            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtTotal.Rows
                'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))

                strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aplokasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("aplokasinama")) & "',     Public Function M0_APVoucher_Cabang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN VOUCHER HUTANG (ACCOUNT PAYABLES) CABANG 
        '//SUMBER RI(RECEIVE INVOICE), PRT(PURCHASE RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, supplierCategory(3) As String, 
        'supplierAwal(4) As String, supplierAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer, cabang(11) As String, tglJTAwal(12) As String, tglJTAkhir(13) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, supplierCategory, 
        'supplierAwal, supplierAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, cabang, tglJTAwal, tglJTAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", tglJTAwal As String = "", tglJTAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", supplierCat As String = "", supplierAwal As String = "", supplierAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0
        Dim vCabang As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 14) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        'area = dataDetail(2)
        area = ""

        'supplierCategory(3) As String
        supplierCat = dataDetail(3)

        'supplierAwal(4) As String
        supplierAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'supplierAkhir(5) As String
        supplierAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        'salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)
        salesmanCat = ""

        'salesman(7) As String
        'salesman = dataDetail(7)
        salesman = ""

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(10)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(10)
        End If

        'cabang(11) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(11)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "cabang can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vCabang = dataDetail(11)
        End If

        'tglJTAwal(12) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(12)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(12)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(12))
            End If
        Else
            tglJTAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglJTAkhir(13) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(13)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(13)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglJTAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglJTAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(13))
            End If
        Else
            tglJTAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ap_Voucher_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ap_Voucher_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ap_Voucher_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AP Voucher data." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL DATA SUPPLIER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------

        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "
        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'S') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND (t.tsumber = 'RI' OR t.tsumber = 'PRT') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        'If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "

        If Len(supplierCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & supplierCat & "') "

        If Len(supplierAwal) > 0 And Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & supplierAwal & "' AND '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & supplierAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        End If
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtSupplier As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

            Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")

                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

    Public Function M0_APVoucher_Lokasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN VOUCHER HUTANG (ACCOUNT PAYABLES) LOKASI 
        '//SUMBER RI(RECEIVE INVOICE), PRT(PURCHASE RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, supplierCategory(3) As String, 
        'supplierAwal(4) As String, supplierAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer, lokasi(11) As String, tglJTAwal(12) As String, tglJTAkhir(13) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, supplierCategory, 
        'supplierAwal, supplierAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, lokasi, tglJTAwal, tglJTAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)

        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ap_Voucher_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ap_Voucher_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

            result(2) = "Failed replace AP Voucher data." : GoTo selesai

        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "
        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'S') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND (t.tsumber = 'RI' OR t.tsumber = 'PRT') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA

        ElseIf Len(supplierAwal) > 0 Then

                sqlValasRI &= " AND (CASE '" & FixDouble(statusJT) & "' WHEN 0 THEN ri.ritgljatuhtempo > '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' WHEN 1 THEN ri.ritgljatuhtempo <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' ELSE ri.ritgljatuhtempo LIKE '%' END) "

                sqlFungsionalPRT = " SELECT prt.prtid as apid, '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' as aplokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as aplokasinama, prt.prttgl as aptgl, prt.prtsumber as apsumber, prt.prtnotransaksi as apnotransaksi, prt.prtsupplier as apkontak, c.kkode as apkontakkode, c.knama as apkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as apalamat1, c.k1alamat2 as apalamat2, c.k1alamat3 as apalamat3, c.k1alamat4 as apalamat4, c.k1alamat5 as apalamat5, c.k1notelp1 as apnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as apnotelp2, s.snilai as apnorek, '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as apmatauang, '" & FixDouble(kursFungsional) & "' as apkurs, prt.prturaian as apuraian, prt.prtcatatan as apcatatan, (prt.prttotaltransaksi * prt.prtkurs * -1) as aptotal, (CASE prt.prtmatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar * -1),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas * -1),0) * prt.prtkurs END) as apbayar, (prt.prttotaltransaksi * prt.prtkurs * -1) - (CASE prt.prtmatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar * -1),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas * -1),0) * prt.prtkurs END) as apsisa, prt.prttgljatuhtempo as aptgljatuhtempo, prt.prtstatuslunas as apstatuslunas, prt.prttgllunas as aptgllunas, prt.prtinputtgl as apinputtgl, 1 as apisfungsional, 0 as apissaldoakhir "
