                    'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                    urutSAkhir += 1

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT
                    urut += 1
                Next
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL TOTAL VOUCHER SEMUA KONTAK ==============


            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            'SALDO TOTAL
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ap_Voucher_Detail(apnourut, idlogin, apid, aplokasi, aplokasinama, aptgl, apsumber, apnotransaksi, apkontak, apkontakkode, apkontaknama, apalamat1, apalamat2, apalamat3, apalamat4, apalamat5, apnotelp1, apnotelp2, apnorek, apmatauang, apkurs, apuraian, apcatatan, aptotal, apbayar, apsisa, aptgljatuhtempo, apstatuslunas, aptgllunas, apinputtgl, apisfungsional, apissaldoakhir, idmsmq, apuserid, apcustomtext1, apcustomtext2, apcustomtext3, apcustomtext4, apcustomtext5, apcustomint1, apcustomint2, apcustomint3, apcustomint4, apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1, apcustomdbl2, apcustomdbl3, apcustomdbl4, apcustomdbl5, apcustomdate1, apcustomdate2, apcustomdate3, apcustomdate4, apcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Total AP Voucher." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
            'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Total AP Voucher." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================
            'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++


        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN VOUCHER PER KONTAK -------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER HUTANG (ACCOUNT PAYABLES) CABANG

        Dim vCabang As String = ""

        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING

        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity

        'validKey = ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then

        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================

        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then

        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================

        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA

            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================

        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String

                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        'area = dataDetail(2)
        area = ""

        'supplierCategory(3) As String
        supplierCat = dataDetail(3)

        'supplierAwal(4) As String
        supplierAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'supplierAkhir(5) As String
        supplierAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        'salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)
        salesmanCat = ""

        'salesman(7) As String
        'salesman = dataDetail(7)
        salesman = ""

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer

        Else

        End If

        Else

        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AP Voucher data." : GoTo selesai

        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'S') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND (t.tsumber = 'RI' OR t.tsumber = 'PRT') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        'If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SUPPLIER
        If Len(supplierCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & supplierCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(supplierAwal) > 0 And Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & supplierAwal & "' AND '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & supplierAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        End If
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtSupplier As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA SUPPLIER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN VOUCHER PER KONTAK --------------------------------------------
        If dtSupplier.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING
            Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
            Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
            If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
            If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
                result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If


            'AMBIL SETTING UMUR ----------------------------------------------------
            Dim umur1 As Double = 0, umur2 As Double = 0, umur3 As Double = 0, umur4 As Double = 0, umur5 As Double = 0
            Dim umur6 As Double = 0, umur7 As Double = 0, umur8 As Double = 0, umur9 As Double = 0, umur10 As Double = 0
            sql = "  SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting'"
            sql &= " AND (skode = 'UmurHutang1' OR skode = 'UmurHutang2' OR skode = 'UmurHutang3' OR skode = 'UmurHutang4'"
            sql &= " OR skode = 'UmurHutang5' OR skode = 'UmurHutang6' OR skode = 'UmurHutang7' OR skode = 'UmurHutang8'"
            sql &= " OR skode = 'UmurHutang9' OR skode = 'UmurHutang10')"
            Dim DtUmur As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If DtUmur.Rows.Count >= 10 Then
                umur1 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang1'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur1) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 1 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur2 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang2'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur2) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 2 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur3 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang3'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur3) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 3 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur4 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang4'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur4) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 4 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur5 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang5'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur5) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 5 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur6 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang6'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur6) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 6 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur7 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang7'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur7) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 7 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur8 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang8'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur8) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 8 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur9 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang9'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur9) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 9 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur10 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang10'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur10) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 10 setting value." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                result(2) = "Setting AP Aging not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL SETTING UMUR ---------------------------------------------


            Dim dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSSubtotal As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsionalRI As String = "", sqlValasRI As String = ""
            Dim sqlFungsionalPRT As String = "", sqlValasPRT As String = ""
            Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSubtotal As String = ""
            Dim urut As Double = 1, urutSAkhir As Double = 1, idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG VOUCHER PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtSupplier.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL
                'RI FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsionalRI = "SELECT ri.riid as apid, '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' as apcabang, IFNULL(br.bnama,'') as apcabangnama, ri.ritgl as aptgl, ri.risumber as apsumber, ri.rinotransaksi as apnotransaksi, ri.risupplier as apkontak, c.kkode as apkontakkode, c.knama as apkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as apalamat1, c.k1alamat2 as apalamat2, c.k1alamat3 as apalamat3, c.k1alamat4 as apalamat4, c.k1alamat5 as apalamat5, c.k1notelp1 as apnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as apnotelp2, s.snilai as apnorek, '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as apmatauang, '" & FixDouble(kursFungsional) & "' as apkurs, ri.riuraian as apuraian, ri.ricatatan as apcatatan, (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) as aptotal, (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) + IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs) + IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) END) as apbayar, (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) as apsisa, ri.ritgljatuhtempo as aptgljatuhtempo, ri.ristatuslunas as apstatuslunas, ri.ritgllunas as aptgllunas, ri.riinputtgl as apinputtgl, 1 as apisfungsional, 0 as apissaldoakhir, "
                'UMUR NEGATIF +++++++++++++++++++++++
                'UMUR_1         : JIKA UMUR1 = 0 MAKA 0, JIKA TGLJT < UMUR1 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur1) & " THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as apumur_1, "

                    sql = "Insert into M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail(apnourut, idlogin, apid, apcabang, apcabangnama, aptgl, apsumber, apnotransaksi, apkontak, apkontakkode, apkontaknama, apalamat1, apalamat2, apalamat3, apalamat4, apalamat5, apnotelp1, apnotelp2, apnorek, apmatauang, apkurs, apuraian, apcatatan, aptotal, apbayar, apsisa, aptgljatuhtempo, apstatuslunas, aptgllunas, apinputtgl, apisfungsional, apissaldoakhir, apumur_1, apumur1, apumur2, apumur3, apumur4, apumur5, apumur6, apumur7, apumur8, apumur9, apumur10, apumur_10, idmsmq, apuserid, apcustomtext1, apcustomtext2, apcustomtext3, apcustomtext4, apcustomtext5, apcustomint1, apcustomint2, apcustomint3, apcustomint4, apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1, apcustomdbl2, apcustomdbl3, apcustomdbl4, apcustomdbl5, apcustomdate1, apcustomdate2, apcustomdate3, apcustomdate4, apcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing Subtotal AP Voucher : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress AP Voucher : " & IIf(orderBy = "kkode", dr("kkode"), dr("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN HITUNG Voucher PER KONTAK +++++++++++++++++++


            'HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA KONTAK +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            'TAMBAHKAN STEP
            stepKe += 1

            'AMBIL TOTAL VOUCHER SEMUA KONTAK =====================
            'CLEAR QUERY
            strValue.Clear()

            sqlSubtotal = "SELECT '0' as apid, ap.apcabang, ap.apcabangnama, ap.aptgl, ap.apsumber, '' as apnotransaksi, '0' as apkontak, '' as apkontakkode, '' as apkontaknama, '' as apalamat1, '' as apalamat2, '' as apalamat3, '' as apalamat4, '' as apalamat5, '' as apnotelp1, '' as apnotelp2, ap.apnorek, ap.apmatauang, ap.apkurs, 'Total' as apuraian, 'Total' as apcatatan, SUM(ap.aptotal) as aptotal, SUM(ap.apbayar) as apbayar, SUM(ap.apsisa) as apsisa, ap.aptgljatuhtempo, ap.apstatuslunas, ap.aptgllunas, ap.apinputtgl, ap.apisfungsional, ap.apissaldoakhir, SUM(ap.apumur_1) as apumur_1, SUM(ap.apumur1) as apumur1, SUM(ap.apumur2) as apumur2, SUM(ap.apumur3) as apumur3, SUM(ap.apumur4) as apumur4, SUM(ap.apumur5) as apumur5, SUM(ap.apumur6) as apumur6, SUM(ap.apumur7) as apumur7, SUM(ap.apumur8) as apumur8, SUM(ap.apumur9) as apumur9, SUM(ap.apumur10) as apumur10, SUM(ap.apumur_10) as apumur_10 "
            sqlSubtotal &= " FROM M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail ap "
            sqlSubtotal &= " WHERE ap.idlogin = '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' "
            sqlSubtotal &= " AND ap.idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' "
            sqlSubtotal &= " AND ap.apissaldoakhir = '" & FixDouble(0) & "' "
            sqlSubtotal &= " GROUP BY ap.apmatauang "
            sqlSubtotal &= " ORDER BY ap.apisfungsional DESC, ap.apmatauang "

            'AMBIL SALDO SUBTOTAL
            dtSSubtotal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSubtotal, strCon)
            If dtSSubtotal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                'URUTAN SALDO AKHIR
                urutSAkhir = 1

                'INSERT SALDO SUBTOTAL KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                'SORTING DATA TERLEBIH DAHULU
                dtSSubtotal = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtSSubtotal, "", "apisfungsional DESC, apmatauang")
                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSSubtotal.Rows
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'MAPPING :         apnourut,                     idlogin,                           apid,                             apcabang,                             apcabangnama,                                             aptgl,                              apsumber,                             apnotransaksi,                             apkontak,                           apsisa,                                             aptgljatuhtempo,                   apstatuslunas,                                           aptgllunas,                                              apinputtgl,                                         apisfungsional,                 apissaldoakhir,                         apumur_1,                           apumur1,                           apumur2,                           apumur3,                           apumur4,                           apumur5,                           apumur6,                           apumur7,                           apumur8,                           apumur9,                           apumur10,                           apumur_10,                     idmsmq,                    apuserid,                 apcustomtext1,           apcustomtext2,           apcustomtext3,           apcustomtext4,                           apcustomdate1,                                      apcustomdate2,                                      apcustomdate3,                                      apcustomdate4,                                      apcustomdate5
                    strValue.Append("('" & urut & "', '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apcabang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apcabangnama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("aptgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat1")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat2")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("apalamat3")) & "', '" &                     'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                    urutSAkhir += 1

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT
                    urut += 1
                Next
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL TOTAL VOUCHER SEMUA KONTAK ==============


            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            'SALDO TOTAL
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail(apnourut, idlogin, apid, apcabang, apcabangnama, aptgl, apsumber, apnotransaksi, apkontak, apkontakkode, apkontaknama, apalamat1, apalamat2, apalamat3, apalamat4, apalamat5, apnotelp1, apnotelp2, apnorek, apmatauang, apkurs, apuraian, apcatatan, aptotal, apbayar, apsisa, aptgljatuhtempo, apstatuslunas, aptgllunas, apinputtgl, apisfungsional, apissaldoakhir, apumur_1, apumur1, apumur2, apumur3, apumur4, apumur5, apumur6, apumur7, apumur8, apumur9, apumur10, apumur_10, idmsmq, apuserid, apcustomtext1, apcustomtext2, apcustomtext3, apcustomtext4, apcustomtext5, apcustomint1, apcustomint2, apcustomint3, apcustomint4, apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1, apcustomdbl2, apcustomdbl3, apcustomdbl4, apcustomdbl5, apcustomdate1, apcustomdate2, apcustomdate3, apcustomdate4, apcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""

                End If

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================

            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================
            'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++


        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN VOUCHER PER KONTAK -------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_APVoucher_Aging_Lokasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER HUTANG (ACCOUNT PAYABLES) LOKASI
        '//SUMBER RI(RECEIVE INVOICE), PRT(PURCHASE RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, supplierCategory(3) As String, 
        'supplierAwal(4) As String, supplierAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer, lokasi(11) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, supplierCategory, 
        'supplierAwal, supplierAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, lokasi

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", supplierCat As String = "", supplierAwal As String = "", supplierAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0
        Dim vLokasi As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 12) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'area(2) As String
        'area = dataDetail(2)
        area = ""

        'supplierCategory(3) As String
        supplierCat = dataDetail(3)

        'supplierAwal(4) As String
        supplierAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'supplierAkhir(5) As String
        supplierAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String
        'salesmanCat = dataDetail(6)
        salesmanCat = ""

        'salesman(7) As String
        'salesman = dataDetail(7)
        salesman = ""

        'matauang(8) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        'orderBy(9) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(9)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'statusJT(10) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(10)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "statusJT required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            statusJT = dataDetail(10)
        End If

        'lokasi(11) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(11)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "lokasi can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vLokasi = dataDetail(11)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace AP Voucher data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL DATA SUPPLIER SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------
        'KONTAK KATEGORI SUPPLIER, DAN AKUN SESUAI SETTING VOUCHER HUTANG
        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "
        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'S') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND (t.tsumber = 'RI' OR t.tsumber = 'PRT') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        'If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SUPPLIER
        If Len(supplierCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & supplierCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(supplierAwal) > 0 And Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & supplierAwal & "' AND '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & supplierAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        End If
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesmanCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman = '" & salesmanCat & "') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER SALESMAN
        'If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN GROUPING
        sql += " GROUP BY c1.kid "
        'TAMBAHKAN SORTING
        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

        Dim dtSupplier As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL DATA SUPPLIER SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------

                If Double.IsNaN(umur5) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 5 setting value." : GoTo selesai

    Public Function M0_APSummary_Aging_Cabang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER HUTANG (ACCOUNT PAYABLES) CABANG
        '//SUMBER RI(RECEIVE INVOICE), PRT(PURCHASE RETUR)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, area(2) As String, supplierCategory(3) As String, 
        'supplierAwal(4) As String, supplierAkhir(5) As String, salesmanCategory(6) As String, salesman(7) As String, matauang(8) As String,
        'orderBy(9) As String, statusJT(10) As Integer, cabang(11) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, area, supplierCategory, 
        'supplierAwal, supplierAkhir, salesmanCategory, salesman, matauang,
        'orderBy, statusJT, cabang

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim area As String = "", supplierCat As String = "", supplierAwal As String = "", supplierAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCat As String = "", salesman As String = "", matauang As String = "", orderBy As String = "", statusJT As Integer = 0
        Dim vCabang As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA

            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then

        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'salesman = dataDetail(7)

        ElseIf dataDetail(9).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(9).ToString <> "knama" Then

        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

        sql = "SELECT c1.kid, c1.kkode, c1.knama FROM m1_contact c1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c1.kid = t.tkontak LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid "

        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        'If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "

            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & supplierAwal & "' AND '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & supplierAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK <= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " <= '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        End If

        'If Len(salesman) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c2." & orderBy & " = '" & salesman & "') "

        sql += " ORDER BY c1." & orderBy & ""

            sql &= " AND (skode = 'UmurHutang1' OR skode = 'UmurHutang2' OR skode = 'UmurHutang3' OR skode = 'UmurHutang4'"

            sql &= " OR skode = 'UmurHutang9' OR skode = 'UmurHutang10')"
            Dim DtUmur As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If DtUmur.Rows.Count >= 10 Then

                If Double.IsNaN(umur1) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 1 setting value." : GoTo selesai

                If Double.IsNaN(umur6) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 6 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur7 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang7'", Double.NaN))

            End If
            'END OF AMBIL SETTING UMUR ---------------------------------------------


            Dim dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSSubtotal As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsionalRI As String = "", sqlValasRI As String = ""
            Dim sqlFungsionalPRT As String = "", sqlValasPRT As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG VOUCHER PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtSupplier.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL
                'RI FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsionalRI = "SELECT ri.riid as apid, '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' as apcabang, IFNULL(br.bnama,'') as apcabangnama, ri.ritgl as aptgl, ri.risumber as apsumber, ri.rinotransaksi as apnotransaksi, ri.risupplier as apkontak, c.kkode as apkontakkode, c.knama as apkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as apalamat1, c.k1alamat2 as apalamat2, c.k1alamat3 as apalamat3, c.k1alamat4 as apalamat4, c.k1alamat5 as apalamat5, c.k1notelp1 as apnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as apnotelp2, s.snilai as apnorek, '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as apmatauang, '" & FixDouble(kursFungsional) & "' as apkurs, ri.riuraian as apuraian, ri.ricatatan as apcatatan, (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) as aptotal, (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) + IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs) + IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) END) as apbayar, (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) as apsisa, ri.ritgljatuhtempo as aptgljatuhtempo, ri.ristatuslunas as apstatuslunas, ri.ritgllunas as aptgllunas, ri.riinputtgl as apinputtgl, 1 as apisfungsional, 0 as apissaldoakhir, "

                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur2) & " THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur1) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur2) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur1) & " THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as apumur1, "

                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur3) & " THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur2) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur3) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur2) & " THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as apumur2, "
                'UMUR3          : JIKA UMUR3 = 0 DAN UMUR4 = 0 MAKA 0,                                               JIKA UMUR3 = 0 DAN UMUR4 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR4 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        JIKA UMUR3 <> 0 DAN UMUR4 <> 0 DAN TGLJT < UMUR4 DAN TGLJT >= UMUR3 MAKA TAMPILKAN SISA
                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur3) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur4) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur4) & " THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur3) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur4) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur4) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur3) & " THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as apumur3, "

                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " = 0 THEN 0 WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " = 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur5) & " THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur4) & " <> 0 AND " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < " & FixDouble(umur5) & " AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur4) & " THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as apumur4, "

                sqlFungsionalRI &= " (CASE WHEN " & FixDouble(umur5) & " = 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < 0 THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) WHEN " & FixDouble(umur5) & " <> 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) < 0 AND DATEDIFF('" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "',ri.ritgljatuhtempo) >= " & FixDouble(umur5) & " THEN (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) ELSE 0 END) as apumur5, "

"', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT SALDO AKHIR
                    urutSAkhir += 1

                    'INCREMENT NOURUT
                    urut += 1
                Next
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL TOTAL VOUCHER SEMUA KONTAK ==============


            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            'SALDO TOTAL
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ap_Voucher_Aging_Detail(apnourut, idlogin, apid, apcabang, apcabangnama, aptgl, apsumber, apnotransaksi, apkontak, apkontakkode, apkontaknama, apalamat1, apalamat2, apalamat3, apalamat4, apalamat5, apnotelp1, apnotelp2, apnorek, apmatauang, apkurs, apuraian, apcatatan, aptotal, apbayar, apsisa, aptgljatuhtempo, apstatuslunas, aptgllunas, apinputtgl, apisfungsional, apissaldoakhir, apumur_1, apumur1, apumur2, apumur3, apumur4, apumur5, apumur6, apumur7, apumur8, apumur9, apumur10, apumur_10, idmsmq, apuserid, apcustomtext1, apcustomtext2, apcustomtext3, apcustomtext4, apcustomtext5, apcustomint1, apcustomint2, apcustomint3, apcustomint4, apcustomint5, apcustomdbl1, apcustomdbl2, apcustomdbl3, apcustomdbl4, apcustomdbl5, apcustomdate1, apcustomdate2, apcustomdate3, apcustomdate4, apcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Total AP Voucher." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
            'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtSupplier.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Total AP Voucher." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================
            'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++


        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN VOUCHER PER KONTAK -------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        '//LAPORAN UMUR VOUCHER HUTANG (ACCOUNT PAYABLES) LOKASI

        'salesmanCategory(6) As String

        'salesman(7) As String
        'salesman = dataDetail(7)
        salesman = ""

        matauang = dataDetail(8)

        sql += " WHERE (c1.kkategori = 'S') AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' AND (t.tsumber = 'RI' OR t.tsumber = 'PRT') "
        ''TAMBAHKAN FILTER AREA
        'If Len(area) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.karea = '" & area & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KATEGORI SUPPLIER
        If Len(supplierCat) > 0 Then sql += " AND (c1.kkategorisupplier = '" & supplierCat & "') "
        'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
        If Len(supplierAwal) > 0 And Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & supplierAwal & "' AND '" & supplierAkhir & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SUPPLIER AWAL DIISI MAKA FILTER KONTAK >= SUPPLIER AWAL
            sql += " AND (c1." & orderBy & " >= '" & supplierAwal & "') "
        ElseIf Len(supplierAkhir) > 0 Then

        End If

        Dim dtSupplier As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

                If Double.IsNaN(umur5) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 5 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur6 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang6'", Double.NaN))

                umur7 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang7'", Double.NaN))

                umur9 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang9'", Double.NaN))
                If Double.IsNaN(umur9) Then result(2) = "Invalid AP Aging 9 setting value." : GoTo selesai
                umur10 = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(DtUmur, "snilai", "skode = 'UmurHutang10'", Double.NaN))

            Else
                result(2) = "Setting AP Aging not found." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF AMBIL SETTING UMUR ---------------------------------------------


            Dim dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSSubtotal As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsionalRI As String = "", sqlValasRI As String = ""
            Dim sqlFungsionalPRT As String = "", sqlValasPRT As String = ""
            Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSubtotal As String = ""
            Dim urut As Double = 1, urutSAkhir As Double = 1, idkontak As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG VOUCHER PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtSupplier.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL
                'RI FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsionalRI = "SELECT ri.riid as apid, '" & FixQuotes(vLokasi) & "' as aplokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as aplokasinama, ri.ritgl as aptgl, ri.risumber as apsumber, ri.rinotransaksi as apnotransaksi, ri.risupplier as apkontak, c.kkode as apkontakkode, c.knama as apkontaknama, c.k1alamat1 as apalamat1, c.k1alamat2 as apalamat2, c.k1alamat3 as apalamat3, c.k1alamat4 as apalamat4, c.k1alamat5 as apalamat5, c.k1notelp1 as apnotelp1, c.k1notelp2 as apnotelp2, s.snilai as apnorek, '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as apmatauang, '" & FixDouble(kursFungsional) & "' as apkurs, ri.riuraian as apuraian, ri.ricatatan as apcatatan, (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) as aptotal, (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) + IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs) + IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) END) as apbayar, (ri.ritotaltransaksi * ri.rikurs) - (CASE ri.rimatauang WHEN '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' THEN IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayar),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(vpd.jmlbayarvalas),0) * ri.rikurs END) - IFNULL(SUM(prt.prttotaltransaksi),0) as apsisa, ri.ritgljatuhtempo as aptgljatuhtempo, ri.ristatuslunas as apstatuslunas, ri.ritgllunas as aptgllunas, ri.riinputtgl as apinputtgl, 1 as apisfungsional, 0 as apissaldoakhir, "
