            'JIKA COSTCENTER AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= COSTCENTER AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.costcenter <= '" & FixQuotes(costcenterAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER DIVISI
        If Len(divisiAwal) > 0 And Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA DIVISI AWAL DAN DIVISI AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " it.divisi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(divisiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(divisiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(divisiAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA DIVISI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= DIVISI AWAL
            Filter &= " it.divisi >= '" & FixQuotes(divisiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA DIVISI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= DIVISI AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.divisi <= '" & FixQuotes(divisiAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER SUBDIVISI
        If Len(subdivisiAwal) > 0 And Len(subdivisiAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA SUBDIVISI AWAL DAN SUBDIVISI AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " it.subdivisi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(subdivisiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(subdivisiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(subdivisiAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA SUBDIVISI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= SUBDIVISI AWAL
            Filter &= " it.subdivisi >= '" & FixQuotes(subdivisiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(subdivisiAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA SUBDIVISI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= SUBDIVISI AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.subdivisi <= '" & FixQuotes(subdivisiAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER PROYEK
        If Len(proyekAwal) > 0 And Len(proyekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA PROYEK AWAL DAN PROYEK AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " it.proyek BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(proyekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(proyekAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(proyekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA PROYEK AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= PROYEK AWAL
            Filter &= " it.proyek >= '" & FixQuotes(proyekAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(proyekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA PROYEK AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= PROYEK AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.proyek <= '" & FixQuotes(proyekAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid, it.gudang"
        If Len(costcenterAwal) > 0 Or Len(costcenterAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.costcenter"
        If Len(divisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.divisi"
        If Len(subdivisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(subdivisiAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.subdivisi"
        If Len(proyekAwal) > 0 Or Len(proyekAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.proyek"

        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ", it.gudang"
        If Len(costcenterAwal) > 0 Or Len(costcenterAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.costcenter"
        If Len(divisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.divisi"
        If Len(subdivisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(subdivisiAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.subdivisi"
        If Len(proyekAwal) > 0 Or Len(proyekAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.proyek"

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = "", gudang As String = "", costcenter As String = ""
            Dim divisi As String = "", subdivisi As String = "", proyek As String = ""
            Dim dtSA As New DataTable, saldoawal As Double = 0
            Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", sqlSAGabung As String = "", sqlSMGabung As String = ""
            Dim sqlSAJadi As String = "", sqlSMJadi As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                idbarang = dr1("bid") : gudang = dr1("gudang")
                costcenter = dr1("costcenter") : divisi = dr1("divisi")
                subdivisi = dr1("subdivisi") : proyek = dr1("proyek")

                'QUERY SALDO AWAL ###########################
                sqlSA = "  SELECT IFNULL(it.id,0) as msid, IFNULL(it.cabang,'') as mscabang, IFNULL(br.bnama,'') as mscabangnama, IFNULL(it.lokasi,'') as mslokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as mslokasinama, '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' as msgudang, w.wnama as msgudangnama, '" & FixQuotes(costcenter) & "' as mscostcenter, IFNULL(cc.ccnama,'') as mscostcenternama, '" & FixQuotes(divisi) & "' as msdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as msdivisinama, '" & FixQuotes(subdivisi) & "' as mssubdivisi, IFNULL(sd.sdnama,'') as mssubdivisinama, '" & FixQuotes(proyek) & "' as msproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as msproyeknama, i.bid as msidbarang, i.bkode as mskodebarang, i.btipe as mstipebarang, i.bnama as msnamabarang, i.bsatuan as mssatuanbarang, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as mstgl, '' as mssumber, '' as msnotransaksi, 0 as mskontak,  '' as mskontakkode,  '' as mskontaknama, 'Saldo Awal' as msuraian, 'Saldo Awal' as mscatatan, 'Saldo Awal' as mscatatandetail, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as msjmlmasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as msjmlkeluar, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & " 00:00:00' as msinputtgl, IFNULL(it.customtext1,'') as mscustomtext1, IFNULL(it.customtext2,'') as mscustomtext2, IFNULL(it.customtext3,'') as mscustomtext3, IFNULL(it.customtext4,'') as mscustomtext4, IFNULL(it.customtext5,'') as mscustomtext5, 0 as mscustomint1, 0 as mscustomint2, 0 as mscustomint3, 0 as mscustomint4, 0 as mscustomint5, 0 as mscustomdbl1, 0 as mscustomdbl2, 0 as mscustomdbl3, 0 as mscustomdbl4, 0 as mscustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as mscustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as mscustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as mscustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as mscustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as mscustomdate5"
                sqlSA &= " FROM m1_item i"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse w ON w.wkode = '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixQuotes(costcenter) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixQuotes(divisi) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_subdivision sd ON sd.sdkode = '" & FixQuotes(subdivisi) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixQuotes(proyek) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.gudang = w.wkode AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' "
                If Len(costcenterAwal) > 0 Or Len(costcenterAkhir) > 0 Then sqlSA &= " AND it.costcenter = cc.cckode"
                If Len(divisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then sqlSA &= " AND it.divisi = d.dkode"
                If Len(subdivisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(subdivisiAkhir) > 0 Then sqlSA &= " AND it.subdivisi = sd.sdkode"
                If Len(proyekAwal) > 0 Or Len(proyekAkhir) > 0 Then sqlSA &= " AND it.proyek = p.pkode"

                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON it.cabang = br.bkode"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_location lc ON it.lokasi = lc.lkode"
                sqlSA &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "'"

                sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 1 as msnourut, ms.msid, ms.mscabang, ms.mscabangnama, ms.mslokasi, ms.mslokasinama, ms.msgudang, ms.msgudangnama, ms.mscostcenter, ms.mscostcenternama, ms.msdivisi, ms.msdivisinama, ms.mssubdivisi, ms.mssubdivisinama, ms.msproyek, ms.msproyeknama, ms.msidbarang, ms.mskodebarang, ms.mstipebarang, ms.msnamabarang, ms.mssatuanbarang, ms.mstgl, ms.mssumber, ms.msnotransaksi, ms.mskontak,  ms.mskontakkode,  ms.mskontaknama,  ms.msuraian, ms.mscatatan, ms.mscatatandetail, 0 as msjmlmasuk, 0 as msjmlkeluar, SUM(ms.msjmlmasuk - ms.msjmlkeluar) as mssaldo, ms.msinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as msuserid, ms.mscustomtext1, ms.mscustomtext2, ms.mscustomtext3, ms.mscustomtext4, ms.mscustomtext5, ms.mscustomint1, ms.mscustomint2, ms.mscustomint3, ms.mscustomint4, ms.mscustomint5, ms.mscustomdbl1, ms.mscustomdbl2, ms.mscustomdbl3, ms.mscustomdbl4, ms.mscustomdbl5, ms.mscustomdate1, ms.mscustomdate2, ms.mscustomdate3, ms.mscustomdate4, ms.mscustomdate5"
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM ( " & sqlSA & " ) as ms"
                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY ms.msgudang, ms.msidbarang"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                dtSA = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSAGabung, strCon)
                If dtSA.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    saldoawal = Double.Parse(dtSA.Rows(0)("mssaldo"))
                Else
                    saldoawal = 0
                End If

                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI #########################
                sqlSM = "  SELECT it.id as msid, it.cabang as mscabang, IFNULL(br.bnama,'') as mscabangnama, it.lokasi as mslokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as mslokasinama, it.gudang as msgudang, w.wnama as msgudangnama, IFNULL(it.costcenter,'') as mscostcenter, IFNULL(cc.ccnama,'') as mscostcenternama, IFNULL(it.divisi,'') as msdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as msdivisinama, IFNULL(it.subdivisi,'') as mssubdivisi, IFNULL(sd.sdnama,'') as mssubdivisinama, IFNULL(it.proyek,'') as msproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as msproyeknama, it.idbarang as msidbarang, i.bkode as mskodebarang, it.tipebarang as mstipebarang, it.namabarang as msnamabarang, it.satuanbarang as mssatuanbarang, it.tgl as mstgl, it.sumber as mssumber, it.notransaksi as msnotransaksi, it.kontak as mskontak,  c.kkode as mskontakkode, c.knama as mskontaknama,  it.uraian as msuraian, it.catatan as mscatatan, it.catatandetail as mscatatandetail, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as msjmlmasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as msjmlkeluar, it.inputtgl as msinputtgl, it.customtext1 as mscustomtext1, it.customtext2 as mscustomtext2, it.customtext3 as mscustomtext3, it.customtext4 as mscustomtext4, it.customtext5 as mscustomtext5, it.customint1 as mscustomint1, it.customint2 as mscustomint2, it.customint3 as mscustomint3, it.customint4 as mscustomint4, it.customint5 as mscustomint5, it.customdbl1 as mscustomdbl1, it.customdbl2 as mscustomdbl2, it.customdbl3 as mscustomdbl3, it.customdbl4 as mscustomdbl4, it.customdbl5 as mscustomdbl5, it.customdate1 as mscustomdate1, it.customdate2 as mscustomdate2, it.customdate3 as mscustomdate3, it.customdate4 as mscustomdate4, it.customdate5 as mscustomdate5"
                sqlSM &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it"
                sqlSM &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid"
                sqlSM &= " JOIN m1_branch br ON it.cabang = br.bkode"
                sqlSM &= " JOIN m1_location lc ON it.lokasi = lc.lkode"
                sqlSM &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON it.gudang = w.wkode"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON it.costcenter = cc.cckode"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON it.divisi = d.dkode"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_subdivision sd ON it.subdivisi = sd.sdkode"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON it.proyek = p.pkode"
                sqlSM &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON it.kontak = c.kid"
                sqlSM &= " WHERE it.gudang = '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "'"
                sqlSM &= " AND it.idbarang = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "'"
                sqlSM &= " AND it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixDouble(tglAkhir) & "'"
                If Len(costcenterAwal) > 0 Or Len(costcenterAkhir) > 0 Then sqlSM &= " AND it.costcenter = '" & FixQuotes(costcenter) & "'"
                If Len(divisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then sqlSM &= " AND it.divisi = '" & FixQuotes(divisi) & "'"
                If Len(subdivisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(subdivisiAkhir) > 0 Then sqlSM &= " AND it.subdivisi = '" & FixQuotes(subdivisi) & "'"
                If Len(proyekAwal) > 0 Or Len(proyekAkhir) > 0 Then sqlSM &= " AND it.proyek = '" & FixQuotes(proyek) & "'"
                sqlSM &= " ORDER BY it.tgl, it.inputtgl, it.id"

                sqlSMGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, @nourut := @nourut + 1 as msnourut, ms.msid, ms.mscabang, ms.mscabangnama, ms.mslokasi, ms.mslokasinama, ms.msgudang, ms.msgudangnama, ms.mscostcenter, ms.mscostcenternama, ms.msdivisi, ms.msdivisinama, ms.mssubdivisi, ms.mssubdivisinama, ms.msproyek, ms.msproyeknama, ms.msidbarang, ms.mskodebarang, ms.mstipebarang, ms.msnamabarang, ms.mssatuanbarang, ms.mstgl, ms.mssumber, ms.msnotransaksi, ms.mskontak,  ms.mskontakkode,  ms.mskontaknama,  ms.msuraian, ms.mscatatan, ms.mscatatandetail, ms.msjmlmasuk, ms.msjmlkeluar, @saldo := @saldo + ms.msjmlmasuk - ms.msjmlkeluar as mssaldo, ms.msinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as msuserid, ms.mscustomtext1, ms.mscustomtext2, ms.mscustomtext3, ms.mscustomtext4, ms.mscustomtext5, ms.mscustomint1, ms.mscustomint2, ms.mscustomint3, ms.mscustomint4, ms.mscustomint5, ms.mscustomdbl1, ms.mscustomdbl2, ms.mscustomdbl3, ms.mscustomdbl4, ms.mscustomdbl5, ms.mscustomdate1, ms.mscustomdate2, ms.mscustomdate3, ms.mscustomdate4, ms.mscustomdate5"
                sqlSMGabung &= " FROM ( " & sqlSM & " ) as ms"
                sqlSMGabung &= " , (SELECT @nourut := 1) AS variableInit1"
                sqlSMGabung &= " , (SELECT @saldo := " & FixDouble(saldoawal) & ") AS variableInit2"


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Mutasi_Stok_Detail (" & sqlSAGabung & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If

                'SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSMJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Mutasi_Stok_Detail (" & sqlSMGabung & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSMJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Data Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report 'Nothing' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_Anggaran(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN Anggaran Global
        '- Akun L/R Tahun Berjalan dan Akun L/R Bulan Berjalan tidak perlu ditampilkan di Neraca Mutasi
        '- Akun L/R Ditahan buat Saldo Awal, Saldo Akhir, Mutasi diisi nol 
        '       : REALISASI AKUN +  (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tahun(0) As Integer, bulan(1) As Integer, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String, saldoNol(5) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tahun, bulan, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang, saldoNol

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tahun As String = "", bulan As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = "", saldoNol As Integer = 0

        Dim norekLRBulan As String = "", norekLRTahun As String = "", norekLRDitahan As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Integer

        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            tahun = dataDetail(0)
        End If

        'bulan(1) As String
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            bulan = dataDetail(1)
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        'saldoNol(5) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(5)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(5)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Anggaran WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace budgeting data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------
        'AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiTahunBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRTahun = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Yearly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiDitahan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL SALDO L/R DITAHAN
        '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)
        Dim saldoDitahan As Double = 0
        Dim sqlDitahan As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0)) AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0)) AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0)) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmlkredit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rjmldebit),0)) END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "') AND (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN (r.rtahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & ") ELSE (r.rtahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & " or (r.rtahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rbulan <= " & FixDouble(bulan) & ")) END) ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim dtDitahan As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlDitahan, strCon)
        If dtDitahan.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            saldoDitahan = Double.Parse(dtDitahan.Rows(0)("pksaldo"))
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING -----------------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT * FROM ("
        sql &= " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as nmtahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as nmbulan, '' as nmcabang, '' as nmcabangnama, '' as nmlokasi, '' as nmlokasinama, '' as nmcostcenter, '' as nmcostcenternama, '' as nmdivisi, '' as nmdivisinama, '' as nmsubdivisi, '' as nmsubdivisinama, '' as nmproyek, '' as nmproyeknama, c.cnomor as nmnorek, c.cnama as nmnoreknama, c.ctipe as nmtipe, IFNULL(t.tmatauang,'') as nmmatauang, IFNULL(t.tkurs,0) as nmkurs, IFNULL(t.turaian,'') as nmuraian, IFNULL(t.tcatatan,'') as nmcatatan, IFNULL(r.ranggaran,0) as nmanggaran, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) as nmdebit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) END) as nmkredit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmsaldo, IFNULL(r.ranggaran,0) - (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmvariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as nmuserid, '' as nmcustomtext1, '' as nmcustomtext2, '' as nmcustomtext3, '' as nmcustomtext4, '' as nmcustomtext5, 0 as nmcustomint1, 0 as nmcustomint2, 0 as nmcustomint3, 0 as nmcustomint4, 0 as nmcustomint5, 0 as nmcustomdbl1, 0 as nmcustomdbl2, 0 as nmcustomdbl3, 0 as nmcustomdbl4, 0 as nmcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate5"
        sql &= " FROM m1_coa c"
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND YEAR(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND MONTH(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_realization r ON c.cnomor = r.rnorek AND r.rtahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rbulan = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " WHERE c.cgd = 'D' AND c.caktif = 1"

        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        sql &= " GROUP BY c.cnomor"
        sql &= " ) as anggaran"
        'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA FILTER DATA YANG SALDONYA <> 0 SAJA
        If saldoNol = 0 Then sql &= " WHERE anggaran.nmanggaran <> '0' OR anggaran.nmsaldo <> '0' OR anggaran.nmvariasi <> '0'"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY anggaran.nmnorek"
        'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------


        'SIMPAN KE M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Anggaran(" & sql & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed processing budgeting report." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_Anggaran_Cabang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN Anggaran Cabang
        '- Akun L/R Tahun Berjalan dan Akun L/R Bulan Berjalan tidak perlu ditampilkan di Neraca Mutasi
        '- Akun L/R Ditahan buat Saldo Awal, Saldo Akhir, Mutasi diisi nol 
        '       : REALISASI AKUN +  (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tahun(0) As Integer, bulan(1) As Integer, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String, saldoNol(5) As Integer,
        'cabang(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tahun, bulan, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang, saldoNol, cabang

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim vCabang As String = ""
        Dim norekLRBulan As String = "", norekLRTahun As String = "", norekLRDitahan As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then

        'Query(2) As String

        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer

            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai

            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai

            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================

            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else

        End If

        'bulan(1) As String
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            bulan = dataDetail(1)
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        'saldoNol(5) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(5)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(5)
        End If

        'cabang(6) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(6)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "cabang can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vCabang = dataDetail(6)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Anggaran WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace budgeting data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------
        'AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiTahunBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRTahun = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Yearly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiDitahan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL SALDO L/R DITAHAN
        '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)
        Dim saldoDitahan As Double = 0
        Dim sqlDitahan As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0)) AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0)) AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0)) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmlkredit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rwjmldebit),0)) END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_branch r ON c.cnomor = r.rwnorek WHERE r.rwcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "') AND (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN (r.rwtahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & ") ELSE (r.rwtahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & " or (r.rwtahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rwbulan <= " & FixDouble(bulan) & ")) END) ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim dtDitahan As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlDitahan, strCon)
        If dtDitahan.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            saldoDitahan = Double.Parse(dtDitahan.Rows(0)("pksaldo"))
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING -----------------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT * FROM ("
        sql &= " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as nmtahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as nmbulan, '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' as nmcabang, IFNULL(br.bnama,'') as nmcabangnama, '' as nmlokasi, '' as nmlokasinama, '' as nmcostcenter, '' as nmcostcenternama, '' as nmdivisi, '' as nmdivisinama, '' as nmsubdivisi, '' as nmsubdivisinama, '' as nmproyek, '' as nmproyeknama, c.cnomor as nmnorek, c.cnama as nmnoreknama, c.ctipe as nmtipe, IFNULL(t.tmatauang,'') as nmmatauang, IFNULL(t.tkurs,0) as nmkurs, IFNULL(t.turaian,'') as nmuraian, IFNULL(t.tcatatan,'') as nmcatatan, IFNULL(r.rwanggaran,0) as nmanggaran, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) as nmdebit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) END) as nmkredit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmsaldo, IFNULL(r.rwanggaran,0) - (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmvariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as nmuserid, '' as nmcustomtext1, '' as nmcustomtext2, '' as nmcustomtext3, '' as nmcustomtext4, '' as nmcustomtext5, 0 as nmcustomint1, 0 as nmcustomint2, 0 as nmcustomint3, 0 as nmcustomint4, 0 as nmcustomint5, 0 as nmcustomdbl1, 0 as nmcustomdbl2, 0 as nmcustomdbl3, 0 as nmcustomdbl4, 0 as nmcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate5"
        sql &= " FROM m1_coa c"
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND YEAR(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND MONTH(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_realization_branch r ON c.cnomor = r.rwnorek AND r.rwcabang = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "' AND r.rwtahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rwbulan = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = '" & FixQuotes(vCabang) & "'"
        sql &= " WHERE c.cgd = 'D' AND c.caktif = 1"

        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        sql &= " GROUP BY c.cnomor"
        sql &= " ) as anggaran"
        'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA FILTER DATA YANG SALDONYA <> 0 SAJA
        If saldoNol = 0 Then sql &= " WHERE anggaran.nmanggaran <> '0' OR anggaran.nmsaldo <> '0' OR anggaran.nmvariasi <> '0'"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY anggaran.nmnorek"
        'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------


        'SIMPAN KE M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Anggaran(" & sql & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed processing budgeting report." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_Anggaran_Lokasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN Anggaran Lokasi
        '- Akun L/R Tahun Berjalan dan Akun L/R Bulan Berjalan tidak perlu ditampilkan di Neraca Mutasi
        '- Akun L/R Ditahan buat Saldo Awal, Saldo Akhir, Mutasi diisi nol 
        '       : REALISASI AKUN +  (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tahun(0) As Integer, bulan(1) As Integer, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String, saldoNol(5) As Integer,
        'lokasi(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tahun, bulan, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang, saldoNol, lokasi

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tahun As String = "", bulan As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = "", saldoNol As Integer = 0
        Dim vlokasi As String = ""
        Dim norekLRBulan As String = "", norekLRTahun As String = "", norekLRDitahan As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then

        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL

        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            tahun = dataDetail(0)
        End If

        'bulan(1) As String
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            bulan = dataDetail(1)
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        'saldoNol(5) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(5)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(5)
        End If

        'lokasi(6) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(6)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "lokasi can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vlokasi = dataDetail(6)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Anggaran WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace budgeting data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------
        'AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiTahunBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRTahun = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Yearly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiDitahan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL SALDO L/R DITAHAN
        '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)
        Dim saldoDitahan As Double = 0
        Dim sqlDitahan As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rljmldebit),0)) AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rljmlkredit),0)) AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rljmldebit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rljmlkredit),0)) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rljmlkredit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rljmldebit),0)) END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_location r ON c.cnomor = r.rlnorek WHERE r.rllokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vlokasi) & "' AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "') AND (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN (r.rltahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & ") ELSE (r.rltahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & " or (r.rltahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rlbulan <= " & FixDouble(bulan) & ")) END) ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim dtDitahan As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlDitahan, strCon)
        If dtDitahan.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            saldoDitahan = Double.Parse(dtDitahan.Rows(0)("pksaldo"))
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING -----------------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT * FROM ("
        sql &= " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as nmtahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as nmbulan, '' as nmcabang, '' as nmcabangnama, '" & FixQuotes(vlokasi) & "' as nmlokasi, IFNULL(lc.lnama,'') as nmlokasinama, '' as nmcostcenter, '' as nmcostcenternama, '' as nmdivisi, '' as nmdivisinama, '' as nmsubdivisi, '' as nmsubdivisinama, '' as nmproyek, '' as nmproyeknama, c.cnomor as nmnorek, c.cnama as nmnoreknama, c.ctipe as nmtipe, IFNULL(t.tmatauang,'') as nmmatauang, IFNULL(t.tkurs,0) as nmkurs, IFNULL(t.turaian,'') as nmuraian, IFNULL(t.tcabang,'') as nmcatatan, IFNULL(r.rlanggaran,0) as nmanggaran, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) as nmdebit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) END) as nmkredit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmsaldo, IFNULL(r.rlanggaran,0) - (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmvariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as nmuserid, '' as nmcustomtext1, '' as nmcustomtext2, '' as nmcustomtext3, '' as nmcustomtext4, '' as nmcustomtext5, 0 as nmcustomint1, 0 as nmcustomint2, 0 as nmcustomint3, 0 as nmcustomint4, 0 as nmcustomint5, 0 as nmcustomdbl1, 0 as nmcustomdbl2, 0 as nmcustomdbl3, 0 as nmcustomdbl4, 0 as nmcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate5"
        sql &= " FROM m1_coa c"
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vlokasi) & "' AND YEAR(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND MONTH(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_realization_location r ON c.cnomor = r.rlnorek AND r.rllokasi = '" & FixQuotes(vlokasi) & "' AND r.rltahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rlbulan = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_location lc ON lc.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(vlokasi) & "'"
        sql &= " WHERE c.cgd = 'D' AND c.caktif = 1"

        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        sql &= " GROUP BY c.cnomor"
        sql &= " ) as anggaran"
        'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA FILTER DATA YANG SALDONYA <> 0 SAJA
        If saldoNol = 0 Then sql &= " WHERE anggaran.nmanggaran <> '0' OR anggaran.nmsaldo <> '0' OR anggaran.nmvariasi <> '0'"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY anggaran.nmnorek"
        'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------


        'SIMPAN KE M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Anggaran(" & sql & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed processing budgeting report." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================

            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai

        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String

        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        Else

        End If

        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        If (dataDetail.Length <> 7) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            tahun = dataDetail(0)
        End If

        'bulan(1) As String
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            bulan = dataDetail(1)
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        'saldoNol(5) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(5)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(5)
        End If

        'costcenter(6) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(6)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "costcenter can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vcostcenter = dataDetail(6)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Anggaran WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace budgeting data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------
        'AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiTahunBerjalan'", strCon)
