        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Yearly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiDitahan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL SALDO L/R DITAHAN
        '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)
        Dim saldoDitahan As Double = 0
        Dim sqlDitahan As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0)) AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0)) AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0)) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmlkredit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rccjmldebit),0)) END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_Cost_Center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek WHERE r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixQuotes(vcostcenter) & "' AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "') AND (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN (r.rcctahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & ") ELSE (r.rcctahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & " or (r.rcctahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rccbulan <= " & FixDouble(bulan) & ")) END) ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim dtDitahan As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlDitahan, strCon)
        If dtDitahan.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            saldoDitahan = Double.Parse(dtDitahan.Rows(0)("pksaldo"))
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING -----------------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT * FROM ("
        sql &= " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as nmtahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as nmbulan, '' as nmcabang, '' as nmcabangnama, '' as nmlokasi, '' as nmlokasinama, '" & FixQuotes(vcostcenter) & "' as nmcostcenter, IFNULL(cc.ccnama,'') as nmcostcenternama, '' as nmdivisi, '' as nmdivisinama, '' as nmsubdivisi, '' as nmsubdivisinama, '' as nmproyek, '' as nmproyeknama, c.cnomor as nmnorek, c.cnama as nmnoreknama, c.ctipe as nmtipe, IFNULL(t.tmatauang,'') as nmmatauang, IFNULL(t.tkurs,0) as nmkurs, IFNULL(t.turaian,'') as nmuraian, IFNULL(t.tcatatan,'') as nmcatatan, IFNULL(r.rccanggaran,0) as nmanggaran, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) as nmdebit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) END) as nmkredit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmsaldo, IFNULL(r.rccanggaran,0) - (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmvariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as nmuserid, '' as nmcustomtext1, '' as nmcustomtext2, '' as nmcustomtext3, '' as nmcustomtext4, '' as nmcustomtext5, 0 as nmcustomint1, 0 as nmcustomint2, 0 as nmcustomint3, 0 as nmcustomint4, 0 as nmcustomint5, 0 as nmcustomdbl1, 0 as nmcustomdbl2, 0 as nmcustomdbl3, 0 as nmcustomdbl4, 0 as nmcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate5"
        sql &= " FROM m1_coa c"
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tcostcenter = '" & FixQuotes(vcostcenter) & "' AND YEAR(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND MONTH(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_realization_Cost_Center r ON c.cnomor = r.rccnorek AND r.rcccostcenter = '" & FixQuotes(vcostcenter) & "' AND r.rcctahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rccbulan = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_Cost_Center cc ON cc.cckode = '" & FixQuotes(vcostcenter) & "'"
        sql &= " WHERE c.cgd = 'D' AND c.caktif = 1"

        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        sql &= " GROUP BY c.cnomor"
        sql &= " ) as anggaran"
        'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA FILTER DATA YANG SALDONYA <> 0 SAJA
        If saldoNol = 0 Then sql &= " WHERE anggaran.nmanggaran <> '0' OR anggaran.nmsaldo <> '0' OR anggaran.nmvariasi <> '0'"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY anggaran.nmnorek"
        'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------


        'SIMPAN KE M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Anggaran(" & sql & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed processing budgeting report." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 7) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            tahun = dataDetail(0)
        End If

        'bulan(1) As String
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "bulan required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            bulan = dataDetail(1)
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        'saldoNol(5) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(5)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(5)
        End If

        'divisi(6) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(6)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "divisi can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vdivisi = dataDetail(6)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Anggaran WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace budgeting data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------
        'AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiTahunBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRTahun = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Yearly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiDitahan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL SALDO L/R DITAHAN
        '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)
        Dim saldoDitahan As Double = 0
        Dim sqlDitahan As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0)) AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0)) AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0)) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmlkredit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rdjmldebit),0)) END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek WHERE r.rddivisi = '" & FixQuotes(vdivisi) & "' AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "') AND (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN (r.rdtahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & ") ELSE (r.rdtahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & " or (r.rdtahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rdbulan <= " & FixDouble(bulan) & ")) END) ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim dtDitahan As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlDitahan, strCon)
        If dtDitahan.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            saldoDitahan = Double.Parse(dtDitahan.Rows(0)("pksaldo"))
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING -----------------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT * FROM ("
        sql &= " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as nmtahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as nmbulan, '' as nmcabang, '' as nmcabangnama, '' as nmlokasi, '' as nmlokasinama, '' as nmcostcenter, '' as nmcostcenternama, '" & FixQuotes(vdivisi) & "' as nmdivisi, IFNULL(d.dnama,'') as nmdivisinama, '' as nmsubdivisi, '' as nmsubdivisinama, '' as nmproyek, '' as nmproyeknama, c.cnomor as nmnorek, c.cnama as nmnoreknama, c.ctipe as nmtipe, IFNULL(t.tmatauang,'') as nmmatauang, IFNULL(t.tkurs,0) as nmkurs, IFNULL(t.turaian,'') as nmuraian, IFNULL(t.tcatatan,'') as nmcatatan, IFNULL(r.rdanggaran,0) as nmanggaran, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) as nmdebit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) END) as nmkredit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmsaldo, IFNULL(r.rdanggaran,0) - (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmvariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as nmuserid, '' as nmcustomtext1, '' as nmcustomtext2, '' as nmcustomtext3, '' as nmcustomtext4, '' as nmcustomtext5, 0 as nmcustomint1, 0 as nmcustomint2, 0 as nmcustomint3, 0 as nmcustomint4, 0 as nmcustomint5, 0 as nmcustomdbl1, 0 as nmcustomdbl2, 0 as nmcustomdbl3, 0 as nmcustomdbl4, 0 as nmcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate5"
        sql &= " FROM m1_coa c"
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tdivisi = '" & FixQuotes(vdivisi) & "' AND YEAR(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND MONTH(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_realization_division r ON c.cnomor = r.rdnorek AND r.rddivisi = '" & FixQuotes(vdivisi) & "' AND r.rdtahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rdbulan = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_division d ON d.dkode = '" & FixQuotes(vdivisi) & "'"
        sql &= " WHERE c.cgd = 'D' AND c.caktif = 1"

        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        sql &= " GROUP BY c.cnomor"
        sql &= " ) as anggaran"
        'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA FILTER DATA YANG SALDONYA <> 0 SAJA
        If saldoNol = 0 Then sql &= " WHERE anggaran.nmanggaran <> '0' OR anggaran.nmsaldo <> '0' OR anggaran.nmvariasi <> '0'"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY anggaran.nmnorek"
        'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------


        'SIMPAN KE M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Anggaran(" & sql & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed processing budgeting report." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        '       : REALISASI AKUN +  (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tahun(0) As Integer, bulan(1) As Integer, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String, saldoNol(5) As Integer,
        'proyek(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail

        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then

        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================

        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

            result(2) = "Failed replace budgeting data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_ANGGARAN -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------
        'AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiTahunBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRTahun = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Yearly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiDitahan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL SALDO L/R DITAHAN
        '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)
        Dim saldoDitahan As Double = 0
        Dim sqlDitahan As String = "SELECT c.cnomor as pknorek, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0)) AS pkdebit, (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0)) AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0)) ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmlkredit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(r.rpjmldebit),0)) END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek WHERE r.rpproyek = '" & FixQuotes(vproyek) & "' AND (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "') AND (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN (r.rptahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & ") ELSE (r.rptahun < " & FixDouble(tahun) & " or (r.rptahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rpbulan <= " & FixDouble(bulan) & ")) END) ORDER BY c.cnomor"
        Dim dtDitahan As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlDitahan, strCon)
        If dtDitahan.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            saldoDitahan = Double.Parse(dtDitahan.Rows(0)("pksaldo"))
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING -----------------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT * FROM ("
        sql &= " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "' as nmtahun, '" & FixDouble(bulan) & "' as nmbulan, '' as nmcabang, '' as nmcabangnama, '' as nmlokasi, '' as nmlokasinama, '' as nmcostcenter, '' as nmcostcenternama, '' as nmdivisi, '' as nmdivisinama, '' as nmsubdivisi, '' as nmsubdivisinama, '" & FixQuotes(vproyek) & "' as nmproyek, IFNULL(p.pnama,'') as nmproyeknama, c.cnomor as nmnorek, c.cnama as nmnoreknama, c.ctipe as nmtipe, IFNULL(t.tmatauang,'') as nmmatauang, IFNULL(t.tkurs,0) as nmkurs, IFNULL(t.turaian,'') as nmuraian, IFNULL(t.tcatatan,'') as nmcatatan, IFNULL(r.rpanggaran,0) as nmanggaran, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) as nmdebit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) END) as nmkredit, (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmsaldo, IFNULL(r.rpanggaran,0) - (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "' ELSE (CASE c.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) END) as nmvariasi, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as nmuserid, '' as nmcustomtext1, '' as nmcustomtext2, '' as nmcustomtext3, '' as nmcustomtext4, '' as nmcustomtext5, 0 as nmcustomint1, 0 as nmcustomint2, 0 as nmcustomint3, 0 as nmcustomint4, 0 as nmcustomint5, 0 as nmcustomdbl1, 0 as nmcustomdbl2, 0 as nmcustomdbl3, 0 as nmcustomdbl4, 0 as nmcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as nmcustomdate5"
        sql &= " FROM m1_coa c"
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tproyek = '" & FixQuotes(vproyek) & "' AND YEAR(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND MONTH(t.ttgl) = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2_realization_project r ON c.cnomor = r.rpnorek AND r.rpproyek = '" & FixQuotes(vproyek) & "' AND r.rptahun = " & FixDouble(tahun) & " AND r.rpbulan = " & FixDouble(bulan) & ""
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_project p ON p.pkode = '" & FixQuotes(vproyek) & "'"
        sql &= " WHERE c.cgd = 'D' AND c.caktif = 1"

        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c.cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        sql &= " GROUP BY c.cnomor"
        sql &= " ) as anggaran"
        'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA FILTER DATA YANG SALDONYA <> 0 SAJA
        If saldoNol = 0 Then sql &= " WHERE anggaran.nmanggaran <> '0' OR anggaran.nmsaldo <> '0' OR anggaran.nmvariasi <> '0'"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY anggaran.nmnorek"
        'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------


        'SIMPAN KE M2R_ANGGARAN
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Anggaran(" & sql & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed processing budgeting report." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_SalesmanPoint(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN POIN SALESMAN

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, salesmanCatAwal(2) As String, salesmanCatAkhir(3) As String, salesmanAreaAwal(4) As String, 
        'salesmanAreaAkhir(5) As String, salesmanAwal(6) As String, salesmanAkhir(7) As String, customerCatAwal(8) As String, customerCatAkhir(9) As String, 
        'customerAreaAwal(10) As String, customerAreaAkhir(11) As String, customerAwal(12) As String, customerAkhir(13) As String, orderBy(14) As String


        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, salesmanCatAwal, salesmanCatAkhir, salesmanAreaAwal, 
        'salesmanAreaAkhir, salesmanAwal, salesmanAkhir, customerCatAwal, customerCatAkhir, 
        'customerAreaAwal, customerAreaAkhir, customerAwal, customerAkhir, orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCatAwal As String = "", salesmanCatAkhir As String = "", salesmanAreaAwal As String = "", salesmanAreaAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanAwal As String = "", salesmanAkhir As String = ""
        Dim customerCatAwal As String = "", customerCatAkhir As String = "", customerAreaAwal As String = "", customerAreaAkhir As String = ""
        Dim customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 15) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'salesmanCatAwal(2) As String
        salesmanCatAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'salesmanCatAkhir(3) As String
        salesmanCatAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'salesmanAreaAwal(4) As String
        salesmanAreaAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'salesmanAreaAkhir(5) As String
        salesmanAreaAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanAwal(6) As String
        salesmanAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'salesmanAkhir(7) As String
        salesmanAkhir = dataDetail(7)

        'customerCatAwal(8) As String
        customerCatAwal = dataDetail(8)

        'customerCatAkhir(9) As String
        customerCatAkhir = dataDetail(9)

        'customerAreaAwal(10) As String
        customerAreaAwal = dataDetail(10)

        'customerAreaAkhir(11) As String
        customerAreaAkhir = dataDetail(11)

        'customerAwal(12) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(12)

        'customerAkhir(13) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(13)

        'orderBy(14) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(14)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(14).ToString <> "salesmankode" And dataDetail(14).ToString <> "salesmannama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(14)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Salesman_Point ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Salesman_Point
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Salesman_Point WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Salesman Point data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Salesman_Point -----------------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN SALESMAN POINT -----------------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlSalesman As String = "", sqlPoint As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""

        'AMBIL DATA SALESMAN
        sqlSalesman = "  SELECT c.kid as salesman, c.kkode as salesmankode, c.knama as salesmannama, c.kkategorisalesman as kategorisalesman, sc.scnama as kategorisalesmannama, c.karea as areasalesman, a.anama as areasalesmannama, sp.spid as idpoin, sp.spnama as namapoin, sp.spjmlbarang as jmlbarangpoin, sp.sppoint as nilaipoin "
        sqlSalesman &= " FROM m1_contact c"
        sqlSalesman &= " JOIN m1_selling_point sp"
        sqlSalesman &= " LEFT JOIN m1_salesman_category sc ON c.kkategorisalesman = sc.sckode"
        sqlSalesman &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a ON c.karea = a.akode"
        sqlSalesman &= " WHERE c.kkategori = 'M'"
        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        End If


        'AMBIL DATA POIN
        sqlPoint = "  SELECT si.sibagianpenjualan as salesman, sp.spid as idpoin, si.siid as idinvoice, si.sitgl as tglinvoice, si.sinotransaksi as notransaksi, si.sicustomer as customer, c1.kkode as customerkode, c1.knama as customernama, c1.karea as customerarea, a1.anama as customerareanama, sid.idbarang, i.bkode as kodebarang, sid.namabarang, sid.tipebarang, SUM(sid.jmlbarang) as jmlbarang, sid.satuanbarang, FLOOR((SUM(sid.jmlbarang) / sp.spjmlbarang) * sp.sppoint) as jumlahpoin "
        sqlPoint &= " FROM m5_si si"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON si.sicustomer = c1.kid"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_contact c2 ON si.sibagianpenjualan = c2.kid"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_item i ON sid.idbarang = i.bid"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_selling_point sp ON i.bkomisi = sp.spid"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_salesman_category sc ON c2.kkategorisalesman = sc.sckode"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a1 ON c1.karea = a1.akode"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a2 ON c2.karea = a2.akode"

        'FILTER
        sqlPoint &= " WHERE c1.karea = c2.karea AND c2.kkategori = 'M' AND si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
        'TANGGAL
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCatAwal) > 0 And Len(customerCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer >= '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer <= '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'GROUP BY
        sqlPoint &= " GROUP BY si.sibagianpenjualan, sp.spid"

        'ORDER BY
        sqlPoint &= " ORDER BY si.sibagianpenjualan, sp.spid, i.bkode, si.sitgl, si.siinputtgl, si.siid, sid.idsidetail"


        'GABUNGKAN SQL
        sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.salesman, s.salesmankode, s.salesmannama, s.kategorisalesman, s.kategorisalesmannama, s.areasalesman, s.areasalesmannama, s.idpoin, s.namapoin, s.jmlbarangpoin, s.nilaipoin, p.idinvoice, p.tglinvoice, p.notransaksi, p.customer, p.customerkode, p.customernama, p.customerarea, p.customerareanama, p.idbarang, p.kodebarang, p.namabarang, p.tipebarang, p.jmlbarang, p.satuanbarang, p.jumlahpoin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as userid, '' as customtext1, '' as customtext2, '' as customtext3, '' as customtext4, '' as customtext5, 0 as customint1, 0 as customint2, 0 as customint3, 0 as customint4, 0 as customint5, 0 as customdbl1, 0 as customdbl2, 0 as customdbl3, 0 as customdbl4, 0 as customdbl5, '1900-01-01' as customdate1, '1900-01-01' as customdate2, '1900-01-01' as customdate3, '1900-01-01' as customdate4, '1900-01-01' as customdate5"
        sqlJadi &= " FROM (" & sqlSalesman & ") as s"
        sqlJadi &= " LEFT JOIN (" & sqlPoint & ") as p"
        sqlJadi &= " ON s.salesman = p.salesman AND s.idpoin = p.idpoin"
        sqlJadi &= " ORDER BY s." & orderBy & ", s.namapoin"


        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        'POIN MURNI DARI PENJUALAN
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Salesman_Point (" & sqlJadi & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Salesman Point. #1" : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'POIN DARI TRANSAKSI PENYESUAIAN POIN
        Dim sqlSpa As String = ""
        sqlSpa = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, c.kid as salesman, c.kkode as salesmankode, c.knama as salesmannama, c.kkategorisalesman as kategorisalesman, sc.scnama as kategorisalesmannama, c.karea as areasalesman, a.anama as areasalesmannama, 0 as idpoin, 'Penyesuaian Poin' as namapoin, 1 as jmlbarangpoin, 1 as nilaipoin, spa.spaid as idinvoice, spa.spatgl as tglinvoice, spa.spanotransaksi as notransaksi, 0 as customer, '' as customerkode, '' as customernama, '' as customerarea, '' as customerareanama, 0 as idbarang, '' as kodebarang, '' as namabarang, '' as tipebarang, SUM(spad.poinmasuk-spad.poinkeluar) as jmlbarang, '' as satuanbarang, SUM(spad.poinmasuk-spad.poinkeluar) as jumlahpoin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as userid, '' as customtext1, '' as customtext2, '' as customtext3, '' as customtext4, '' as customtext5, 0 as customint1, 0 as customint2, 0 as customint3, 0 as customint4, 0 as customint5, 0 as customdbl1, 0 as customdbl2, 0 as customdbl3, 0 as customdbl4, 0 as customdbl5, '1900-01-01' as customdate1, '1900-01-01' as customdate2, '1900-01-01' as customdate3, '1900-01-01' as customdate4, '1900-01-01' as customdate5"
        sqlSpa &= " FROM m1_contact c"
        sqlSpa &= " JOIN m5_spa_detail spad ON c.kid = spad.kontak"
        sqlSpa &= " JOIN m5_spa spa ON spad.idspa = spa.spaid"
        sqlSpa &= " JOIN m0_menu mn ON mn.mnmoduleid = 5 AND mn.mnid = 54"
        sqlSpa &= " LEFT JOIN m1_salesman_category sc ON c.kkategorisalesman = sc.sckode"
        sqlSpa &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a ON c.karea = a.akode"

        'FILTER
        sqlSpa &= " WHERE c.kkategori = 'M' AND spa.spastatus IN(2,3,4,7) "
        'TANGGAL
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (spa.spatgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (spa.spatgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (spa.spatgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'ORDER BY
        sqlSpa &= " ORDER BY " & orderBy & ", spa.spatgl, spa.spainputtgl, spa.spaid, spad.idspadetail"

        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        'POIN DARI TRANSAKSI PENYESUAIAN POIN
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Salesman_Point (" & sqlSpa & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Salesman Point. #2" : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        'END OF PERHITUNGAN SALESMAN POINT ----------------------------------------------


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_SalesmanPointDetail(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN POIN SALESMAN DETAIL

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, salesmanCatAwal(2) As String, salesmanCatAkhir(3) As String, salesmanAreaAwal(4) As String, 
        'salesmanAreaAkhir(5) As String, salesmanAwal(6) As String, salesmanAkhir(7) As String, customerCatAwal(8) As String, customerCatAkhir(9) As String, 
        'customerAreaAwal(10) As String, customerAreaAkhir(11) As String, customerAwal(12) As String, customerAkhir(13) As String, orderBy(14) As String


        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama

        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan,

        'salesmanAreaAkhir, salesmanAwal, salesmanAkhir, customerCatAwal, customerCatAkhir, 
        'customerAreaAwal, customerAreaAkhir, customerAwal, customerAkhir, orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)

        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim salesmanCatAwal As String = "", salesmanCatAkhir As String = "", salesmanAreaAwal As String = "", salesmanAreaAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanAwal As String = "", salesmanAkhir As String = ""
        Dim customerCatAwal As String = "", customerCatAkhir As String = "", customerAreaAwal As String = "", customerAreaAkhir As String = ""
        Dim customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA

            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL

            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else

        'salesmanCatAwal(2) As String

        salesmanAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'customerAkhir(13) As String

        ElseIf dataDetail(14).ToString <> "salesmankode" And dataDetail(14).ToString <> "salesmannama" Then

        Else

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)

        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Salesman_Point
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Salesman_Point WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then

        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Salesman_Point -----------------------------------

        Dim sqlSalesman As String = "", sqlPoint As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""

        'AMBIL DATA SALESMAN
        sqlSalesman = "  SELECT c.kid as salesman, c.kkode as salesmankode, c.knama as salesmannama, c.kkategorisalesman as kategorisalesman, sc.scnama as kategorisalesmannama, c.karea as areasalesman, a.anama as areasalesmannama, sp.spid as idpoin, sp.spnama as namapoin, sp.spjmlbarang as jmlbarangpoin, sp.sppoint as nilaipoin "
        sqlSalesman &= " FROM m1_contact c"
        sqlSalesman &= " JOIN m1_selling_point sp"
        sqlSalesman &= " LEFT JOIN m1_salesman_category sc ON c.kkategorisalesman = sc.sckode"
