        sqlSalesman &= " WHERE c.kkategori = 'M'"
        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        End If


        'AMBIL DATA POIN
        sqlPoint = "  SELECT si.sibagianpenjualan as salesman, sp.spid as idpoin, si.siid as idinvoice, si.sitgl as tglinvoice, si.sinotransaksi as notransaksi, si.sicustomer as customer, c1.kkode as customerkode, c1.knama as customernama, c1.karea as customerarea, a1.anama as customerareanama, sid.idbarang, i.bkode as kodebarang, sid.namabarang, sid.tipebarang, SUM(sid.jmlbarang) as jmlbarang, sid.satuanbarang, FLOOR((SUM(sid.jmlbarang) / sp.spjmlbarang) * sp.sppoint) as jumlahpoin "
        sqlPoint &= " FROM m5_si si"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON si.sicustomer = c1.kid"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_contact c2 ON si.sibagianpenjualan = c2.kid"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_item i ON sid.idbarang = i.bid"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_selling_point sp ON i.bkomisi = sp.spid"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_salesman_category sc ON c2.kkategorisalesman = sc.sckode"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a1 ON c1.karea = a1.akode"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a2 ON c2.karea = a2.akode"

        'FILTER
        sqlPoint &= " WHERE c1.karea = c2.karea AND c2.kkategori = 'M' AND si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
        'TANGGAL
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCatAwal) > 0 And Len(customerCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer >= '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer <= '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'GROUP BY
        sqlPoint &= " GROUP BY si.sibagianpenjualan, sp.spid, si.siid, i.bid"

        'ORDER BY
        sqlPoint &= " ORDER BY si.sibagianpenjualan, sp.spid, i.bkode, si.sitgl, si.siinputtgl, si.siid, sid.idsidetail"


        'GABUNGKAN SQL
        sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.salesman, s.salesmankode, s.salesmannama, s.kategorisalesman, s.kategorisalesmannama, s.areasalesman, s.areasalesmannama, s.idpoin, s.namapoin, s.jmlbarangpoin, s.nilaipoin, p.idinvoice, p.tglinvoice, p.notransaksi, p.customer, p.customerkode, p.customernama, p.customerarea, p.customerareanama, p.idbarang, p.kodebarang, p.namabarang, p.tipebarang, p.jmlbarang, p.satuanbarang, p.jumlahpoin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as userid, '' as customtext1, '' as customtext2, '' as customtext3, '' as customtext4, '' as customtext5, 0 as customint1, 0 as customint2, 0 as customint3, 0 as customint4, 0 as customint5, 0 as customdbl1, 0 as customdbl2, 0 as customdbl3, 0 as customdbl4, 0 as customdbl5, '1900-01-01' as customdate1, '1900-01-01' as customdate2, '1900-01-01' as customdate3, '1900-01-01' as customdate4, '1900-01-01' as customdate5"
        sqlJadi &= " FROM (" & sqlSalesman & ") as s"
        sqlJadi &= " LEFT JOIN (" & sqlPoint & ") as p"
        sqlJadi &= " ON s.salesman = p.salesman AND s.idpoin = p.idpoin"
        sqlJadi &= " ORDER BY s." & orderBy & ", s.namapoin"


        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Salesman_Point (" & sqlJadi & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Salesman Point." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'POIN DARI TRANSAKSI PENYESUAIAN POIN
        Dim sqlSpa As String = ""
        sqlSpa = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, c.kid as salesman, c.kkode as salesmankode, c.knama as salesmannama, c.kkategorisalesman as kategorisalesman, sc.scnama as kategorisalesmannama, c.karea as areasalesman, a.anama as areasalesmannama, 0 as idpoin, 'Penyesuaian Poin' as namapoin, 1 as jmlbarangpoin, 1 as nilaipoin, spa.spaid as idinvoice, spa.spatgl as tglinvoice, spa.spanotransaksi as notransaksi, 0 as customer, '' as customerkode, '' as customernama, '' as customerarea, '' as customerareanama, 0 as idbarang, '' as kodebarang, '' as namabarang, '' as tipebarang, (spad.poinmasuk-spad.poinkeluar) as jmlbarang, '' as satuanbarang, (spad.poinmasuk-spad.poinkeluar) as jumlahpoin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as userid, '' as customtext1, '' as customtext2, '' as customtext3, '' as customtext4, '' as customtext5, 0 as customint1, 0 as customint2, 0 as customint3, 0 as customint4, 0 as customint5, 0 as customdbl1, 0 as customdbl2, 0 as customdbl3, 0 as customdbl4, 0 as customdbl5, '1900-01-01' as customdate1, '1900-01-01' as customdate2, '1900-01-01' as customdate3, '1900-01-01' as customdate4, '1900-01-01' as customdate5"
        sqlSpa &= " FROM m1_contact c"
        sqlSpa &= " JOIN m5_spa_detail spad ON c.kid = spad.kontak"
        sqlSpa &= " JOIN m5_spa spa ON spad.idspa = spa.spaid"
        sqlSpa &= " JOIN m0_menu mn ON mn.mnmoduleid = 5 AND mn.mnid = 54"
        sqlSpa &= " LEFT JOIN m1_salesman_category sc ON c.kkategorisalesman = sc.sckode"
        sqlSpa &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a ON c.karea = a.akode"

        'FILTER
        sqlSpa &= " WHERE c.kkategori = 'M' AND spa.spastatus IN(2,3,4,7) "
        'TANGGAL
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (spa.spatgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (spa.spatgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (spa.spatgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSpa &= " AND (c.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'ORDER BY
        sqlSpa &= " ORDER BY " & orderBy & ", spa.spatgl, spa.spainputtgl, spa.spaid, spad.idspadetail"

        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        'POIN DARI TRANSAKSI PENYESUAIAN POIN
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Salesman_Point (" & sqlSpa & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Salesman Point. #2" : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        'END OF PERHITUNGAN SALESMAN POINT ----------------------------------------------


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_SalesmanRebate(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REBATE SALESMAN

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, salesmanCatAwal(2) As String, salesmanCatAkhir(3) As String, salesmanAreaAwal(4) As String, 
        'salesmanAreaAkhir(5) As String, salesmanAwal(6) As String, salesmanAkhir(7) As String, customerCatAwal(8) As String, customerCatAkhir(9) As String, 
        'customerAreaAwal(10) As String, customerAreaAkhir(11) As String, customerAwal(12) As String, customerAkhir(13) As String, orderBy(14) As String


        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, salesmanCatAwal, salesmanCatAkhir, salesmanAreaAwal, 
        'salesmanAreaAkhir, salesmanAwal, salesmanAkhir, customerCatAwal, customerCatAkhir, 
        'customerAreaAwal, customerAreaAkhir, customerAwal, customerAkhir, orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCatAwal As String = "", salesmanCatAkhir As String = "", salesmanAreaAwal As String = "", salesmanAreaAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanAwal As String = "", salesmanAkhir As String = ""
        Dim customerCatAwal As String = "", customerCatAkhir As String = "", customerAreaAwal As String = "", customerAreaAkhir As String = ""
        Dim customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 15) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'salesmanCatAwal(2) As String
        salesmanCatAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'salesmanCatAkhir(3) As String
        salesmanCatAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'salesmanAreaAwal(4) As String
        salesmanAreaAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'salesmanAreaAkhir(5) As String
        salesmanAreaAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanAwal(6) As String
        salesmanAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'salesmanAkhir(7) As String
        salesmanAkhir = dataDetail(7)

        'customerCatAwal(8) As String
        customerCatAwal = dataDetail(8)

        'customerCatAkhir(9) As String
        customerCatAkhir = dataDetail(9)

        'customerAreaAwal(10) As String
        customerAreaAwal = dataDetail(10)

        'customerAreaAkhir(11) As String
        customerAreaAkhir = dataDetail(11)

        'customerAwal(12) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(12)

        'customerAkhir(13) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(13)

        'orderBy(14) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(14)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(14).ToString <> "salesmankode" And dataDetail(14).ToString <> "salesmannama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(14)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Salesman_Point ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Salesman_Point
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Salesman_Point WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Salesman Point data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Salesman_Point -----------------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN SALESMAN POINT -----------------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlSalesman As String = "", sqlPoint As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""

        'AMBIL DATA SALESMAN
        sqlSalesman = "  SELECT c.kid as salesman, c.kkode as salesmankode, c.knama as salesmannama, c.kkategorisalesman as kategorisalesman, sc.scnama as kategorisalesmannama, c.karea as areasalesman, a.anama as areasalesmannama, 0 as idpoin, s.snama as namapoin, 1 as jmlbarangpoin, s.snilai as nilaipoin, s.sgrup as gruppoin, s.skode as kodepoin "
        sqlSalesman &= " FROM m1_contact c"
        sqlSalesman &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 5 AND s.sgrup LIKE '%rebatearea%' AND LENGTH(s.snilai) > 0 AND s.snilai > 0 "
        sqlSalesman &= " LEFT JOIN m1_salesman_category sc ON c.kkategorisalesman = sc.sckode"
        sqlSalesman &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a ON c.karea = a.akode"
        sqlSalesman &= " WHERE c.kkategori = 'M'"
        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        End If


        'AMBIL DATA POIN
        sqlPoint = "  SELECT si.sibagianpenjualan as salesman, (CASE WHEN c1.karea = c2.karea THEN s1.sgrup ELSE s2.sgrup END) as gruppoin, (CASE WHEN c1.karea = c2.karea THEN s1.skode ELSE s2.skode END) as kodepoin, (CASE WHEN c1.karea = c2.karea THEN s1.snama ELSE s2.snama END) as namapoin, (CASE WHEN c1.karea = c2.karea THEN s1.snilai ELSE s2.snilai END) as nilaipoin, si.siid as idinvoice, si.sitgl as tglinvoice, si.sinotransaksi as notransaksi, si.sicustomer as customer, c1.kkode as customerkode, c1.knama as customernama, c1.karea as customerarea, a1.anama as customerareanama, sid.idbarang, i.bkode as kodebarang, sid.namabarang, sid.tipebarang, sid.jmlbarang as jmlbarang, sid.satuanbarang, (CASE WHEN c1.karea = c2.karea THEN sid.jmlbarang * IFNULL(s1.snilai,0) ELSE sid.jmlbarang * IFNULL(s2.snilai,0) END) as jumlahpoin "
        sqlPoint &= " FROM m5_si si"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON si.sicustomer = c1.kid"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_contact c2 ON si.sibagianpenjualan = c2.kid"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_item i ON sid.idbarang = i.bid"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_salesman_category sc ON c2.kkategorisalesman = sc.sckode"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a1 ON c1.karea = a1.akode"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a2 ON c2.karea = a2.akode"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s1 ON s1.smodule = 5 AND s1.sgrup = 'rebateareasama' AND s1.skode = c1.kkategoricustomer AND LENGTH(s1.snilai) > 0 AND s1.snilai > 0 "
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s2 ON s2.smodule = 5 AND s2.sgrup = 'rebateareabeda' AND s2.skode = c1.kkategoricustomer AND LENGTH(s2.snilai) > 0 AND s2.snilai > 0 "

        'FILTER
        sqlPoint &= " WHERE c2.kkategori = 'M' AND si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
        'TANGGAL
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCatAwal) > 0 And Len(customerCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer >= '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer <= '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'GROUP BY
        'sqlPoint &= " GROUP BY si.sibagianpenjualan, s1.skode, s2.skode"

        'ORDER BY
        'sqlPoint &= " ORDER BY si.sibagianpenjualan, s1.skode, s2.skode, i.bkode, si.sitgl, si.siinputtgl, si.siid, sid.idsidetail"

        Dim sqlPointFix As String = ""
        sqlPointFix = " SELECT salesman, gruppoin, kodepoin, namapoin, nilaipoin, idinvoice, tglinvoice, notransaksi, customer, customerkode, customernama, customerarea, customerareanama, idbarang, kodebarang, namabarang, tipebarang, SUM(jmlbarang) as jmlbarang, satuanbarang, SUM(jmlbarang) * poin.nilaipoin as jumlahpoin "
        sqlPointFix &= " FROM (" & sqlPoint & ") as poin"
        sqlPointFix &= " WHERE poin.gruppoin IS NOT NULL"
        sqlPointFix &= " GROUP BY poin.salesman, poin.gruppoin, poin.kodepoin"


        'GABUNGKAN SQL
        sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.salesman, s.salesmankode, s.salesmannama, s.kategorisalesman, s.kategorisalesmannama, s.areasalesman, s.areasalesmannama, s.idpoin, s.namapoin, s.jmlbarangpoin, s.nilaipoin, p.idinvoice, p.tglinvoice, p.notransaksi, p.customer, p.customerkode, p.customernama, p.customerarea, p.customerareanama, p.idbarang, p.kodebarang, p.namabarang, p.tipebarang, p.jmlbarang, p.satuanbarang, p.jumlahpoin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as userid, '' as customtext1, '' as customtext2, '' as customtext3, '' as customtext4, '' as customtext5, 0 as customint1, 0 as customint2, 0 as customint3, 0 as customint4, 0 as customint5, 0 as customdbl1, 0 as customdbl2, 0 as customdbl3, 0 as customdbl4, 0 as customdbl5, '1900-01-01' as customdate1, '1900-01-01' as customdate2, '1900-01-01' as customdate3, '1900-01-01' as customdate4, '1900-01-01' as customdate5"
        sqlJadi &= " FROM (" & sqlSalesman & ") as s"
        sqlJadi &= " LEFT JOIN (" & sqlPointFix & ") as p"
        sqlJadi &= " ON s.salesman = p.salesman AND s.gruppoin = p.gruppoin AND s.kodepoin = p.kodepoin"
        sqlJadi &= " ORDER BY s." & orderBy & ", s.gruppoin DESC, s.namapoin"

        SimpanLogToFile(sqlJadi)
        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Salesman_Point (" & sqlJadi & ")"
        SimpanLogToFile(sql)
        'result(2) = sql : GoTo selesai
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Salesman Point." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        'END OF PERHITUNGAN SALESMAN POINT ----------------------------------------------


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)
        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_COBA(ByVal param As String) As String
        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim wsResult As String = "", Sql As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)


        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        NamaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If

        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M0_COBA ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M0_COBA
        Sql = "DELETE FROM m_coba WHERE idlogin = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(Sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Coba data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Salesman_Point -----------------------------------

        'GABUNGKAN SQL
        sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '4' as no, knama as data, kkode as isi"
        sqlJadi &= " FROM (m1_contact) LIMIT 20 "

        For i = 0 To 10
            Sql = "INSERT INTO m_coba (idlogin, idmsmq, no, data, isi) VALUE ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '4', 'test', '100000')"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(Sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed Insert Coba. = " & Sql : GoTo selesai
            End If
        Next
        Sql = "INSERT INTO m_coba (" + sqlJadi + ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(Sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed Insert Coba. = " & Sql : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        Sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '50' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(Sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = ""
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)
selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)
        SimpanLogToFile(wsResult)
        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_SalesmanRebateDetail(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REBATE SALESMAN DETAIL

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, salesmanCatAwal(2) As String, salesmanCatAkhir(3) As String, salesmanAreaAwal(4) As String, 
        'salesmanAreaAkhir(5) As String, salesmanAwal(6) As String, salesmanAkhir(7) As String, customerCatAwal(8) As String, customerCatAkhir(9) As String, 
        'customerAreaAwal(10) As String, customerAreaAkhir(11) As String, customerAwal(12) As String, customerAkhir(13) As String, orderBy(14) As String


        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, salesmanCatAwal, salesmanCatAkhir, salesmanAreaAwal, 
        'salesmanAreaAkhir, salesmanAwal, salesmanAkhir, customerCatAwal, customerCatAkhir, 
        'customerAreaAwal, customerAreaAkhir, customerAwal, customerAkhir, orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanCatAwal As String = "", salesmanCatAkhir As String = "", salesmanAreaAwal As String = "", salesmanAreaAkhir As String = ""
        Dim salesmanAwal As String = "", salesmanAkhir As String = ""
        Dim customerCatAwal As String = "", customerCatAkhir As String = "", customerAreaAwal As String = "", customerAreaAkhir As String = ""
        Dim customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = ""
        Dim orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 15) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'salesmanCatAwal(2) As String
        salesmanCatAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'salesmanCatAkhir(3) As String
        salesmanCatAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'salesmanAreaAwal(4) As String
        salesmanAreaAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'salesmanAreaAkhir(5) As String
        salesmanAreaAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'salesmanAwal(6) As String
        salesmanAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'salesmanAkhir(7) As String
        salesmanAkhir = dataDetail(7)

        'customerCatAwal(8) As String
        customerCatAwal = dataDetail(8)

        'customerCatAkhir(9) As String
        customerCatAkhir = dataDetail(9)

        'customerAreaAwal(10) As String
        customerAreaAwal = dataDetail(10)

        'customerAreaAkhir(11) As String
        customerAreaAkhir = dataDetail(11)

        'customerAwal(12) As String
        customerAwal = dataDetail(12)

        'customerAkhir(13) As String
        customerAkhir = dataDetail(13)

        'orderBy(14) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(14)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(14).ToString <> "salesmankode" And dataDetail(14).ToString <> "salesmannama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(14)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Salesman_Point ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Salesman_Point
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Salesman_Point WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Salesman Point data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Salesman_Point -----------------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN SALESMAN POINT -----------------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlSalesman As String = "", sqlPoint As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""

        'AMBIL DATA SALESMAN
        sqlSalesman = "  SELECT c.kid as salesman, c.kkode as salesmankode, c.knama as salesmannama, c.kkategorisalesman as kategorisalesman, sc.scnama as kategorisalesmannama, c.karea as areasalesman, a.anama as areasalesmannama, 0 as idpoin, s.snama as namapoin, 1 as jmlbarangpoin, s.snilai as nilaipoin, s.sgrup as gruppoin, s.skode as kodepoin "
        sqlSalesman &= " FROM m1_contact c"
        sqlSalesman &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 5 AND s.sgrup LIKE '%rebatearea%' AND LENGTH(s.snilai) > 0 AND s.snilai > 0 "
        sqlSalesman &= " LEFT JOIN m1_salesman_category sc ON c.kkategorisalesman = sc.sckode"
        sqlSalesman &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a ON c.karea = a.akode"
        sqlSalesman &= " WHERE c.kkategori = 'M'"
        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkategorisalesman <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlSalesman &= " AND (c.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        End If


        'AMBIL DATA POIN
        sqlPoint = "  SELECT si.sibagianpenjualan as salesman, (CASE WHEN c1.karea = c2.karea THEN s1.sgrup ELSE s2.sgrup END) as gruppoin, (CASE WHEN c1.karea = c2.karea THEN s1.skode ELSE s2.skode END) as kodepoin, (CASE WHEN c1.karea = c2.karea THEN s1.snama ELSE s2.snama END) as namapoin, (CASE WHEN c1.karea = c2.karea THEN s1.snilai ELSE s2.snilai END) as nilaipoin, si.siid as idinvoice, si.sitgl as tglinvoice, si.sinotransaksi as notransaksi, si.sicustomer as customer, c1.kkode as customerkode, c1.knama as customernama, c1.karea as customerarea, a1.anama as customerareanama, sid.idbarang, i.bkode as kodebarang, sid.namabarang, sid.tipebarang, sid.jmlbarang as jmlbarang, sid.satuanbarang, (CASE WHEN c1.karea = c2.karea THEN sid.jmlbarang * IFNULL(s1.snilai,0) ELSE sid.jmlbarang * IFNULL(s2.snilai,0) END) as jumlahpoin "
        sqlPoint &= " FROM m5_si si"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON si.sicustomer = c1.kid"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_contact c2 ON si.sibagianpenjualan = c2.kid"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi"
        sqlPoint &= " JOIN m1_item i ON sid.idbarang = i.bid"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_salesman_category sc ON c2.kkategorisalesman = sc.sckode"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a1 ON c1.karea = a1.akode"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m1_area a2 ON c2.karea = a2.akode"
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s1 ON s1.smodule = 5 AND s1.sgrup = 'rebateareasama' AND s1.skode = c1.kkategoricustomer AND LENGTH(s1.snilai) > 0 AND s1.snilai > 0 "
        sqlPoint &= " LEFT JOIN m0_setting s2 ON s2.smodule = 5 AND s2.sgrup = 'rebateareabeda' AND s2.skode = c1.kkategoricustomer AND LENGTH(s2.snilai) > 0 AND s2.snilai > 0 "

        'FILTER
        sqlPoint &= " WHERE c2.kkategori = 'M' AND si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
        'TANGGAL
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkategorisalesman <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER SALESMAN
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c2.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerCatAwal) > 0 And Len(customerCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerCatAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer >= '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerCatAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkategoricustomer <= '" & FixQuotes(customerCatAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER AREA CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerAreaAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAreaAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea >= '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAreaAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.karea <= '" & FixQuotes(customerAreaAkhir) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER CUSTOMER
        If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(customerAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlPoint &= " AND (c1.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(customerAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'GROUP BY
        'sqlPoint &= " GROUP BY si.sibagianpenjualan, s1.skode, s2.skode"

        'ORDER BY
        'sqlPoint &= " ORDER BY si.sibagianpenjualan, s1.skode, s2.skode, i.bkode, si.sitgl, si.siinputtgl, si.siid, sid.idsidetail"

        'Dim sqlPointFix As String = ""
        'sqlPointFix = " SELECT salesman, gruppoin, kodepoin, namapoin, nilaipoin, idinvoice, tglinvoice, notransaksi, customer, customerkode, customernama, customerarea, customerareanama, idbarang, kodebarang, namabarang, tipebarang, SUM(jmlbarang) as jmlbarang, satuanbarang, SUM(jmlbarang) * poin.nilaipoin as jumlahpoin "
        'sqlPointFix = " FROM (" & sqlPoint & ") as poin"
        'sqlPointFix = " WHERE poin.gruppoin IS NOT NULL"
        'sqlPointFix = " GROUP BY poin.salesman, poin.gruppoin, poin.kodepoin"


        'GABUNGKAN SQL
        sqlJadi = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, s.salesman, s.salesmankode, s.salesmannama, s.kategorisalesman, s.kategorisalesmannama, s.areasalesman, s.areasalesmannama, s.idpoin, s.namapoin, s.jmlbarangpoin, s.nilaipoin, p.idinvoice, p.tglinvoice, p.notransaksi, p.customer, p.customerkode, p.customernama, p.customerarea, p.customerareanama, p.idbarang, p.kodebarang, p.namabarang, p.tipebarang, p.jmlbarang, p.satuanbarang, p.jumlahpoin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as userid, '' as customtext1, '' as customtext2, '' as customtext3, '' as customtext4, '' as customtext5, 0 as customint1, 0 as customint2, 0 as customint3, 0 as customint4, 0 as customint5, 0 as customdbl1, 0 as customdbl2, 0 as customdbl3, 0 as customdbl4, 0 as customdbl5, '1900-01-01' as customdate1, '1900-01-01' as customdate2, '1900-01-01' as customdate3, '1900-01-01' as customdate4, '1900-01-01' as customdate5"
        sqlJadi &= " FROM (" & sqlSalesman & ") as s"
        sqlJadi &= " LEFT JOIN (" & sqlPoint & ") as p"
        sqlJadi &= " ON s.salesman = p.salesman AND s.gruppoin = p.gruppoin AND s.kodepoin = p.kodepoin"
        sqlJadi &= " ORDER BY s." & orderBy & ", s.gruppoin DESC, s.namapoin"


        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        sql = "Insert into M2r_Salesman_Point (" & sqlJadi & ")"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed proccessing Salesman Point." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ -> pesan = prosentase
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(Prosentase) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress report." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        'END OF PERHITUNGAN SALESMAN POINT ----------------------------------------------


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_CustomerPoint(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN POIN PELANGGAN DETAIL

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, cabangAwal(2) As String, cabangAkhir(3) As String, 
        'lokasiAwal(4) As String, lokasiAkhir(5) As String, customerCatAwal(6) As String, customerCatAkhir(7) As String, 
        'customerAwal(8) As String, customerAkhir(9) As String, OrderBy(10) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, cabangAwal, cabangAkhir, 
        'lokasiAwal, lokasiAkhir, customerCatAwal, customerCatAkhir, 
        'customerAwal, customerAkhir, OrderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim FilterCPA As String = "", FilterSI As String = ""

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", cabangAwal As String = "", cabangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim lokasiAwal As String = "", lokasiAkhir As String = "", customerCatAwal As String = "", customerCatAkhir As String = ""
        Dim customerAwal As String = "", customerAkhir As String = "", OrderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================

        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey

        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID

        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)
