            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function m2r_bb_costcenter(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN STOCK COVER DAY

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, kategoriAwal(5) As String, kategoriAkhir(6) As String, 
        'gudangAwal(7) As String, gudangAkhir(8) As String, saldoNol(9) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'MAPPING FILTER REPORT
        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, akunAwal, akunAkhir,
        'divisiAwal, divisiAkhir, comboDK 

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        'VARIABEL MAPPING FILTER REPORT
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", akunAwal As String = "", akunAkhir As String = ""
        Dim divisiAwal As String = "", divisiAkhir As String = "", comboDK As Integer = 0

        'VARIABEL TGL 1 SD 7
        Dim tgl1 As Date, tgl2 As Date, tgl3 As Date, tgl4 As Date, tgl5 As Date, tgl6 As Date, tgl7 As Date

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'JUMLAH MAPPING FILTER REPORT
        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 7) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'SET NILAI FILTER REPORT KE VARIABEL, SESUAI URUTAN INDEKS MAPPING
        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'akunAwal(2) As String
        akunAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'akunAkhir(3) As String
        akunAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'divisiAwal(4) As String
        divisiAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'DivisiAkhir(5) As String
        divisiAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'comboDK(6) As String
        If dataDetail(6) = 0 Or dataDetail(6) = 1 Then
            comboDK = Integer.Parse(dataDetail(6))
        Else
            comboDK = 2
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================

        'SET TGL 1 SD 7
        tgl1 = Date.Parse(tglAwal)
        tgl2 = DateAdd(DateInterval.Day, 1, tgl1)
        tgl3 = DateAdd(DateInterval.Day, 2, tgl1)
        tgl4 = DateAdd(DateInterval.Day, 3, tgl1)
        tgl5 = DateAdd(DateInterval.Day, 4, tgl1)
        tgl6 = DateAdd(DateInterval.Day, 5, tgl1)
        tgl7 = Date.Parse(tglAkhir)

        'VALIDASI TANGGAL TIDAK BOLEH MELEBIHI 7 HARI
        Dim jarakTgl As Long = DateDiff(DateInterval.Day, Date.Parse(tglAwal), Date.Parse(tglAkhir))
        If jarakTgl <> 6 Then
            result(2) = "Difference between Start Date and End Date must be 7 days." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_bb_divisi ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_bb_divisi
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_bb_divisi WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Inventory Balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_bb_divisi -----------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlMutasi As String = ""


        'QUERY COVER DAY ###############################
        sqlMutasi = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin,"
        sqlMutasi &= " '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, "
        sqlMutasi &= " IFNULL(t.tcostcenter,'') as divisikode,"
        sqlMutasi &= " IFNULL(cc.ccnama , '') as divisinama,"
        sqlMutasi &= " IFNULL(t.tnorek, '') as norek,"
        sqlMutasi &= " IFNULL(c.cnama, '') as namarek,"
        sqlMutasi &= " IFNULL(t.ttgl, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') as tgl,"
        sqlMutasi &= " IFNULL(c.cdc, '') as cdc,"
        sqlMutasi &= " IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit), 0) as debit,"
        sqlMutasi &= " IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit), 0) as kredit,"
        sqlMutasi &= " IFNULL(c.ccustomdbl1, 1) as customedbl1,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl1)) & "' THEN (CASE c.ccustomdbl1 WHEN 0 THEN 0  ELSE ((CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit) 	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit)	END)  	 ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END) 	END) / c.ccustomdbl1) 	END ) Else 0 END AS qty1,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl2)) & "' THEN (CASE c.ccustomdbl1 WHEN 0 THEN 0  ELSE ((CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit) 	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit)	END)  	 ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END) 	END) / c.ccustomdbl1) 	END ) Else 0 END AS qty2,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl3)) & "' THEN (CASE c.ccustomdbl1 WHEN 0 THEN 0  ELSE ((CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit) 	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit)	END)  	 ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END) 	END) / c.ccustomdbl1) 	END ) Else 0 END AS qty3,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl4)) & "' THEN (CASE c.ccustomdbl1 WHEN 0 THEN 0  ELSE ((CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit) 	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit)	END)  	 ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END) 	END) / c.ccustomdbl1) 	END ) Else 0 END AS qty4,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl5)) & "' THEN (CASE c.ccustomdbl1 WHEN 0 THEN 0  ELSE ((CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit) 	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit)	END)  	 ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END) 	END) / c.ccustomdbl1) 	END ) Else 0 END AS qty5,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl6)) & "' THEN (CASE c.ccustomdbl1 WHEN 0 THEN 0  ELSE ((CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit) 	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit)	END)  	 ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END) 	END) / c.ccustomdbl1) 	END ) Else 0 END AS qty6,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl7)) & "' THEN (CASE c.ccustomdbl1 WHEN 0 THEN 0  ELSE ((CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit) 	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit)	END)  	 ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END) 	END) / c.ccustomdbl1) 	END ) Else 0 END AS qty7,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl 	WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl1)) & "' THEN (CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit) END)  		ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END)   END) Else 0  END  AS jumlah1,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl 	WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl2)) & "' THEN (CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit) END)  		ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END)   END) Else 0  END  AS jumlah2,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl 	WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl3)) & "' THEN (CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit) END)  		ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END)   END) Else 0  END  AS jumlah3,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl 	WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl4)) & "' THEN (CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit) END)  		ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END)   END) Else 0  END  AS jumlah4,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl 	WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl5)) & "' THEN (CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit) END)  		ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END)   END) Else 0  END  AS jumlah5,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl 	WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl6)) & "' THEN (CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit) END)  		ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END)   END) Else 0  END  AS jumlah6,"
        sqlMutasi &= " CASE t.ttgl 	WHEN '" & FixDouble(AsFormatTanggal(tgl7)) & "' THEN (CASE c.cdc  	WHEN 'D' THEN (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "' 	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tdebit - t.tkredit) END)  		ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(comboDK) & "'  	when 0 then SUM(t.tdebit)	when 1 then SUM(t.tkredit)	else SUM(t.tkredit - t.tdebit)	END)   END) Else 0  END  AS jumlah7"
        sqlMutasi &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t "
        sqlMutasi &= " JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON t.tcostcenter = cc.cckode"
        sqlMutasi &= " LEFT JOIN m1_coa c ON t.tnorek = c.cnomor"
        sqlMutasi &= " Where t.tstatus in (2,3,4,7)"

        'FILTER TGL
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlMutasi &= " AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlMutasi &= " AND t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlMutasi &= " AND t.ttgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER AKUN
        If Len(akunAwal) > 0 And Len(akunAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlMutasi &= " AND t.tnorek BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(akunAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(akunAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(akunAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlMutasi &= " AND t.tnorek >= '" & FixQuotes(akunAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(akunAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlMutasi &= " AND t.tnorek <= '" & FixQuotes(akunAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER DIVISI
        If Len(divisiAwal) > 0 And Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlMutasi &= " AND t.tcostcenter BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(divisiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(divisiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(divisiAwal) > 0 Then
            sqlMutasi &= " AND t.tcostcenter >= '" & FixQuotes(divisiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then
            sqlMutasi &= " AND t.tcostcenter <= '" & FixQuotes(divisiAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        sqlMutasi &= "GROUP BY  t.tnorek ASC,t.tcostcenter ASC, t.ttgl ASC   "
        sqlMutasi &= "ORDER BY  t.tnorek ASC,t.tcostcenter ASC, t.ttgl ASC  "

        'INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU #########################
        sqlJadi = " INSERT INTO m2r_bb_divisi (" & sqlMutasi & ")"
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------


        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
            'result(2) = "Failed proccessing Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
            result(2) = sqlJadi : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
        progressPersen = 100

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_BukuBesar_AkunLawan(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN BUKU BESAR (AKUN LAWAN)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 5) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_BukuBesar_AkunLawan ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_BukuBesar_AkunLawan
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_BukuBesar_AkunLawan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace general ledger data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_BukuBesar_AkunLawan -----------------------------

        'BUAT FILTER NOREK -------------------------------------------------------
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1' ) " ' AND ctipe = '0') "
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER NOREK ------------------------------------------------

        'AMBIL NOREK ANTARA NOREK AWAL DAN NOREK AKHIR
        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor FROM m1_coa " & Filter & " ORDER BY cnomor", strCon)

        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2r_Kasbank_Harian SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
            Dim sqlSAwal As String = "", sqlSMutasi As String = "", sqlSAkhir As String = ""
            Dim SAwal As Double = 0, SMutasi As Double = 0, SAkhir As Double = 0
            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, currNorek As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN INSERT M2r_Kasbank_Harian PER NOREK ------------------------
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
                currNorek = dr("cnomor") : strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'BUAT QUERY UNTUK AMBIL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAwal = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldoawal FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSMutasi = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldomutasi FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SALDO AKHIR
                sqlSAkhir = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldoakhir FROM m2_transaction_journal t LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'GABUNGKAN SQL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                sql = "SELECT (" & sqlSAwal & ") as saldoawal, (" & sqlSMutasi & ") as saldomutasi, (" & sqlSAkhir & ") as saldoakhir"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dtSAwal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAwal.Rows
                        'SET NILAI SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                        SAwal = FixDouble(dr1("saldoawal")) : SMutasi = FixDouble(dr1("saldomutasi")) : SAkhir = FixDouble(dr1("saldoakhir"))
                    Next
                Else
                    result(2) = "Failed Getting '" & currNorek & "' starting balance." : GoTo selesai
                End If

                'AMBIL TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                sql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, t1.tid as kbhid, t1.tkontak as kbhkontak, c.kkode as kbhkontakkode, c.knama as kbhkontaknama, t1.ttgl as kbhtgl, t1.tidtransaksi as kbhidtransaksi, t1.tsumber as kbhsumber, t1.tnotransaksi as kbhnotransaksi, t1.tmatauang as kbhmatauang, t1.tkurs as kbhkurs, t1.tnorek as kbhnorek, coa1.cnama as kbhnoreknama, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t1.tdebit ELSE t1.tdebitvalas END) as kbhdebit, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t1.tkredit ELSE t1.tkreditvalas END) as kbhkredit, t2.tid as kbhidlawan, t2.tnorek as kbhnoreklawan, coa2.cnama as kbhnoreklawannama, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t2.tkredit ELSE t2.tkreditvalas END) as kbhdebitlawan, (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN t2.tdebit ELSE t2.tdebitvalas END) as kbhkreditlawan, t2.turaian as kbhuraian, t2.tcatatan as kbhcatatan, '" & FixDouble(SAwal) & "' as kbhsaldoawal, '" & FixDouble(SMutasi) & "' as kbhsaldomutasi, '" & FixDouble(SAkhir) & "' as kbhsaldoakhir, t2.tinputtgl as kbhinputtgl, '' as kbhnogiro, '' as kbhbank, '0' as kbhjumlah, '1900-01-01' as kbhtgljthtempo, '1900-01-01' as kbhtglcair, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as kbhuserid FROM m2_transaction_journal t1 JOIN m2_transaction_journal t2 ON t1.tnotransaksi = t2.tnotransaksi AND t1.tid <> t2.tid JOIN m1_coa coa1 ON t1.tnorek = coa1.cnomor JOIN m1_coa coa2 ON t2.tnorek = coa2.cnomor JOIN m1_contact c ON t1.tkontak = c.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t1.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t1.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t1.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t1.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t1.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) ORDER BY t1.tnorek, t1.ttgl, t1.tnotransaksi, t2.turutan"
                dtSMutasi = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dtSMutasi.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSMutasi.Rows
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT TRANSAKSI MUTASI NOREK
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                            idlogin,                             kbhid,                             kbhkontak,                             kbhkontakkode,                             kbhkontaknama,                                             kbhtgl,                              kbhidtransaksi                              kbhsumber                              kbhnotransaksi,                             kbhmatauang,                             kbhkurs,                             kbhnorek,                             kbhnoreknama,                             kbhdebit,                             kbhkredit,                             kbhidlawan,                             kbhnoreklawan,                             kbhnoreklawannama,                             kbhdebitlawan,                             kbhkreditlawan,                             kbhuraian,                             kbhcatatan,                             kbhsaldoawal,                             kbhsaldomutasi,                             kbhsaldoakhir,                                             kbhinputtgl,                                                     kbhnogiro,                             kbhbank,                             kbhjumlah,                                             kbhtgljthtempo,                                              kbhtglcair,                              idmsmq,                             kbhuserid,                  kbhcustomtext1,          kbhcustomtext2,          kbhcustomtext3,          kbhcustomtext4,          kbhcustomtext5,kbhcustomint1,kbhcustomint2,kbhcustomint3,kbhcustomint4,kbhcustomint5,kbhcustomdbl1,     kbhcustomdbl2,          kbhcustomdbl3,          kbhcustomdbl4,          kbhcustomdbl5,                                 kbhcustomdate1,                                     kbhcustomdate2,                                     kbhcustomdate3,                                     kbhcustomdate4,                                     kbhcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixQuotes(dr1("idlogin")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhkontak")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhkontakkode")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhkontaknama")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhtgl"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhidtransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhsumber")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnotransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhkurs")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnoreknama")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhkredit")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhidlawan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnoreklawan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnoreklawannama")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhdebitlawan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhkreditlawan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhsaldomutasi")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhinputtgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd H:mm:ss")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhnogiro")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhbank")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("kbhjumlah")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhtgljthtempo"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("kbhtglcair"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("kbhuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
                    Next
                End If

                'SIMPAN KE M2r_BukuBesar_AkunLawan
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_BukuBesar_AkunLawan(idlogin, kbhid, kbhkontak, kbhkontakkode, kbhkontaknama, kbhtgl, kbhidtransaksi, kbhsumber, kbhnotransaksi, kbhmatauang, kbhkurs, kbhnorek, kbhnoreknama, kbhdebit, kbhkredit, kbhidlawan, kbhnoreklawan, kbhnoreklawannama, kbhdebitlawan, kbhkreditlawan, kbhuraian, kbhcatatan, kbhsaldoawal, kbhsaldomutasi, kbhsaldoakhir, kbhinputtgl, kbhnogiro, kbhbank, kbhjumlah, kbhtgljthtempo, kbhtglcair, idmsmq, kbhuserid, kbhcustomtext1, kbhcustomtext2, kbhcustomtext3, kbhcustomtext4, kbhcustomtext5, kbhcustomint1, kbhcustomint2, kbhcustomint3, kbhcustomint4, kbhcustomint5, kbhcustomdbl1, kbhcustomdbl2, kbhcustomdbl3, kbhcustomdbl4, kbhcustomdbl5, kbhcustomdate1, kbhcustomdate2, kbhcustomdate3, kbhcustomdate4, kbhcustomdate5) values " & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing '" & currNorek & "' daily cash report." : GoTo selesai
                        'result(2) = sql : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If

                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtNorek.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currNorek & "' daily cash report." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT M2r_Kasbank_Harian PER NOREK -----------------

        Else

            'JIKA TIDAK ADA DATA MAKA LANGSUNG UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtNorek.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress 'No Data' daily cash report." : GoTo selesai
            End If

        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_NeracaMutasi_Cabang(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN NERACA MUTASI
        '- Akun L/R Tahun Berjalan dan Akun L/R Bulan Berjalan tidak perlu ditampilkan di Neraca Mutasi
        '- Akun L/R Ditahan buat Saldo Awal, Saldo Akhir, Mutasi diisi nol 
        '       : REALISASI AKUN +  (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String, saldoNol(5) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang, saldoNol

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = "", saldoNol As Integer = 0
        Dim Vcabang As String = ""

        Dim norekLRBulan As String = "", norekLRTahun As String = "", norekLRDitahan As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 7) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================

        'cabang(0) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(0)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "cabang can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Vcabang = dataDetail(0)
        End If

        'tglAwal(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(2) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(2)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(2)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(2))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(3) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(3)

        'norekAkhir(4) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(4)

        'matauang(5) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(5)

        'saldoNol(6) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(6)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(6)
        End If

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace trial balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------
        'AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiTahunBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRTahun = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Yearly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiDitahan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL SALDO L/R DITAHAN
        '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)
        Dim saldoDitahan As Double = 0
        Dim sqlDitahan As String = "SELECT  c.cnomor as pknorek,  '" & FixQuotes(Vcabang) & "' as pkcabang, IFNULL(br.bnama,'') as pkcabangnama, (IFNULL(SUM(rw.rwjmldebit),0)) AS pkdebit,  (IFNULL(SUM(rw.rwjmlkredit),0)) AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc 	WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(rw.rwjmldebit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(rw.rwjmlkredit),0)) 	ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(rw.rwjmlkredit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(rw.rwjmldebit),0))  END) AS pksaldo FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_branch rw ON c.cnomor = rw.rwnorek LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON br.bkode = rw.rwcabang WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')  AND (CASE WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN (rw.rwtahun < YEAR('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "')) ELSE (rw.rwtahun < YEAR('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "') or (rw.rwtahun = YEAR('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "')  AND rw.rwbulan <= MONTH('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "'))) END)  AND (rw.rwcabang = '" & FixQuotes(Vcabang) & "')  ORDER BY c.cnomor "
        Dim dtDitahan As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlDitahan, strCon)
        If dtDitahan.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            saldoDitahan = Double.Parse(dtDitahan.Rows(0)("pksaldo"))
        End If


        'END OF AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING -----------------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", ftJoinSA As String = "", ftJoinSM As String = ""

        'FILTER NOREK
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1') "
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If


        'AMBIL NOREK ANTARA NOREKAWAL DAN NOREK AKHIR
        Dim dtAmbilNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor FROM m1_coa " & Filter & " ORDER BY cnomor", strCon)
        Dim currNorek As String = "", currFilter As String = ""
        If dtAmbilNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtAmbilNorek.Rows
                stepKe = stepKe + 1 : strValue.Clear()

                currNorek = FxDB(dr("cnomor"), "")
                currFilter = Filter & " AND cnomor = '" & currNorek & "'"

                'FILTER JOIN SALDO AWAL
                ftJoinSA = "ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND (CASE c.cjenis WHEN 'P' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'  WHEN 'B' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'  ELSE t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'   END) AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') 	WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) AND t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(Vcabang) & "' "
                'SQL SALDO AWAL
                sqlSA = "SELECT c.cnomor as sanorek, c.cnama as sanoreknama, t.tcabang as nmcabang, br.bnama AS nmcabangnama , c.cdc sacdc,  c.ctipe satipe, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN s.snilai ELSE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) as samatauang, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "')  WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' 				WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)   ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) 	END) END) as sadebit,  (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') 	WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) 	ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' 	WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0)  ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) 	END) END) as sakredit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN (CASE c.cdc  							WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0)   ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) 			ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "'  WHEN s.snilai THEN (CASE c.cdc 	WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) 	ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)   END) ELSE (CASE c.cdc  WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0)   END)    END)  END) as sasaldo  FROM m1_coa c  LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t " & ftJoinSA & "  LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON t.tcabang = br.bkode  " & currFilter & "   GROUP BY c.cnomor  "

                'FILTER JOIN SALDO MUTASI
                ftJoinSM = "ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)  AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'  AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "')  WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) AND (t.tcabang = '" & FixQuotes(Vcabang) & "')"
                'SQL SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSM = "SELECT c.cnomor as smnorek,  (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') 	WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)  	ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' 				WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) 				ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0)  				END) 	END) as smdebit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0)  ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' 			WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) 			ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0)  			END) END) as smkredit   FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t " & ftJoinSM & "  LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON t.tcabang = br.bkode  " & currFilter & "  GROUP BY c.cnomor "


                'SORTING NOREK
                Sorting = " ORDER BY sa.sanorek"

                'GABUNGKAN SQL SALDO AWAL DAN SALDO MUTASI
                sql = "SELECT  '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, sa.sanorek as nmnorek,  sa.sanoreknama as nmnoreknama, sa.satipe as nmtipe, sa.samatauang as nmmatauang, 0 as nmkurs,  sa.nmcabang as nmcabang , IFNULL(sa.nmcabangnama,'') as nmcabangnama , '' as nmuraian,  '' as nmcatatan, (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "'  ELSE sa.sasaldo END) as nmsaldoawal,  (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN 0  ELSE sm.smdebit END) as nmdebit, (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN 0  ELSE sm.smkredit END) as nmkredit, (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0  WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "'   ELSE (CASE sa.sacdc  			WHEN 'D' THEN sa.sasaldo + sm.smdebit - sm.smkredit  			ELSE sa.sasaldo - sm.smdebit + sm.smkredit END) END) as nmsaldoakhir, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'  as idmsmq,  '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as nmuserid FROM "
                sql &= " (" & sqlSA & ") as sa "
                sql &= " JOIN "
                sql &= " (" & sqlSM & ") as sm "
                sql &= " ON sa.sanorek = sm.smnorek "
                sql &= " JOIN m1_coa mycoa "
                sql &= " ON sa.sanorek = mycoa.cnomor "
                sql &= Sorting
                'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------

                'AMBIL SALDO NOREK SESUAI SQL YANG TELAH DIBUAT
                Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

                'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2R_NERACA_MUTASI SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
                'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
                'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
                'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
                If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                    dtNorek = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtNorek, "nmsaldoawal <> '0' OR nmdebit <> '0' OR nmkredit <> '0' OR nmsaldoakhir <> '0'")
                End If

                'PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_NERACA_MUTASI -----------------------------------  
                If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT NERACA MUTASI
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                  idlogin,                            nmnorek,                             nmnoreknama,                  nmtipe,                           nmmatauang,                             nmkurs,                                nmcabang                            nmcabangnama                                nmuraian,                             nmcatatan,                             nmsaldoawal,                             nmdebit,                             nmkredit,                             nmsaldoakhir,                             idmsmq,                             nmuserid,                   nmcustomtext1,           nmcustomtext2,           nmcustomtext3,           nmcustomtext4,           nmcustomtext5,nmcustomint1,nmcustomint2,nmcustomint3,nmcustomint4,nmcustomint5, nmcustomdbl1,           nmcustomdbl2,           nmcustomdbl3,           nmcustomdbl4,           nmcustomdbl5,                                nmcustomdate1,                                      nmcustomdate2,                                      nmcustomdate3,                                      nmcustomdate4,                                      nmcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & dr1("idlogin") & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmnoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("nmtipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmkurs")) & "',  '" & FxDB(dr1("nmcabang"), "") & "',  '" & FxDB(dr1("nmcabangnama"), "") & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
                    Next

                    'SIMPAN KE m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail
                    If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                        sql = "Insert into m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail(idlogin, nmnorek, nmnoreknama, nmtipe, nmmatauang, nmkurs, nmcabang, nmcabangnama, nmuraian, nmcatatan, nmsaldoawal, nmdebit, nmkredit, nmsaldoakhir, idmsmq, nmuserid, nmcustomtext1, nmcustomtext2, nmcustomtext3, nmcustomtext4, nmcustomtext5, nmcustomint1, nmcustomint2, nmcustomint3, nmcustomint4, nmcustomint5, nmcustomdbl1, nmcustomdbl2, nmcustomdbl3, nmcustomdbl4, nmcustomdbl5, nmcustomdate1, nmcustomdate2, nmcustomdate3, nmcustomdate4, nmcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                            'result(2) = "Failed processing report." & currNorek : GoTo selesai
                            result(2) = sql : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail ----------------------------


                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtAmbilNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtAmbilNorek.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currNorek & "'." : GoTo selesai
                End If

            Next
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_NeracaMutasi_Lokasi(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN NERACA MUTASI
        '- Akun L/R Tahun Berjalan dan Akun L/R Bulan Berjalan tidak perlu ditampilkan di Neraca Mutasi
        '- Akun L/R Ditahan buat Saldo Awal, Saldo Akhir, Mutasi diisi nol 
        '       : REALISASI AKUN +  (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String, saldoNol(5) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang, saldoNol

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = "", saldoNol As Integer = 0
        Dim Vlokasi As String = ""

        Dim norekLRBulan As String = "", norekLRTahun As String = "", norekLRDitahan As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================
