        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 7) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================

        'lokasi(0) As String
        If (Len(dataDetail(0)) = 0) Then
            result(2) = "lokasi can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Vlokasi = dataDetail(0)
        End If

        'tglAwal(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(2) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(2)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(2)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(2))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(3) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(3)

        'norekAkhir(4) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(4)

        'matauang(5) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(5)

        'saldoNol(6) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(6)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "saldoNol required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            saldoNol = dataDetail(6)
        End If

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMSQ DI m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace trial balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail -----------------------------


        'AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING ------------------------------------------
        'AKUN L/R BULAN BERJALAN
        Dim dtLR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRBulan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Monthly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R TAHUN BERJALAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiTahunBerjalan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRTahun = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Yearly Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AKUN L/R DITAHAN
        dtLR = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode= 'LabaRugiDitahan'", strCon)
        If dtLR.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            norekLRDitahan = dtLR.Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Retained Profit/Loss CoA not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL SALDO L/R DITAHAN
        '3. L/R DITAHAN AMBIL DARI : REALISASI AKUN + (L/R TAHUN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA) + (L/R BULAN BERJALAN TAHUN SEBELUMNYA)
        Dim saldoDitahan As Double = 0
        Dim sqlDitahan As String = "SELECT  c.cnomor as pknorek,  '" & FixQuotes(Vlokasi) & "' as pkcabang, IFNULL(l.lnama,'') as pkcabangnama,  (IFNULL(SUM(rl.rljmldebit),0)) AS pkdebit,  (IFNULL(SUM(rl.rljmlkredit),0)) AS pkkredit, (CASE c.cdc 	 	WHEN 'D' THEN (IFNULL(SUM(rl.rljmldebit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(rl.rljmlkredit),0)) 		ELSE (IFNULL(SUM(rl.rljmlkredit),0)) - (IFNULL(SUM(rl.rljmldebit),0))  END) AS pksaldo  FROM m1_coa c LEFT JOIN m2_realization_location rl ON c.cnomor = rlnorek LEFT JOIN m1_location l ON rl.rllokasi = l.lkode WHERE (c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "')   AND (CASE  		WHEN c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR c.cnomor = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN (rl.rltahun < YEAR('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "'))  		ELSE (rl.rltahun < YEAR('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "') or (rl.rltahun = YEAR('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "')   AND rl.rltahun <= MONTH('" & FixDouble(tglAwal) & "'))) END)   AND (rl.rllokasi = '" & FixQuotes(Vlokasi) & "')    ORDER BY c.cnomor  "
        Dim dtDitahan As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlDitahan, strCon)
        If dtDitahan.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            saldoDitahan = Double.Parse(dtDitahan.Rows(0)("pksaldo"))
        End If


        'END OF AMBIL AKUN LABARUGI DARI SETTING -----------------------------------


        'BUAT SQL ----------------------------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", ftJoinSA As String = "", ftJoinSM As String = ""

        'FILTER NOREK
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1') "
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If


        'AMBIL NOREK ANTARA NOREKAWAL DAN NOREK AKHIR
        Dim dtAmbilNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor FROM m1_coa " & Filter & " ORDER BY cnomor", strCon)
        Dim currNorek As String = "", currFilter As String = ""
        If dtAmbilNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtAmbilNorek.Rows
                stepKe = stepKe + 1 : strValue.Clear()

                currNorek = FxDB(dr("cnomor"), "")
                currFilter = Filter & " AND cnomor = '" & currNorek & "'"

                'FILTER JOIN SALDO AWAL
                ftJoinSA = "ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND (CASE c.cjenis 	WHEN 'P' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'   	WHEN 'B' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'   ELSE t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'    END)   AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') 	 			WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%'  			ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)  AND t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(Vlokasi) & "' "
                'SQL SALDO AWAL
                sqlSA = "SELECT c.cnomor as sanorek, c.cnama as sanoreknama, t.tlokasi as nmcabang, l.lnama AS nmcabangnama , c.cdc sacdc,  c.ctipe satipe, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "')  	WHEN 0 THEN s.snilai 	ELSE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END) as samatauang,   (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "')  	WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) 	ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)   				ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) 					END)  END) as sadebit,  (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') 		WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) 	 	ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' 					WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0)  				ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) 	 				END) END) as sakredit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') 	WHEN 0 THEN (CASE c.cdc	WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0)   								ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)  END) 				ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "'  				WHEN s.snilai THEN (CASE c.cdc 															WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) 	 														ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)  END) 				ELSE (CASE c.cdc   						WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0)    END)    END)  END) as sasaldo FROM m1_coa c  LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t " & ftJoinSA & "   LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional'  LEFT JOIN m1_location l ON t.tlokasi = l.lkode   " & currFilter & "    GROUP BY c.cnomor    "

                'FILTER JOIN SALDO MUTASI
                ftJoinSM = "ON c.cnomor = t.tnorek  AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)   AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'  AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "')   WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' 	ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "'  END)  AND (t.tlokasi = '" & FixQuotes(Vlokasi) & "')  "
                'SQL SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSM = "SELECT c.cnomor as smnorek,  (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') 	WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)  	 ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' 				WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) 				ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) 	END) as smdebit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0)  ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' 			WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) 			ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0)  			 END) END) as smkredit   FROM m1_coa c  LEFT JOIN m2_transaction_journal t " & ftJoinSM & "  LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting'  AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional'  LEFT JOIN m1_branch br ON t.tcabang = br.bkode  " & currFilter & "  GROUP BY c.cnomor "


                'SORTING NOREK
                Sorting = " ORDER BY sa.sanorek"

                'GABUNGKAN SQL SALDO AWAL DAN SALDO MUTASI
                sql = "SELECT  '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, sa.sanorek as nmnorek,  sa.sanoreknama as nmnoreknama, sa.satipe as nmtipe, sa.samatauang as nmmatauang, 0 as nmkurs,  sa.nmcabang as nmcabang , IFNULL(sa.nmcabangnama,'') as nmcabangnama , '' as nmuraian,  '' as nmcatatan, (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0 WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "'  ELSE sa.sasaldo END) as nmsaldoawal,  (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN 0  ELSE sm.smdebit END) as nmdebit, (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN 0  ELSE sm.smkredit END) as nmkredit, (CASE WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRBulan) & "' OR sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRTahun) & "' THEN 0  WHEN sa.sanorek = '" & FixQuotes(norekLRDitahan) & "' THEN '" & FixDouble(saldoDitahan) & "'   ELSE (CASE sa.sacdc  			WHEN 'D' THEN sa.sasaldo + sm.smdebit - sm.smkredit  			ELSE sa.sasaldo - sm.smdebit + sm.smkredit END) END) as nmsaldoakhir, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'  as idmsmq,  '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' as nmuserid FROM "
                sql &= " (" & sqlSA & ") as sa "
                sql &= " JOIN "
                sql &= " (" & sqlSM & ") as sm "
                sql &= " ON sa.sanorek = sm.smnorek "
                sql &= " JOIN m1_coa mycoa "
                sql &= " ON sa.sanorek = mycoa.cnomor "
                sql &= Sorting
                'END OF BUAT SQL ---------------------------------------------------------

                'AMBIL SALDO NOREK SESUAI SQL YANG TELAH DIBUAT
                Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

                'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2R_NERACA_MUTASI SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
                'CEK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL
                'JIKA TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA TAMPILKAN SEMUA DATA
                'JIKA TIDAK TAMPILKAN SALDO NOL MAKA DATA DIFILTER LAGI YANG SALDO NYA > 0 SAJA
                If saldoNol <> 1 Then
                    dtNorek = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtNorek, "nmsaldoawal <> '0' OR nmdebit <> '0' OR nmkredit <> '0' OR nmsaldoakhir <> '0'")
                End If

                'PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_NERACA_MUTASI -----------------------------------  
                If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT NERACA MUTASI
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                  idlogin,                            nmnorek,                             nmnoreknama,                  nmtipe,                           nmmatauang,                             nmkurs,                                nmcabang                            nmcabangnama                                nmuraian,                             nmcatatan,                             nmsaldoawal,                             nmdebit,                             nmkredit,                             nmsaldoakhir,                             idmsmq,                             nmuserid,                   nmcustomtext1,           nmcustomtext2,           nmcustomtext3,           nmcustomtext4,           nmcustomtext5,nmcustomint1,nmcustomint2,nmcustomint3,nmcustomint4,nmcustomint5, nmcustomdbl1,           nmcustomdbl2,           nmcustomdbl3,           nmcustomdbl4,           nmcustomdbl5,                                nmcustomdate1,                                      nmcustomdate2,                                      nmcustomdate3,                                      nmcustomdate4,                                      nmcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & dr1("idlogin") & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmnorek")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmnoreknama")) & "', " & dr1("nmtipe") & ", '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmmatauang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmkurs")) & "',  '" & FxDB(dr1("nmcabang"), "") & "',  '" & FxDB(dr1("nmcabangnama"), "") & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmuraian")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmcatatan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmsaldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmdebit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmkredit")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("nmsaldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("idmsmq")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("nmuserid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
                    Next

                    'SIMPAN KE m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail
                    If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                        sql = "Insert into m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail(idlogin, nmnorek, nmnoreknama, nmtipe, nmmatauang, nmkurs, nmcabang, nmcabangnama, nmuraian, nmcatatan, nmsaldoawal, nmdebit, nmkredit, nmsaldoakhir, idmsmq, nmuserid, nmcustomtext1, nmcustomtext2, nmcustomtext3, nmcustomtext4, nmcustomtext5, nmcustomint1, nmcustomint2, nmcustomint3, nmcustomint4, nmcustomint5, nmcustomdbl1, nmcustomdbl2, nmcustomdbl3, nmcustomdbl4, nmcustomdbl5, nmcustomdate1, nmcustomdate2, nmcustomdate3, nmcustomdate4, nmcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                            'result(2) = "Failed processing report." & currNorek : GoTo selesai
                            result(2) = sql : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT m2r_neraca_mutasi_detail ----------------------------


                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtAmbilNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtAmbilNorek.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currNorek & "'." : GoTo selesai
                End If

            Next
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_StokProduksiVsPenjualanFix(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN STOK PRODUKSI VS PENJUALAN

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tahun(0) As Double, kategoriBarangAwal(1) As String, kategoriBarangAkhir(2) As String, barangAwal(3) As String,
        'barangAkhir(4) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tahun, kategoriBarangAwal, kategoriBarangAkhir, barangAwal,
        'barangAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tahun As Double = 0, kategoriBarangAwal As String = "", kategoriBarangAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = ""
        Dim barangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 5) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Double
        If IsNumeric(dataDetail(0)) = False Then
            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            tahun = Double.Parse(dataDetail(0))
        End If

        'kategoriBarangAwal(1) As String
        kategoriBarangAwal = dataDetail(1)

        'kategoriBarangAkhir(2) As String
        kategoriBarangAkhir = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAwal(3) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(3)

        'barangAkhir(4) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(4)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Produksi_Vs_Penjualan ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Produksi_Vs_Penjualan
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Produksi_Vs_Penjualan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Produksi_Vs_Penjualan -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang"
        sql &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"

        'FILTER BARANG (KATEGORI)
        If Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 And Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AWAL DAN KATEGORI BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= KATEGORI BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= KATEGORI BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid"

        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i.bkode"

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim dtJan, dtFeb, dtMar, dtApr, dtMei, dtJun, dtJul, dtAgu, dtSep, dtOkt, dtNov, dtDes As New DataTable
            Dim sqlSAwal As String = "", sqlSProduksi As String = "", sqlSNotProduksi As String = ""
            Dim sqlSPenjualan As String = "", sqlSNotPenjualan As String = "", sqlBulan As String = ""
            Dim idbarang As String = "", kodebarang As String = ""
            Dim stokCurr As Double = 0, stokClose As Double = 0, stokProduksiPenjualan As Double = 0
            Dim ftBarang As String = "", tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
            Dim drUrutan As Integer = 0

            'BUAT QUERY SALDO AWAL
            sqlSAwal = "  SELECT 1 as urutan, 'Saldo Awal' as keterangan, i.bid, i.bkode, IFNULL(SUM((CASE WHEN it.id IS NULL OR n.kodetabel IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE it.jmlbarang * (-1) END) END)), 0) as jumlah "
            sqlSAwal &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlSAwal &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl < 'tglAwal' "
            sqlSAwal &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

            'BUAT QUERY SALDO MASUK PRODUKSI
            sqlSProduksi = "  SELECT 2 as urutan, 'Produksi' as keterangan, i.bid, i.bkode, IFNULL(SUM((CASE WHEN it.id IS NULL OR n.kodetabel IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE it.jmlbarang END)), 0) as jumlah "
            sqlSProduksi &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlSProduksi &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl BETWEEN 'tglAwal' AND 'tglAkhir' AND it.jenismutasi = 1 AND it.sumber = 'PD' "
            sqlSProduksi &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

            'BUAT QUERY SALDO MASUK SELAIN PRODUKSI
            sqlSNotProduksi = "  SELECT 3 as urutan, 'Masuk Selain Produksi' as keterangan, i.bid, i.bkode, IFNULL(SUM((CASE WHEN it.id IS NULL OR n.kodetabel IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE it.jmlbarang END)), 0) as jumlah "
            sqlSNotProduksi &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlSNotProduksi &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl BETWEEN 'tglAwal' AND 'tglAkhir' AND it.jenismutasi = 1 AND it.sumber <> 'PD' "
            sqlSNotProduksi &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

            'BUAT QUERY SALDO KELUAR PENJUALAN
            sqlSPenjualan = "  SELECT 5 as urutan, 'Penjualan' as keterangan, i.bid, i.bkode, IFNULL(SUM((CASE WHEN it.id IS NULL OR n.kodetabel IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE it.jmlbarang END)), 0) as jumlah "
            sqlSPenjualan &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlSPenjualan &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl BETWEEN 'tglAwal' AND 'tglAkhir' AND it.jenismutasi = 0 AND it.sumber = 'SI' "
            sqlSPenjualan &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

            'BUAT QUERY SALDO KELUAR SELAIN PENJUALAN
            sqlSNotPenjualan = "  SELECT 6 as urutan, 'Keluar Selain Penjualan' as keterangan, i.bid, i.bkode, IFNULL(SUM((CASE WHEN it.id IS NULL OR n.kodetabel IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE it.jmlbarang END)), 0) as jumlah "
            sqlSNotPenjualan &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlSNotPenjualan &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl BETWEEN 'tglAwal' AND 'tglAkhir' AND it.jenismutasi = 0 AND it.sumber <> 'SI' "
            sqlSNotPenjualan &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, KODEBARANG
                idbarang = dr1("bid") : kodebarang = dr1("bkode")

                'SET FILTER BARANG
                ftBarang = " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "' "

                'MAPPING (urutan, keterangan, bid, bkode, jumlah)

                '------ Keterangan -------- | ------ Urutan -------
                'Saldo Awal                 | 1
                'Produksi                   | 2
                'Masuk Selain Produksi      | 3
                'Stock Bulan Ini            | 4 (1 + 2 + 3)
                'Penjualan                  | 5
                'Keluar Selain Penjualan    | 6
                'Stock Akhir Bulan Ini      | 7 (4 - 5 - 6)
                'Produksi VS Penjualan      | 8 (2 - 5)

                'HITUNG SALDO JANUARI -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                tglAwal = tahun & "-01-01" : tglAkhir = tahun & "-01-31"
                '1 HITUNG Saldo Awal
                sqlBulan = "  (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSAwal, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ") "
                '2 HITUNG Produksi
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSProduksi, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '3 HITUNG Masuk Selain Produksi
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSNotProduksi, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '5 HITUNG Penjualan
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSPenjualan, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '6 HITUNG Keluar Selain Penjualan
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSNotPenjualan, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                dtJan = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlBulan, strCon)

                '4 HITUNG Stock Bulan Ini (1 + 2 + 3)
                stokCurr = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 1 OR urutan = 2 OR urutan = 3)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtJan, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "4~Stock Bulan Ini~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokCurr & "")

                '7 HITUNG Stock Akhir Bulan Ini (4 - 5 - 6)
                stokClose = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 4)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 5)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 6)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtJan, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "7~Stock Akhir Bulan Ini~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokClose & "")

                '8 HITUNG Produksi VS Penjualan (2 - 5)
                stokProduksiPenjualan = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 2)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 5)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtJan, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "8~Produksi VS Penjualan~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokProduksiPenjualan & "")
                'END OF HITUNG SALDO JANUARI ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


                'HITUNG SALDO FEBRUARI ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                tglAwal = tahun & "-02-01" : tglAkhir = tahun & "-02-31"
                '1 HITUNG Saldo Awal
                sqlBulan = "  (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSAwal, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ") "
                '2 HITUNG Produksi
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSProduksi, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '3 HITUNG Masuk Selain Produksi
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSNotProduksi, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '5 HITUNG Penjualan
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSPenjualan, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '6 HITUNG Keluar Selain Penjualan
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSNotPenjualan, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                dtFeb = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlBulan, strCon)

                '4 HITUNG Stock Bulan Ini (1 + 2 + 3)
                stokCurr = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtFeb, "jumlah", "(urutan = 1 OR urutan = 2 OR urutan = 3)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtFeb, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "4~Stock Bulan Ini~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokCurr & "")

                '7 HITUNG Stock Akhir Bulan Ini (4 - 5 - 6)
                stokClose = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtFeb, "jumlah", "(urutan = 4)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtFeb, "jumlah", "(urutan = 5)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtFeb, "jumlah", "(urutan = 6)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtFeb, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "7~Stock Akhir Bulan Ini~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokClose & "")

                '8 HITUNG Produksi VS Penjualan (2 - 5)
                stokProduksiPenjualan = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtFeb, "jumlah", "(urutan = 2)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtFeb, "jumlah", "(urutan = 5)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtFeb, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "8~Produksi VS Penjualan~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokProduksiPenjualan & "")
                'END OF HITUNG SALDO FEBRUARI ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


                'HITUNG SALDO MARET -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                tglAwal = tahun & "-03-01" : tglAkhir = tahun & "-03-31"
                '1 HITUNG Saldo Awal
                sqlBulan = "  (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSAwal, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ") "
                '2 HITUNG Produksi
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSProduksi, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '3 HITUNG Masuk Selain Produksi
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSNotProduksi, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '5 HITUNG Penjualan

                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSPenjualan, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '6 HITUNG Keluar Selain Penjualan
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSNotPenjualan, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                dtDes = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlBulan, strCon)

                '4 HITUNG Stock Bulan Ini (1 + 2 + 3)
                stokCurr = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtDes, "jumlah", "(urutan = 1 OR urutan = 2 OR urutan = 3)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtDes, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "4~Stock Bulan Ini~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokCurr & "")

                '7 HITUNG Stock Akhir Bulan Ini (4 - 5 - 6)
                stokClose = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtDes, "jumlah", "(urutan = 4)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtDes, "jumlah", "(urutan = 5)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtDes, "jumlah", "(urutan = 6)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtDes, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "7~Stock Akhir Bulan Ini~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokClose & "")

                '8 HITUNG Produksi VS Penjualan (2 - 5)
                stokProduksiPenjualan = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtDes, "jumlah", "(urutan = 2)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtDes, "jumlah", "(urutan = 5)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtDes, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "8~Produksi VS Penjualan~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokProduksiPenjualan & "")
                'END OF HITUNG SALDO DESEMBER ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


                'RESET STRING QUERY
                strValue.Clear()

                'PERULANGAN SEBANYAK DATA SALDO (1 s.d.8)
                If dtJan.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    'MAPPING (urutan, keterangan, bid, bkode, jumlah)
                    For Each drDetail As DataRow In dtJan.Rows
                        'SET URUTAN
                        drUrutan = Integer.Parse(drDetail("urutan"))

                        'BUAT QUERY INSERT PERBARANG PERTAHUN
                        strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))

                        'SALDO BULAN FEBRUARI SD DESEMBER AMBIL DARI DTFEB SD DTDES BERDASARKAN URUTAN YANG SAMA
                        'mapping :                       idlogin,                   pvptahun,                        pvpidbarang,                          pvpkodebarang,            pvpurutan,                           pvpketerangan,                                  pvpjan,                                       pvpfeb,                                                                             pvpmar,                                                                             pvpapr,                                                                             pvpmei,                                                                             pvpjun,                                                                             pvpjul,                                                                             pvpagu,                                                                             pvpsep,                                                                             pvpokt,                                                                             pvpnov,                                                                             pvpdes,                                                              idmsmq,                   pvpuserid,                pvpcustomtext1,          pvpcustomtext2,          pvpcustomtext3,          pvpcustomtext4,          pvpcustomtext5, pvpcustomint1, pvpcustomint2, pvpcustomint3, pvpcustomint4, pvpcustomint5, pvpcustomdbl1, pvpcustomdbl2,        pvpcustomdbl3,          pvpcustomdbl4,          pvpcustomdbl5,                             pvpcustomdate1,                                     pvpcustomdate2,                                     pvpcustomdate3,                                     pvpcustomdate4,                                     pvpcustomdate5
                        strValue.Append("('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "', '" & FixDouble(tahun) & "', '" & FixQuotes(drDetail("bid")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(drDetail("bkode")) & "', " & drUrutan & ", '" & FixQuotes(drDetail("keterangan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(drDetail("jumlah")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtFeb, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtMar, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtApr, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtMei, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtJun, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtJul, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtAgu, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtSep, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtOkt, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtNov, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(AsDataTableDSum(dtDes, "jumlah", "urutan = " & drUrutan & "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", " & 0 & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
                    Next
                End If

                'SIMPAN KE M2r_Produksi_Vs_Penjualan
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into M2r_Produksi_Vs_Penjualan(idlogin, pvptahun, pvpidbarang, pvpkodebarang, pvpurutan, pvpketerangan, pvpjan, pvpfeb, pvpmar, pvpapr, pvpmei, pvpjun, pvpjul, pvpagu, pvpsep, pvpokt, pvpnov, pvpdes, idmsmq, pvpuserid, pvpcustomtext1, pvpcustomtext2, pvpcustomtext3, pvpcustomtext4, pvpcustomtext5, pvpcustomint1, pvpcustomint2, pvpcustomint3, pvpcustomint4, pvpcustomint5, pvpcustomdbl1, pvpcustomdbl2, pvpcustomdbl3, pvpcustomdbl4, pvpcustomdbl5, pvpcustomdate1, pvpcustomdate2, pvpcustomdate3, pvpcustomdate4, pvpcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing Production VS Sales Report. - " & kodebarang : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Production VS Sales Report : " & kodebarang : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Production VS Sales Report : " & "Nothing" : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_StokProduksiVsPenjualan(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN STOK PRODUKSI VS PENJUALAN

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tahun(0) As Double, kategoriBarangAwal(1) As String, kategoriBarangAkhir(2) As String, barangAwal(3) As String,
        'barangAkhir(4) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tahun, kategoriBarangAwal, kategoriBarangAkhir, barangAwal,
        'barangAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        Dim tahun As Double = 0, kategoriBarangAwal As String = "", kategoriBarangAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = ""
        Dim barangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 5) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tahun(0) As Double
        If IsNumeric(dataDetail(0)) = False Then
            result(2) = "tahun required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            tahun = Double.Parse(dataDetail(0))
        End If

        'kategoriBarangAwal(1) As String
        kategoriBarangAwal = dataDetail(1)

        'kategoriBarangAkhir(2) As String
        kategoriBarangAkhir = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAwal(3) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(3)

        'barangAkhir(4) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(4)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Produksi_Vs_Penjualan ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Produksi_Vs_Penjualan
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Produksi_Vs_Penjualan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Produksi_Vs_Penjualan -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang"
        sql &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1"

        'FILTER BARANG (KATEGORI)
        If Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 And Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AWAL DAN KATEGORI BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= KATEGORI BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= KATEGORI BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid"

        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i.bkode"

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim dtJan, dtFeb, dtMar, dtApr, dtMei, dtJun, dtJul, dtAgu, dtSep, dtOkt, dtNov, dtDes As New DataTable
            Dim sqlSAwal As String = "", sqlSProduksi As String = "", sqlSNotProduksi As String = ""
            Dim sqlSPenjualan As String = "", sqlSNotPenjualan As String = "", sqlBulan As String = ""
            Dim idbarang As String = "", kodebarang As String = ""
            Dim stokCurr As Double = 0, stokClose As Double = 0, stokProduksiPenjualan As Double = 0
            Dim ftBarang As String = "", tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
            Dim drUrutan As Integer = 0

            'BUAT QUERY SALDO AWAL
            sqlSAwal = "  SELECT 1 as urutan, 'SA' as keterangan, i.bid, i.bkode, IFNULL(SUM((CASE WHEN it.id IS NULL OR n.kodetabel IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE it.jmlbarang * (-1) END) END)), 0) as jumlah "
            sqlSAwal &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlSAwal &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl < 'tglAwal' "
            sqlSAwal &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

            'BUAT QUERY SALDO MASUK PRODUKSI
            sqlSProduksi = "  SELECT 2 as urutan, 'Prod' as keterangan, i.bid, i.bkode, IFNULL(SUM((CASE WHEN it.id IS NULL OR n.kodetabel IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE it.jmlbarang END)), 0) as jumlah "
            sqlSProduksi &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlSProduksi &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl BETWEEN 'tglAwal' AND 'tglAkhir' AND it.jenismutasi = 1 AND it.sumber = 'PD' "
            sqlSProduksi &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

            'BUAT QUERY SALDO MASUK SELAIN PRODUKSI
            sqlSNotProduksi = "  SELECT 3 as urutan, 'In Other' as keterangan, i.bid, i.bkode, IFNULL(SUM((CASE WHEN it.id IS NULL OR n.kodetabel IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE it.jmlbarang END)), 0) as jumlah "
            sqlSNotProduksi &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlSNotProduksi &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl BETWEEN 'tglAwal' AND 'tglAkhir' AND it.jenismutasi = 1 AND it.sumber <> 'PD' "
            sqlSNotProduksi &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

            'BUAT QUERY SALDO KELUAR PENJUALAN
            sqlSPenjualan = "  SELECT 5 as urutan, 'Sales' as keterangan, i.bid, i.bkode, IFNULL(SUM((CASE WHEN it.id IS NULL OR n.kodetabel IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE it.jmlbarang END)), 0) as jumlah "
            sqlSPenjualan &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlSPenjualan &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl BETWEEN 'tglAwal' AND 'tglAkhir' AND it.jenismutasi = 0 AND it.sumber = 'SI' "
            sqlSPenjualan &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

            'BUAT QUERY SALDO KELUAR SELAIN PENJUALAN
            sqlSNotPenjualan = "  SELECT 6 as urutan, 'Out Other' as keterangan, i.bid, i.bkode, IFNULL(SUM((CASE WHEN it.id IS NULL OR n.kodetabel IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE it.jmlbarang END)), 0) as jumlah "
            sqlSNotPenjualan &= " FROM m1_item i "
            sqlSNotPenjualan &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl BETWEEN 'tglAwal' AND 'tglAkhir' AND it.jenismutasi = 0 AND it.sumber <> 'SI' "
            sqlSNotPenjualan &= " LEFT JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, KODEBARANG
                idbarang = dr1("bid") : kodebarang = dr1("bkode")

                'SET FILTER BARANG
                ftBarang = " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "' "

                'MAPPING (urutan, keterangan, bid, bkode, jumlah)

                '------ Keterangan -------- | ------ Urutan -------
                'SA                 | 1
                'Prod                   | 2
                'In Other      | 3
                'Stock            | 4 (1 + 2 + 3)
                'Sales                  | 5
                'Out Other    | 6
                'Stock End      | 7 (4 - 5 - 6)
                'Prod VS Sal      | 8 (2 - 5)

                'HITUNG SALDO JANUARI -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                tglAwal = tahun & "-01-01" : tglAkhir = tahun & "-01-31"
                '1 HITUNG SA
                sqlBulan = "  (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSAwal, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ") "
                '2 HITUNG Prod
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSProduksi, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '3 HITUNG In Other
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSNotProduksi, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '5 HITUNG Sales
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSPenjualan, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                '6 HITUNG Out Other
                sqlBulan &= " UNION ALL (" & Replace(Replace(sqlSNotPenjualan, "tglAwal", tglAwal), "tglAkhir", tglAkhir) & ftBarang & ")"
                dtJan = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlBulan, strCon)

                '4 HITUNG Stock (1 + 2 + 3)
                stokCurr = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 1 OR urutan = 2 OR urutan = 3)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtJan, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "4~Stock~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokCurr & "")

                '7 HITUNG Stock End (4 - 5 - 6)
                stokClose = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 4)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 5)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 6)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtJan, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "7~Stock End~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokClose & "")

                '8 HITUNG Prod VS Sal (2 - 5)
                stokProduksiPenjualan = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 2)")) - Double.Parse(AsDataTableDSum(dtJan, "jumlah", "(urutan = 5)"))
                AsDataTableTambahData(dtJan, "urutan~keterangan~bid~bkode~jumlah", "8~Prod VS Sal~" & idbarang & "~" & kodebarang & "~" & stokProduksiPenjualan & "")
                'END OF HITUNG SALDO JANUARI ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


                'HITUNG SALDO FEBRUARI ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                tglAwal = tahun & "-02-01" : tglAkhir = tahun & "-02-31"
