        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", cabangAwal As String = "", cabangAkhir As String = "", lokasiAwal As String = "", lokasiAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================

        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If


        'cabangAwal(2) As String
        cabangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'cabangAkhir(3) As String
        cabangAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'lokasiAwal(4) As String
        lokasiAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'lokasiAkhir(5) As String
        lokasiAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan_perhari_1 ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ m2r_penjualan_perhari_1
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_penjualan_perhari_1 WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Inventory Balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan_perhari_1 -----------------------------------


        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan_perhari_2 ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ m2r_penjualan_perhari_2
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_penjualan_perhari_2 WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Inventory Balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan_perhari_2 -----------------------------------

        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlMutasi As String = ""
        Dim sqljual1 As String = "", sqljual2 As String = ""


        sqljual1 = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin , '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq , '" & userid & "' as userid , IFNULL(sp.urutan,1) AS urutan , 	si.sicabang AS cabang, 	si.silokasi AS lokasi, b.bnama AS sicabang , l.lnama AS silokasi , si.siid , sid.idsi ,  si.sinotransaksi , si.sitgl ,	(((Sum((sid.jml * sid.harga) - sid.jmldiskon) - si.sijmldiskon) + si.sitotalpajak1detail) + si.sibiayalain) as totaltransaksi , 	sp.carabayar  as kode ,  pm.nama AS carabayar , sp.matauang , sp.jumlah , sp.jumlahvalas , si.sistatus as status "
        sqljual1 &= " FROM m5_si si "
        sqljual1 &= " JOIN  m1_branch b ON si.sicabang = b.bkode "
        sqljual1 &= " JOIN  m1_location l ON si.silokasi = l.lkode AND si.sicabang = l.lcabang "
        sqljual1 &= " LEFT JOIN m5_si_pay sp ON si.siid = sp.idsi "
        sqljual1 &= " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi "
        sqljual1 &= " LEFT JOIN m0_payment_method pm ON sp.carabayar = pm.kode "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER CABANG 
        If Len(cabangAwal) > 0 And Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CABANG AWAL DAN CABANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sicabang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(cabangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CABANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= CABANG AWAL 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sicabang >= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CABANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= CABANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sicabang <= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "'"
        End If


        'FILTER LOKASI 
        If Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 And Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AWAL DAN LOKASI AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.silokasi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= LOKASI AWAL 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.silokasi >= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= LOKASI AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.silokasi <= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER 
        sqljual1 &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        sqljual1 &= " GROUP BY si.sicadfdbang, si.silokasi, si.sitgl , si.siid , sp.carabayar   "
        sqljual1 &= " ORDER BY si.sicabang, si.silokasi, si.sitgl , si.siid , sp.carabayar  "

        sqljual2 = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin , '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq , '" & userid & "' as userid ,	si.sicabang	, 	si.silokasi	,  si.siid	, si.sitgl , sp.carabayar  as kode ,  pm.nama AS carabayar , sp.matauang , sp.jumlah , sp.jumlahvalas , si.sistatus AS status  "
        sqljual2 &= " FROM m5_si si "
        sqljual2 &= " LEFT JOIN m5_si_pay	sp ON si.siid =	sp.idsi "
        sqljual2 &= " LEFT JOIN m0_payment_method	pm ON sp.carabayar = pm.kode "

        'Filterr TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA Filterr BETWEEN 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr >= TGL AWAL 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr <= TGL AKHIR
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'Filterr CABANG 
        If Len(cabangAwal) > 0 And Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CABANG AWAL DAN CABANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA Filterr BETWEEN 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sicabang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(cabangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CABANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr >= CABANG AWAL 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sicabang >= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CABANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr <= CABANG AKHIR
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sicabang <= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "'"
        End If


        'Filterr LOKASI 
        If Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 And Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AWAL DAN LOKASI AKHIR DIISI MAKA Filterr BETWEEN 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.silokasi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr >= LOKASI AWAL 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.silokasi >= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr <= LOKASI AKHIR
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.silokasi <= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER 
        sqljual2 &= IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filterr), Filterr)

        sqljual2 &= " GROUP BY si.sicabang, si.silokasi, si.sitgl	, si.siid ,	sp.carabayar  "
        sqljual2 &= " ORDER BY si.sicabang, si.silokasi, sp.carabayar "

        'sqlJadi = " SELECT idlogin ,'" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq , '" & userid & "' as userid ,  IFNULL(sp.urutan,1) AS urutan , 	si.sicabang AS cabang, 	si.silokasi AS lokasi, b.bnama AS sicabang , l.lnama AS silokasi , si.siid , sid.idsi , si.sitgl , si.sinotransaksi , 	(((Sum((sid.jml * sid.harga) - sid.jmldiskon) - si.sijmldiskon) + si.sitotalpajak1detail) + si.sibiayalain) as totaltransaksi , 	sp.carabayar  as kode ,  pm.nama AS carabayar , sp.matauang , sp.jumlah , sp.jumlahvalas FROM "
        'sqlJadi += " (" & sqljual1 & ")  as Jadi "
        'sqlJadi += " WHERE  ((si.sistatus = 2) OR	(sistatus = 3) OR (sistatus = 4) OR (sistatus = 7) )"
        'sqlJadi += " Order By sitgl ASC"

        'INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU #########################
        sqlMutasi = " INSERT INTO m2r_penjualan_perhari_1 (" & sqljual1 & ")"
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------


        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlMutasi, strCon) = False Then
            'result(2) = "Failed proccessing Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
            result(2) = sqlMutasi : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU #########################
        sqlMutasi = " INSERT INTO m2r_penjualan_perhari_2 (" & sqljual2 & ")"
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------


        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlMutasi, strCon) = False Then
            'result(2) = "Failed proccessing Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
            result(2) = sqlMutasi : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
        progressPersen = 100

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai

        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_komisi_abd(ByVal param As String) As String

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Filterr As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = ""


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 4) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================

        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(1) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'kontakAwal(2) As String
        kontakAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'kontakAkhir(3) As String
        kontakAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_komisi_abd ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ m2r_komisi_abd
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_komisi_abd WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Inventory Balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_komisi_abd -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL SALESMAN SESUAI FILTER ---------------------
        sql = " SELECT k.kid,  k.kkode, k.knama "
        sql += " FROM m1_contact k "
        sql += " WHERE k.kkategori = 'M' "

        'FILTER KONTAK 
        If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " k.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " k.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " k.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(" AND", Filterr), Filterr)

        'AMBIL DATA SALESMAN 
        Dim dtkontak As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL SALESMAN SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------

        If dtkontak.Rows.Count > 0 Then


            Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlMutasi As String = ""
            Dim sqlSI As String = "", sqlSR As String = "", sql1 As String = ""
            Dim idkontak As String = ""


            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtkontak.Rows

                stepKe += 1

                idkontak = dr1("kid")


                'QUERY SALDO AWAL HUTANG  ###############################
                sqlSI = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin , ks.kkode AS salesmankode, ks.knama AS salesmannama , si.sitgl AS tgl , si.sinotransaksi AS notransaksi  , si.sisumber as sumber ,  k.kkode AS customerkode, k.knama AS customernama, b.bkode AS barangkode, b.bnama AS barangnama, b.bkategori AS kategorikode, ic.icnama AS kategoribarang,  LEFT(b.bkategori,2) as grupkode  , CASE LEFT(ic.icnama,2) 	WHEN 'P.' THEN 'PAKU' 	WHEN 'KA' THEN CASE ic.icnama WHEN 'KAWAT' THEN 'KAWAT'	ELSE 'LAIN-LAIN' END ELSE 'LAIN-LAIN' END AS grup , SUM((sid.jml * sid.harga) - sid.jmldiskon) AS jumlah "
                sqlSI += " FROM m5_si si   "
                sqlSI += " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi 	 "
                sqlSI += " JOIN m1_contact ks  ON  si.sibagianpenjualan  = ks.kid "
                sqlSI += " JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sicustomer = k.kid   "
                sqlSI += " JOIN m1_item b ON sid.idbarang = b.bid "
                sqlSI += " JOIN m1_item_category ic ON b.bkategori = ic.ickode  "
                sqlSI += " WHERE ((si.sistatus = 2) or (si.sistatus = 3) or (si.sistatus = 4) or (si.sistatus = 7)) AND si.sibagianpenjualan = '" & FixDouble(idkontak) & "' "
                sqlSI += " GROUP BY si.sibagianpenjualan , si.sisumber ,  LEFT(b.bkategori,2) , si.sitgl , si.sinotransaksi "
                sqlSI += " ORDER BY si.sibagianpenjualan , si.sisumber ,LEFT(b.bkategori,2) , si.sitgl , si.sinotransaksi  "

                sqlSR = " SELECT  '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin , ks.kkode AS salesmankode, ks.knama AS salesmannama , sr.srtgl AS tgl , sr.srnotransaksi AS notransaksi  ,sr.srsumber as sumber ,  k.kkode AS customerkode, k.knama AS customernama, b.bkode AS barangkode, b.bnama AS barangnama, b.bkategori AS kategorikode, ic.icnama AS kategoribarang,  LEFT(b.bkategori,2) as grupkode  , CASE LEFT(ic.icnama,2) 	WHEN 'P.' THEN 'PAKU' 	WHEN 'KA' THEN CASE ic.icnama WHEN 'KAWAT' THEN 'KAWAT'	ELSE 'LAIN-LAIN'		END 	ELSE 'LAIN-LAIN' END AS grup, SUM((srd.jml * srd.harga) - srd.jmldiskon) AS jumlah  "
                sqlSR += " FROM m5_sr sr "
                sqlSR += " JOIN m5_sr_detail srd ON sr.srid = srd.idsr  "
                sqlSR += " JOIN m1_contact ks ON  sr.srbagianpenjualan  = ks.kid  "
                sqlSR += " JOIN m1_contact k ON sr.srcustomer = k.kid  "
                sqlSR += " JOIN m1_item b ON srd.idbarang = b.bid "
                sqlSR += " JOIN m1_item_category ic ON b.bkategori = ic.ickode  "
                sqlSR += " WHERE ((sr.srstatus = 2) or (sr.srstatus = 3) or (sr.srstatus = 4) or (sr.srstatus = 7)) AND sr.srbagianpenjualan = '" & FixDouble(idkontak) & "' "
                sqlSR += "  GROUP BY sr.srbagianpenjualan , sr.srsumber ,  LEFT(b.bkategori,2) , sr.srtgl , sr.srnotransaksi  "
                sqlSR += "  ORDER BY sr.srbagianpenjualan ,sr.srsumber ,  LEFT(b.bkategori,2) , sr.srtgl , sr.srnotransaksi  "

                sqlJadi = "SELECT @nourut := @nourut + 1 as nourut  , idlogin , '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as userid , salesmankode , salesmannama, tgl , notransaksi , sumber , customerkode , customernama , barangkode , barangnama , kategorikode , kategoribarang , grupkode, grup , jumlah FROM  "
                sqlJadi += "  ((" & sqlSI & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlSR & ")) as jadi"
                sqlJadi += " , (SELECT @nourut := 0) AS variableInit1  "

                'FILTER TGL 
                If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
                    'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
                    Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
                    Filter &= " tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
                ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
                    'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
                    Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
                    Filter &= " tgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
                ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
                    'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
                    Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
                    Filter &= " tgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
                End If

                ''FILTER KONTAK 
                'If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                '    'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
                '    Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
                '    Filter &= " salesmankode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "'"
                'ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
                '    'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
                '    Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
                '    Filter &= " salesmankode >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "'"
                'ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                '    'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
                '    Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
                '    Filter &= " salesmankode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "'"
                'End If

                'FILTER 
                sqlJadi += IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)
                sqlJadi += " Order By salesmankode ASC, sumber ASC , nourut,  kategorikode ASC  , tgl ASC, notransaksi ASC "

                'INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU #########################
                sqlMutasi = " INSERT INTO m2r_komisi_abd(" & sqlJadi & ")"
                'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlMutasi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
                    'result(2) = "sqlMutasi   -  " & sqlMutasi : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
                progressPersen = 100

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai

                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next
        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report 'Nothing' Warehouse : " & IIf(OrderBy = "kid", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_Total_Selisih_StokOpname(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN MUTASI STOK

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String
        'gudangAwal(4) As String, gudangAkhir(5) As String, orderBy(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'gudangAwal, gudangAkhir, orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim gudangAwal As String = "", gudangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'gudangAwal(2) As String
        gudangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'gudangAkhir(3) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'barangAwal(4) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'barangAkhir(5) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(5)


        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Mutasi_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Mutasi_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_Stok_Opname WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Mutasi_Stok -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT sp.spgudang as gudang, w.wnama AS gudangnama,  	sp.sptgl as tgl, il.ilnama as lokasibarang , spd.idbarang , b.bkode , spd.namabarang, spd.satuan ,  SUM(spd.jmlfisik) AS jmlfisik "
        sql &= " FROM m3_sp sp "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON spgudang = w.wkode "
        sql &= " JOIN m3_sp_detail spd ON sp.spid = spd.idsp AND sp.spstatus IN(2,3,4,7)  "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item b ON spd.idbarang = b.bid    "
        'sql &= " LEFT JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON spd.idbarang = sid.idbarang  "
        'sql &= " LEFT JOIN m5_si si ON sid.idsi = si.siid AND sp.sptgl = si.sitgl AND sp.spgudang = si.sigudang AND  "
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_location il ON spd.lokasibarang = il.ilkode "

        'FILTER TGL
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = " sp.sptgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter &= " sp.sptgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter &= " sp.sptgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER GUDANG
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL DAN GUDANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " sp.spgudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= GUDANG AWAL
            Filter &= " sp.spgudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= GUDANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " sp.spgudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " spd.idbarang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " spd.idbarang >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " spd.idbarang <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        sql &= " GROUP BY sp.spgudang , sp.sptgl , spd.idbarang"
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY sp.spgudang , sp.sptgl , spd.idbarang"

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------

        'result(2) = dtBarang.Rows.Count & "- asa" & sql : GoTo selesai


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = "", gudang As String = "", tgl As String = "", dtSA As New DataTable, saldoawal As Double = 0
            Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", sqlSAGabung As String = "", sqlSMGabung As String = ""
            Dim sqlSAJadi As String = "", sqlSMJadi As String = ""
            Dim SqlSI As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN 
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG, TGL
                idbarang = dr1("idbarang") : gudang = dr1("gudang") : tgl = dr1("tgl") : lokasibarang = dr1("lokasibarang") : jmlfisik = dr1("jmlfisik") ': jmlbarangjual = dr1("jmlbarangjual") 


                'Query Ambil Jml Barang Terjual
                SqlSI = " SELECT sid.idbarang, SUM(sid.jmlbarang) as jmlbarangjual  "
                SqlSI += " FROM m5_si si "
                SqlSI += " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi AND si.sitgl = '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND si.sigudang = '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' AND sid.idbarang =  '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "' AND si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
                SqlSI += " GROUP BY sid.idbarang "
                SqlSI += " ORDER BY sid.idbarang "

                Dim dtBarangSI As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(SqlSI, strCon)
                If dtBarangSI.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    jmlbarangjual = FixDouble(dtBarangSI.Rows(0)("jmlbarangjual"))
                Else
                    jmlbarangjual = 0
                End If


                'QUERY SALDO AWAL ###########################
                sqlSA = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as msuserid,'" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' as gudang, wa.wnama as gudangnama, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as tgl,  i.bid as idbarang, i.bkode as bkode, i.bnama as namabarang, i.bsatuan AS satuan, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as jmlmasuk, (CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE 0 END) as jmlkeluar "
                sqlSA &= " FROM m1_item i"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_warehouse wa ON wa.wkode = '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.gudang = wa.wkode AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
                sqlSA &= " WHERE i.bid = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "'"
                'result(2) = "sqlSA -" & sqlSA : GoTo selesai

                sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as msuserid, ms.gudang, ms.gudangnama,  ms.tgl, ms.idbarang, '" & FxDB(dr1("lokasibarang"), "") & "' AS lokasibarang ,  ms.bkode, ms.namabarang, ms.satuan, " & FxDB(jmlbarangjual, 0) & " as jmlbarangjual , " & FxDB(dr1("jmlfisik"), 0) & " as jmlfisik ,   SUM(ms.jmlmasuk - ms.jmlkeluar) as saldoawal, '' As catatan "
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM ( " & sqlSA & " ) as ms"
                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY ms.tgl, ms.gudang , ms.idbarang"
                ' result(2) = "sqlSAGabung - " & sqlSAGabung : GoTo selesai

                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO m2r_Stok_Opname (" & sqlSAGabung & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================

                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report 'Nothing' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    '        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================

    '        End If
    '        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================

    Public Function M0_StokOpname(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN MUTASI STOK

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else

            End If
        Else

        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'barangAkhir(5) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(6)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "vSelisih required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            vSelisih = dataDetail(6)
        End If

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Mutasi_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Mutasi_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_Stok_Opname WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Mutasi_Stok -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT sp.spgudang as gudang, w.wnama AS gudangnama,  	sp.sptgl as tgl, il.ilnama as lokasibarang , spd.idbarang , b.bkode , spd.namabarang, spd.satuan ,  SUM(spd.jmlfisik) AS jmlfisik "
        sql &= " FROM m3_sp sp "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON spgudang = w.wkode "
        sql &= " JOIN m3_sp_detail spd ON sp.spid = spd.idsp AND sp.spstatus IN(2,3,4,7)  "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item b ON spd.idbarang = b.bid    "
        'sql &= " LEFT JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON spd.idbarang = sid.idbarang  "
        'sql &= " LEFT JOIN m5_si si ON sid.idsi = si.siid AND sp.sptgl = si.sitgl AND sp.spgudang = si.sigudang AND  "

        'FILTER TGL

            Filter = " sp.sptgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter &= " sp.sptgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter &= " sp.sptgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER GUDANG
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL DAN GUDANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " sp.spgudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= GUDANG AWAL
            Filter &= " sp.spgudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= GUDANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " sp.spgudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " spd.idbarang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " spd.idbarang >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " spd.idbarang <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If


        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        'sql &= " GROUP BY sp.spgudang , sp.sptgl , spd.idbarang"
        sql &= " GROUP BY sp.spgudang , spd.idbarang"

        'ORDER BY
        'sql &= " ORDER BY sp.spgudang , sp.sptgl , spd.idbarang"
        sql &= " ORDER BY sp.spgudang , spd.idbarang"

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------

        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            Dim dtBarangSI As New DataTable
            Dim dtSaldoAwal As New DataTable
            Dim idbarang As String = "", gudang As String = "", tgl As String = "", dtSA As New DataTable, saldoawal As Double = 0, harga As Double = 0
            Dim sqlSA As String = "", sqlSM As String = "", sqlSAGabung As String = "", sqlSMGabung As String = ""
            Dim sqlSAJadi As String = "", sqlSMJadi As String = ""
            Dim SqlSI As String = ""

            'Query Ambil Jml Barang Terjual
            SqlSI = " SELECT sid.idbarang, IFNULL(SUM(sid.jmlbarang),0) as jmlbarangjual  "
            SqlSI += " FROM m5_si si "
            SqlSI += " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi AND si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND si.sigudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "' AND si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
            SqlSI += " GROUP BY sid.idbarang "
            SqlSI += " ORDER BY sid.idbarang "
            dtBarangSI = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(SqlSI, strCon)


            'QUERY SALDO AWAL ###########################
            sqlSA = " SELECT i.bid, IFNULL(SUM(CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE (it.jmlbarang * -1) END),0) as saldoawal, i.bhppaverage as harga "
            sqlSA &= " FROM m1_item i"
            sqlSA &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "' AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
            sqlSA &= " GROUP BY i.bid"
            dtSaldoAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSA, strCon)



            'PERULANGAN 
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG, TGL
                idbarang = dr1("idbarang") : gudang = dr1("gudang") : tgl = dr1("tgl") : lokasibarang = dr1("lokasibarang") : jmlfisik = dr1("jmlfisik") ': jmlbarangjual = dr1("jmlbarangjual") 

                'Ambil Jml Barang Terjual
                jmlbarangjual = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtBarangSI, "jmlbarangjual", "idbarang = '" & idbarang & "'", 0))

                'Ambil Saldo Awal
                saldoawal = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSaldoAwal, "saldoawal", "bid = '" & idbarang & "'", 0))
                harga = Double.Parse(AsDataTableDLookup(dtSaldoAwal, "harga", "bid = '" & idbarang & "'", 0))

                'Query Insert
                sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT  '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' As idlogin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' As idmsmq, '" & FixQuotes(userid) & "' As msuserid, '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' As gudang, '" & FixQuotes(dr1("gudangnama")) & "' as gudangnama,  '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as tgl, '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "' as idbarang, '" & FxDB(dr1("lokasibarang"), "") & "' AS lokasibarang ,  '" & FixQuotes(dr1("bkode")) & "' as bkode, '" & FixQuotes(dr1("namabarang")) & "' as namabarang, '" & FixQuotes(dr1("satuan")) & "' as satuan, " & FxDB(jmlbarangjual, 0) & " as jmlbarangjual , " & FxDB(dr1("jmlfisik"), 0) & " as jmlfisik ,   '" & FixDouble(saldoawal) & "' as saldoawal, '' As catatan ,  '" & FixDouble(harga) & "' as harga ,  " & FxDB(saldoawal, 0) & " - ( " & FxDB(jmlbarangjual, 0) & " + " & FxDB(dr1("jmlfisik"), 0) & " ) As selisih, (" & FixDouble(saldoawal) & " - ( " & FxDB(jmlbarangjual, 0) & " + " & FxDB(dr1("jmlfisik"), 0) & " )) * " & FixDouble(harga) & " as total  "
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM m1_item   "
                sqlSAGabung &= " WHERE bid =  '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "' "

                'Filterr vSelisih
                If vSelisih = 1 Then
                    Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND"), Filterr)
                    ' SELISIH <> 0
                    Filterr &= " selisih <> 0 "
                End If

                'Filterr
                sqlSAGabung &= IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(" Having", Filterr), Filterr)


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO m2r_Stok_Opname (" & sqlSAGabung & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("namabarang")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("namabarang")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report 'Nothing' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_RekapKartuStokOld1(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REKAP KARTU STOK

        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================

        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai

        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================

        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai

        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================

        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 7) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String

            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)


        'orderBy(4) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(4)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(4)
        End If

        ''gudangAwal(5) As String
        'gudangAwal = dataDetail(5)

        ''gudangAkhir(6) As String
        'gudangAkhir = dataDetail(6)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kartu_Stok WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok -----------------------------------


        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        If Len(FilterBarang) > 0 Then
            FilterBarang = " AND " & FilterBarang
        End If


        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL HPP
        Dim sqlHppSa As String = "", sqlSAJadi As String = ""
        sqlHppSa = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, i.bid, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldohpp, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldonilai "
        sqlHppSa &= " FROM m1_item i "

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        progressPersen = 10 : stepKe = 1
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

        'INSERT DATA SALDO AWAL HPP KE TABEL PEMBANTU
        If dtHppSa.Rows.Count > 0 Then
