                counter += 1
                strHppSa.Append(IIf(Len(strHppSa.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))

                'mapping :                       idmsmq,                                id,                                        jml,                                             hpp,                                             nilai
                strHppSa.Append("('" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(dr1("bid"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(dr1("kssaldojml"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(dr1("kssaldohpp"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(dr1("kssaldonilai"), 0)) & "')")

                If Len(strHppSa.ToString) > 0 And (counter >= dtHppSa.Rows.Count Or counter Mod batasCounter = 0) Then
                    sqlSAJadi = " Insert into m2r_hppglobalsa (idmsmq, id, jml, hpp, nilai) values" & strHppSa.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance COGS " & " - " & sqlSAJadi : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                    strHppSa.Clear()
                End If

            Next
        End If

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        progressPersen = 20 : stepKe = 2
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card " & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'AMBIL SALDO MASUK HPP
        Dim sqlHppMs As String = "", sqlMsJadi As String = ""
        sqlHppMs = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, i.bid, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldohpp, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldonilai "
        sqlHppMs &= " FROM m1_item i "
        sqlHppMs &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.jenismutasi = 1 AND it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' " & FilterBarang
        sqlHppMs &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "
        sqlHppMs &= " GROUP BY i.bid "
        Dim dtHppMs As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlHppMs, strCon)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        progressPersen = 30 : stepKe = 3
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card " & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'INSERT DATA SALDO MASUK HPP KE TABEL PEMBANTU
        If dtHppMs.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            Dim strHppms As New StringBuilder : counter = 0
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtHppMs.Rows

    Public Function M0_RekapKartuStok(ByVal param As String) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------

        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail

        'orderBy(4) As String, gudangAwal(5) As String, gudangAkhir(6) As String, katbarangAwal(7) As String, katbarangAkhir(8) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'orderBy, gudangAwal, gudangAkhir, katbarangAwal, katbarangAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim search As String = ""

        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder, strInsert As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0, counter As Double = 0, batasCounter As Double = 1000

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""
        'Dim gudangAwal As String = "", gudangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim katbarangAwal As String = "", katbarangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT

        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_InventoryAgingKawata(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN INVENTORY AGING KAWATA

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, gudangAwal(5) As String, gudangAkhir(6) As String, katbarangAwal(7) As String, katbarangAkhir(8) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'orderBy, gudangAwal, gudangAkhir, katbarangAwal, katbarangAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim FilterBarang As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder, strInsert As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0, counter As Double = 0, batasCounter As Double = 1000

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""
        'Dim gudangAwal As String = "", gudangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim katbarangAwal As String = "", katbarangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 9) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)


        'orderBy(4) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(4)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(4)
        End If

        ''gudangAwal(5) As String
        'gudangAwal = dataDetail(5)

        ''gudangAkhir(6) As String
        'gudangAkhir = dataDetail(6)

        'katbarangAwal(7) As String
        katbarangAwal = dataDetail(7)

        'katbarangAkhir(8) As String
        katbarangAkhir = dataDetail(8)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kartu_Stok WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok -----------------------------------


        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KATEGORI)
        If Len(katbarangAwal) > 0 And Len(katbarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(katbarangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(katbarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(katbarangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        If Len(FilterBarang) > 0 Then
            FilterBarang = " AND " & FilterBarang
        End If


        'AMBIL SALDO AKHIR HPP
        Dim sqlHppSk As String = "", sqlSkJadi As String = ""
        sqlHppSk = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, i.bid, IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml, (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) as kssaldohpp, (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) as kssaldonilai "
        sqlHppSk &= " FROM m1_item i "
        sqlHppSk &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' " & FilterBarang
        sqlHppSk &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "

        Dim dtHppsk As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlHppSk, strCon)

    Public Function M0_InventoryAgingKawata2(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN INVENTORY AGING KAWATA

        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, gudangAwal(5) As String, gudangAkhir(6) As String, katbarangAwal(7) As String, katbarangAkhir(8) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------

        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'orderBy, gudangAwal, gudangAkhir, katbarangAwal, katbarangAkhir

        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""

        'katbarangAwal(7) As String

        'katbarangAkhir(8) As String

        ElseIf Len(katbarangAkhir) > 0 Then

            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)

    Public Function M0_CashFlow(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN CASH FLOW (AKUN LAWAN)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, norekAwal, norekAkhir, matauang

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder, strMutasi As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 5) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kasbank_Harian ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kasbank_Harian
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Kasbank_Harian WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace general ledger data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kasbank_Harian -----------------------------

        'BUAT FILTER NOREK -------------------------------------------------------
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1') AND ctipe IN(0, 1) "
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER NOREK ------------------------------------------------

        'AMBIL NOREK ANTARA NOREK AWAL DAN NOREK AKHIR
        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor FROM m1_coa " & Filter & " ORDER BY cnomor", strCon)

        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2r_Kasbank_Harian SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
            Dim sqlSAwal As String = "", sqlSMutasi As String = "", sqlSAkhir As String = ""
            Dim SAwal As Double = 0, SMutasi As Double = 0, SAkhir As Double = 0
            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, currNorek As String = ""
            Dim dtTgl As New DataTable, currTgl As String = ""
            Dim dtMutasi As New DataTable

            'AMBIL TANGGAL
            sql = " SELECT tkas.ttgl "
            sql &= "FROM m2_transaction_journal tkas "
            sql &= "JOIN m1_coa c ON tkas.tnorek = c.cnomor "
            sql &= "JOIN m1_contact k ON tkas.tkontak = k.kid "
            sql &= "WHERE tkas.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) "
            sql &= "AND tkas.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
            sql &= "GROUP BY tkas.ttgl ASC "
            dtTgl = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

            'PERULANGAN INSERT M2r_Kasbank_Harian PER NOREK ------------------------
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
                currNorek = dr("cnomor") : strValue.Clear() : strMutasi.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAwal = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldoawal FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact k ON t.tkontak = k.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SALDO MUTASI
                sqlSMutasi = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldomutasi FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact k ON t.tkontak = k.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'SALDO AKHIR
                sqlSAkhir = "SELECT (CASE WHEN LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') = 0 OR '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' = s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit) - SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas) - SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) as saldoakhir FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact k ON t.tkontak = k.kid LEFT JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' WHERE t.tstatus IN(2, 3, 4, 7) AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' AND t.ttgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"
                'GABUNGKAN SQL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                sql = "SELECT (" & sqlSAwal & ") as saldoawal, (" & sqlSMutasi & ") as saldomutasi, (" & sqlSAkhir & ") as saldoakhir"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
                If dtSAwal.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSAwal.Rows
                        'SET NILAI SALDO AWAL, SALDO MUTASI DAN SALDO AKHIR
                        SAwal = FixDouble(dr1("saldoawal")) : SMutasi = FixDouble(dr1("saldomutasi")) : SAkhir = FixDouble(dr1("saldoakhir"))
                    Next

                    result(2) = "Failed Getting '" & currNorek & "' starting balance." : GoTo selesai

           kbhuserid,                                  kbhcustomtext1,                                     kbhcustomtext2,                                 kbhcustomtext3,             Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtNorek.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtNorek.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress 'No Data' daily cash report." : GoTo selesai
            End If

        result(2) = notransaksi

selesai:

        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_Penjualan_OK(ByVal param As String) As String

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Filterr As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim sumber As String = "", tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = ""


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String

            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)

            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================

        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")

        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_penjualan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan -----------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSI As String = "", sqlSI2 As String = ""

        'QUERY SI ###############################

        sqlSI = " SELECT si.sitgl , si.sinotransaksi , k.kkode , k.knama , c.cnama AS kota , prov.pnama AS propinsi , sid.namabarang , b.bkode , sid.jml , sid.satuan , sid.harga , sid.jmldiskon , ((sid.jml * sid.harga) - sid.jmldiskon) AS total , si.sitotalpajak1detail , si.sitotalpajak2detail , si.sibiayalain , si.sijmldiskon , si.sijmluangmuka, si.sitotaltransaksi   "



        sqlSI += " FROM m5_si si  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sicustomer = k.kid  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_item b ON sid.idbarang = b.bid  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_city c ON k.k1kota = c.ckode  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_province prov ON k.k1propinsi = prov.pkode  "


        'FILTER TGL

            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER KOTA 
        If Len(kotaAwal) > 0 And Len(kotaAkhir) > 0 Then

        ElseIf Len(kotaAwal) > 0 Then

        sqlSI2 = " SELECT SUM(sid.jml) AS tjml"
        sqlSI2 += " FROM m5_si si  "
        sqlSI2 += " JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sicustomer = k.kid  "
        sqlSI2 += " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi  "
        sqlSI2 += " JOIN m1_item b ON sid.idbarang = b.bid  "
        sqlSI2 += " JOIN m1_city c ON k.k1kota = c.ckode  "
        sqlSI2 += " JOIN m1_province prov ON k.k1propinsi = prov.pkode  "

        'Filterr TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA Filterr BETWEEN 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then

            Filterr &= " si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr <= TGL AKHIR
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)

        End If

            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " c.cnama BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kotaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kotaAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kotaAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr >= TGL AWAL 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " c.cnama >= '" & FixQuotes(kotaAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kotaAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr <= TGL AKHIR
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)

        sqlJadi = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as userid , sitgl , sinotransaksi , kkode , knama , kota , propinsi , namabarang , bkode , jml , satuan , harga , jmldiskon , total , sitotalpajak1detail , sitotalpajak2detail , sibiayalain , sijmldiskon , sijmluangmuka, sitotaltransaksi, tjml FROM  "
        sqlJadi += "  ((" & sqlSI & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlSI2 & ")) as jadi"

        'INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU #########################

        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1

selesai:

        End If

    Public Function M0_Penjualan(ByVal param As String) As String

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Filterr As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim sumber As String = "", tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = ""


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 4) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================

        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(2) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'kotaAwal(2) As String
        kotaAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'kotaAkhir(3) As String
        kotaAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ m2r_penjualan
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_penjualan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Inventory Balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan -----------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSI As String = "", sqlSI2 As String = ""

        'QUERY SI ###############################

        sqlSI = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as userid , si.sitgl , si.sinotransaksi , k.kkode , k.knama , k1kota As kodekota , c.cnama AS kota , c.cpropinsi As kodepropinsi, prov.pnama AS propinsi , sid.namabarang , b.bkode , sid.jml , sid.satuan , sid.harga , sid.jmldiskon , ((sid.jml * sid.harga) - sid.jmldiskon) AS total , si.sitotalpajak1detail , si.sitotalpajak2detail , si.sibiayalain , si.sijmldiskon , si.sijmluangmuka, si.sitotaltransaksi, "

        sqlSI += " (SELECT SUM(sid.jml)  "
        sqlSI += " FROM m5_si si "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sicustomer = k.kid   "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi AND (si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7)) AND (si.sisaldoawal = 0 )  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_item b ON sid.idbarang = b.bid   "
        sqlSI += " LEFT JOIN m1_city c ON k.k1kota = c.ckode   "
        sqlSI += " LEFT JOIN m1_province prov ON c.cpropinsi = prov.pkode "


        'Filterr TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA Filterr BETWEEN 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr >= TGL AWAL 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr <= TGL AKHIR
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'Filterr KOTA 
        If Len(kotaAwal) > 0 And Len(kotaAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA Filterr BETWEEN 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " c.cnama BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kotaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kotaAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kotaAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr >= TGL AWAL 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " c.cnama >= '" & FixQuotes(kotaAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kotaAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr <= TGL AKHIR
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " c.cnama <= '" & FixQuotes(kotaAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'Filterr 
        sqlSI += IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filterr), Filterr)

        sqlSI += " ) As tjml "

        sqlSI += " FROM m5_si si  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sicustomer = k.kid  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi AND (si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7)) AND (si.sisaldoawal = 0 ) "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_item b ON sid.idbarang = b.bid  "
        sqlSI += " LEFT JOIN m1_city c ON k.k1kota = c.ckode  "
        sqlSI += " LEFT JOIN m1_province prov ON c.cpropinsi = prov.pkode  "


        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER KOTA 
        If Len(kotaAwal) > 0 And Len(kotaAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " c.cnama BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kotaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kotaAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kotaAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " c.cnama >= '" & FixQuotes(kotaAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kotaAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " c.cnama <= '" & FixQuotes(kotaAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER 
        sqlSI += IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        'result(2) = sqlSI : GoTo selesai


        'INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU #########################
        sqlMutasi = " INSERT INTO m2r_penjualan (" & sqlSI & ")"
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------


        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlMutasi, strCon) = False Then
            'result(2) = "Failed proccessing Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
            result(2) = sqlMutasi : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
        progressPersen = 100

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai

        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then

selesai:

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then

            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " (si.sitgl) <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"

        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function
