        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'gudangAwal(2) As String
        gudangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'gudangAkhir(3) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'kategoriBarangAwal(4) As String
        kategoriBarangAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'kategoriBarangAkhir(5) As String
        kategoriBarangAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'barangAwal(6) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'barangAkhir(7) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(7)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_batch_pertanggal ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_batch_pertanggal
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_batch_pertanggal WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_batch_pertanggal -----------------------------------


        'Filter Gudang ---------------------------------------------------------------
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AWAL DAN gudang AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            filterGudang = " AND nbi.nbigudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= gudang AWAL
            filterGudang = " AND nbi.nbigudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= gudang AKHIR
            filterGudang = " AND nbi.nbigudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'End of Filter Gudang --------------------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"

        'FILTER KategoriBarang
        If Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 And Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AWAL DAN KategoriBarang AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= KategoriBarang AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= KategoriBarang AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i.bkode"

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = "" ', gudang As String = ""
            Dim sqlSAGabung As String = "", sqlSAJadi As String = ""
            Dim dtInsert As New DataTable


            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                idbarang = FxDB(dr1("bid"), 0)

                'QUERY
                sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, bp.gudang as bpgudang, bp.gudangnama as bpgudangnama, bp.idbarang as bpidbarang, bp.kodebarang as bpkodebarang, bp.namabarang as bpnamabarang, bp.nobatch as bpnobatch, bp.tglexpired as bptglexpired, bp.satuan as bpsatuan, SUM(bp.jmlmasuk) as bpmasuk, SUM(bp.jmlkeluar) as bpkeluar, SUM(bp.jmlsisa) as bpsisa, '" & FixDouble(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as bpuserid, '' as bpcustomtext1, '' as bpcustomtext2, '' as bpcustomtext3, '' as bpcustomtext4, '' as bpcustomtext5, '0' as bpcustomint1, '0' as bpcustomint2, '0' as bpcustomint3, '0' as bpcustomint4, '0' as bpcustomint5, '0' as bpcustomdbl1, '0' as bpcustomdbl2, '0' as bpcustomdbl3, '0' as bpcustomdbl4, '0' as bpcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate5 FROM "
                sqlSAGabung &= " (SELECT nbi.nbigudang as gudang, w.wnama as gudangnama, nbi.nbiidbarang as idbarang, i.bkode as kodebarang, i.bnama as namabarang, nbi.nbikode as nobatch, nbi.nbicustomdate1 as tglexpired, nbi.nbisatuan as satuan, nbi.nbijmlmasuk as jmlmasuk, SUM((CASE IFNULL(nbo.nboid,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE nbo.nbojmlkeluar END)) as jmlkeluar, nbi.nbijmlmasuk - SUM((CASE IFNULL(nbo.nboid,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE nbo.nbojmlkeluar END)) as jmlsisa "
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM m1_no_batch_in nbi "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_item i ON nbi.nbiidbarang = i.bid AND i.bid = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "' " & filterGudang
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON nbi.nbigudang = w.wkode "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON nbi.nbisumber = it.sumber  "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbi.nbiidtransaksi = it.idutama "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbi.nbigudang = it.gudang "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbi.nbiidbarang = it.idbarang "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND it.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlSAGabung &= " LEFT JOIN m1_no_batch_out nbo ON nbi.nbiidbatchin = nbo.nboidbatchin "
                sqlSAGabung &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction ito ON nbo.nbosumber = ito.sumber "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbo.nboidtransaksi = ito.idutama "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbo.nbogudang = ito.gudang "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbo.nboidbarang = ito.idbarang "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND ito.tgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY nbi.nbiidbatchin "
                sqlSAGabung &= " ORDER BY w.wkode, i.bkode, nbi.nbikode "
                sqlSAGabung &= " ) as bp "
                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY bp.gudang, bp.idbarang, bp.nobatch "
                sqlSAGabung &= " HAVING bpsisa <> 0 "

                dtInsert = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSAGabung, strCon)
                strInsert.Clear()
                If dtInsert.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each drInsert As DataRow In dtInsert.Rows
                        strInsert.Append(IIf(Len(strInsert.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                                       idlogin,                                           bpgudang,                                               bpgudangnama,                                           bpidbarang,                                         bpkodebarang,                                           bpnamabarang,                                               bpnobatch,                                                          bptglexpired,                                                       bpsatuan,                                           bpmasuk,                                            bpkeluar,                                           bpsisa,                                             idmsmq,                                         bpuserid,                                           bpcustomtext1,                                              bpcustomtext2,                                          bpcustomtext3,                                              bpcustomtext4,                                          bpcustomtext5,                                              bpcustomint1,                                           bpcustomint2,                                           bpcustomint3,                                           bpcustomint4,                                           bpcustomint5,                                           bpcustomdbl1,                                           bpcustomdbl2,                                           bpcustomdbl3,                                           bpcustomdbl4,                                           bpcustomdbl5,                                                           bpcustomdate1,                                                                      bpcustomdate2,                                                                      bpcustomdate3,                                                                      bpcustomdate4,                                                                          bpcustomdate5
                        strInsert.Append("('" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idlogin"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpgudang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpgudangnama"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpidbarang"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpkodebarang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpnamabarang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpnobatch"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bptglexpired"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpsatuan"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpmasuk"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpkeluar"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpsisa"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idmsmq"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpuserid"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext1"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext2"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext3"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext4"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext5"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint1"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint2"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint3"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint4"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint5"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl1"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl2"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl3"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl4"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl5"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate1"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate2"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate3"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate4"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate5"), "1900-01-01"))) & "')")
                    Next
                End If


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strInsert.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sqlSAJadi = " Insert into m2r_batch_pertanggal (idlogin, bpgudang, bpgudangnama, bpidbarang, bpkodebarang, bpnamabarang, bpnobatch, bptglexpired, bpsatuan, bpmasuk, bpkeluar, bpsisa, idmsmq, bpuserid, bpcustomtext1, bpcustomtext2, bpcustomtext3, bpcustomtext4, bpcustomtext5, bpcustomint1, bpcustomint2, bpcustomint3, bpcustomint4, bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1, bpcustomdbl2, bpcustomdbl3, bpcustomdbl4, bpcustomdbl5, bpcustomdate1, bpcustomdate2, bpcustomdate3, bpcustomdate4, bpcustomdate5) values" & strInsert.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", FxDB(dr1("bkode"), ""), FxDB(dr1("bnama"), "")) & " - " & sqlSAJadi : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", FxDB(dr1("bkode"), ""), FxDB(dr1("bnama"), "")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_StokBatchPertanggal(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN Rekap Stok Barang Batch (Pertanggal)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, gudangAwal(5) As String, gudangAkhir(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, 
        'gudangAwal, gudangAkhir
        'kategoriBarangAwal, kategoriBarangAkhir, 
        'barangAwal, barangAkhir, 

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", filterGudang As String = ""
        Dim stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder, strInsert As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim gudangAwal As String = "", gudangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim kategoriBarangAwal As String = "", kategoriBarangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 8) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'gudangAwal(2) As String
        gudangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'gudangAkhir(3) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'kategoriBarangAwal(4) As String
        kategoriBarangAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'kategoriBarangAkhir(5) As String
        kategoriBarangAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'barangAwal(6) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'barangAkhir(7) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(7)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_batch_pertanggal ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_batch_pertanggal
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_batch_pertanggal WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_batch_pertanggal -----------------------------------


        'Filter Gudang ---------------------------------------------------------------
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AWAL DAN gudang AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            filterGudang = " AND nbi.nbigudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= gudang AWAL
            filterGudang = " AND nbi.nbigudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= gudang AKHIR
            filterGudang = " AND nbi.nbigudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'End of Filter Gudang --------------------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"

        'FILTER KategoriBarang
        If Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 And Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AWAL DAN KategoriBarang AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= KategoriBarang AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= KategoriBarang AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i.bkode"

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = "" ', gudang As String = ""
            Dim sqlSAGabung As String = "", sqlSAJadi As String = ""
            Dim dtInsert As New DataTable


            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                idbarang = FxDB(dr1("bid"), 0)

                'QUERY
                sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, bp.gudang as bpgudang, bp.gudangnama as bpgudangnama, bp.idbarang as bpidbarang, bp.kodebarang as bpkodebarang, bp.namabarang as bpnamabarang, bp.nobatch as bpnobatch, bp.tglexpired as bptglexpired, bp.satuan as bpsatuan, SUM(bp.jmlmasuk) as bpmasuk, SUM(bp.jmlkeluar) as bpkeluar, SUM(bp.jmlsisa) as bpsisa, '" & FixDouble(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as bpuserid, '' as bpcustomtext1, '' as bpcustomtext2, '' as bpcustomtext3, '' as bpcustomtext4, '' as bpcustomtext5, '0' as bpcustomint1, '0' as bpcustomint2, '0' as bpcustomint3, '0' as bpcustomint4, '0' as bpcustomint5, '0' as bpcustomdbl1, '0' as bpcustomdbl2, '0' as bpcustomdbl3, '0' as bpcustomdbl4, '0' as bpcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate5 FROM "
                sqlSAGabung &= " (SELECT nbi.nbigudang as gudang, w.wnama as gudangnama, nbi.nbiidbarang as idbarang, i.bkode as kodebarang, i.bnama as namabarang, nbi.nbikode as nobatch, nbi.nbicustomdate1 as tglexpired, nbi.nbisatuan as satuan, nbi.nbijmlmasuk as jmlmasuk, SUM((CASE IFNULL(ito.id,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE nbo.nbojmlkeluar END)) as jmlkeluar, nbi.nbijmlmasuk - SUM((CASE IFNULL(ito.id,0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE nbo.nbojmlkeluar END)) as jmlsisa "
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM m1_no_batch_in nbi "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_item i ON nbi.nbiidbarang = i.bid AND i.bid = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "' " & filterGudang
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON nbi.nbigudang = w.wkode "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbi.nbitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlSAGabung &= " LEFT JOIN m1_no_batch_out nbo ON nbi.nbiidbatchin = nbo.nboidbatchin "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbo.nbotgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY nbi.nbiidbatchin "
                sqlSAGabung &= " ORDER BY w.wkode, i.bkode, nbi.nbikode "
                sqlSAGabung &= " ) as bp "
                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY bp.gudang, bp.idbarang, bp.nobatch "
                sqlSAGabung &= " HAVING bpsisa <> 0 "

                dtInsert = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSAGabung, strCon)
                strInsert.Clear()
                If dtInsert.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each drInsert As DataRow In dtInsert.Rows
                        strInsert.Append(IIf(Len(strInsert.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                                       idlogin,                                           bpgudang,                                               bpgudangnama,                                           bpidbarang,                                         bpkodebarang,                                           bpnamabarang,                                               bpnobatch,                                                          bptglexpired,                                                       bpsatuan,                                           bpmasuk,                                            bpkeluar,                                           bpsisa,                                             idmsmq,                                         bpuserid,                                           bpcustomtext1,                                              bpcustomtext2,                                          bpcustomtext3,                                              bpcustomtext4,                                          bpcustomtext5,                                              bpcustomint1,                                           bpcustomint2,                                           bpcustomint3,                                           bpcustomint4,                                           bpcustomint5,                                           bpcustomdbl1,                                           bpcustomdbl2,                                           bpcustomdbl3,                                           bpcustomdbl4,                                           bpcustomdbl5,                                                           bpcustomdate1,                                                                      bpcustomdate2,                                                                      bpcustomdate3,                                                                      bpcustomdate4,                                                                          bpcustomdate5
                        strInsert.Append("('" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idlogin"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpgudang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpgudangnama"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpidbarang"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpkodebarang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpnamabarang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpnobatch"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bptglexpired"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpsatuan"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpmasuk"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpkeluar"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpsisa"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idmsmq"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpuserid"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext1"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext2"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext3"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext4"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext5"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint1"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint2"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint3"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint4"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint5"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl1"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl2"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl3"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl4"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl5"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate1"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate2"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate3"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate4"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate5"), "1900-01-01"))) & "')")
                    Next
                End If


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strInsert.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sqlSAJadi = " Insert into m2r_batch_pertanggal (idlogin, bpgudang, bpgudangnama, bpidbarang, bpkodebarang, bpnamabarang, bpnobatch, bptglexpired, bpsatuan, bpmasuk, bpkeluar, bpsisa, idmsmq, bpuserid, bpcustomtext1, bpcustomtext2, bpcustomtext3, bpcustomtext4, bpcustomtext5, bpcustomint1, bpcustomint2, bpcustomint3, bpcustomint4, bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1, bpcustomdbl2, bpcustomdbl3, bpcustomdbl4, bpcustomdbl5, bpcustomdate1, bpcustomdate2, bpcustomdate3, bpcustomdate4, bpcustomdate5) values" & strInsert.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", FxDB(dr1("bkode"), ""), FxDB(dr1("bnama"), "")) & " - " & sqlSAJadi : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", FxDB(dr1("bkode"), ""), FxDB(dr1("bnama"), "")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_MutasiStokBatchPertanggalOld(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN Mutasi Stok Barang Batch (Pertanggal)

        'Detail

        'gudangAwal, gudangAkhir
        'kategoriBarangAwal, kategoriBarangAkhir,

        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", filterGudang As String = ""
        Dim stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder, strInsert As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim gudangAwal As String = "", gudangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim kategoriBarangAwal As String = "", kategoriBarangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then

        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================

        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String

        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 8) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'gudangAwal(2) As String
        gudangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'gudangAkhir(3) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'kategoriBarangAwal(4) As String
        kategoriBarangAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'kategoriBarangAkhir(5) As String
        kategoriBarangAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'barangAwal(6) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'barangAkhir(7) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(7)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_batch_pertanggal ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_batch_pertanggal
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_batch_pertanggal WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_batch_pertanggal -----------------------------------


        'Filter Gudang ---------------------------------------------------------------
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AWAL DAN gudang AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            filterGudang = " AND it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= gudang AWAL
            filterGudang = " AND it.gudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= gudang AKHIR
            filterGudang = " AND it.gudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'End of Filter Gudang --------------------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"

        'FILTER KategoriBarang
        If Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 And Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AWAL DAN KategoriBarang AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= KategoriBarang AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= KategoriBarang AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i.bkode"

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = "" ', gudang As String = ""
            Dim sqlSAGabung As String = "", sqlSAJadi As String = ""
            Dim dtInsert As New DataTable
            Dim drSisa As Double = 0

            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                idbarang = FxDB(dr1("bid"), 0)

                'QUERY
                sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, bp.gudang as bpgudang, bp.gudangnama as bpgudangnama, bp.idbarang as bpidbarang, bp.kodebarang as bpkodebarang, bp.namabarang as bpnamabarang, bp.nobatch as bpnobatch, bp.tglexpired as bptglexpired, bp.satuan as bpsatuan, SUM(bp.msk) as bpmasuk, SUM(bp.klr) as bpkeluar, 0 as bpsisa, '" & FixDouble(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as bpuserid, '' as bpcustomtext1, '' as bpcustomtext2, '' as bpcustomtext3, '' as bpcustomtext4, '' as bpcustomtext5, '0' as bpcustomint1, '0' as bpcustomint2, '0' as bpcustomint3, '0' as bpcustomint4, '0' as bpcustomint5, SUM(bp.saw) as bpcustomdbl1, '0' as bpcustomdbl2, '0' as bpcustomdbl3, '0' as bpcustomdbl4, '0' as bpcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate5 FROM "

                sqlSAGabung &= " (SELECT bin.nbigudang as gudang, bin.nbigudangnama as gudangnama, bin.nbiidbarang as idbarang, bin.nbikodebarang as kodebarang, bin.nbinamabarang as namabarang, bin.nbikode as nobatch, bin.nbicustomdate1 as tglexpired, bin.nbisatuan as satuan, "
                sqlSAGabung &= " (CASE WHEN bin.tglin < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' THEN bin.nbijmlmasuk ELSE 0 END) - SUM((CASE WHEN IFNULL(bout.tglout,'" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' THEN bout.nbojmlkeluar ELSE 0 END)) as saw, "
                sqlSAGabung &= " (CASE WHEN bin.tglin BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' THEN bin.nbijmlmasuk ELSE 0 END) as msk, "
                sqlSAGabung &= " SUM((CASE WHEN IFNULL(bout.tglout,'9999-12-31') BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' THEN bout.nbojmlkeluar ELSE 0 END)) as klr FROM "

                sqlSAGabung &= " (SELECT it.tgl as tglin, nbi.nbiidbatchin, nbi.nbigudang, w.wnama as nbigudangnama, nbi.nbiidbarang, i.bkode as nbikodebarang, i.bnama as nbinamabarang, nbi.nbikode, nbi.nbicustomdate1, nbi.nbisatuan, nbi.nbijmlmasuk "
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM m1_no_batch_in nbi "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON nbi.nbigudang = w.wkode "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON nbi.nbisumber = it.sumber "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbi.nbiidtransaksi = it.idutama "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbi.nbigudang = it.gudang "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbi.nbiidbarang = it.idbarang "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND it.jenismutasi = 1 "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND it.tgl BETWEEN '1900-01-01' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_item i ON nbi.nbiidbarang = i.bid AND i.bid = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "' " & filterGudang
                sqlSAGabung &= " ) as bin "

                sqlSAGabung &= " LEFT JOIN "

                sqlSAGabung &= " (SELECT ito.tgl as tglout, nbo.nboidbatchin, nbo.nbojmlkeluar "
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM m1_no_batch_out nbo "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction ito ON nbo.nbosumber = ito.sumber "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbo.nboidtransaksi = ito.idutama "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbo.nbogudang = ito.gudang "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbo.nboidbarang = ito.idbarang "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND ito.jenismutasi = 0 "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND ito.tgl BETWEEN '1900-01-01' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_item i ON nbo.nboidbarang = i.bid AND i.bid = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "' " & filterGudang.Replace("it.gudang", "ito.gudang")
                sqlSAGabung &= " ) as bout "

                sqlSAGabung &= " ON bin.nbiidbatchin = bout.nboidbatchin "
                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY bin.nbiidbatchin "
                sqlSAGabung &= " ORDER BY bin.nbigudang, bin.nbikodebarang, bin.nbikode "
                sqlSAGabung &= " ) as bp "

                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY bp.gudang, bp.idbarang, bp.nobatch "
                sqlSAGabung &= " HAVING bpcustomdbl1 <> 0 OR bpmasuk <> 0 OR bpkeluar <> 0 "

                dtInsert = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSAGabung, strCon)
                strInsert.Clear()
                If dtInsert.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each drInsert As DataRow In dtInsert.Rows
                        drSisa = Double.Parse(drInsert("bpcustomdbl1")) + Double.Parse(drInsert("bpmasuk")) - Double.Parse(drInsert("bpkeluar"))
                        strInsert.Append(IIf(Len(strInsert.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                                       idlogin,                                           bpgudang,                                               bpgudangnama,                                           bpidbarang,                                         bpkodebarang,                                           bpnamabarang,                                               bpnobatch,                                                          bptglexpired,                                                       bpsatuan,                                           bpmasuk,                                            bpkeluar,                                 bpsisa,                                         idmsmq,                                            bpuserid,                                           bpcustomtext1,                                              bpcustomtext2,                                          bpcustomtext3,                                              bpcustomtext4,                                          bpcustomtext5,                                              bpcustomint1,                                           bpcustomint2,                                           bpcustomint3,                                           bpcustomint4,                                           bpcustomint5,                                           bpcustomdbl1,                                           bpcustomdbl2,                                           bpcustomdbl3,                                           bpcustomdbl4,                                           bpcustomdbl5,                                                           bpcustomdate1,                                                                      bpcustomdate2,                                                                      bpcustomdate3,                                                                      bpcustomdate4,                                                                          bpcustomdate5
                        strInsert.Append("('" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idlogin"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpgudang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpgudangnama"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpidbarang"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpkodebarang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpnamabarang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpnobatch"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bptglexpired"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpsatuan"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpmasuk"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpkeluar"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drSisa, 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idmsmq"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpuserid"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext1"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext2"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext3"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext4"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext5"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint1"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint2"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint3"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint4"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint5"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl1"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl2"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl3"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl4"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl5"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate1"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate2"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate3"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate4"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate5"), "1900-01-01"))) & "')")
                    Next
                End If


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strInsert.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sqlSAJadi = " Insert into m2r_batch_pertanggal (idlogin, bpgudang, bpgudangnama, bpidbarang, bpkodebarang, bpnamabarang, bpnobatch, bptglexpired, bpsatuan, bpmasuk, bpkeluar, bpsisa, idmsmq, bpuserid, bpcustomtext1, bpcustomtext2, bpcustomtext3, bpcustomtext4, bpcustomtext5, bpcustomint1, bpcustomint2, bpcustomint3, bpcustomint4, bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1, bpcustomdbl2, bpcustomdbl3, bpcustomdbl4, bpcustomdbl5, bpcustomdate1, bpcustomdate2, bpcustomdate3, bpcustomdate4, bpcustomdate5) values" & strInsert.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", FxDB(dr1("bkode"), ""), FxDB(dr1("bnama"), "")) & " - " & sqlSAJadi : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", FxDB(dr1("bkode"), ""), FxDB(dr1("bnama"), "")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_MutasiStokBatchPertanggal(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN Mutasi Stok Barang Batch (Pertanggal)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, gudangAwal(5) As String, gudangAkhir(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, 
        'gudangAwal, gudangAkhir
        'kategoriBarangAwal, kategoriBarangAkhir, 
        'barangAwal, barangAkhir, 

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", filterGudang As String = ""
        Dim stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder, strInsert As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = ""
        Dim gudangAwal As String = "", gudangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim kategoriBarangAwal As String = "", kategoriBarangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 8) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'gudangAwal(2) As String
        gudangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'gudangAkhir(3) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'kategoriBarangAwal(4) As String
        kategoriBarangAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'kategoriBarangAkhir(5) As String
        kategoriBarangAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'barangAwal(6) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'barangAkhir(7) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(7)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_batch_pertanggal ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_batch_pertanggal
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_batch_pertanggal WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_batch_pertanggal -----------------------------------


        'Filter Gudang ---------------------------------------------------------------
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AWAL DAN gudang AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            filterGudang = " AND nbi.nbigudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= gudang AWAL
            filterGudang = " AND nbi.nbigudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA gudang AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= gudang AKHIR
            filterGudang = " AND nbi.nbigudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'End of Filter Gudang --------------------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama"
        sql &= " FROM m1_item i"

        Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
        Filter &= " i.bbatch = 1 "

        'FILTER KategoriBarang
        If Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 And Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AWAL DAN KategoriBarang AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= KategoriBarang AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KategoriBarang AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= KategoriBarang AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriBarangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " i.bkode <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i.bkode"

        'AMBIL DATA BARANG
        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtBarang.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idbarang As String = "" ', gudang As String = ""
            Dim sqlSAGabung As String = "", sqlSAJadi As String = ""
            Dim dtInsert As New DataTable
            Dim drSisa As Double = 0

            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtBarang.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
