                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                idbarang = FxDB(dr1("bid"), 0)

                'QUERY
                sqlSAGabung = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, bp.gudang as bpgudang, bp.gudangnama as bpgudangnama, bp.idbarang as bpidbarang, bp.kodebarang as bpkodebarang, bp.namabarang as bpnamabarang, bp.nobatch as bpnobatch, bp.tglexpired as bptglexpired, bp.satuan as bpsatuan, SUM(bp.msk) as bpmasuk, SUM(bp.klr) as bpkeluar, 0 as bpsisa, '" & FixDouble(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as bpuserid, '' as bpcustomtext1, '' as bpcustomtext2, bp.nbicustomtext3 as bpcustomtext3, '' as bpcustomtext4, '' as bpcustomtext5, '0' as bpcustomint1, '0' as bpcustomint2, '0' as bpcustomint3, '0' as bpcustomint4, '0' as bpcustomint5, SUM(bp.saw) as bpcustomdbl1, '0' as bpcustomdbl2, '0' as bpcustomdbl3, '0' as bpcustomdbl4, '0' as bpcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as bpcustomdate5 FROM "

                sqlSAGabung &= " (SELECT bin.nbigudang as gudang, bin.nbigudangnama as gudangnama, bin.nbiidbarang as idbarang, bin.nbikodebarang as kodebarang, bin.nbinamabarang as namabarang, bin.nbikode as nobatch, bin.nbicustomdate1 as tglexpired, bin.nbisatuan as satuan, bin.nbicustomtext3, "
                sqlSAGabung &= " (CASE WHEN bin.tglin < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' THEN bin.nbijmlmasuk ELSE 0 END) - SUM((CASE WHEN IFNULL(bout.tglout,'" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' THEN bout.nbojmlkeluar ELSE 0 END)) as saw, "
                sqlSAGabung &= " (CASE WHEN bin.tglin BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' THEN bin.nbijmlmasuk ELSE 0 END) as msk, "
                sqlSAGabung &= " SUM((CASE WHEN IFNULL(bout.tglout,'9999-12-31') BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' THEN bout.nbojmlkeluar ELSE 0 END)) as klr FROM "

                sqlSAGabung &= " (SELECT nbi.nbitgl as tglin, nbi.nbiidbatchin, nbi.nbigudang, w.wnama as nbigudangnama, nbi.nbiidbarang, i.bkode as nbikodebarang, i.bnama as nbinamabarang, nbi.nbikode, nbi.nbicustomdate1, nbi.nbisatuan, nbi.nbijmlmasuk, nbi.nbicustomtext3 "
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM m1_no_batch_in nbi "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON nbi.nbigudang = w.wkode "
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbi.nbitgl BETWEEN '1900-01-01' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_item i ON nbi.nbiidbarang = i.bid AND i.bid = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "' " & filterGudang
                sqlSAGabung &= " ) as bin "

                sqlSAGabung &= " LEFT JOIN "

                sqlSAGabung &= " (SELECT nbo.nbotgl as tglout, nbo.nboidbatchin, nbo.nbojmlkeluar "
                sqlSAGabung &= " FROM m1_no_batch_out nbo "
                sqlSAGabung &= " JOIN m1_item i ON nbo.nboidbarang = i.bid AND i.bid = '" & FixDouble(idbarang) & "' " & filterGudang.Replace("nbi.nbigudang", "nbo.nbogudang")
                sqlSAGabung &= " AND nbo.nbotgl BETWEEN '1900-01-01' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
                sqlSAGabung &= " ) as bout "

                sqlSAGabung &= " ON bin.nbiidbatchin = bout.nboidbatchin "
                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY bin.nbiidbatchin "
                sqlSAGabung &= " ORDER BY bin.nbigudang, bin.nbikodebarang, bin.nbikode "
                sqlSAGabung &= " ) as bp "

                sqlSAGabung &= " GROUP BY bp.gudang, bp.idbarang, bp.nobatch "
                sqlSAGabung &= " HAVING bpcustomdbl1 <> 0 OR bpmasuk <> 0 OR bpkeluar <> 0 "

                dtInsert = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlSAGabung, strCon)
                strInsert.Clear()
                If dtInsert.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    For Each drInsert As DataRow In dtInsert.Rows
                        drSisa = Double.Parse(drInsert("bpcustomdbl1")) + Double.Parse(drInsert("bpmasuk")) - Double.Parse(drInsert("bpkeluar"))
                        strInsert.Append(IIf(Len(strInsert.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                                       idlogin,                                           bpgudang,                                               bpgudangnama,                                           bpidbarang,                                         bpkodebarang,                                           bpnamabarang,                                               bpnobatch,                                                          bptglexpired,                                                       bpsatuan,                                           bpmasuk,                                            bpkeluar,                                 bpsisa,                                         idmsmq,                                            bpuserid,                                           bpcustomtext1,                                              bpcustomtext2,                                          bpcustomtext3,                                              bpcustomtext4,                                          bpcustomtext5,                                              bpcustomint1,                                           bpcustomint2,                                           bpcustomint3,                                           bpcustomint4,                                           bpcustomint5,                                           bpcustomdbl1,                                           bpcustomdbl2,                                           bpcustomdbl3,                                           bpcustomdbl4,                                           bpcustomdbl5,                                                           bpcustomdate1,                                                                      bpcustomdate2,                                                                      bpcustomdate3,                                                                      bpcustomdate4,                                                                          bpcustomdate5
                        strInsert.Append("('" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idlogin"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpgudang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpgudangnama"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpidbarang"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpkodebarang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpnamabarang"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpnobatch"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bptglexpired"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpsatuan"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpmasuk"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpkeluar"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drSisa, 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idmsmq"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpuserid"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext1"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext2"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext3"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext4"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomtext5"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint1"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint2"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint3"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint4"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomint5"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl1"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl2"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl3"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl4"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdbl5"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate1"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate2"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate3"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate4"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("bpcustomdate5"), "1900-01-01"))) & "')")
                    Next
                End If


                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                If Len(strInsert.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sqlSAJadi = " Insert into m2r_batch_pertanggal (idlogin, bpgudang, bpgudangnama, bpidbarang, bpkodebarang, bpnamabarang, bpnobatch, bptglexpired, bpsatuan, bpmasuk, bpkeluar, bpsisa, idmsmq, bpuserid, bpcustomtext1, bpcustomtext2, bpcustomtext3, bpcustomtext4, bpcustomtext5, bpcustomint1, bpcustomint2, bpcustomint3, bpcustomint4, bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1, bpcustomdbl2, bpcustomdbl3, bpcustomdbl4, bpcustomdbl5, bpcustomdate1, bpcustomdate2, bpcustomdate3, bpcustomdate4, bpcustomdate5) values" & strInsert.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", FxDB(dr1("bkode"), ""), FxDB(dr1("bnama"), "")) & " - " & sqlSAJadi : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", FxDB(dr1("bkode"), ""), FxDB(dr1("bnama"), "")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function m0_Perhitungan_Insentive_2(ByVal param As String) As String

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", FilterSi As String = "", FilterSr As String = "", FilterPv As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""

        '\\YANG HARUS DIRUBAH SETIAP FUNGSI
        '\\PARAMETER FILTER REPORT
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", salesmanAwal As String = "", salesmanAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        '\\YANG HARUS DIRUBAH SETIAP FUNGSI
        '\\PANJANG ARRAY SESUAI BANYAKNYA FILTER REPORT

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 4) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
            'Else
            '    result(2) = "OK" : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================

        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'salesmanAwal(2) As String
        salesmanAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'salesmanAkhir(3) As String
        salesmanAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        '\\YANG HARUS DIRUBAH SETIAP FUNGSI
        '\\PROSES PEMBUATAN REPORT

        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMQ DI M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER

        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_perhitungan_insentive WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace laba rugi invoice data global." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER -----------------------------

        'BUAT FILTER SI ------------------------------------------------------
        FilterSi = " WHERE si.sistatus IN (2,3,4,7) "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If


        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (k.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (k.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (k.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        'END OF BUAT FILTER SI ------------------------------------------------


        'BUAT FILTER SR ------------------------------------------------------
        FilterSr = " WHERE sr.srstatus IN (2,3,4,7) "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srtgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srtgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If


        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (k.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (k.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (k.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        'END OF BUAT FILTER SR ------------------------------------------------


        'BUAT FILTER PV ------------------------------------------------------
        FilterPv = " WHERE pv.pvstatus IN (2,3,4,7) "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (pv.pvtgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (pv.pvtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (k.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (k.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (k.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        'END OF BUAT FILTER PV ------------------------------------------------

        'AMBIL TGL DI TRANSAKSI SI DAN ST ANTARA TGLAWAL DAN TGLAKHIR FILTER
        Dim dtSalesman As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT * FROM (SELECT k.kkode AS salesman FROM m5_si si JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sibagianpenjualan = k.kid  WHERE k.kkode BETWEEN '" & salesmanAwal & "' AND '" & salesmanAkhir & "' AND si.sistatus IN (2,3,4,7)  UNION ALL SELECT k.kkode As salesman FROM m5_sr sr JOIN m1_contact k ON sr.srbagianpenjualan = k.kid  WHERE k.kkode BETWEEN '" & salesmanAwal & "' AND '" & salesmanAkhir & "' AND sr.srstatus IN (2,3,4,7)  UNION ALL SELECT k.kkode AS salesman FROM m5_pv pv  JOIN m5_pv_detail pvd ON pv.pvid = pvd.idpv JOIN m5_si si ON pvd.idtransaksi = si.siid AND pvd.sumber = 'SI' JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sibagianpenjualan = k.kid WHERE k.kkode BETWEEN '" & salesmanAwal & "' AND '" & salesmanAkhir & "' AND pv.pvstatus IN (2,3,4,7)  ) as ceksalesman  GROUP BY salesman ASC", strCon)

        If dtSalesman.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA TG:, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL m2r_perhitungan_insentive SEBANYAK SALESMAN YANG TERAMBIL
            Dim dtLr As New DataTable, currTgl As String = "", vsql As String = ""
            Dim strReport As New StringBuilder, sqlReportJadi As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN INSERT m2r_perhitungan_insentive ------------------------
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtSalesman.Rows
                strReport.Clear()
                sqlReportJadi = ""

                vsql = "SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' As idlogin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' AS idmsmq,  kodesalesman , namasalesman , sumber , notransaksi , tgl , totaltransaksi , komisi "
                vsql &= " FROM ( SELECT k.kkode AS kodesalesman , k.knama AS namasalesman ,  si.sisumber AS sumber , si.sinotransaksi AS notransaksi , si.sitgl AS tgl ,  si.sitotaltransaksi AS totaltransaksi, (si.sitotaltransaksi * (1/100)) as komisi "
                vsql &= " FROM m5_si si JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sibagianpenjualan = k.kid   " & FilterSi & " "
                vsql &= " UNION ALL  "
                vsql &= " SELECT k.kkode AS kodesalesman , k.knama AS namasalesman ,  sr.srsumber AS sumber ,  sr.srnotransaksi AS notransaksi ,  sr.srtgl AS tgl ,  sr.srtotaltransaksi AS totaltransaksi, (sr.srtotaltransaksi * (1/100)) as komisi   "
                vsql &= " FROM m5_sr sr JOIN m1_contact k ON sr.srbagianpenjualan = k.kid   " & FilterSr & "  "
                vsql &= " UNION ALL "
                vsql &= " SELECT k.kkode AS kodesalesman ,  k.knama AS namasalesman ,  pvd.sumber AS sumber ,  pv.pvnotransaksi AS notransaksi , pv.pvtgl AS tgl ,  pvd.jmlbayar AS totaltransaksi ,   "
                vsql &= " IF((pv.pvtgl - si.sitgl)  BETWEEN 0 AND 30, (pvd.jmlbayar * (3/100)) ,IF((pv.pvtgl - si.sitgl) BETWEEN 31 AND 60,(pvd.jmlbayar * (3/100)), (pvd.jmlbayar * (2/100)) )  ) AS komisi  "
                vsql &= " FROM m5_pv pv JOIN m5_pv_detail pvd ON pv.pvid = pvd.idpv JOIN m5_si si ON pvd.idtransaksi = si.siid AND pvd.sumber = 'SI' JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sibagianpenjualan = k.kid "
                vsql &= " " & FilterPv & " AND (pv.pvtgl - si.sitgl) < 90 ) AS a  "


                result(2) = vsql : GoTo selesai

                stepKe = stepKe + 1

                dtLr = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(vsql, strCon)
                If (dtLr.Rows.Count > 0) Then
                    For Each drInsert As DataRow In dtLr.Rows
                        strReport.Append(IIf(Len(strReport.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                        'mapping :                                       idlogin,                                           idmsmq,                                                 kodesalesman,                                           namasalesman,                                             sumber,                                          notransaksi                                                         tgl                                                         totaltransaksi,                                             komisi         
                        strReport.Append("('" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idlogin"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idmsmq"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("kodesalesman"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("namasalesman"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("sumber"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("notransaksi"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("tgl"), "1900-01-01"))) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("totaltransaksi"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("komisi"), 0)) & "')")
                    Next

                    If Len(strReport.ToString) > 0 Then
                        sqlReportJadi = " Insert into m2r_perhitungan_insentive(idlogin, idmsmq, kodesalesman, namasalesman, sumber, notransaksi, tgl, totaltransaksi, komisi) values" & strReport.ToString & ""
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlReportJadi, strCon) = False Then
                            result(2) = "Failed processing '" & currTgl & "' perhitungan insentive." : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If

                End If

                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtSalesman.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtSalesman.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currTgl & "' laba rugi invoice" : GoTo selesai
                End If

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT m2r_lr_invoice_global -----------------
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function m0_Perhitungan_Insentive(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN NILAI PERSEDIAAN PERTANGGAL

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'orderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", FilterSi As String = "", FilterSr As String = "", FilterPv As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", salesmanAwal As String = "", salesmanAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 4) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(Now)
        End If

        'salesmanAwal(2) As String
        salesmanAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'salesmanAkhir(3) As String
        salesmanAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_perhitungan_insentive WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = " SELECT k.kid ,  k.kkode , k.knama "
        sql &= " FROM m1_contact k "
        'sql &= " WHERE k.kkategori = 'M' "


        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        'Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " k.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " k.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " k.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        sql &= " GROUP BY k.kkode "
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY k.kkode "



        'BUAT FILTER SI 
        FilterSi = " AND si.sistatus IN (2,3,4,7) "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER SI 

        'BUAT FILTER SR 
        FilterSr = "  AND sr.srstatus IN (2,3,4,7) "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srtgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srtgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER SR 

        'BUAT FILTER PV
        FilterPv = " AND pv.pvstatus IN (2,3,4,7) "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (pv.pvtgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (pv.pvtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER PV 


        'AMBIL DATA SALESMAN
        Dim dtSalesman As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

        'END OF AMBIL SALESMAN SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtSalesman.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim idsalesman As String = ""
            Dim sqll As String = ""
            Dim sqlJadi As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtSalesman.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                idsalesman = dr1("kkode")

                'QUERY ###########################
                sqll = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' As idlogin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' AS idmsmq, urutan ,  kodesalesman , namasalesman , sumber , notransaksi , tgl , totaltransaksi , komisi , sicustomdate1 , sicustomtext1 "
                sqll &= " FROM ( SELECT 1 AS urutan , k.kkode AS kodesalesman , k.knama AS namasalesman ,  si.sisumber AS sumber , si.sinotransaksi AS notransaksi , si.sitgl AS tgl ,  si.sitotaltransaksi AS totaltransaksi, (si.sitotaltransaksi * (1/100)) as komisi , '1900-01-01' AS sicustomdate1 , '' AS sicustomtext1  "
                sqll &= " FROM m5_si si JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sibagianpenjualan = k.kid "
                sqll &= " WHERE k.kkode = '" & FixQuotes(idsalesman) & "'  " & FilterSi & "  "
                sqll &= " UNION ALL  "
                sqll &= " SELECT 2 AS urutan ,  k.kkode AS kodesalesman , k.knama AS namasalesman ,  sr.srsumber AS sumber ,  sr.srnotransaksi AS notransaksi ,  sr.srtgl AS tgl ,  sr.srtotaltransaksi AS totaltransaksi, (sr.srtotaltransaksi * (-1/100)) as komisi , '1900-01-01' AS sicustomdate1 , '' AS sicustomtext1   "
                sqll &= " FROM m5_sr sr JOIN m1_contact k ON sr.srbagianpenjualan = k.kid "
                sqll &= " WHERE k.kkode = '" & FixQuotes(idsalesman) & "'  " & FilterSr & "  "
                sqll &= " UNION ALL "
                sqll &= " SELECT 3 AS urutan ,  k.kkode AS kodesalesman ,  k.knama AS namasalesman ,  'PV' AS sumber ,  pv.pvnotransaksi AS notransaksi , pv.pvtgl AS tgl ,  pvd.jmlbayar AS totaltransaksi ,   "
                sqll &= " IF((pv.pvtgl - si.sitgl)  BETWEEN 0 AND 30, (pvd.jmlbayar * (3/100)) ,IF((pv.pvtgl - si.sitgl) BETWEEN 31 AND 60,(pvd.jmlbayar * (3/100)), (pvd.jmlbayar * (2/100)) )  ) AS komisi  , "
                sqll &= " si.sitgl AS sicustomdate1 , si.sinotransaksi AS sicustomtext1 "
                sqll &= " FROM m5_pv pv JOIN m5_pv_detail pvd ON pv.pvid = pvd.idpv JOIN m5_si si ON pvd.idtransaksi = si.siid AND pvd.sumber = 'SI' JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sibagianpenjualan = k.kid "
                sqll &= " WHERE k.kkode = '" & FixQuotes(idsalesman) & "' AND (pv.pvtgl - si.sitgl) <= 90 " & FilterPv & " ) AS a "
                'sqll &= " LIMIT 1"

                'result(2) = sqll : GoTo selesai

                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlJadi = " INSERT INTO m2r_perhitungan_insentive (" & sqll & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "kkode", dr1("kkode"), dr1("knama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtSalesman.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / dtSalesman.Rows.Count, 2) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG Voucher PER KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtCustomer.Rows
                'SET IDKONTAK
                idkontak = dr("kid")
                kodekontak = dr("kkode")
                namakontak = dr("knama")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL
                'SI FUNGSIONAL

                'TAMBAHKAN FILTER KODE/NAMA KONTAK
                If Len(customerAwal) > 0 And Len(customerAkhir) > 0 Then
                    'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
                    sqlFungsionalSR += " AND (c." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "

                    sqlFungsionalSR += " AND (c." & orderBy & " <= '" & customerAkhir & "') "
                End If

                    'JIKA CUSTOMER AWAL DAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
                    sqlValasSR += " AND (c." & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & customerAwal & "' AND '" & customerAkhir & "') "

            End If
            'END OF AMBIL TOTAL VOUCHER SEMUA KONTAK ==============


            'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
            'SALDO TOTAL
            If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                sql = "Insert into M2r_Ar_Voucher(arnourut, idlogin, arid, artgl, arsumber, arnotransaksi, arkontak, arkontakkode, arkontaknama, aralamat1, aralamat2, aralamat3, aralamat4, aralamat5, arnotelp1, arnotelp2, arnorek, armatauang, arkurs, aruraian, arcatatan, artotal, arbayar, arsisa, artgljatuhtempo, arstatuslunas, artgllunas, arinputtgl, arisfungsional, arissaldoakhir, idmsmq, aruserid, arcustomtext1, arcustomtext2, arcustomtext3, arcustomtext4, arcustomtext5, arcustomint1, arcustomint2, arcustomint3, arcustomint4, arcustomint5, arcustomdbl1, arcustomdbl2, arcustomdbl3, arcustomdbl4, arcustomdbl5, arcustomdate1, arcustomdate2, arcustomdate3, arcustomdate4, arcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Total AR Voucher." : GoTo selesai
                End If
            End If
            'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / (dtCustomer.Rows.Count + 1), 2)) * stepKe)

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Total AR Voucher." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================
            'END OF HITUNG TOTAL SEMUA KONTAK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++


        End If
        'END OF PERHITUNGAN Voucher PER KONTAK -------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        sqlHppSk &= " FROM m1_item i "
        sqlHppSk &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' " & FilterBarang
        sqlHppSk &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "
        sqlHppSk &= " GROUP BY i.bid "
        Dim dtHppSk As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlHppSk, strCon)

        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card " & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL JML
        Dim sqlJmlSa As String = "", sqlSaJmlJadi As String = ""
        sqlJmlSa = "  SELECT it.gudang as ksgudang, i.bid as ksidbarang, i.bdepartemen as kscustomtext1 , i.bsubdepartemen as kscustomtext2 , IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) as kssaldojml "
        sqlJmlSa &= " FROM m1_item i "
        sqlJmlSa &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' " & FilterBarang & " " & FilterGudang & FilterDepartemen
        sqlJmlSa &= " GROUP BY it.gudang ASC, i.bkode "

        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

        If dtJmlSa.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            Dim strJmlSa As New StringBuilder : counter = 0
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtJmlSa.Rows

                strJmlSa.Append(IIf(Len(strJmlSa.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))

            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        '\\YANG HARUS DIRUBAH SETIAP FUNGSI
        '\\PANJANG ARRAY SESUAI BANYAKNYA FILTER REPORT

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 8) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================

        '\\YANG HARUS DIRUBAH SETIAP FUNGSI
        '\\VALIDASI TIPE DATA SESUAI FILTER REPORT

        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'cabangAwal(2) As String
        cabangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'cabangAkhir(3) As String
        cabangAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'lokasiAwal(4) As String
        lokasiAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'lokasiAkhir(5) As String
        lokasiAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'katcustomAwal(6) As String
        katcustomAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'katcustomAkhir(7) As String
        katcustomAkhir = dataDetail(7)

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        '\\YANG HARUS DIRUBAH SETIAP FUNGSI
        '\\PROSES PEMBUATAN REPORT

        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMQ DI M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_penjualan_barang_pertgl WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace laba rugi invoice data global." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER -----------------------------


        'BUAT FILTER SI ------------------------------------------------------
        FilterSi = " WHERE si.sistatus IN (2,3,4,7) "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        '-
        If Len(cabangAwal) > 0 And Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sicabang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(cabangAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sicabang >= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sicabang <= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        If Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 And Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.silokasi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "' ) "
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.silokasi >= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.silokasi <= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        If Len(katcustomAwal) > 0 And Len(katcustomAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (k.kkategoricustomer BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(katcustomAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(katcustomAkhir) & "' ) "
        ElseIf Len(katcustomAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (k.kkategoricustomer >= '" & FixQuotes(katcustomAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(katcustomAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (k.kkategoricustomer <= '" & FixQuotes(katcustomAkhir) & "') "
        End If


        'END OF BUAT FILTER SI ------------------------------------------------


        'BUAT FILTER SR ------------------------------------------------------
        FilterSr = " WHERE sr.srstatus IN (2,3,4,7) "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srtgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srtgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        '-
        If Len(cabangAwal) > 0 And Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srcabang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(cabangAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srcabang >= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srcabang <= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        If Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 And Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srlokasi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "' ) "
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srlokasi >= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (sr.srlokasi <= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "') "
        End If


        If Len(katcustomAwal) > 0 And Len(katcustomAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (k.kkategoricustomer BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(katcustomAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(katcustomAkhir) & "' ) "
        ElseIf Len(katcustomAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = FilterSr & " AND (k.kkategoricustomer >= '" & FixQuotes(katcustomAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(katcustomAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSr = katcustomAkhir & " AND (k.kkategoricustomer <= '" & FixQuotes(katcustomAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        'END OF BUAT FILTER SR ------------------------------------------------


        'result(2) = FilterSi & FilterSr : GoTo selesai

        'AMBIL TGL DI TRANSAKSI SI DAN ST ANTARA TGLAWAL DAN TGLAKHIR FILTER
        Dim dtTgl As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT * FROM ( SELECT si.sitgl AS tgl FROM m5_si si WHERE si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND si.sistatus IN (2,3,4,7) UNION ALL SELECT sr.srtgl As tgl FROM m5_sr sr WHERE sr.srtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND sr.srstatus IN (2,3,4,7) ) As cektgl GROUP BY tgl ASC ", strCon)
        Dim dtLokasi As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT * FROM ( SELECT si.silokasi AS lokasi FROM m5_si si WHERE si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & lokasiAwal & "' AND '" & lokasiAkhir & "' AND si.sistatus IN (2,3,4,7) UNION ALL SELECT sr.srlokasi As lokasi FROM m5_sr sr  WHERE sr.srtgl BETWEEN '" & lokasiAwal & "' AND '" & lokasiAkhir & "' AND sr.srstatus IN (2,3,4,7) ) As cektgl GROUP BY lokasi ASC  ", strCon)
        If dtTgl.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA TG:, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL m2r_lr_invoice_global SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
            Dim dtLr As New DataTable, currTgl As String = "", vsql As String = ""
            Dim strReport As New StringBuilder, sqlReportJadi As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN INSERT m2r_lr_invoice_global ------------------------
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtTgl.Rows
                strReport.Clear()
                sqlReportJadi = ""

                'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET SALDO AWAL, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
                currTgl = AsFormatTanggal(dr("tgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd") : strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                For Each drr As DataRow In dtLokasi.Rows
                    strReport.Clear()
                    sqlReportJadi = ""

                    stepKe += 1
                    CurrLokasi = dr("lokasi")

                    'buat query laba rugi invoice pertgl
                    vsql = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' As idlogin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' AS idmsmq, sicarabayar , urutan , urutaan , cabang , 	lokasi, sicabang , silokasi ,  	sijmlbayar, sijmlkembali , 	siid ,  sitgl , totaltransaksi , kode ,  carabayar , matauang , jumlah  , jumlahvalas , cckode ,  ccnama , kid , knama , kcustomdbl1, caption , sumber , '' AS lrcustomtext1, '' AS lrcustomtext2,  '' AS lrcustomtext3, '' AS lrcustomtext4, '' AS lrcustomtext5, 0 AS lrcustomint1, 0 AS lrcustomint2, 0 AS lrcustomint3, 0 AS lrcustomint4, 0 AS lrcustomint5, 0 AS lrcustomdbl1,  0 AS lrcustomdbl2,  0 AS lrcustomdbl3, 0 AS lrcustomdbl4, 0 AS lrcustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' AS lrcustomdate1, '1900-01-01' AS lrcustomdate2, '1900-01-01' AS lrcustomdate3,  '1900-01-01' AS lrcustomdate4, '1900-01-01' AS lrcustomdate5  FROM ( (SELECT 	si.sicarabayar , 	CASE si.sicarabayar 	WHEN 1 THEN 0	WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(sp.urutan,1) END as urutan , IFNULL(sp.urutan,1) AS urutaan , 	si.sicabang AS cabang , 		si.silokasi AS  lokasi,	b.bnama AS sicabang ,  	l.lnama AS silokasi ,  		si.sijmlbayar, si.sijmlkembali , 		si.siid , si.sitgl , 	si.sitotaltransaksi AS  totaltransaksi , 	sp.carabayar  as kode ,  	pm.nama AS carabayar , 	sp.matauang , 	Sum(sp.jumlah) as jumlah  , 	sp.jumlahvalas , cc.cckode , cc.ccnama , 	k.kid , 	k.knama , 	k.kcustomdbl1, CASE sp.carabayar  		WHEN 8 THEN 	CASE  k.kcustomtext1 WHEN '07' THEN 7  		ELSE 1 END  		ELSE 0 END AS caption , si.sisumber AS sumber FROM m5_si si JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sicustomer = k.kid JOIN m1_customer_category cc ON JOIN m0_payment_method pm ON sp.carabayar = pm.kode " & FilterSi & "  AND si.sitgl = '" & currTgl & "' AND silokasi = '" & CurrLokasi & "' GROUP BY si.sicabang ASC , si.silokasi ASC, cc.cckode ASC, si.sitgl ASC , si.siid ASC ,si.sicarabayar ASC , sp.carabayar ASC ORDER BY si.sicabang ASC , si.silokasi ASC, cc.cckode ASC, si.sitgl ASC , si.siid ASC ,si.sicarabayar ASC , sp.carabayar ASC ) UNION ALL (SELECT	0 AS sicarabayar , 	0 as urutan , 	0 urutaan , 	sr.srcabang AS cabang , 		sr.srlokasi AS  lokasi,	b.bnama AS sicabang ,  	l.lnama AS silokasi ,  		0 AS sijmlbayar, 0 AS sijmlkembali , 		sr.srid AS siid , sr.srtgl AS sitgl , 	sr.srtotaltransaksi AS  totaltransaksi , 	0 AS kode ,   	0 AS carabayar , 	0 AS matauang , 	0 as jumlah  , 	0 AS jumlahvalas ,  cc.cckode , cc.ccnama , 	k.kid , 	k.knama , 	k.kcustomdbl1,	0  AS caption , sr.srsumber AS sumber FROM m5_sr sr JOIN m1_contact k ON sr.srcustomer = k.kid   JOIN m1_customer_category cc ON k.kkategoricustomer = cc.cckode JOIN  m1_branch b ON sr.srcabang = b.bkode 	JOIN  m1_location l ON sr.srlokasi = l.lkode AND sr.srcabang = l.lcabang " & FilterSr & " AND sr.srtgl = '" & currTgl & "'  AND sr.srlokasi = '" & CurrLokasi & "' GROUP BY sr.srcabang ASC , sr.srlokasi ASC ,  cc.cckode ASC, sr.srtgl ASC , sr.srid ASC ORDER BY sr.srcabang ASC , sr.srlokasi ASC, cc.cckode ASC, sr.srtgl ASC , sr.srid ASC )  ) AS penjualan ORDER BY cabang ASC , lokasi ASC , cckode ASC , sitgl ASC , sumber ASC    "

                    'result(2) = vsql : GoTo selesai

                    dtLr = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(vsql, strCon)
                    If (dtLr.Rows.Count > 0) Then
                        For Each drInsert As DataRow In dtLr.Rows
                            strReport.Append(IIf(Len(strReport.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                            'Detail
                            'mapping :                                       idlogin,                                            idmsmq,                                            sicarabayar,                                          urutan,                                               urutaan,                                            cabang,                                            lokasi,                                           sicabang,                                              silokasi,                                           sijmlbayar,                                                 sijmlkembali,                                             siid,                                                            sitgl,                                                       totaltransaksi,                                            kode,                                         carabayar,                                               matauang,                                             jumlah,                                             jumlahvalas,                                            cckode,                                          ccnama,                                               kid,                                          knama,                                           kcustomdbl1,                                              caption,                                            Sumber                           lrcustomtext1,                                           lrcustomtext2,                                          lrcustomtext3,                                             lrcustomtext4,                                              lrcustomtext5,                                          lrcustomint1,                                           lrcustomint2,                                           lrcustomint3,                                           lrcustomint4,                                           lrcustomint5,                                           lrcustomdbl1,                                           lrcustomdbl2,                                           lrcustomdbl3,                                           lrcustomdbl4,                                           lrcustomdbl5,                                                            lrcustomdate1,                                                                     lrcustomdate2,                                                                       lrcustomdate3,                                                                         lrcustomdate4,                                                                      lrcustomdate5
                            strReport.Append("('" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idlogin"), "")) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("idmsmq"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("sicarabayar"), 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("urutan"), 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("urutaan"), 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("cabang"), "")) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lokasi"), "")) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("sicabang"), "")) & "'  , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("silokasi"), "")) & "'  , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("sijmlbayar"), 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("sijmlkembali"), 0)) & "'  , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("siid"), 0)) & "'  , '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("sitgl"), "1900-01-01"))) & "'  , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("totaltransaksi"), 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("kode"), 0)) & "'  , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("carabayar"), 0)) & "'  , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("matauang"), "")) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("jumlah"), 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("jumlahvalas"), 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("cckode"), "")) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("ccnama"), "")) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("kid"), 0)) & "' ,  '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("knama"), "")) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("kcustomdbl1"), 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("caption"), 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("sumber"), "")) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomtext1"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomtext2"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomtext3"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomtext4"), "")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomtext5"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomint1"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomint2"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomint3"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomint4"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomint5"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomdbl1"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomdbl2"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomdbl3"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomdbl4"), 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomdbl5"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomdate1"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomdate2"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomdate3"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomdate4"), "1900-01-01"))) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(drInsert("lrcustomdate5"), "1900-01-01"))) & "')")
                        Next
                        If Len(strReport.ToString) > 0 Then
                            'Detail
                            sqlReportJadi = " Insert into m2r_penjualan_barang_pertgl (idlogin, idmsmq, sicarabayar , urutan , urutaan , cabang , 	lokasi, sicabang , silokasi ,  	sijmlbayar, sijmlkembali , 	siid , sitgl , totaltransaksi , kode ,  carabayar , matauang , jumlah  , jumlahvalas , cckode , ccnama ,  kid , knama , kcustomdbl1, caption , sumber , lrcustomtext1, lrcustomtext2, lrcustomtext3, lrcustomtext4, lrcustomtext5, lrcustomint1, lrcustomint2, lrcustomint3, lrcustomint4, lrcustomint5, lrcustomdbl1, lrcustomdbl2, lrcustomdbl3, lrcustomdbl4, lrcustomdbl5, lrcustomdate1, lrcustomdate2, lrcustomdate3, lrcustomdate4, lrcustomdate5) values" & strReport.ToString & ""
                            'result(2) = sqlReportJadi : GoTo selesai
                            'result(2) = dtLr.Rows.Count : GoTo selesai
                            If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlReportJadi, strCon) = False Then
                                result(2) = "Failed processing '" & currTgl & "' penjualan bulanan pertgl." : GoTo selesai
                            End If
                        End If

                    End If

                    'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                    Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtTgl.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtTgl.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                    'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                    sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currTgl & "' laba rugi invoice" : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                Next

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT m2r_penjualan_barang_pertgl -----------------
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_MutasiStok_Rekap_pershift(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN MUTASI STOK REKAP (CABANG. LOKASI, GUDANG, COSTCENTER, DIVISI, SUBDIVISI, PROYEK)

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'cabangAwal(4) As String, cabangAkhir(5) As String, lokasiAwal(6) As String, lokasiAkhir(7) As String,
        'gudangAwal(8) As String, gudangAkhir(9) As String, costcenterAwal(10) As String, costcenterAkhir(11) As String, 
        'divisiAwal(12) As String, divisiAkhir(13) As String, subdivisiAwal(14) As String, subdivisiAkhir(15) As String, 
        'proyekAwal(16) As String, proyekAkhir(17) As String, orderBy(18) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan,

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid

        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai

                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If

        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)
