        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()


        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Mutasi_Stok_Detail ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Mutasi_Stok_Detail
        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Mutasi_Stok_Detail WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Mutasi_Stok_Detail -----------------------------------


        'CEK SUDAH INPUT STOCK OPNAME ATAU BELUM, BERDASARKAN SETTING
        'JIKA SETTING CETAK MUTASI STOK REKAP HARUS INPUT STOCK OPNAME MAKA CEK DATA DAHULU
        sql = "  SELECT s.snilai, IFNULL(c.ccabang,'') as ccabang, IFNULL(c.clokasi,'') as clokasi, IFNULL(c.cgudang,'') as cgudang "
        sql &= " FROM m0_setting s "
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2r_mutasi_stok_custom c "
        sql &= " ON c.ctgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
        'FILTER CABANG
        If Len(cabangAwal) > 0 And Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CABANG AWAL DAN CABANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql &= " AND c.ccabang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(cabangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CABANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= CABANG AWAL
            sql &= " AND c.ccabang >= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA CABANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= CABANG AKHIR
            sql &= " AND c.ccabang <= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'FILTER LOKASI
        If Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 And Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AWAL DAN LOKASI AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql &= " AND c.clokasi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= LOKASI AWAL
            sql &= " AND c.clokasi >= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= LOKASI AKHIR
            sql &= " AND c.clokasi <= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        'FILTER GUDANG
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL DAN GUDANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            sql &= " AND c.cgudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= GUDANG AWAL
            sql &= " AND c.cgudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= GUDANG AKHIR
            sql &= " AND c.cgudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If
        sql &= " WHERE s.smodule = 3 AND s.sgrup = 'stockopname' AND s.skode = 'CetakMutasiStokRekap' "
        sql &= " GROUP BY s.smodule, s.sgrup, s.skode, c.ccabang, c.clokasi, c.cgudang, c.ctgl "

        'result(2) = "sql " & sql : GoTo selesai

        Dim isCustom As String = "", ftCabang As String = "", ftLokasi As String = "", ftGudang As String = ""
        Dim dtCustom As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon) 'snilai, ccabang, clokasi, cgudang
        If dtCustom.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each drCustom In dtCustom.Rows
                'SET SETTING
                isCustom = drCustom("snilai")

                'FILTER CABANG
                ftCabang &= IIf(Len(ftCabang) > 0, ", ", "")
                ftCabang &= "'" & FixQuotes(drCustom("ccabang")) & "'"

                'FILTER LOKASI
                ftLokasi &= IIf(Len(ftLokasi) > 0, ", ", "")
                ftLokasi &= "'" & FixQuotes(drCustom("clokasi")) & "'"

                'FILTER GUDANG
                ftGudang &= IIf(Len(ftGudang) > 0, ", ", "")
                ftGudang &= "'" & FixQuotes(drCustom("cgudang")) & "'"

            Next

        Else
            result(2) = "Setting for Stock Summary permission not found." : GoTo selesai

        End If


        'AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = "  SELECT i.bid, i.bkode, i.bnama, ifnull(it.cabang,"""") as  cabang, ifnull(it.lokasi,"""") as lokasi, ititem.gudang as gudang, ifnull(it.costcenter,"""") as costcenter, ifnull(it.divisi,"""") as divisi, ifnull(it.subdivisi,"""") as subdivisi, ifnull(it.proyek,"""") as proyek"
        sql &= " FROM (SELECT idbarang, gudang FROM m1_item_transaction GROUP BY idbarang, gudang) ititem "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item i ON ititem.idbarang = i.bid "
        'sql &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON ititem.gudang = w.wkode "
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND ititem.gudang = it.gudang "


        'JIKA SETTING CETAK MUTASI STOK REKAP HARUS INPUT STOCK OPNAME MAKA TAMBAHKAN FILTER SESUAI DATA YANG SUDAH DIAMBIL
        If isCustom = 1 Then
            'FILTER CABANG CUSTOM
            If Len(ftCabang) > 0 Then
                Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
                Filter &= " it.cabang IN(" & ftCabang & ")"
            End If

            'FILTER LOKASI CUSTOM
            If Len(ftLokasi) > 0 Then
                Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
                Filter &= " it.lokasi IN(" & ftLokasi & ")"
            End If

            'FILTER GUDANG CUSTOM
            If Len(ftGudang) > 0 Then
                Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
                Filter &= " ititem.gudang IN(" & ftGudang & ")"
            End If
        End If


        'FILTER CABANG
        If Len(cabangAwal) > 0 And Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA CABANG AWAL DAN CABANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " it.cabang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(cabangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA CABANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= CABANG AWAL
            Filter &= " it.cabang >= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(cabangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA CABANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= CABANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.cabang <= '" & FixQuotes(cabangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER LOKASI
        If Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 And Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA LOKASI AWAL DAN LOKASI AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " it.lokasi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA LOKASI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= LOKASI AWAL
            Filter &= " it.lokasi >= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA LOKASI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= LOKASI AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.lokasi <= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER GUDANG
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL DAN GUDANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " ititem.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' And '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= GUDANG AWAL
            Filter &= "ititem.gudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA GUDANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= GUD'ANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " ititem.gudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER COSTCENTER
        If Len(costcenterAwal) > 0 And Len(costcenterAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA COSTCENTER AWAL DAN COSTCENTER AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " it.costcenter BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(costcenterAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(costcenterAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(costcenterAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA COSTCENTER AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= COSTCENTER AWAL
            Filter &= " it.costcenter >= '" & FixQuotes(costcenterAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(costcenterAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA COSTCENTER AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= COSTCENTER AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.costcenter <= '" & FixQuotes(costcenterAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER DIVISI
        If Len(divisiAwal) > 0 And Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA DIVISI AWAL DAN DIVISI AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " it.divisi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(divisiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(divisiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(divisiAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA DIVISI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= DIVISI AWAL
            Filter &= " it.divisi >= '" & FixQuotes(divisiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA DIVISI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= DIVISI AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.divisi <= '" & FixQuotes(divisiAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER SUBDIVISI
        If Len(subdivisiAwal) > 0 And Len(subdivisiAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA SUBDIVISI AWAL DAN SUBDIVISI AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " it.subdivisi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(subdivisiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(subdivisiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(subdivisiAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA SUBDIVISI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= SUBDIVISI AWAL
            Filter &= " it.subdivisi >= '" & FixQuotes(subdivisiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(subdivisiAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA SUBDIVISI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= SUBDIVISI AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.subdivisi <= '" & FixQuotes(subdivisiAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER PROYEK
        If Len(proyekAwal) > 0 And Len(proyekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA PROYEK AWAL DAN PROYEK AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " it.proyek BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(proyekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(proyekAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(proyekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA PROYEK AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= PROYEK AWAL
            Filter &= " it.proyek >= '" & FixQuotes(proyekAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(proyekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA PROYEK AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= PROYEK AKHIR
            Filter &= " it.proyek <= '" & FixQuotes(proyekAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY IDBARANG
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid, ititem.gudang"
        If Len(costcenterAwal) > 0 Or Len(costcenterAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.costcenter"
        If Len(divisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.divisi"
        If Len(subdivisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(subdivisiAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.subdivisi"
        If Len(proyekAwal) > 0 Or Len(proyekAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.proyek"

        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & ", ititem.gudang"
        If Len(costcenterAwal) > 0 Or Len(costcenterAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.costcenter"
        If Len(divisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(divisiAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.divisi"
        If Len(subdivisiAwal) > 0 Or Len(subdivisiAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.subdivisi"
        If Len(proyekAwal) > 0 Or Len(proyekAkhir) > 0 Then sql &= ", it.proyek"

        'result(2) = "sql2 " & sql : GoTo selesai

        Dim dtBarang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF AMBIL BARANG SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------
        'result(2) = "@" & dtBarang.Rows.Count.ToString + " " + sql : GoTo selesai

                'sqlSAB = " SELECT SUM(msa.msjmlmasuk - msa.msjmlkeluar) + " & FixDouble(jmlmasuk) & " - " & FixDouble(jmlkeluar) & ", '" & FixDouble(jmlmasukB) & "' as mscustomdbl2, '" & FixDouble(jmlkeluarB) & "' as mscustomdbl3, SUM(msa.msjmlmasuk - msa.msjmlkeluar) + (" & FixDouble(jmlmasuk) & " - " & FixDouble(jmlkeluar) & ") + (" & FixDouble(jmlmasukB) & " - " & FixDouble(jmlkeluarB) & ")  as mscustomdbl4 "
                sqlSAB &= " FROM ( " & sqlSA & " ) as msa "
                sqlSAB &= " GROUP BY msa.msgudang, msa.msidbarang"

                'result(2) = "saldo awal , masuk, keluar , saldo akhir shift siang" & sqlSAB : GoTo selesai

                ' GABUNG sqlSAGabung (Shift Pagi) & sqlSAB (shift siang)
                sqlSAGabungB = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, msb.msnourut,  msb.msid, msb.mscabang, msb.mscabangnama, msb.mslokasi, msb.mslokasinama, msb.msgudang, msb.msgudangnama, msb.mscostcenter, msb.mscostcenternama, msb.msdivisi, msb.msdivisinama, msb.mssubdivisi,  msb.mssubdivisinama, msb.msproyek, msb.msproyeknama, msb.msidbarang, msb.mskodebarang, msb.mstipebarang, msb.msnamabarang, msb.mssatuanbarang, msb.mstgl, msb.mssumber, msb.msnotransaksi, msb.mskontak,  msb.mskontakkode,  msb.mskontaknama,  msb.msuraian, msb.mscatatan, msb.mscatatandetail, msb.msjmlmasuk, msb.msjmlkeluar, msb.mssaldo, msb.msinputtgl, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq,  '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as msuserid, msb.mscustomtext1, msb.mscustomtext2, msb.mscustomtext3, msb.mscustomtext4, msb.mscustomtext5, msb.mscustomint1, msb.mscustomint2, msb.mscustomint3,  msb.mscustomint4, msb.mscustomint5, msb.mscustomdbl1, msb.mscustomdbl2, msb.mscustomdbl3, msb.mscustomdbl4, msb.mscustomdbl5, msb.mscustomdate1, msb.mscustomdate2, msb.mscustomdate3, msb.mscustomdate4, msb.mscustomdate5 FROM "
                sqlSAGabungB &= " ((" & sqlSAGabung & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlSAB & ")) as msb"

                If Len(shift) > 0 Then
                    FilterShift = IIf(Len(FilterShift) > 0, String.Concat(FilterShift, " AND"), FilterShift)
                    'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
                    FilterShift &= " msb.mscustomtext2 = '" & FixQuotes(shift) & "'"
                End If

                ' result(2) = FilterShift : GoTo selesai

                'FILTER
                sqlSAGabungB &= IIf(Len(FilterShift) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE", FilterShift), FilterShift)


                sqlSAGabungB &= " ORDER BY  mscustomtext2 ASC , msidbarang ASC "

                'result(2) = sqlSAGabungB : GoTo selesai

                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlSAJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Mutasi_Stok_Detail (" & sqlSAGabungB & ")"

                'result(2) = sqlSAJadi : GoTo selesai
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSAJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If

                ''SALDO MUTASI
                'sqlSMJadi = " INSERT INTO M2r_Mutasi_Stok_Detail (" & sqlSMGabung & ")"
                'If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlSMJadi, strCon) = False Then
                '    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Data Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                'End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================

                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report '" & FixQuotes(gudang) & "' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", dr1("bkode"), dr1("bnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

dataKosong:

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Report 'Nothing' Warehouse : " & IIf(orderBy = "bkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M13_StudentGeneralLedger(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN BUKU BESAR PER SISWA

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, norekAwal(2) As String, norekAkhir(3) As String, matauang(4) As String, perTanggal(5) As Integer,
        'kontakAwal(6) As String, kontakAkhir(7) As String, OrderBy(8) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail

        'kontakAwal, kontakAkhir, OrderBy

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", norekAwal As String = "", norekAkhir As String = "", matauang As String = "", perTanggal As Integer = 0
        Dim kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = "", tahunAkademik As String = "", fakultas As String = "", programStudi As String = "", kelasAwal As String = "", kelasAkhir As String = "", kategoriSiswa As String = ""


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then

        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 15) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'norekAwal(2) As String
        norekAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'norekAkhir(3) As String
        norekAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'matauang(4) As String
        matauang = dataDetail(4)

        'perTanggal(5) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataDetail(5)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "perTanggal required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            perTanggal = dataDetail(5)
        End If

        'kontakAwal(6) As String
        kontakAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'kontakAkhir(7) As String
        kontakAkhir = dataDetail(7)
        tahunAkademik = dataDetail(8)
        fakultas = dataDetail(9)
        programStudi = dataDetail(10)
        kelasAwal = dataDetail(11)
        kelasAkhir = dataDetail(12)
        kategoriSiswa = dataDetail(13)

        'orderBy(8) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(14)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(14).ToString <> "kkode" And dataDetail(14).ToString <> "knama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(14)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMQ DI M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_general_ledger WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace general ledger data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER -----------------------------

        'BUAT FILTER NOREK -------------------------------------------------------
        Filter = " WHERE (cgd = 'D' AND caktif = '1') "
        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (cnomor <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'FILTER KONTAK
        If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (" & orderBy & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (" & orderBy & " >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (" & orderBy & " <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'FILTER TAHUN AKADEMIK

            Filter = Filter & " AND (sitahunajaran = '" & FixQuotes(tahunAkademik) & "')"

        ElseIf Len(kelasAwal) > 0 Then

        ElseIf Len(kelasAkhir) > 0 Then

        End If
        'FILTER KATEGORI SISWA
        If Len(kategoriSiswa) > 0 Then
            Filter = Filter & " AND (sckode = '" & FixQuotes(kategoriSiswa) & "')"
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER NOREK ------------------------------------------------

        'AMBIL NOREK ANTARA NOREKAWAL DAN NOREK AKHIR
        'Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor, kid FROM m1_coa JOIN m2_transaction_journal ON cnomor = tnorek AND tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) JOIN m1_contact ON tkontak = kid " & Filter & " GROUP BY tkontak, cnomor ORDER BY " & orderBy & ", cnomor", strCon)
        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT cnomor, kid FROM m1_coa JOIN m2_transaction_journal ON cnomor = tnorek AND tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) JOIN m1_contact ON tkontak = kid JOIN m13_si ON kkode = sinosiswa JOIN m13_student_category ON sikategorisiswa = scid " & Filter & " GROUP BY tkontak, cnomor ORDER BY " & orderBy & ", cnomor", strCon)
        ' result(2) = idMsmq : GoTo selesai

        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA NOREK, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, currNorek As String = "", saldoAwal As Double = 0, idKontak As Double = 0

            'PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER PER NOREK ------------------------
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET SALDO AWAL, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
                currNorek = FxDB(dr("cnomor"), "") : saldoAwal = 0 : idKontak = Double.Parse(FxDB(dr("kid"), 0)) : strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL NOREK
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, 1 as glnourut, 0 as glid, " & FixDouble(idKontak) & " as glkontak, c.kkode as glkontakkode, c.knama as glkontaknama, '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' as gltgl, '' as glnotransaksi, '" & FixQuotes(currNorek) & "' as glnorek, coa.cnama as glnoreknama, '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' as glmatauang, 0 as glkurs, 'Saldo Awal' as gluraian, 'Saldo Awal' as glcatatan, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END)as gldebit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE (CASE '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) END) as glkredit, (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN             'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT M2R_GENERAL_LEDGER PER NOREK -----------------
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M13_StudentSummary(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN REKAP BUKU PEMBANTU SISWA

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail

        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)

        sql = "DELETE FROM M2r_Bp_Card WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"

        End If

        'AMBIL NOREK SESUAI FILTER -----------------------------------------------
        'sql = "  SELECT t.tnorek, coa.cnama"
        'sql &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
        'sql &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"
        'sql &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
        'sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_cost_center cc ON t.tcostcenter = cc.cckode"
        'sql &= " LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON c1.ksalesman = c2.kid"
        'sql &= " WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"

        sql = "SELECT t.tnorek, coa.cnama FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid LEFT JOIN m13_si si ON c1.kkode = si.sinosiswa LEFT JOIN m13_faculty f ON si.sifakultas = f.fkode LEFT JOIN m13_study_program sp ON si.siprogramstudi = sp.spkode LEFT JOIN m13_student_category sc ON si.sikategorisiswa = sc.scid WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"

        'FILTER NOREK
        If Len(norekAwal) > 0 And Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(norekAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek >= '" & FixQuotes(norekAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(norekAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (t.tnorek <= '" & FixQuotes(norekAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'FILTER CONTACT
        If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c1.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')"
        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            sql &= " AND (c1.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
        End If

        'FILTER MATAUANG
        If Len(matauang) > 0 Then sql += " AND (t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') "

        'FILTER TAHUN AKADEMIK
        If Len(thnAkademik) > 0 Then
            sql = +" AND (sitahunajaran = '" & FixQuotes(thnAkademik) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER TAHUN FAKULTAS
        If Len(fakultas) > 0 Then
            sql = +" AND (sifakultas = '" & FixQuotes(fakultas) & "')"
        End If
        'FILTER PROGRAM STUDI

            sql = +" AND (siprogramstudi = '" & FixQuotes(programStudi) & "')"

        End If

        sql &= " GROUP BY t.tnorek"
        sql &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek"

        Dim dtNorek As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        'END OF  AMBIL NOREK SESUAI FILTER ---------------------------------------


        'AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ----------------------------------
        Dim dtMatauang As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT skode, snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'accounting' AND (skode = 'MataUangFungsional' OR skode = 'Kurs')", strCon)
        Dim uangFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'MataUangFungsional'", "Not found")
        If uangFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        Dim kursFungsional As String = AsDataTableDLookup(dtMatauang, "snilai", "skode = 'Kurs'", "Not found")
        If kursFungsional = "Not found" Then
            result(2) = "Setting Exchange Rate Functional Currency not found." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0, urut As Double = 1
        'END OF AMBIL MATAUANG FUNGSIONAL DARI SETTING ---------------------------


        'PERHITUNGAN KARTU PER NOREK --------------------------------------------
        If dtNorek.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim dtSAwal As New DataTable, dtSMutasi As New DataTable, dtSMutasiTemp As New DataTable, dtSAkhir As New DataTable
            Dim sqlFungsional As String = "", sqlValas As String = "", sqlJadi As String = ""
            Dim norek As String = "", dtTotal As New DataTable

            'PERULANGAN HITUNG KARTU PER NOREK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtNorek.Rows
                'SET NOREK
                norek = dr("tnorek")

                'RESET QUERY INSERT, SET STEPKE
                strValue.Clear() : stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'SALDO AWAL =========================================
                'QUERY SALDO AWAL FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsional = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as bpmatauang, (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) as bpsaldoawal, t.tkontak as bpkontak, c1.kkode as bpkontakkode"
                sqlFungsional &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
                sqlFungsional &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"
                sqlFungsional &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
                sqlFungsional &= " LEFT JOIN m13_si si ON si.sinosiswa = c1.kkode"
                sqlFungsional &= " LEFT JOIN m13_faculty f ON si.sifakultas = f.fkode"
                sqlFungsional &= " LEFT JOIN m13_study_program sp ON si.siprogramstudi = sp.spkode"
                sqlFungsional &= " LEFT JOIN m13_student_category sc ON si.sikategorisiswa = sc.scid"
                sqlFungsional &= " WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
                sqlFungsional &= " AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(norek) & "'"
                sqlFungsional &= " AND (CASE coa.cjenis WHEN 'P' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' WHEN 'B' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' ELSE t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' END)"
                sqlFungsional &= " AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"

                'FILTER CONTACT
                If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (c1.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER TAHUN AKADEMIK
                If Len(thnAkademik) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (sitahunajaran = '" & FixQuotes(thnAkademik) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER TAHUN FAKULTAS
                If Len(fakultas) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (sifakultas = '" & FixQuotes(fakultas) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER PROGRAM STUDI
                If Len(programStudi) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (siprogramstudi = '" & FixQuotes(programStudi) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER KELAS
                If Len(kelasAwal) > 0 And Len(kelasAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (sikelas BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kelasAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kelasAkhir) & "') "
                ElseIf Len(kelasAwal) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (sikelas >= '" & FixQuotes(kelasAwal) & "') "
                ElseIf Len(kelasAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (sikelas <= '" & FixQuotes(kelasAkhir) & "') "
                End If
                'FILTER KATEGORI SISWA
                If Len(kategoriSiswa) > 0 Then
                    sqlFungsional &= " AND (sckode = '" & FixQuotes(kategoriSiswa) & "')"
                End If

                sqlFungsional &= " GROUP BY t.tnorek, t.tkontak"
                sqlFungsional &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek, t.tkontak"

                'QUERY SALDO AWAL VALAS
                sqlValas = "  SELECT t.tmatauang as bpmatauang, (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) as bpsaldoawal, t.tkontak as bpkontak, c1.kkode as bpkontakkode"
                sqlValas &= " FROM m2_transaction_journal t"
                sqlValas &= " JOIN m1_coa coa ON t.tnorek = coa.cnomor"
                sqlValas &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON t.tkontak = c1.kid"
                sqlValas &= " LEFT JOIN m13_si si ON si.sinosiswa = c1.kkode"
                sqlValas &= " LEFT JOIN m13_faculty f ON si.sifakultas = f.fkode"
                sqlValas &= " LEFT JOIN m13_study_program sp ON si.siprogramstudi = sp.spkode"
                sqlValas &= " LEFT JOIN m13_student_category sc ON si.sikategorisiswa = sc.scid"
                sqlValas &= " WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7)"
                sqlValas &= " AND t.tmatauang <> '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "'"
                sqlValas &= " AND t.tnorek = '" & FixQuotes(norek) & "'"
                sqlValas &= " AND (CASE coa.cjenis WHEN 'P' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' WHEN 'B' THEN t.ttgl >= '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(tglAwal, "yyyy-01-01")) & "' AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' ELSE t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' END)"
                sqlValas &= " AND (CASE LENGTH('" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "') WHEN 0 THEN t.tmatauang LIKE '%' ELSE t.tmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(matauang) & "' END)"

                'FILTER CONTACT
                If Len(kontakAwal) > 0 And Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (c1.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(kontakAwal) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (c1.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAwal) & "')"
                ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (c1.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER TAHUN AKADEMIK
                If Len(thnAkademik) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (sitahunajaran = '" & FixQuotes(thnAkademik) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER TAHUN FAKULTAS
                If Len(fakultas) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (sifakultas = '" & FixQuotes(fakultas) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER PROGRAM STUDI
                If Len(programStudi) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (siprogramstudi = '" & FixQuotes(programStudi) & "')"
                End If
                'FILTER KELAS
                If Len(kelasAwal) > 0 And Len(kelasAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (sikelas BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kelasAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kelasAkhir) & "') "
                ElseIf Len(kelasAwal) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (sikelas >= '" & FixQuotes(kelasAwal) & "') "
                ElseIf Len(kelasAkhir) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (sikelas <= '" & FixQuotes(kelasAkhir) & "') "
                End If
                'FILTER KATEGORI SISWA
                If Len(kategoriSiswa) > 0 Then
                    sqlValas &= " AND (sckode = '" & FixQuotes(kategoriSiswa) & "')"
                End If

                sqlValas &= " GROUP BY t.tnorek, t.tkontak, t.tmatauang"
                sqlValas &= " ORDER BY t.tnorek, t.tkontak, t.tmatauang"

                'GABUNGKAN QUERY SALDO AWAL FUNGSIONAL DAN VALAS
                sqlJadi = "  SELECT bpmatauang, bpsaldoawal, bpkontak, bpkontakkode"
                sqlJadi &= " FROM ((" & sqlFungsional & ") UNION ALL (" & sqlValas & ")) as SAwal"
                sqlJadi &= " ORDER BY bpmatauang = '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' DESC, bpmatauang ASC"

                'AMBIL SALDO AWAL
                dtSAwal = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlJadi, strCon)
                'END OF SALDO AWAL ==================================


                'SALDO MUTASI =======================================
                'QUERY SALDO MUTASI FUNGSIONAL
                sqlFungsional = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(uangFungsional) & "' as bpmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) as bpdebit, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) as bpkredit, t.tkontak as bpkontak, c1.kkode as bpkontakkode"

                    If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                        sql = "Insert into M2r_Bp_Card(bpnourut, idlogin, bpid, bptgl, bpsumber, bpnotransaksi, bpkontak, bpkontakkode, bpkontaknama, bpalamat1, bpalamat2, bpalamat3, bpalamat4, bpalamat5, bpnotelp1, bpnotelp2, bpnorek, bpnoreknama, bpcostcenter, bpcostcenternama, bpmatauang, bpkurs, bpuraian, bpcatatan, bpsaldoawal, bpdebit, bpkredit, bpsaldoakhir, bptgljatuhtempo, bpstatuslunas, bptgllunas, bpinputtgl, bpisfungsional, bpissaldoakhir, idmsmq, bpuserid, bpcustomtext1, bpcustomtext2, bpcustomtext3, bpcustomtext4, bpcustomtext5, bpcustomint1, bpcustomint2, bpcustomint3, bpcustomint4, bpcustomint5, bpcustomdbl1, bpcustomdbl2, bpcustomdbl3, bpcustomdbl4, bpcustomdbl5, bpcustomdate1, bpcustomdate2, bpcustomdate3, bpcustomdate4, bpcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_Omzet_Tagihan4(ByVal param As String) As String

            End If

        End If

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        '\\YANG HARUS DIRUBAH SETIAP FUNGSI
        '\\PROSES PEMBUATAN REPORT

        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_omzet_tagihan ------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASRAKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_omzet_tagihan
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_omzet_tagihan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace laba rugi invoice data global." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_omzet_tagihan -----------------------------

        'BUAT FILTER SI ------------------------------------------------------
        FilterSi = " WHERE si.sistatus IN (2,3,4,7) "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = FilterSi & " AND (si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER SI ------------------------------------------------

        'BUAT FILTER PV ------------------------------------------------------
        FilterPv = " WHERE pv.pvstatus IN (2,3,4,7) "

        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (pv.pvtgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterPv = FilterPv & " AND (pv.pvtgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER PV ------------------------------------------------

        'BUAT FILTER CR ------------------------------------------------------

        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then

        Dim dtCR As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(" SELECT cr.* , k.kkode FROM m2_cr cr JOIN m1_contact k ON cr.crkontak = k.kid WHERE cr.crtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "'  AND cr.crstatus IN (2,3,4,7) ", strCon)

        If dtTgl.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            'JIKA TERDAPAT DATA TG:, MAKA PERULANGAN INSERT KE TABEL m2r_lr_invoice_global SEBANYAK NOREK YANG TERAMBIL
            Dim currTgl As String = "", vsql As String = ""
            Dim strReport As New StringBuilder, sqlReportJadi As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN INSERT m2r_lr_invoice_global ------------------------
            For Each dr As DataRow In dtTgl.Rows
                strReport.Clear()
                sqlReportJadi = ""

                'SET CURRENT NOREK, RESET SALDO AWAL, RESET QUERY, SET STEPKE
                currTgl = AsFormatTanggal(dr("tgl"), "yyyy-MM-dd") : strValue.Clear() ': stepKe = stepKe + 1

                'OMSET SI
                Dim OmsetFDN As Decimal = 0, OmsetSoftex As Decimal = 0, OmsetCussons As Decimal = 0
                For i = 0 To dtSI.Rows.Count - 1
                    If dtSI.Rows(i)("sitgl") = currTgl Then
                        If dtSI.Rows(i)("kkode").ToString.Contains("F") Then ' FDN
                            OmsetFDN += dtSI.Rows(i)("sitotal")
                        ElseIf dtSI.Rows(i)("kkode").ToString.Contains("S") Then ' SOFTEX
                            OmsetSoftex += dtSI.Rows(i)("sitotal")
                        ElseIf dtSI.Rows(i)("kkode").ToString.Contains("C") Then ' CUSSONS
                            OmsetCussons += dtSI.Rows(i)("sitotal")
                        End If
                    End If
                Next

                For u = 0 To dtCR.Rows.Count - 1
                    If dtCR.Rows(u)("crtgl") = currTgl Then
                        If dtCR.Rows(u)("crnorek").ToString.Contains("410101.004") Then ' kasmasukUVPASIR1
                            kasmasukUVPASIR1 += dtCR.Rows(u)("crjumlah")
                        ElseIf dtCR.Rows(u)("crnorek").ToString.Contains("410101.005") Then ' kasmasukUVLUMA1
                            kasmasukUVLUMA1 += dtCR.Rows(u)("crjumlah")
                        End If
                    End If
                Next

                'TUNAI KIRIMAN PV
                Dim PVFDN1 As Decimal = 0, PVSOFTEX1 As Decimal = 0, PVCUSSON1 As Decimal = 0
                Dim minCurrTgl1 As Date = DateTime.Parse(currTgl)
                Dim minCurrTgl As String = AsFormatTanggal(DateTime.Parse(currTgl).AddDays(-1), "yyyy-MM-dd")
                For p = 0 To dtPV.Rows.Count - 1
                    If dtPV.Rows(p)("pvtgl") = minCurrTgl Then
                        If dtPV.Rows(p)("kkode").ToString.Contains("F") Then ' FDN
                            PVFDN1 += dtPV.Rows(p)("totaltransaksi")
                        ElseIf dtPV.Rows(p)("kkode").ToString.Contains("S") Then ' SOFTEX
                            PVSOFTEX1 += dtPV.Rows(p)("totaltransaksi")
                        ElseIf dtPV.Rows(p)("kkode").ToString.Contains("C") Then ' CUSSONS
                            PVCUSSON1 += dtPV.Rows(p)("totaltransaksi")
                        End If
                    End If

                Next

                'TAGIHAN SELES GET OMSET PER H-14
                'SI
                Dim omsetFDN2 As Decimal = 0, omsetSOFTEX2 As Decimal = 0, omsetCUSSON2 As Decimal = 0
                'Dim minCurrTgl1 As Date = DateTime.Parse(currTgl)
                Dim min14CurrTgl As String = AsFormatTanggal(DateTime.Parse(currTgl).AddDays(-14), "yyyy-MM-dd")
                For q = 0 To dtSI.Rows.Count - 1
                    If dtSI.Rows(q)("sitgl") = min14CurrTgl Then
                        If dtSI.Rows(q)("kkode").ToString.Contains("F") Then ' FDN
                            omsetFDN2 += dtSI.Rows(q)("sitotal")
                        ElseIf dtSI.Rows(q)("kkode").ToString.Contains("S") Then ' SOFTEX
                            omsetSOFTEX2 += dtSI.Rows(q)("sitotal")
                        ElseIf dtSI.Rows(q)("kkode").ToString.Contains("C") Then ' CUSSONS
                            omsetCUSSON2 += dtSI.Rows(q)("sitotal")
                        End If
                    End If
                Next

                'SLIP BELUM CAIR PV PER TGL 
                Dim PVFDN4 As Decimal = 0, PVSOFTEX4 As Decimal = 0, PVCUSSON4 As Decimal = 0
                For r = 0 To dtPV2.Rows.Count - 1
                    If dtPV2.Rows(r)("pvtgl") = currTgl Then
                        If dtCR.Rows(r)("crnorek").ToString.Contains("110202.022") Then
                            If dtPV2.Rows(r)("kkode").ToString.Contains("F") Then ' FDN
                                PVFDN4 += dtPV2.Rows(r)("totaltransaksi")
                            ElseIf dtPV2.Rows(r)("kkode").ToString.Contains("S") Then ' SOFTEX
                                PVSOFTEX4 += dtPV2.Rows(r)("totaltransaksi")
                            ElseIf dtPV2.Rows(r)("kkode").ToString.Contains("C") Then ' CUSSONS
                                PVCUSSON4 += dtPV2.Rows(r)("totaltransaksi")
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                Next

                'BAYAR SALES PV 
                Dim PVFDN3 As Decimal = 0, PVSOFTEX2 As Decimal = 0, PVCUSSON3 As Decimal = 0
                Dim minSI14CurrTgl As String = AsFormatTanggal(DateTime.Parse(currTgl).AddDays(-14), "yyyy-MM-dd")
                For s = 0 To dtPV3.Rows.Count - 1
                    If dtPV3.Rows(s)("sitgl") = minSI14CurrTgl Then
                        If dtPV3.Rows(s)("kkode").ToString.Contains("F") Then ' FDN
                            PVFDN1 += dtPV3.Rows(s)("sitotal")
                        ElseIf dtPV3.Rows(s)("kkode").ToString.Contains("S") Then ' SOFTEX
                            PVSOFTEX1 += dtPV3.Rows(s)("sitotal")
                        ElseIf dtPV3.Rows(s)("kkode").ToString.Contains("C") Then ' CUSSONS
                            PVCUSSON1 += dtPV3.Rows(s)("sitotal")
                        End If
                    End If

                Next

                strReport.Append(IIf(Len(strReport.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'Detail
                'mapping :                                       idlogin,                                           idmsmq,                                                             tgl                                                         omsetFDN1,                                           kelcustomer         
                strReport.Append("('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(FxDB(currTgl, "1900-01-01"))) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(OmsetFDN.ToString, 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(OmsetSoftex.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(OmsetCussons.ToString, 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(kasmasukUVPASIR1.ToString, 0)) & "' ,'" & FixDouble(FxDB(kasmasukUVLUMA1.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(PVFDN1.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(PVSOFTEX1.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(PVCUSSON1.ToString, 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(omsetFDN2.ToString, 0)) & "' ,'" & FixDouble(FxDB(omsetSOFTEX2.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(omsetCUSSON2.ToString, 0)) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(PVFDN4.ToString, 0)) & "' ,'" & FixDouble(FxDB(PVSOFTEX4.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixDouble(FxDB(PVCUSSON4.ToString, 0)) & "')")
                'Next
                If Len(strReport.ToString) > 0 Then
                    'Detail
                    sqlReportJadi = " Insert into m2r_omzet_tagihan(idlogin, idmsmq, tgl , omsetFDN1, omsetSOFTEX1,omsetCUSSON1, kasmasukUVPASIR1, kasmasukUVLUMA1 , PVFDN1 , PVSOFTEX1 , PVCUSSON1, omsetFDN2 , omsetSOFTEX2 , omsetCUSSON2, PVFDN4,PVSOFTEX4,PVCUSSON4 ) values" & strReport.ToString & ""
                    'result(2) = sqlReportJadi : GoTo selesai
                    'result(2) = dtLr.Rows.Count : GoTo selesai
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlReportJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing '" & currTgl & "' omzet dan tagihan." : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If

                'End If

                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA NOREK) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML NOREK MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                Dim progressPersen As Double = IIf(stepKe = dtTgl.Rows.Count, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / dtTgl.Rows.Count, 2)) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress '" & currTgl & "' laba rugi invoice" : GoTo selesai
                End If

            Next
            'END OF PERULANGAN INSERT m2r_omzet_tagihan -----------------
        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_HarianAlamindo(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN HARIAN ALAMINDO

        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""

        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================

            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai

        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then

                result(2) = "Date required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            result(2) = "Date can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'tglAwalPJ(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then

                result(2) = "Start Sales Date required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwalPJ = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If

        End If

        'tglAkhirPJ(2) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(2)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(2)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "End Sales Date required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhirPJ = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(2))
            End If
        Else
            result(2) = "End Sales Date can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()


        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_laporan_penjualan ------------------------------------
        stepKe = 1
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_laporan_penjualan
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_laporan_penjualan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace daily report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #0." : GoTo selesai

        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_laporan_penjualan -----------------------------


        Dim dt As New DataTable

        stepKe = 2
        Dim A_PenjF As Decimal = 0, A_PenjC As Decimal = 0, A_PenjS As Decimal = 0, A_PenjUP As Decimal = 0, A_PenjUL As Decimal = 0, A_PenjTotal As Decimal = 0
        Dim A_ReturF As Decimal = 0, A_ReturC As Decimal = 0, A_ReturS As Decimal = 0, A_ReturUP As Decimal = 0, A_ReturUL As Decimal = 0, A_ReturTotal As Decimal = 0

        '1. PENJUALAN FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT SUBSTR(c.kkode FROM 1 FOR 1) as kode, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi) as total FROM m5_si si JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid AND si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND si.sitgl = '" & tglAwal & "' GROUP BY SUBSTR(c.kkode FROM 1 FOR 1)", strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows
                If dr("kode") = "F" Then 'PENJUALAN FDN
                    A_PenjF = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "C" Then 'PENJUALAN CUSSONS
                    A_PenjC = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "S" Then 'PENJUALAN SOFTEX
                    A_PenjS = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "P" Then 'PENJUALAN ULI P
                    A_PenjUP = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "L" Then 'PENJUALAN  ULI L
                    A_PenjUL = dr("total")
                End If
            Next
        End If


        '2. RETUR FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT SUBSTR(c.kkode FROM 1 FOR 1) as kode, SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi) as total FROM m5_sr sr JOIN m1_contact c ON sr.srcustomer = c.kid AND sr.srstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND sr.srtgl = '" & tglAwal & "' GROUP BY SUBSTR(c.kkode FROM 1 FOR 1)", strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows
                If dr("kode") = "F" Then 'RETUR FDN
                    A_ReturF = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "C" Then 'RETUR CUSSONS
                    A_ReturC = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "S" Then 'RETUR SOFTEX
                    A_ReturS = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "P" Then 'RETUR ULI P
                    A_ReturUP = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "L" Then 'RETUR ULI L
                    A_ReturUL = dr("total")
                End If
            Next
        End If


        ''3. PENJUALAN DAN RETUR ULI P, ULI L
        'dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT t.tnorek as kode, SUM(t.tkredit) as penjualan, SUM(t.tdebit) as retur FROM m2_transaction_journal t WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tnorek IN('410101.004','410101.005','410103.004','410103.005') AND t.ttgl = '" & tglAwal & "' GROUP BY t.tnorek", strCon)
        'If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
        '    For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows
        '        If dr("kode") = "410101.004" Then 'PENJUALAN ULI P
        '            A_PenjUP = dr("penjualan")
        '        ElseIf dr("kode") = "410101.005" Then 'PENJUALAN ULI L
        '            A_PenjUL = dr("penjualan")
        '        ElseIf dr("kode") = "410103.004" Then 'RETUR ULI P
        '            A_ReturUP = dr("retur")
        '        ElseIf dr("kode") = "410103.005" Then 'RETUR ULI L
        '            A_ReturUL = dr("retur")
        '        End If
        '    Next
        'End If

        'HITUNG TOTAL
        Dim A_NettoF As Decimal = 0, A_NettoC As Decimal = 0, A_NettoS As Decimal = 0, A_NettoUP As Decimal = 0, A_NettoUL As Decimal = 0, A_NettoTotal As Decimal = 0
        A_PenjTotal = A_PenjF + A_PenjC + A_PenjS + A_PenjUP + A_PenjUL
        A_ReturTotal = A_ReturF + A_ReturC + A_ReturS + A_ReturUP + A_ReturUL
        A_NettoF = A_PenjF - A_ReturF
        A_NettoC = A_PenjC - A_ReturC
        A_NettoS = A_PenjS - A_ReturS
        A_NettoUP = A_PenjUP - A_ReturUP
        A_NettoUL = A_PenjUL - A_ReturUL
        A_NettoTotal = A_NettoF + A_NettoC + A_NettoS + A_NettoUP + A_NettoUL

        'INSERT TABEL PEMBANTU
        sql = "  INSERT INTO m2r_laporan_harian (idlogin, lhgrup, lhurutan, lhketerangan,                        lhfdn,                    lhcussons,                     lhsoftex,                      lhulipsr,                      lhulilmj,                           lhtotal,                      idmsmq,                    lhuserid) "
        'PENJUALAN
        sql &= "     VALUES ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "',    '1',      '1',  'Penjualan', '" & FixDouble(A_PenjF) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_PenjC) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_PenjS) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_PenjUP) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_PenjUL) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_PenjTotal) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "') "
        'RETUR
        sql &= "          , ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "',    '1',      '2',  'Retur Penjualan', '" & FixDouble(A_ReturF) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_ReturC) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_ReturS) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_ReturUP) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_ReturUL) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_ReturTotal) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "') "
        'NETTO
        sql &= "          , ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "',    '1',      '3',  'Netto Penjualan', '" & FixDouble(A_NettoF) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_NettoC) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_NettoS) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_NettoUP) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_NettoUL) & "', '" & FixDouble(A_NettoTotal) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "') "
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed processing #1." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #1." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL PENJUALAN DAN RETUR --------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL PENJUALAN TUNAI -------------------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 3
        Dim A_PenjTunaiF As Decimal = 0, A_PenjTunaiC As Decimal = 0, A_PenjTunaiS As Decimal = 0, A_PenjTunaiUP As Decimal = 0, A_PenjTunaiUL As Decimal = 0, A_PenjTunaiTotal As Decimal = 0

        '1. PENJUALAN TUNAI FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT SUBSTR(c.kkode FROM 1 FOR 1) as kode, SUM(pvd.jmlbayar) as total FROM m5_pv pv JOIN m5_pv_detail pvd ON pv.pvid = pvd.idpv AND pv.pvstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND pvd.sumber = 'SI' AND pv.pvtgl = ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL 1 DAY) JOIN m5_si si ON pvd.idtransaksi = si.siid AND si.sitgl = '" & tglAwal & "' JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid GROUP BY SUBSTR(c.kkode FROM 1 FOR 1)", strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows
                If dr("kode") = "F" Then 'PENJUALAN TUNAI FDN
                    A_PenjTunaiF = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "C" Then 'PENJUALAN TUNAI CUSSONS
                    A_PenjTunaiC = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "S" Then 'PENJUALAN TUNAI SOFTEX
                    A_PenjTunaiS = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "P" Then 'PENJUALAN TUNAI ULI P
                    A_PenjTunaiUP = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "L" Then 'PENJUALAN TUNAI ULI L
                    A_PenjTunaiUL = dr("total")
                End If
            Next
        End If


        '2. PENJUALAN TUNAI ULI P, ULI L
        'BELUM

        'TOTAL PENJUALAN TUNAI
        A_PenjTunaiTotal = A_PenjTunaiF + A_PenjTunaiC + A_PenjTunaiS + A_PenjTunaiUP + A_PenjTunaiUL


        '3. HITUNG % PENJUALAN TUNAI ((penjualan tunai / netto penjualan) * 100)
        Dim A_PenjTunaiPersenF As Decimal = IIf(A_NettoF = 0, 100, (A_PenjTunaiF / IIf(A_NettoF = 0, 1, A_NettoF)) * 100)
        Dim A_PenjTunaiPersenC As Decimal = IIf(A_NettoC = 0, 100, (A_PenjTunaiC / IIf(A_NettoC = 0, 1, A_NettoC)) * 100)
        Dim A_PenjTunaiPersenS As Decimal = IIf(A_NettoS = 0, 100, (A_PenjTunaiS / IIf(A_NettoS = 0, 1, A_NettoS)) * 100)
        Dim A_PenjTunaiPersenUP As Decimal = IIf(A_NettoUP = 0, 100, (A_PenjTunaiUP / IIf(A_NettoUP = 0, 1, A_NettoUP)) * 100)
        Dim A_PenjTunaiPersenUL As Decimal = IIf(A_NettoUL = 0, 100, (A_PenjTunaiUL / IIf(A_NettoUL = 0, 1, A_NettoUL)) * 100)
        Dim A_PenjTunaiPersenTotal As Decimal = IIf(A_NettoTotal = 0, 100, (A_PenjTunaiTotal / IIf(A_NettoTotal = 0, 1, A_NettoTotal)) * 100)

        '4. HITUNG PENJUALAN KREDIT (netto - penjualan tunai)
        Dim A_PenjKreditF As Decimal = A_NettoF - A_PenjTunaiF
        Dim A_PenjKreditC As Decimal = A_NettoC - A_PenjTunaiC
        Dim A_PenjKreditS As Decimal = A_NettoS - A_PenjTunaiS
        Dim A_PenjKreditUP As Decimal = A_NettoUP - A_PenjTunaiUP
        Dim A_PenjKreditUL As Decimal = A_NettoUL - A_PenjTunaiUL
        Dim A_PenjKreditTotal As Decimal = A_PenjKreditF + A_PenjKreditC + A_PenjKreditS + A_PenjKreditUP + A_PenjKreditUL

        '5. HITUNG % PENJUALAN KREDIT ((penjualan kredit / netto penjualan) * 100)
        Dim A_PenjKreditPersenF As Decimal = IIf(A_NettoF = 0, 100, (A_PenjKreditF / IIf(A_NettoF = 0, 1, A_NettoF)) * 100)
        Dim A_PenjKreditPersenC As Decimal = IIf(A_NettoC = 0, 100, (A_PenjKreditC / IIf(A_NettoC = 0, 1, A_NettoC)) * 100)

        Dim A_PenjKreditPersenUP As Decimal = IIf(A_NettoUP = 0, 100, (A_PenjKreditUP / IIf(A_NettoUP = 0, 1, A_NettoUP)) * 100)
        Dim A_PenjKreditPersenUL As Decimal = IIf(A_NettoUL = 0, 100, (A_PenjKreditUL / IIf(A_NettoUL = 0, 1, A_NettoUL)) * 100)

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "410101.002" Then  'PENJUALAN CLAIM S

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "410101.003" Then 'PENJUALAN CLAIM C

            result(2) = "Failed processing #1#2." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)
