        Dim C_PembF As Decimal = 0, C_PembC As Decimal = 0, C_PembS As Decimal = 0, C_PembUP As Decimal = 0, C_PembUL As Decimal = 0, C_PembTotal As Decimal = 0
        Dim C_ReturJualF As Decimal = 0, C_ReturJualC As Decimal = 0, C_ReturJualS As Decimal = 0, C_ReturJualUP As Decimal = 0, C_ReturJualUL As Decimal = 0, C_ReturJualTotal As Decimal = 0
        Dim C_PenyMasukF As Decimal = 0, C_PenyMasukC As Decimal = 0, C_PenyMasukS As Decimal = 0, C_PenyMasukUP As Decimal = 0, C_PenyMasukUL As Decimal = 0, C_PenyMasukTotal As Decimal = 0
        Dim C_JUmumF As Decimal = 0, C_JUmumC As Decimal = 0, C_JUmumS As Decimal = 0, C_JUmumUP As Decimal = 0, C_JUmumUL As Decimal = 0, C_JUmumTotal As Decimal = 0

        '3. PEMBELIAN, RETUR JUAL, PENYESUAIAN MASUK DAN JURNAL UMUM FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT t.tsumber as sumber, t.tnorek as kode, SUM(t.tdebit) as total FROM m2_transaction_journal t WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tnorek IN('110301.001', '110301.002', '110301.003', '110301.004', '110301.005') AND t.tdebit <> 0 AND t.ttgl = '" & tglAwal & "' GROUP BY t.tnorek, t.tsumber", strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows

                If dr("kode") = "110301.001" Then 'PERSEDIAAN FDN
                    If dr("sumber") = "RI" Then 'PEMBELIAN
                        C_PembF = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SR" Then 'RETUR PENJUALAN
                        C_ReturJualF = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SA" Then 'PENYESUAIAN MASUK
                        C_PenyMasukF = dr("total")
                    Else 'JURNAL UMUM
                        C_JUmumF += dr("total")
                    End If

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.003" Then 'PERSEDIAAN CUSSONS
                    If dr("sumber") = "RI" Then 'PEMBELIAN
                        C_PembC = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SR" Then 'RETUR PENJUALAN
                        C_ReturJualC = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SA" Then 'PENYESUAIAN MASUK
                        C_PenyMasukC = dr("total")
                    Else 'JURNAL UMUM
                        C_JUmumC += dr("total")
                    End If

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.002" Then 'PERSEDIAAN SOFTEX
                    If dr("sumber") = "RI" Then 'PEMBELIAN
                        C_PembS = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SR" Then 'RETUR PENJUALAN
                        C_ReturJualS = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SA" Then 'PENYESUAIAN MASUK
                        C_PenyMasukS = dr("total")
                    Else 'JURNAL UMUM
                        C_JUmumS += dr("total")
                    End If

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.004" Then 'PERSEDIAAN ULI P
                    If dr("sumber") = "RI" Then 'PEMBELIAN
                        C_PembUP = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SR" Then 'RETUR PENJUALAN
                        C_ReturJualUP = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SA" Then 'PENYESUAIAN MASUK
                        C_PenyMasukUP = dr("total")
                    Else 'JURNAL UMUM
                        C_JUmumUP += dr("total")
                    End If

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.005" Then 'PERSEDIAAN ULI L
                    If dr("sumber") = "RI" Then 'PEMBELIAN
                        C_PembUL = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SR" Then 'RETUR PENJUALAN
                        C_ReturJualUL = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SA" Then 'PENYESUAIAN MASUK
                        C_PenyMasukUL = dr("total")
                    Else 'JURNAL UMUM
                        C_JUmumUL += dr("total")
                    End If

                End If

            Next
        End If

        'HITUNG TOTAL PEMBELIAN, RETUR JUAL, PENYESUAIAN MASUK DAN JURNAL UMUM FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        C_PembTotal = C_PembF + C_PembC + C_PembS + C_PembUP + C_PembUL
        C_ReturJualTotal = C_ReturJualF + C_ReturJualC + C_ReturJualS + C_ReturJualUP + C_ReturJualUL
        C_PenyMasukTotal = C_PenyMasukF + C_PenyMasukC + C_PenyMasukS + C_PenyMasukUP + C_PenyMasukUL
        C_JUmumTotal = C_JUmumF + C_JUmumC + C_JUmumS + C_JUmumUP + C_JUmumUL


        '4. PEMBELIAN ULI P, ULI L
        'BELUM

        '5. RETUR JUAL ULI P, ULI L
        'BELUM

        '6. PENYESUAIAN MASUK ULI P, ULI L
        'BELUM

        '7. BARANG MASUK ULI
        'BELUM

        'HITUNG TOTAL BARANG TERSEDIA (PERSEDIAAN AWAL + PERUBAHAN HARGA + PEMBELIAN + RETUR JUAL + PENYESUAIAN MASUK + JURNAL UMUM)
        Dim C_TotalTersediaF As Decimal = 0, C_TotalTersediaC As Decimal = 0, C_TotalTersediaS As Decimal = 0, C_TotalTersediaUP As Decimal = 0, C_TotalTersediaUL As Decimal = 0, C_TotalTersediaTotal As Decimal = 0
        C_TotalTersediaF = C_PersAwalF + C_PerHargaF + C_PembF + C_ReturJualF + C_PenyMasukF + C_JUmumF
        C_TotalTersediaC = C_PersAwalC + C_PerHargaC + C_PembC + C_ReturJualC + C_PenyMasukC + C_JUmumC
        C_TotalTersediaS = C_PersAwalS + C_PerHargaS + C_PembS + C_ReturJualS + C_PenyMasukS + C_JUmumS
        C_TotalTersediaUP = C_PersAwalUP + C_PerHargaUP + C_PembUP + C_ReturJualUP + C_PenyMasukUP + C_JUmumUP
        C_TotalTersediaUL = C_PersAwalUL + C_PerHargaUL + C_PembUL + C_ReturJualUL + C_PenyMasukUL + C_JUmumUL
        C_TotalTersediaTotal = C_PersAwalTotal + C_PerHargaTotal + C_PembTotal + C_ReturJualTotal + C_PenyMasukTotal + C_JUmumTotal


        Dim C_PenjF As Decimal = 0, C_PenjC As Decimal = 0, C_PenjS As Decimal = 0, C_PenjUP As Decimal = 0, C_PenjUL As Decimal = 0, C_PenjTotal As Decimal = 0
        Dim C_ReturBeliF As Decimal = 0, C_ReturBeliC As Decimal = 0, C_ReturBeliS As Decimal = 0, C_ReturBeliUP As Decimal = 0, C_ReturBeliUL As Decimal = 0, C_ReturBeliTotal As Decimal = 0
        Dim C_PenyKeluarF As Decimal = 0, C_PenyKeluarC As Decimal = 0, C_PenyKeluarS As Decimal = 0, C_PenyKeluarUP As Decimal = 0, C_PenyKeluarUL As Decimal = 0, C_PenyKeluarTotal As Decimal = 0
        Dim C_KJUmumF As Decimal = 0, C_KJUmumC As Decimal = 0, C_KJUmumS As Decimal = 0, C_KJUmumUP As Decimal = 0, C_KJUmumUL As Decimal = 0, C_KJUmumTotal As Decimal = 0

        '8. BARANG JUAL, RETUR BELI, PENYESUAIAN KELUAR DAN JURNAL UMUM FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT t.tsumber as sumber, t.tnorek as kode, SUM(t.tkredit) as total FROM m2_transaction_journal t WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tnorek IN('110301.001', '110301.002', '110301.003', '110301.004', '110301.005') AND t.tkredit <> 0 AND t.ttgl = '" & tglAwal & "' GROUP BY t.tnorek, t.tsumber", strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows

                If dr("kode") = "110301.001" Then 'PERSEDIAAN FDN
                    If dr("sumber") = "SI" Then 'PENJUALAN
                        C_PenjF = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "PRT" Then 'RETUR PEMBELIAN
                        C_ReturBeliF = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SA" Then 'PENYESUAIAN KELUAR
                        C_PenyKeluarF = dr("total")
                    Else 'JURNAL UMUM
                        C_KJUmumF += dr("total")
                    End If

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.003" Then 'PERSEDIAAN CUSSONS
                    If dr("sumber") = "SI" Then 'PENJUALAN
                        C_PenjC = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "PRT" Then 'RETUR PEMBELIAN
                        C_ReturBeliC = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SA" Then 'PENYESUAIAN KELUAR
                        C_PenyKeluarC = dr("total")
                    Else 'JURNAL UMUM
                        C_KJUmumC += dr("total")
                    End If

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.002" Then 'PERSEDIAAN SOFTEX
                    If dr("sumber") = "SI" Then 'PENJUALAN
                        C_PenjS = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "PRT" Then 'RETUR PEMBELIAN
                        C_ReturBeliS = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SA" Then 'PENYESUAIAN KELUAR
                        C_PenyKeluarS = dr("total")
                    Else 'JURNAL UMUM
                        C_KJUmumS += dr("total")
                    End If

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.004" Then 'PERSEDIAAN ULI P
                    If dr("sumber") = "SI" Then 'PENJUALAN
                        C_PenjUP = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "PRT" Then 'RETUR PEMBELIAN
                        C_ReturBeliUP = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SA" Then 'PENYESUAIAN KELUAR
                        C_PenyKeluarUP = dr("total")
                    Else 'JURNAL UMUM
                        C_KJUmumUP += dr("total")
                    End If

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.005" Then 'PERSEDIAAN ULI L
                    If dr("sumber") = "SI" Then 'PENJUALAN
                        C_PenjUL = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "PRT" Then 'RETUR PEMBELIAN
                        C_ReturBeliUL = dr("total")
                    ElseIf dr("sumber") = "SA" Then 'PENYESUAIAN KELUAR
                        C_PenyKeluarUL = dr("total")
                    Else 'JURNAL UMUM
                        C_KJUmumUL += dr("total")
                    End If

                End If

            Next
        End If

        'HITUNG TOTAL BARANG JUAL, RETUR BELI, PENYESUAIAN KELUAR DAN JURNAL UMUM FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        C_PenjTotal = C_PenjF + C_PenjC + C_PenjS + C_PenjUP + C_PenjUL
        C_ReturBeliTotal = C_ReturBeliF + C_ReturBeliC + C_ReturBeliS + C_ReturBeliUP + C_ReturBeliUL
        C_PenyKeluarTotal = C_PenyKeluarF + C_PenyKeluarC + C_PenyKeluarS + C_PenyKeluarUP + C_PenyKeluarUL
        C_KJUmumTotal = C_KJUmumF + C_KJUmumC + C_KJUmumS + C_KJUmumUP + C_KJUmumUL


        '9. BARANG JUAL ULI P, ULI L
        'BELUM

        '10. RETUR BELI ULI P, ULI L
        'BELUM

        '11. PENYESUAIAN KELUAR ULI P, ULI L
        'BELUM

        '12. BARANG KELUAR ULI
        'BELUM

        'HITUNG TOTAL BARANG TERJUAL (BARANG JUAL + RETUR BELI + PENYESUAIAN KELUAR + JURNAL UMUM)
        Dim C_TotalTerjualF As Decimal = 0, C_TotalTerjualC As Decimal = 0, C_TotalTerjualS As Decimal = 0, C_TotalTerjualUP As Decimal = 0, C_TotalTerjualUL As Decimal = 0, C_TotalTerjualTotal As Decimal = 0
        C_TotalTerjualF = C_PenjF + C_ReturBeliF + C_PenyKeluarF + C_KJUmumF
        C_TotalTerjualC = C_PenjC + C_ReturBeliC + C_PenyKeluarC + C_KJUmumC
        C_TotalTerjualS = C_PenjS + C_ReturBeliS + C_PenyKeluarS + C_KJUmumS
        C_TotalTerjualUP = C_PenjUP + C_ReturBeliUP + C_PenyKeluarUP + C_KJUmumUP
        C_TotalTerjualUL = C_PenjUL + C_ReturBeliUL + C_PenyKeluarUL + C_KJUmumUL
        C_TotalTerjualTotal = C_PenjTotal + C_ReturBeliTotal + C_PenyKeluarTotal + C_KJUmumTotal


        Dim C_PersAkhirF As Decimal = 0, C_PersAkhirC As Decimal = 0, C_PersAkhirS As Decimal = 0, C_PersAkhirUP As Decimal = 0, C_PersAkhirUL As Decimal = 0, C_PersAkhirTotal As Decimal = 0

        '13. PERSEDIAAN AKHIR
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT t.tnorek as kode, SUM(t.tdebit-t.tkredit) as total FROM m2_transaction_journal t WHERE t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND t.tnorek IN( '110301.001', '110301.002', '110301.003', '110301.004', '110301.005' ) AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAwal & "' GROUP BY t.tnorek", strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows
                If dr("kode") = "110301.001" Then 'PERSEDIAAN AKHIR FDN
                    C_PersAkhirF = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.003" Then 'PERSEDIAAN AKHIR CUSSONS
                    C_PersAkhirC = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.002" Then 'PERSEDIAAN AKHIR SOFTEX
                    C_PersAkhirS = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.004" Then 'PERSEDIAAN AKHIR ULI P
                    C_PersAkhirUP = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "110301.005" Then 'PERSEDIAAN AKHIR ULI L
                    C_PersAkhirUL = dr("total")
                End If
            Next
        End If

        'HITUNG TOTAL PERSEDIAAN AKHIR FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        C_PersAkhirTotal = C_PersAkhirF + C_PersAkhirC + C_PersAkhirS + C_PersAkhirUP + C_PersAkhirUL


        '14. FAST
        'PERSEDIAAN DENGAN COVER MONTH <= 3 BULAN
        'COVER MONTH = STOK / PENJUALAN BULAN LALU
        Dim C_FastF As Decimal = 0, C_FastC As Decimal = 0, C_FastS As Decimal = 0, C_FastUP As Decimal = 0, C_FastUL As Decimal = 0, C_FastTotal As Decimal = 0

        'AMBIL STOK PERTANGGAL
        sql = "  INSERT INTO m2r_item_stock_global( "
        sql &= " SELECT i.bid as idbarang, '" & tglAwal & "' as tgl, ROUND(SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE it.jmlbarang * -1 END)),2) as stok, ROUND(SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE it.jmlbarang * it.hpp * -1 END)),2) as nilai "
        sql &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it "
        sql &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 AND it.tgl <= '" & tglAwal & "' "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid AND i.bjenis = 'P' "
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid "
        sql &= " ) "
        sql &= " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stok = VALUES(stok), nilai = VALUES(nilai) "
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed getting item stock." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL STOK KELUAR BULAN LALU
        sql = "  INSERT INTO m2r_item_stock_out( "
        sql &= " SELECT "
        sql &= " it.idbarang, "
        sql &= " DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%Y') as tahun, "
        sql &= " DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%m') as bulan, "
        sql &= " ROUND(SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE it.jmlbarang * -1 END)),2) as stok "
        sql &= " FROM "
        sql &= " m1_item_transaction it "
        sql &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 AND it.sumber IN('SI','SR') "
        sql &= " AND YEAR(it.tgl) = DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%Y') "
        sql &= " AND MONTH(it.tgl) = DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%m') "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid AND i.bjenis = 'P' "
        sql &= " GROUP BY it.idbarang "
        sql &= " ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stok = VALUES(stok) "
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed getting item stock out." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'AMBIL FAST
        sql = "  SELECT "
        sql &= " i.brekpersediaan, "
        sql &= " ROUND(isg.nilai,2) as nilai, "
        sql &= " ROUND((CASE ROUND(isg.stok,2) "
        sql &= " WHEN 0 THEN 0 "
        sql &= " ELSE IFNULL(ROUND(isg.stok,2) / ROUND(IFNULL(iso.stok,0),2), ROUND(isg.stok,2)) "
        sql &= " END),2) as covermonth "
        sql &= " FROM "
        sql &= " m2r_item_stock_global isg "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item i ON isg.idbarang = i.bid AND i.bjenis = 'P' AND isg.tgl = '" & tglAwal & "' "
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2r_item_stock_out iso ON isg.idbarang = iso.idbarang "
        sql &= " AND iso.tahun = DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%Y') "
        sql &= " AND iso.bulan = DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%m') "
        sql &= " HAVING covermonth <= 3 "
        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            C_FastF = AsDataTableDSum(dt, "nilai", "brekpersediaan = '110301.001'")
            C_FastC = AsDataTableDSum(dt, "nilai", "brekpersediaan = '110301.003'")
            C_FastS = AsDataTableDSum(dt, "nilai", "brekpersediaan = '110301.002'")
            C_FastUP = AsDataTableDSum(dt, "nilai", "brekpersediaan = '110301.004'")
            C_FastUL = AsDataTableDSum(dt, "nilai", "brekpersediaan = '110301.005'")
        End If

        'HITUNG TOTAL FAST FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        C_FastTotal = C_FastF + C_FastC + C_FastS + C_FastUP + C_FastUL


        '15. % FAST (FAST / PERSEDIAAN AKHIR) * 100
        Dim C_FastPersenF As Decimal = 0, C_FastPersenC As Decimal = 0, C_FastPersenS As Decimal = 0, C_FastPersenUP As Decimal = 0, C_FastPersenUL As Decimal = 0, C_FastPersenTotal As Decimal = 0
        C_FastPersenF = IIf(C_PersAkhirF = 0, 100, (C_FastF / IIf(C_PersAkhirF = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirF)) * 100)
        C_FastPersenC = IIf(C_PersAkhirC = 0, 100, (C_FastC / IIf(C_PersAkhirC = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirC)) * 100)
        C_FastPersenS = IIf(C_PersAkhirS = 0, 100, (C_FastS / IIf(C_PersAkhirS = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirS)) * 100)
        C_FastPersenUP = IIf(C_PersAkhirUP = 0, 100, (C_FastUP / IIf(C_PersAkhirUP = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirUP)) * 100)
        C_FastPersenUL = IIf(C_PersAkhirUL = 0, 100, (C_FastUL / IIf(C_PersAkhirUL = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirUL)) * 100)
        C_FastPersenTotal = IIf(C_PersAkhirTotal = 0, 100, (C_FastTotal / IIf(C_PersAkhirTotal = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirTotal)) * 100)


        '16. SLOW
        'PERSEDIAAN DENGAN COVER MONTH <= 3 BULAN (PERSEDIAAN AKHIR - FAST)
        Dim C_SlowF As Decimal = 0, C_SlowC As Decimal = 0, C_SlowS As Decimal = 0, C_SlowUP As Decimal = 0, C_SlowUL As Decimal = 0, C_SlowTotal As Decimal = 0

        C_SlowF = C_PersAkhirF - C_FastF
        C_SlowC = C_PersAkhirC - C_FastC
        C_SlowS = C_PersAkhirS - C_FastS
        C_SlowUP = C_PersAkhirUP - C_FastUP
        C_SlowUL = C_PersAkhirUL - C_FastUL

        'HITUNG TOTAL SLOW FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        C_SlowTotal = C_SlowF + C_SlowC + C_SlowS + C_SlowUP + C_SlowUL


        '17. % SLOW (SLOW / PERSEDIAAN AKHIR) * 100
        Dim C_SlowPersenF As Decimal = 0, C_SlowPersenC As Decimal = 0, C_SlowPersenS As Decimal = 0, C_SlowPersenUP As Decimal = 0, C_SlowPersenUL As Decimal = 0, C_SlowPersenTotal As Decimal = 0
        C_SlowPersenF = IIf(C_PersAkhirF = 0, 100, (C_SlowF / IIf(C_PersAkhirF = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirF)) * 100)
        C_SlowPersenC = IIf(C_PersAkhirC = 0, 100, (C_SlowC / IIf(C_PersAkhirC = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirC)) * 100)
        C_SlowPersenS = IIf(C_PersAkhirS = 0, 100, (C_SlowS / IIf(C_PersAkhirS = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirS)) * 100)
        C_SlowPersenUP = IIf(C_PersAkhirUP = 0, 100, (C_SlowUP / IIf(C_PersAkhirUP = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirUP)) * 100)
        C_SlowPersenUL = IIf(C_PersAkhirUL = 0, 100, (C_SlowUL / IIf(C_PersAkhirUL = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirUL)) * 100)
        C_SlowPersenTotal = IIf(C_PersAkhirTotal = 0, 100, (C_SlowTotal / IIf(C_PersAkhirTotal = 0, 100, C_PersAkhirTotal)) * 100)


        '18. LABA KOTOR
        'NETTO PENJUALAN + PENDAPATAN CLAIM - TOTAL BARANG TERJUAL
        Dim C_LabaKotorF As Decimal = 0, C_LabaKotorC As Decimal = 0, C_LabaKotorS As Decimal = 0, C_LabaKotorUP As Decimal = 0, C_LabaKotorUL As Decimal = 0, C_LabaKotorTotal As Decimal = 0
        C_LabaKotorF = A_NettoF + A_PenjClaimF - C_TotalTerjualF
        C_LabaKotorC = A_NettoC + A_PenjClaimC - C_TotalTerjualC
        C_LabaKotorS = A_NettoS + A_PenjClaimS - C_TotalTerjualS
        C_LabaKotorUP = A_NettoUP + A_PenjClaimUP - C_TotalTerjualUP
        C_LabaKotorUL = A_NettoUL + A_PenjClaimUL - C_TotalTerjualUL
        C_LabaKotorTotal = A_NettoTotal + A_PenjClaimTotal - C_TotalTerjualTotal


        '19. % LABA KOTOR
        '(LABA KOTOR / NETTO PENJUALAN) * 100
        Dim C_LabaKotorPersenF As Decimal = 0, C_LabaKotorPersenC As Decimal = 0, C_LabaKotorPersenS As Decimal = 0, C_LabaKotorPersenUP As Decimal = 0, C_LabaKotorPersenUL As Decimal = 0, C_LabaKotorPersenTotal As Decimal = 0
        C_LabaKotorPersenF = IIf(A_NettoF + A_PenjClaimF = 0, 100, (C_LabaKotorF / IIf(A_NettoF + A_PenjClaimF = 0, 100, A_NettoF + A_PenjClaimF)) * 100)
        C_LabaKotorPersenC = IIf(A_NettoC + A_PenjClaimC = 0, 100, (C_LabaKotorC / IIf(A_NettoC + A_PenjClaimC = 0, 100, A_NettoC + A_PenjClaimC)) * 100)

                ElseIf dr("kode") = "SS004" Then 'PIUTANG ULI P
                    E_HutangJtUP = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "SS005" Then 'PIUTANG ULI L
                    E_HutangJtUL = dr("total")
                End If
            Next
        End If

        'HITUNG TOTAL SALDO HUTANG JATUH TEMPO FDN, CUSSONS, SOFTEX, ULI P, ULI L
        E_HutangJtTotal = E_HutangJtF + E_HutangJtC + E_HutangJtS + E_HutangJtUP + E_HutangJtUL


        '5. SALDO HUTANG JATUH TEMPO ULI P, ULI L
        'BELUM


        '6. HUTANG ULI JATUH TEMPO
        'BELUM


        '7. PENJUALAN 2 MINGGU LALU
        'PENJUALAN BERDASARKAN FILTER TANGGAL PENJUALAN
        Dim E_PenjLaluF As Decimal = 0, E_PenjLaluC As Decimal = 0, E_PenjLaluS As Decimal = 0, E_PenjLaluUP As Decimal = 0, E_PenjLaluUL As Decimal = 0, E_PenjLaluTotal As Decimal = 0

        dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT SUBSTR(c.kkode FROM 1 FOR 1) as kode, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi) as total FROM m5_si si JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid AND si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwalPJ & "' AND '" & tglAkhirPJ & "' GROUP BY SUBSTR(c.kkode FROM 1 FOR 1)", strCon)
        If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows
                If dr("kode") = "F" Then 'PENJUALAN FDN
                    E_PenjLaluF = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "C" Then 'PENJUALAN CUSSONS
                    E_PenjLaluC = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "S" Then 'PENJUALAN SOFTEX
                    E_PenjLaluS = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "P" Then 'PENJUALAN ULI P
                    E_PenjLaluUP = dr("total")
                ElseIf dr("kode") = "L" Then 'PENJUALAN  ULI L
                    E_PenjLaluUL = dr("total")
                End If
            Next
        End If

        'HITUNG TOTAL  PENJUALAN 2 MINGGU LALU
        E_PenjLaluTotal = E_PenjLaluF + E_PenjLaluC + E_PenjLaluS + E_PenjLaluUP + E_PenjLaluUL


        'INSERT TABEL PEMBANTU
        sql = "  INSERT INTO m2r_laporan_harian (idlogin, lhgrup, lhurutan, lhketerangan,                        lhfdn,                    lhcussons,                     lhsoftex,                      lhulipsr,                      lhulilmj,                                                                lhtotal,                      idmsmq,                    lhuserid) "
        'Saldo Hutang
        sql &= "     VALUES ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "',    '8',      '1',  'Saldo Hutang', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangF) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangC) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangS) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangUP) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangUL) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangTotal) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "') "
        'Saldo Hutang JT
        sql &= "          , ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "',    '8',      '2',  'Saldo Hutang JT', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangJtF) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangJtC) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangJtS) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangJtUP) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangJtUL) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_HutangJtTotal) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "') "
        'Penjualan 2 Minggu Lalu
        sql &= "          , ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "',    '8',      '3',  'Penjualan 2 Minggu Lalu', '" & FixDouble(E_PenjLaluF) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_PenjLaluC) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_PenjLaluS) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_PenjLaluUP) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_PenjLaluUL) & "', '" & FixDouble(E_PenjLaluTotal) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "') "
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed processing #5." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #5." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL HUTANG ---------------------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL SALDO KAS BANK --------------------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 8

        'AMBIL FILTER AKUN KAS BANK
        Dim dtFilter As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT snilai FROM m0_setting WHERE smodule = 0 AND sgrup = 'akun' AND skode = 'KasBankLaporanHarian'", strCon)
        If dtFilter.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            Dim FilterKasBank As String = FxDB(dtFilter.Rows(0)(0), "''")

            sql = ""
            dt = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB("SELECT c.cnama as kode, SUM(t.tdebit-t.tkredit) as total FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_coa c ON t.tnorek = c.cnomor AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND c.cnomor IN(" & FilterKasBank & ") AND t.ttgl <= '" & tglAwal & "' GROUP BY t.tnorek ASC ORDER BY t.tnorek ASC", strCon)
            If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                Dim NoUrut As Double = 1, TotalSaldo As Decimal = 0
                For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows
                    sql &= IIf(Len(sql) > 0, ", ", " VALUES ")
                    'Saldo Akun
                    '                              idlogin, lhgrup,                    lhurutan,                               lhketerangan,                  lhfdn,              lhcussons,               lhsoftex,               lhulipsr,               lhulilmj,                                   lhtotal,                      idmsmq,              lhuserid
                    sql &= " ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "',    '9', '" & FixDouble(NoUrut) & "',  '" & FixQuotes(FxDB(dr("kode"), "")) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(dr("total"), 0)) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "') "

                    TotalSaldo += dr("total")
                    NoUrut += 1
                Next
                sql &= " , ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "',    '9', '" & FixDouble(NoUrut) & "',  'Total', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(TotalSaldo) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "') "
                sql = " INSERT INTO m2r_laporan_harian (idlogin, lhgrup, lhurutan, lhketerangan, lhfdn, lhcussons, lhsoftex, lhulipsr, lhulilmj, lhtotal, idmsmq, lhuserid) " & sql
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed processing #6." : GoTo selesai
                End If

            Else
                GoTo insertKasBankKosong

            End If

        Else

insertKasBankKosong:

            'INSERT TABEL PEMBANTU
            sql = "  INSERT INTO m2r_laporan_harian (idlogin, lhgrup, lhurutan, lhketerangan,           lhfdn,              lhcussons,               lhsoftex,               lhulipsr,               lhulilmj,                lhtotal,                      idmsmq,              lhuserid) "
            'Saldo Akun
            sql &= "     VALUES ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "',    '9',      '1',  '-', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "') "
            'Toal Saldo Akun
            sql &= "          , ('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "',    '9',      '2',  'Total', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "') "
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed processing #6#2." : GoTo selesai
            End If

        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #6." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL SALDO KAS BANK -------------------------------------------------


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_CoverMonth(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN COVER MONTH (STOK / (JML SI BULAN LALU - JML SR BULAN LALU))

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, katBarangAwal(1) As String, katBarangAkhir(2) As String, kodeBarangAwal(3) As String, kodeBarangAkhir(4) As String

        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, katBarangAwal, katBarangAkhir, kodeBarangAwal, kodeBarangAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = ""
        Dim stepKe As Double = 0, totalStep As Double = 4, Prosentase As Double = 100, progressPersen As Double = 0
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder, strMutasi As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", katBarangAwal As String = "", katBarangAkhir As String = "", kodeBarangAwal As String = "", kodeBarangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 5) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "Date required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            result(2) = "Date can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'katBarangAwal(1) As String
        katBarangAwal = dataDetail(1)

        'katBarangAkhir(2) As String
        katBarangAkhir = dataDetail(2)

        'kodeBarangAwal(3) As String
        kodeBarangAwal = dataDetail(3)

        'kodeBarangAkhir(4) As String
        kodeBarangAkhir = dataDetail(4)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()


        'BUAT FILTER BARANG --------------------------------------------------------
        'FILTER KATEGORI BARANG
        If Len(katBarangAwal) > 0 And Len(katBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            'JIKA KAT BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(katBarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(katBarangAkhir) & "' "
        ElseIf Len(katBarangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            'JIKA KAT BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= KAT BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " i.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(katBarangAwal) & "' "
        ElseIf Len(katBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            'JIKA KAT BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= KAT BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(katBarangAkhir) & "' "
        End If

        'FILTER BARANG (KODE)
        If Len(kodeBarangAwal) > 0 And Len(kodeBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " i.bkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kodeBarangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kodeBarangAkhir) & "' "
        ElseIf Len(kodeBarangAwal) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " i.bkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kodeBarangAwal) & "' "
        ElseIf Len(kodeBarangAkhir) > 0 Then
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " i.bkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kodeBarangAkhir) & "' "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER BARANG -------------------------------------------------


        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_stok_covermonth ------------------------------------
        stepKe = 1

        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_stok_covermonth
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_stok_covermonth WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace report data #0." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #1." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_stok_covermonth -----------------------------


        Dim dt As New DataTable


        'AMBIL STOK PERTANGGAL -----------------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 2

        sql = "  INSERT INTO m2r_item_stock_global( "
        sql &= " SELECT i.bid as idbarang, '" & tglAwal & "' as tgl, ROUND(SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE it.jmlbarang * -1 END)),2) as stok, ROUND(SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN it.jmlbarang * it.hpp ELSE it.jmlbarang * it.hpp * -1 END)),2) as nilai "
        sql &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it "
        sql &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 AND it.tgl <= '" & tglAwal & "' "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid AND i.bjenis = 'P' " & Filter
        sql &= " GROUP BY i.bid "
        sql &= " ) "
        sql &= " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stok = VALUES(stok), nilai = VALUES(nilai) "
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed getting item stock #2." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #2." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL STOK PERTANGGAL ----------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL STOK KELUAR BULAN LALU ----------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 3

        sql = "  INSERT INTO m2r_item_stock_out( "
        sql &= " SELECT "
        sql &= " it.idbarang, "
        sql &= " DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%Y') as tahun, "
        sql &= " DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%m') as bulan, "
        sql &= " ROUND(SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN it.jmlbarang ELSE it.jmlbarang * -1 END)),2) as stok "
        sql &= " FROM "
        sql &= " m1_item_transaction it "
        sql &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 AND it.sumber IN('SI','SR') "
        sql &= " AND YEAR(it.tgl) = DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%Y') "
        sql &= " AND MONTH(it.tgl) = DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%m') "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item i ON it.idbarang = i.bid AND i.bjenis = 'P' " & Filter
        sql &= " GROUP BY it.idbarang "
        sql &= " ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stok = VALUES(stok) "
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed getting item stock out #3." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #3." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL STOK KELUAR BULAN LALU ---------------------------------------


        'COVER MONTH ---------------------------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 4

        sql = "  INSERT INTO m2r_stok_covermonth( "
        sql &= " SELECT "
        sql &= " '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, "
        sql &= " i.bid as idbarang, i.bkode as kodebarang, i.bnama as namabarang, i.btipe as tipebarang, i.bkategori as kategori, ic.icnama as kategorinama, '' as gudang, '' as gudangnama, ROUND(isg.stok,2) as stok, i.bsatuan as satuan, i.bsatuan as satuannama, 1 as satuannilai, IFNULL(iso.stok,0) as jmlkeluar, ROUND(isg.nilai,2) as nilai, ROUND((CASE ROUND(isg.stok,2) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(ROUND(isg.stok,2) / ROUND(IFNULL(iso.stok,0),2), ROUND(isg.stok,2)) END),2) as covermonth, "
        sql &= " '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, "
        sql &= " '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as userid, "
        sql &= " '' as customtext1, '' as customtext2, '' as customtext3, '' as customtext4, '' as customtext5, '0' as customint1, '0' as customint2, '0' as customint3, '0' as customint4, '0' as customint5, '0' as customdbl1, '0' as customdbl2, '0' as customdbl3, '0' as customdbl4, '0' as customdbl5, '1900-01-01' as customdate1, '1900-01-01' as customdate2, '1900-01-01' as customdate3, '1900-01-01' as customdate4, '1900-01-01' as customdate5 "
        sql &= " FROM "
        sql &= " m2r_item_stock_global isg "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item i ON isg.idbarang = i.bid AND i.bjenis = 'P' AND isg.tgl = '" & tglAwal & "' " & Filter
        sql &= " JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode "
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m2r_item_stock_out iso ON isg.idbarang = iso.idbarang "
        sql &= " AND iso.tahun = DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%Y') "
        sql &= " AND iso.bulan = DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE('" & tglAwal & "',INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%m') "
        sql &= " ORDER BY i.brekpersediaan, i.bkode "
        sql &= " ) "
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed finishing report #4." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #4." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF COVER MONTH --------------------------------------------------------


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function
