                strReport.Clear()
                strReport.Append(IIf(Len(strReport.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                'Detail 
                'mapping :                      idlogin,                        idmsmq,                 kodebarang,                 namabarang,                   idbarang,                     satuan,                         gudang1,                              jumlah1,                               gudang2,                               jumlah2,                                gudang3,                                jumlah3,                                    gudang4,                    jumlah4,                            gudang5,                                         jumlah5,                                    gudang6,                                   jumlah6,                                gudang7,                                jumlah7,                                 gudang8,                           jumlah8,                                gudang9,                                jumlah9,                                    gudang10,                                   jumlah10                              total                         supplier
                strReport.Append("('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixQuotes(kode) & "', '" & FixQuotes(nama) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idbarang) & "', '" & FixQuotes(satuan) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(gudang1) & "',  '" & FixDouble(FxDB(jumlah1.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(gudang2) & "',  '" & FixDouble(FxDB(jumlah2.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(gudang3) & "',  '" & FixDouble(FxDB(jumlah3.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(gudang4) & "',  '" & FixDouble(FxDB(jumlah4.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(gudang5) & "',  '" & FixDouble(FxDB(jumlah5.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(gudang6) & "',  '" & FixDouble(FxDB(jumlah6.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(gudang7) & "',  '" & FixDouble(FxDB(jumlah7.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(gudang8) & "',  '" & FixDouble(FxDB(jumlah8.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(gudang9) & "',  '" & FixDouble(FxDB(jumlah9.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(gudang10) & "', '" & FixDouble(FxDB(jumlah10.ToString, 0)) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(stokk) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(knama) & "' )")
                'Next 
                If Len(strReport.ToString) > 0 Then
                    'Detail 
                    sqlReportJadi = " insert into m2r_stok(idlogin , idmsmq , kodebarang , namabarang , idbarang , satuan, g1 , j1 , g2 , j2 , g3 , j3, g4 , j4 , g5 , j5 , g6 , j6 , g7 , j7 , g8 , j8 , g9 , j9 , g10 , j10, total, supplier) values " & strReport.ToString & " "
                    'result(2) = sqlReportJadi : GoTo selesai
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlReportJadi, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed proccessing Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If

                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtBarang.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / dtBarang.Rows.Count, 2) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else
            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Inventory Balance , NOTHING ." : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_KomisiLimo(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN KOMISI LIMOPLAST

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, salesmanAwal(2) As String, salesmanAkhir(3) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, salesmanAwal, salesmanAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""
        'Dim isUpdate As Boolean

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = ""
        Dim stepKe As Double = 0, totalStep As Double = 3, Prosentase As Double = 100, progressPersen As Double = 0
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder, strMutasi As New StringBuilder

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", salesmanAwal As String = "", salesmanAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 4) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "Start Date required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            result(2) = "Start Date can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "End Date required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            result(2) = "End Date can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'salesmanAwal(2) As String
        salesmanAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'salesmanAkhir(3) As String
        salesmanAkhir = dataDetail(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()


        'BUAT FILTER SALESMAN ------------------------------------------------------
        'FILTER SALESMAN (KODE)
        If Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 And Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SALESMAN AWAL DAN SALESMAN AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND c.kkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "' "
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SALESMAN AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= SALESMAN AWAL
            Filter &= " AND c.kkode >= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAwal) & "' "
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA SALESMAN AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= SALESMAN AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND c.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(salesmanAkhir) & "' "
        End If
        'END OF BUAT FILTER SALESMAN -----------------------------------------------


        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_komisi_limo ------------------------------------
        stepKe = 1

        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_komisi_limo
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_komisi_limo WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace report data #0." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #1." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_komisi_limo -----------------------------


        Dim dt As New DataTable


        'AMBIL SALES INVOICE ---------------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 2

        sql = "  INSERT INTO m2r_komisi_limo( "
        sql &= " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, "
        sql &= " c.kid, c.kkode, c.knama, si.siid, si.sitgl, si.sinotransaksi, si.sicustomer, c1.kkode as customerkode, c1.knama as customernama, si.sitgljatuhtempo, si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs AS total, IFNULL(pv.pvid, '0') AS pvid, IFNULL(pv.pvtgl, '1900-01-01') AS pvtgl, IFNULL(pv.pvnotransaksi, '') AS pvnotransaksi, "
        sql &= " (CASE IFNULL(pv.pvtgl ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) END) AS jarak, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl < '" & tglAwal & "',pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) AS terbayar, "
        sql &= " (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl < '" & tglAwal & "',pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) AS sisa, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "',pvd.jmlbayar,0 ) END)) AS bayar, "
        sql &= " sc.sckomisi1, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) <= 30,pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) AS 0_30, "
        sql &= " sc.sckomisi2, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) > 30 AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) <= 60, pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) AS 31_60, "
        sql &= " sc.sckomisi3, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) > 60 AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) <= 90,pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) AS 61_90, "
        sql &= " sc.sckomisi4, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) > 90 AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) <= 120,pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) AS 91_120, "
        sql &= " sc.sckomisi5, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) > 120 AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) <= 180,pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) AS 121_180, "
        sql &= " sc.sckomisi6, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) > 180,pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) AS 181_x, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "' AND DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) > 180,(sc.sckomisi6 / 100) * pvd.jmlbayar * (DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, si.sitgl) - 180),0) END)) AS komisi181_x, "
        sql &= " sc.sckomisi7, "
        sql &= " 0 as retur, "
        sql &= " (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "',pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) AS saldo, "
        sql &= " (CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('" & tglAkhir & "', si.sitgl) <= 180 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "',pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) ELSE 0 END) AS saldo0_180, "
        sql &= " (CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('" & tglAkhir & "', si.sitgl) > 180 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi * si.sikurs) - SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "',pvd.jmlbayar,0) END)) ELSE 0 END) AS saldo181_x, "
        sql &= " '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, "
        sql &= " '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as userid, "
        sql &= " '' as customtext1, '' as customtext2, '' as customtext3, '' as customtext4, '' as customtext5, '0' as customint1, '0' as customint2, '0' as customint3, '0' as customint4, '0' as customint5, '0' as customdbl1, '0' as customdbl2, '0' as customdbl3, '0' as customdbl4, '0' as customdbl5, '1900-01-01' as customdate1, '1900-01-01' as customdate2, '1900-01-01' as customdate3, '1900-01-01' as customdate4, '1900-01-01' as customdate5 "
        sql &= " FROM m5_si si "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sibagianpenjualan = c.kid " & Filter
        sql &= " AND si.sistatus IN (2, 3, 4, 7) "
        sql &= " AND si.sitgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_salesman_commission sc ON c.kid = sc.scidkontak "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON si.sicustomer = c1.kid "
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m5_pv_detail pvd ON si.sisumber = pvd.sumber "
        sql &= " AND si.siid = pvd.idtransaksi "
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m5_pv pv ON pvd.idpv = pv.pvid "
        sql &= " AND pv.pvstatus IN (2, 3, 4, 7) "
        sql &= " AND pv.pvtgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' "
        sql &= " GROUP BY si.siid "
        sql &= " HAVING sisa <> 0 "
        sql &= " ORDER BY c.kkode, si.sitgl, si.sinotransaksi, si.siid, pv.pvtgl, pv.pvnotransaksi, pv.pvid, pvd.idpvdetail "
        sql &= " ) "
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed getting sales invoice data #2. - " & sql : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #2." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL SALES INVOICE --------------------------------------------


        'AMBIL SALES RETUR -----------------------------------------------------
        stepKe = 3

        sql = "  INSERT INTO m2r_komisi_limo( "
        sql &= " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, "
        sql &= " c.kid, c.kkode, c.knama, sr.srid, sr.srtgl, sr.srnotransaksi, sr.srcustomer, c1.kkode as customerkode, c1.knama as customernama, sr.srtgljatuhtempo, sr.srtotaltransaksi * sr.srkurs * -1 AS total, IFNULL(pv.pvid, '0') AS pvid, IFNULL(pv.pvtgl, '1900-01-01') AS pvtgl, IFNULL(pv.pvnotransaksi, '') AS pvnotransaksi, "
        sql &= " (CASE IFNULL(pv.pvtgl ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(pv.pvtgl, sr.srtgl) END) AS jarak, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl < '" & tglAwal & "', (pvd.jmlbayar * -1), 0) END)) AS terbayar, "
        sql &= " (sr.srtotaltransaksi * sr.srkurs * -1) - SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl < '" & tglAwal & "', (pvd.jmlbayar * -1), 0) END)) AS sisa, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "', (pvd.jmlbayar * -1), 0) END)) AS bayar, "
        sql &= " sc.sckomisi1, 0 AS 0_30, sc.sckomisi2, 0 AS 31_60, sc.sckomisi3, 0 AS 61_90, sc.sckomisi4, 0 AS 91_120, sc.sckomisi5, 0 AS 121_180, sc.sckomisi6, 0 AS 181_x, 0 AS komisi181_x, sc.sckomisi7, "
        sql &= " SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl BETWEEN '" & tglAwal & "' AND '" & tglAkhir & "', (pvd.jmlbayar * -1), 0) END)) AS retur, "
        sql &= " (sr.srtotaltransaksi * sr.srkurs * -1) - SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "', (pvd.jmlbayar * -1), 0) END)) AS saldo, "
        sql &= " (CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('" & tglAkhir & "', sr.srtgl) <= 180 THEN (sr.srtotaltransaksi * sr.srkurs * -1) - SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "', (pvd.jmlbayar * -1), 0) END)) ELSE 0 END) AS saldo0_180, "
        sql &= " (CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('" & tglAkhir & "', sr.srtgl) > 180 THEN (sr.srtotaltransaksi * sr.srkurs * -1) - SUM((CASE IFNULL(pv.pvid ,- 1) WHEN - 1 THEN 0 ELSE IF (pv.pvtgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "', (pvd.jmlbayar * -1), 0) END)) ELSE 0 END) AS saldo181_x, "
        sql &= " '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as  idmsmq, "
        sql &= " " & FixDouble(userid) & " as userid, "
        sql &= " '' as customtext1, '' as customtext2, '' as customtext3, '' as customtext4, '' as customtext5, '0' as customint1, '0' as customint2, '0' as customint3, '0' as customint4, '0' as customint5, '0' as customdbl1, '0' as customdbl2, '0' as customdbl3, '0' as customdbl4, '0' as customdbl5, '1900-01-01' as customdate1, '1900-01-01' as customdate2, '1900-01-01' as customdate3, '1900-01-01' as customdate4, '1900-01-01' as customdate5 "
        sql &= " FROM m5_sr sr "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_contact c ON sr.srbagianpenjualan = c.kid " & Filter
        sql &= " AND sr.srstatus IN (2, 3, 4, 7) "
        sql &= " AND sr.srtgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_salesman_commission sc ON c.kid = sc.scidkontak "
        sql &= " JOIN m1_contact c1 ON sr.srcustomer = c1.kid "
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m5_pv_detail pvd ON sr.srsumber = pvd.sumber "
        sql &= " AND sr.srid = pvd.idtransaksi "
        sql &= " LEFT JOIN m5_pv pv ON pvd.idpv = pv.pvid "
        sql &= " AND pv.pvstatus IN (2, 3, 4, 7) "
        sql &= " AND pv.pvtgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' "
        sql &= " GROUP BY sr.srid "
        sql &= " HAVING sisa <> 0 "
        sql &= " ORDER BY c.kkode, sr.srtgl, sr.srnotransaksi, sr.srid, pv.pvtgl, pv.pvnotransaksi, pv.pvid, pvd.idpvdetail "
        sql &= " ) "
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed getting item stock out #3." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/TOTAL STEP) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = TOTAL STEP MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = totalStep, Prosentase, (Math.Round(Prosentase / totalStep, 2)) * stepKe)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & idMsmq & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress #3." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF AMBIL SALES RETUR ----------------------------------------------


        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)

        'END OF TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE ======================================================

selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function m0_best_seller_per_store(ByVal param As String) As String

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", FilterSi As String = "", FilterSr As String = "", FilterPv As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", salesmanAwal As String = "", salesmanAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If


        idLogin = paramSplit(0)



        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 4) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(Now)
        End If

        'lokasiAwal(2) As String
        lokasiAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'lokasiAkhir(3) As String
        lokasiAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_top_10_best_seller_per_store WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok -----------------------------------


        'AMBIL LOKASI SESUAI FILTER --------------------------------------------------
        sql = " SELECT l.lkode , l.lnama  "
        sql &= " FROM m1_location l  "


        'FILTER LOKASI (KODE/NAMA)
        'Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
        If Len(lokasiAwal) > 0 And Len(lokasiAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AWAL DAN LOKASI AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " l.lkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= LOKASI AWAL
            Filter &= " l.lkode >= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(salesmanAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA LOKASI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= LOKASI AKHIR
            Filter &= " l.lkode <= '" & FixQuotes(lokasiAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER
        sql &= IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE", Filter), Filter)

        'GROUP BY LOKASI
        sql &= " GROUP BY l.lkode "
        'ORDER BY
        sql &= " ORDER BY l.lkode "


        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = " AND (si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = " AND (si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "') "
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            FilterSi = " AND (si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "') "
        End If

        'END OF BUAT FILTER SI 


        'AMBIL DATA SALESMAN
        Dim dtLokasi As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

        'END OF AMBIL SALESMAN SESUAI FILTER ------------------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        If dtLokasi.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            Dim kodelokasi As String = ""
            Dim sqll As String = ""
            Dim sqlJadi As String = ""

            'PERULANGAN PROSES MUTASI STOK
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtLokasi.Rows

                'SET STEP KE
                stepKe += 1

                'SET IDBARANG, GUDANG
                kodelokasi = dr1("lkode")

                'QUERY ###########################
                sqll = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' As idlogin, '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' AS idmsmq, si.silokasi , l.lnama , b.bkode AS kodebarang , b.bnama AS namabarang , SUM(sid.jml) AS jml , b.bsatuan as satuan, sid.harga , SUM(sid.jml * sid.harga) AS total  "
                sqll &= " FROM m5_si si  "
                sqll &= " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi  "
                sqll &= " JOIN m1_item b ON sid.idbarang = b.bid  "
                sqll &= " JOIN m1_location l ON si.silokasi = l.lkode  "
                sqll &= " WHERE sistatus IN(2,3,4,7) AND l.lkode = '" & FixQuotes(kodelokasi) & "'  " & FilterSi & "  "
                sqll &= " GROUP BY si.silokasi ASC , sid.idbarang ASC "
                sqll &= " ORDER BY si.silokasi ASC , SUM(sid.jml) DESC "
                sqll &= " LIMIT 10"

                'result(2) = sqll : GoTo selesai

                'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
                'SALDO AWAL
                sqlJadi = " INSERT INTO m2r_top_10_best_seller_per_store (" & sqll & ")"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed proccessing Starting Balance Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "lkode", dr1("lkode"), dr1("lnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


                'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
                'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
                progressPersen = IIf(stepKe = dtLokasi.Rows.Count, Prosentase, Math.Round(Prosentase / dtLokasi.Rows.Count, 2) * stepKe)

                'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
                sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
                If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                    result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card  : " & IIf(OrderBy = "lkode", dr1("lkode"), dr1("lnama")) : GoTo selesai
                End If
                'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

            Next

        Else

            'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
            'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
            progressPersen = 100

            'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
            sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
            If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card : " & IIf(OrderBy = "lkode", "Nothing", "Nothing") : GoTo selesai
            End If
            'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 9) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)


        'gudangAwal(4) As String
        gudangAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'gudangAkhir(5) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'orderBy(6) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(6)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(6).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(6).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(6)
        End If

        'noTransaksiAwal(7) As String
        noTransaksiAwal = dataDetail(7)

        'noTransaksiAkhir(8) As String
        noTransaksiAkhir = dataDetail(8)
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_rekap_barang_konsinyasi ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_rekap_barang_konsinyasi
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_rekap_barang_konsinyasi WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_rekap_barang_konsinyasi -----------------------------------


        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "' "
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " AND i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' "
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "' "
        End If

        'FILTER GUDANG
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL DAN GUDANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "' "
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= GUDANG AWAL
            Filter &= " AND it.gudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' "
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= GUDANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND it.gudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "' "
        End If

        ''FILTER NOTRANSAKSI
        'If Len(noTransaksiAwal) > 0 And Len(noTransaksiAkhir) > 0 Then
        '    'JIKA NOTRANSAKSI AWAL DAN NOTRANSAKSI AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
        '    Filter &= " AND it.notransaksi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(noTransaksiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(noTransaksiAkhir) & "' "
        'ElseIf Len(noTransaksiAwal) > 0 Then
        '    'JIKA NOTRANSAKSI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= NOTRANSAKSI AWAL
        '    Filter &= " AND it.notransaksi >= '" & FixQuotes(noTransaksiAwal) & "' "
        'ElseIf Len(noTransaksiAkhir) > 0 Then
        '    'JIKA NOTRANSAKSI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= NOTRANSAKSI AKHIR
        '    Filter &= " AND it.notransaksi <= '" & FixQuotes(noTransaksiAkhir) & "' "
        'End If


        'AMBIL DATA BARANG MASUK (IB, RS, SA MASUK)
        Dim sqlMs As String = "SELECT it.id, it.gudang, it.jenismutasi, it.sumber, it.idutama, it.iddetail, it.notransaksi, it.tgl, it.idbarang, it.namabarang, it.jmlbarang, it.satuanbarang, i.bhargajual1 as harga, 0 as xpenjualan, 0 as xretur, 0 as xpenyesuaian, it.jmlbarang as saldoawal, 0 as penjualan, 0 as retur, 0 as penyesuaian, it.jmlbarang as saldoakhir, 0 as totalpenjualan "
        sqlMs &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it "
        sqlMs &= " JOIN m1_item i "
        sqlMs &= " ON it.idbarang = i.bid "
        sqlMs &= " AND ( (it.sumber = 'RS' AND it.jenismutasi = 1) OR (it.sumber = 'IB' AND it.jenismutasi = 1) OR (it.sumber = 'SA' AND it.jenismutasi = 1) ) "
        sqlMs &= " AND it.tgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' "
        sqlMs &= Filter
        sqlMs &= " ORDER BY it.gudang, it.tgl, it.sumber, it.idutama, it.notransaksi, it.iddetail, it.idbarang"

        Dim dtMasuk As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlMs, strCon)
        If dtMasuk.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            'AMBIL DATA MUTASI BARANG (SI, SR, SA KELUAR)
            Dim sqlMt As String = "SELECT it.id, it.gudang, it.jenismutasi, it.sumber, it.idutama, it.iddetail, it.notransaksi, it.tgl, it.idbarang, it.namabarang, it.jmlbarang, it.satuanbarang "
            sqlMt &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it "
            sqlMt &= " JOIN m1_item i "
            sqlMt &= " ON it.idbarang = i.bid "
            sqlMt &= " AND ( (it.sumber = 'SI' AND it.jenismutasi = 0) OR (it.sumber = 'SR' AND it.jenismutasi = 1) OR (it.sumber = 'SA' AND it.jenismutasi = 0) ) "
            sqlMt &= " AND it.tgl <= '" & tglAkhir & "' "
            sqlMt &= Filter
            sqlMt &= " ORDER BY it.gudang, it.tgl, it.sumber, it.idutama, it.notransaksi, it.iddetail, it.idbarang "

            Dim dtMutasi As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlMt, strCon)
            If dtMutasi.Rows.Count > 0 Then

                Dim mtGudang As String = "", mtJenismutasi As String = 0, mtSumber As String = "", mtIdbarang As String = 0
                Dim mtJmlbarang As Double = 0, mtTgl As String = "1900-01-01"
                Dim dtFilter As New DataTable

                Dim msxPenjualan As Double = 0, msxRetur As Double = 0, msxPenyesuaian As Double = 0
                Dim msSaldoAwal As Double = 0, msPenjualan As Double = 0, msRetur As Double = 0, msHarga As Double = 0
                Dim msPenyesuaian As Double = 0, msSaldoAkhir As Double = 0, msTotalPenjualan As Double = 0
                Dim msId As String = 0, msJmlbarang As Double = 0

                Dim msxPenjualanMinRetur As Double = 0, msPenjualanMinRetur As Double = 0

                'PERULANGAN SEBANYAK DATA MUTASI
                For Each mt As DataRow In dtMutasi.Rows

                    mtGudang = mt("gudang") : mtJenismutasi = mt("jenismutasi") : mtSumber = mt("sumber")
                    mtIdbarang = mt("idbarang") : mtJmlbarang = Double.Parse(mt("jmlbarang"))
                    mtTgl = AsFormatTanggal(mt("tgl"))

                    If mtSumber = "SR" Then
                        'JIKA MUTASI SR MAKA AMBIL DATA TANPA FILTER SALDO
                        dtFilter = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtMasuk, "gudang = '" & mtGudang & "' AND idbarang = '" & mtIdbarang & "'", "gudang, tgl, sumber, idutama, notransaksi, iddetail, idbarang")
                    Else
                        'JIKA BUKA SR MAKA AMBIL DATA YANG SALDONYA MASIH ADA
                        dtFilter = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtMasuk, "gudang = '" & mtGudang & "' AND idbarang = '" & mtIdbarang & "' AND saldoakhir > 0", "gudang, tgl, sumber, idutama, notransaksi, iddetail, idbarang")
                    End If

                    If dtFilter.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                        'PERULANGAN SEBANYAK DATA BARANG MASUK, EXT FOR JIKA JML MUTASI SUDAH TERPENUHI
                        For Each ms As DataRow In dtFilter.Rows

                            msId = ms("id") : msJmlbarang = ms("jmlbarang")

                            msxPenjualan = Double.Parse(ms("xpenjualan")) : msxRetur = Double.Parse(ms("xretur"))
                            msxPenyesuaian = Double.Parse(ms("xpenyesuaian"))

                            msSaldoAwal = Double.Parse(ms("saldoawal")) : msPenjualan = Double.Parse(ms("penjualan"))
                            msRetur = Double.Parse(ms("retur")) : msPenyesuaian = Double.Parse(ms("penyesuaian"))
                            msSaldoAkhir = Double.Parse(ms("saldoakhir")) : msHarga = Double.Parse(ms("harga"))


                            'JIKA TGL MUTASI < TGL AWAL --> MAKA IKUT KOLOM SEBELUM SALDO AWAL
                            If mtTgl < tglAwal Then
                                If mtSumber = "SI" Then
                                    If msSaldoAwal < mtJmlbarang Then
                                        msxPenjualan = msxPenjualan + msSaldoAwal
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - msSaldoAwal
                                    Else
                                        msxPenjualan = msxPenjualan + mtJmlbarang
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - mtJmlbarang
                                    End If

                                ElseIf mtSumber = "SA" Then
                                    If msSaldoAwal < mtJmlbarang Then
                                        msxPenyesuaian = msxPenyesuaian + msSaldoAwal
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - msSaldoAwal
                                    Else
                                        msxPenyesuaian = msxPenyesuaian + mtJmlbarang
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - mtJmlbarang
                                    End If

                                ElseIf mtSumber = "SR" Then
                                    msxPenjualanMinRetur = msxPenjualan - msxRetur
                                    If msxPenjualanMinRetur < mtJmlbarang Then
                                        msxRetur = msxRetur + msxPenjualanMinRetur
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - msxPenjualanMinRetur
                                    Else
                                        msxRetur = msxRetur + mtJmlbarang
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - mtJmlbarang
                                    End If

                                End If


                                'JIKA TGL MUTASI BETWEEN TGLAWAL DAN TGLAKHIR --> MAKA IKUT KOLOM MUTASI
                            Else
                                If mtSumber = "SI" Then
                                    If msSaldoAkhir < mtJmlbarang Then
                                        msPenjualan = msPenjualan + msSaldoAkhir
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - msSaldoAkhir
                                    Else
                                        msPenjualan = msPenjualan + mtJmlbarang
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - mtJmlbarang
                                    End If

                                ElseIf mtSumber = "SA" Then
                                    If msSaldoAkhir < mtJmlbarang Then
                                        msPenyesuaian = msPenyesuaian + msSaldoAkhir
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - msSaldoAkhir
                                    Else
                                        msPenyesuaian = msPenyesuaian + mtJmlbarang
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - mtJmlbarang
                                    End If

                                ElseIf mtSumber = "SR" Then
                                    msPenjualanMinRetur = msPenjualan - msRetur
                                    If msPenjualanMinRetur < mtJmlbarang Then
                                        msRetur = msRetur + msPenjualanMinRetur
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - msPenjualanMinRetur
                                    Else
                                        msRetur = msRetur + mtJmlbarang
                                        mtJmlbarang = mtJmlbarang - mtJmlbarang
                                    End If

                                End If

                            End If

                            'HITUNG SALDO
                            msSaldoAwal = msJmlbarang - msxPenjualan + msxRetur - msxPenyesuaian
                            msSaldoAkhir = msSaldoAwal - msPenjualan + msRetur - msPenyesuaian
                            msTotalPenjualan = msPenjualan * msHarga

                            ''UPDATE DATA BARANG MASUK
                            AsDataTableUpdateData(dtMasuk, "id = '" & msId & "'", "xpenjualan~xretur~xpenyesuaian~saldoawal~penjualan~retur~penyesuaian~saldoakhir~totalpenjualan", msxPenjualan & "~" & msxRetur & "~" & msxPenyesuaian & "~" & msSaldoAwal & "~" & msPenjualan & "~" & msRetur & "~" & msPenyesuaian & "~" & msSaldoAkhir & "~" & msTotalPenjualan)

                            If mtJmlbarang = 0 Then
                                Exit For
                            End If

                        Next

                    End If

                Next

            End If

            'FILTER DATA BARANG MASUK
            Dim ftJadi As String = "(saldoawal <> 0 OR penjualan <> 0 OR retur <> 0 OR penyesuaian <> 0 OR saldoakhir <> 0) "
            'FILTER NOTRANSAKSI
            If Len(noTransaksiAwal) > 0 And Len(noTransaksiAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA NOTRANSAKSI AWAL DAN NOTRANSAKSI AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
                ftJadi &= " AND notransaksi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(noTransaksiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(noTransaksiAkhir) & "' "
            ElseIf Len(noTransaksiAwal) > 0 Then
                'JIKA NOTRANSAKSI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= NOTRANSAKSI AWAL
                ftJadi &= " AND notransaksi >= '" & FixQuotes(noTransaksiAwal) & "' "
            ElseIf Len(noTransaksiAkhir) > 0 Then
                'JIKA NOTRANSAKSI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= NOTRANSAKSI AKHIR
                ftJadi &= " AND notransaksi <= '" & FixQuotes(noTransaksiAkhir) & "' "
            End If

            Dim dtJadi As DataTable = AsDataTableFilterSortDt(dtMasuk, ftJadi, "gudang, tgl, sumber, idutama, notransaksi, iddetail, idbarang")
            If dtJadi.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                'BUAT QUERY INSERT
                For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtJadi.Rows
                    strValue.Append(IIf(Len(strValue.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'mapping :                       idlogin,            rbknourut,                          rbkid,                             rbkgudang,                          rbkjenismutasi,                          rbksumber,                          rbkidutama,                          rbkiddetail,                          rbknotransaksi,                                          rbktgl,                           rbkidbarang,                          rbknamabarang,                          rbkjmlbarang,                          rbksatuanbarang,                          rbkharga,                          rbkxpenjualan,                          rbkxretur,                          rbkxpenyesuaian,                          rbksaldoawal,                          rbkpenjualan,                          rbkretur,                          rbkpenyesuaian,                          rbksaldoakhir,                          rbktotalpenjualan,                     idmsmq,                      rbkuserid,             rbkcustomtext1,          rbkcustomtext2,          rbkcustomtext3,          rbkcustomtext4,          rbkcustomtext5,     rbkcustomint1,        rbkcustomint2,        rbkcustomint3,        rbkcustomint4,        rbkcustomint5,         rbkcustomdbl1,          rbkcustomdbl2,          rbkcustomdbl3,          rbkcustomdbl4,          rbkcustomdbl5,                                     rbkcustomdate1,                                     rbkcustomdate2,                                     rbkcustomdate3,                                     rbkcustomdate4,                                     rbkcustomdate5
                    strValue.Append("('" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("id")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("gudang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("jenismutasi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("sumber")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("idutama")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("iddetail")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("notransaksi")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(dr1("tgl"))) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("idbarang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("namabarang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("jmlbarang")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(dr1("satuanbarang")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("harga")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("xpenjualan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("xretur")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("xpenyesuaian")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("saldoawal")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("penjualan")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("retur")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("penyesuaian")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("saldoakhir")) & "', '" & FixDouble(dr1("totalpenjualan")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "', '" & FixDouble(userid) & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', '" & FixQuotes("") & "', " & FixDouble(0) & ", " & FixDouble(0) & ", " & FixDouble(0) & ", " & FixDouble(0) & ", " & FixDouble(0) & ", '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixDouble(0) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "', '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")) & "')")
                Next

                'SIMPAN KE TABEL PENAMPUNG REPORT
                If Len(strValue.ToString) > 0 Then
                    sql = "Insert into m2r_rekap_barang_konsinyasi(idlogin, rbknourut, rbkid, rbkgudang, rbkjenismutasi, rbksumber, rbkidutama, rbkiddetail, rbknotransaksi, rbktgl, rbkidbarang, rbknamabarang, rbkjmlbarang, rbksatuanbarang, rbkharga, rbkxpenjualan, rbkxretur, rbkxpenyesuaian, rbksaldoawal, rbkpenjualan, rbkretur, rbkpenyesuaian, rbksaldoakhir, rbktotalpenjualan, idmsmq, rbkuserid, rbkcustomtext1, rbkcustomtext2, rbkcustomtext3, rbkcustomtext4, rbkcustomtext5, rbkcustomint1, rbkcustomint2, rbkcustomint3, rbkcustomint4, rbkcustomint5, rbkcustomdbl1, rbkcustomdbl2, rbkcustomdbl3, rbkcustomdbl4, rbkcustomdbl5, rbkcustomdate1, rbkcustomdate2, rbkcustomdate3, rbkcustomdate4, rbkcustomdate5) values" & strValue.ToString & ""
                    If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
                        result(2) = "Failed processing report." : GoTo selesai
                    End If
                End If
            End If

        End If


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS (100/JML DATA CUSTOMER) * stepKe, JIKA STEP = JML BARANG MAKA PROGRESS = PROSENTASE
        progressPersen = 100

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Report." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================



        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_StockCoverWeek(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN STOCK COVER WEEK

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, kategoriAwal(5) As String, kategoriAkhir(6) As String, 
        'gudangAwal(7) As String, gudangAkhir(8) As String, vSatuan(9) As Integer, vPergudang(10) As Integer

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir,
        'orderBy, kategoriAwal, kategoriAkhir, 
        'gudangAwal, gudangAkhir, vSatuan, vPergudang

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100

        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""
        Dim kategoriAwal As String = "", kategoriAkhir As String = "", gudangAwal As String = "", gudangAkhir As String = ""
        Dim vSatuan As Integer = 0, vPergudang As Integer = 0

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT

        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================

            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 11) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================
        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(1) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'barangAwal(2) As String
        barangAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'barangAkhir(3) As String
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'orderBy(4) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(4)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "orderBy can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        ElseIf dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bkode" And dataDetail(4).ToString <> "bnama" Then
            result(2) = "Invalid orderBy criteria." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            orderBy = dataDetail(4)
        End If

        'kategoriAwal(5) As String
        kategoriAwal = dataDetail(5)

        'kategoriAkhir(6) As String
        kategoriAkhir = dataDetail(6)

        'gudangAwal(7) As String
        gudangAwal = dataDetail(7)

        'gudangAkhir(8) As String
        gudangAkhir = dataDetail(8)

        'vSatuan(9) As Integer
        If dataDetail(9) = 1 Then
            vSatuan = dataDetail(9)
        End If

        'vPergudang(10) As Integer
        If dataDetail(10) = 1 Then
            vPergudang = dataDetail(10)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        'Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            Filter &= " AND i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER KATEGORI
        'Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
        If Len(kategoriAwal) > 0 And Len(kategoriAkhir) > 0 Then
