            Filter &= " AND i.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kategoriAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kategoriAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= KATEGORI AWAL
            Filter &= " AND i.bkategori  >= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA KATEGORI AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= KATEGORI AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND i.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER GUDANG
        'Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND"), Filter)
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL DAN GUDANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            Filter &= " AND it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= GUDANG AWAL
            Filter &= " AND it.gudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= GUDANG AKHIR
            Filter &= " AND it.gudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_stok_coverweek ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI m2r_stok_coverweek
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_stok_coverweek WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_stok_coverweek -----------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ----------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlJadi As String = ""
        Dim vJmlhari As Double = DateDiff(DateInterval.Day, Date.Parse(tglAwal), Date.Parse("2016-09-30"))
        Dim vJmlPekan As Double = vJmlhari / 7

        sqlJadi = "  INSERT INTO m2r_stok_coverweek ( "
        sqlJadi &= "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, "
        sqlJadi &= " '" & FixDouble(vJmlhari) & "' as scjmlhari, "
        sqlJadi &= " '" & FixDouble(vJmlPekan) & "' as scjmlpekan, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vPergudang) & " WHEN 0 THEN '' ELSE it.gudang END) as scgudang, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vPergudang) & " WHEN 0 THEN '' ELSE w.wnama END) as scgudangnama, "
        sqlJadi &= " i.bkategori as sckategoribarang, ic.icnama as sckategoribarangnama, it.idbarang as scidbarang, i.bkode as sckodebarang, i.bnama as scnamabarang, i.btipe as sctipebarang, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN i.bsatuan ELSE i.bsatuandefault END) as scsatuan, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN u1.unama ELSE u2.unama END) as scsatuannama, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN u1.unilai ELSE u2.unilai END) as scsatuannilai, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN i.bhargajual1 ELSE i.bhargajual1 * u2.unilai END) as schargajual, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN i.bhargabeli / u2.unilai ELSE i.bhargabeli END) as schargabeli, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL( SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN (it.jmlbarang) ELSE (it.jmlbarang * -1) END)) ,0) ELSE IFNULL( SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN (it.jmlbarang) / u2.unilai ELSE (it.jmlbarang * -1) / u2.unilai END)) ,0) END) as scjmljual, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL( SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN (it.jmlbarang) ELSE (it.jmlbarang * -1) END)) / " & FixDouble(vJmlPekan) & " ,0) ELSE IFNULL( SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN (it.jmlbarang) / u2.unilai ELSE (it.jmlbarang * -1) / u2.unilai END)) / " & FixDouble(vJmlPekan) & " ,0) END) as scjmljualpekan, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN i.bstok ELSE i.bstok / u2.unilai END) as scstok, "
        sqlJadi &= " IFNULL( (i.bstok) / (SUM((CASE it.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN (it.jmlbarang) ELSE (it.jmlbarang * -1) END)) / " & FixDouble(vJmlPekan) & ") ,0) as sccover, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN i.bstok ELSE i.bstok / u2.unilai END) * (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN i.bhargajual1 ELSE i.bhargajual1 * u2.unilai END) as scnilaijual, "
        sqlJadi &= " (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN i.bstok ELSE i.bstok / u2.unilai END) * (CASE " & FixDouble(vSatuan) & " WHEN 0 THEN i.bhargabeli / u2.unilai ELSE i.bhargabeli END) as scnilaibeli, "
        sqlJadi &= " '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "' as idmsmq, "
        sqlJadi &= " '" & FixDouble(userid) & "' as scuserid, "
        sqlJadi &= " '' as sccustomtext1, '' as sccustomtext2, '' as sccustomtext3, '' as sccustomtext4, '' as sccustomtext5, '0' as sccustomint1, '0' as sccustomint2, '0' as sccustomint3, '0' as sccustomint4, '0' as sccustomint5, '0' as sccustomdbl1, '0' as sccustomdbl2, '0' as sccustomdbl3, '0' as sccustomdbl4, '0' as sccustomdbl5, '1900-01-01' as sccustomdate1, '1900-01-01' as sccustomdate2, '1900-01-01' as sccustomdate3, '1900-01-01' as sccustomdate4, '1900-01-01' as sccustomdate5 "
        sqlJadi &= " FROM m1_item_transaction it "
        sqlJadi &= " JOIN m1_item i  ON it.idbarang = i.bid AND it.sumber IN('SI','SR') "
        sqlJadi &= " JOIN m1_warehouse w ON it.gudang = w.wkode "
        sqlJadi &= " JOIN m1_unit u1 ON i.bsatuan = u1.ukode "
        sqlJadi &= " JOIN m1_unit u2 ON i.bsatuandefault = u2.ukode "
        sqlJadi &= " JOIN m1_item_category ic ON i.bkategori = ic.ickode "
        sqlJadi &= " GROUP BY (CASE " & FixDouble(vPergudang) & " WHEN 0 THEN i.bid ELSE it.gudang END), i.bid "
        sqlJadi &= " ORDER BY (CASE " & FixDouble(vPergudang) & " WHEN 0 THEN i.bkategori ELSE it.gudang END), i.bkategori, i." & orderBy & " "
        sqlJadi &= " )"

        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlJadi, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed proccessing report data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
        progressPersen = 100

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

        'kategoriAkhir (5) As String 
        kategoriAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'barangAwal(6) As String 
        barangAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'barangAkhir(7) As String 
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(7)


        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ m2r_penjualan
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_barcode WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Inventory Balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan -----------------------------------


        'PROSES SELECT DATA LP CETAK LABEL ----------------------------------------------
        Dim sqlPL As String = "", sqlPLjadi As String = ""

        'QUERY sqlLP ###############################

        sqlPL = "  SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as userid , "
        sqlPL += " lpd.idbarang , 	lp.lptgl , lp.lpnotransaksi,  	MONTH(lp.lptgl) bulan , "
        sqlPL += " CASE MONTH(lp.lptgl) WHEN 1 THEN 'A'	WHEN 2 THEN 'B' 	WHEN 3 THEN 'C' 	WHEN 4 THEN 'D' 	WHEN 5 THEN 'E' 	WHEN 6 THEN 'F'  "
        sqlPL += " WHEN 7 THEN 'G' 	WHEN 8 THEN 'H' 	WHEN 9 THEN 'I' 	WHEN 10 THEN 'J' 	WHEN 11 THEN 'K' 	WHEN 12 THEN 'L' END AS bulann ,  "
        sqlPL += " RIGHT(YEAR(lp.lptgl),2) as rightt , merk.mnama as merk , b.bkode , c.cnama AS warna , b.bnama AS namabarang , lpd.hargajual1 as hargabeli, lpd.customdbl1 as cstmdbl, dv.dnama as divisi   "
        sqlPL += " FROM m_12_lp lp "
        sqlPL += " JOIN m_12_lp_detail lpd ON lp.lpid = lpd.idlp "
        sqlPL += " JOIN m1_item b ON lpd.idbarang = b.bid "
        sqlPL += " LEFT JOIN m1_merk merk ON b.bamerk = merk.mkode "
        sqlPL += " LEFT JOIN m1_color c ON b.bawarna = c.ckode "
        sqlPL += " LEFT JOIN m1_division dv ON b.bdivisi = dv.dkode "


        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " lp.lptgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " lp.lptgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " lp.lptgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER NO TRANSAKSI
        If Len(notransaksiAwal) > 0 And Len(notransaksiAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " lp.lpnotransaksi BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(notransaksiAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(notransaksiAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(notransaksiAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " lp.lpnotransaksi >= '" & FixQuotes(notransaksiAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(notransaksiAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " lp.lpnotransaksi <= '" & FixQuotes(notransaksiAkhir) & "'"
        End If


        'FILTER KATEGORI BARANG
        If Len(kategoriAwal) > 0 And Len(kategoriAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " b.bkategori BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kategoriAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kategoriAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " b.bkategori >= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kategoriAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " b.bkategori <= '" & FixQuotes(kategoriAkhir) & "'"
        End If


        'FILTER KODE BARANG
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " b.bkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= TGL AWAL 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " b.bkode >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= TGL AKHIR
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " b.bkode <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER 
        sqlPL += IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filter), Filter)

        sqlPL += " ORDER BY lpd.idlpdetail   "
        'result(2) = sqlPL : GoTo selesai

        Dim dtPL As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlPL, strCon)
        'result(2) = dtPL.Rows.Count : GoTo selesai
        Dim strInsert As New StringBuilder

        'INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU #########################
        If dtPL.Rows.Count > 0 Then

            For Each drPL As DataRow In dtPL.Rows

                Dim sctmdbll As Integer = drPL("cstmdbl")
                For i = 0 To sctmdbll - 1
                    strInsert.Clear()
                    strInsert.Append(IIf(Len(strInsert.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))
                    'mapping :                              idlogin,                               idmsmq,                                userid ,                              idbarang ,                                         lptgl ,                             lpnotransaksi,                               bulan ,                              bulann ,                              rightt ,                              merk ,                              bkode ,                              warna ,                               namabarang ,                            hargabeli ,                                 cstmdbl                               divisi
                    strInsert.Append("('" & FixQuotes(drPL("idlogin")) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(drPL("idmsmq")) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(drPL("userid")) & "' , '" & FixDouble(drPL("idbarang")) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(AsFormatTanggal(drPL("lptgl"))) & "',  '" & FixQuotes(drPL("lpnotransaksi")) & "' ,'" & FixQuotes(drPL("bulan")) & "' , '" & FixQuotes(drPL("bulann")) & "' , '" & FixDouble(drPL("rightt")) & "' ,  '" & FxDB(drPL("merk"), "") & "' ,  '" & FixQuotes(drPL("bkode")) & "' , '" & FxDB(drPL("warna"), "") & "' ,  '" & FixQuotes(drPL("namabarang")) & "' ,  '" & FixDouble(drPL("hargabeli")) & "' , '" & FixDouble(drPL("cstmdbl")) & "', '" & FixDouble(drPL("divisi")) & "'  )")

                    If Len(strInsert.ToString) > 0 Then
                        sqlPLjadi = " Insert into m2r_barcode (idlogin, idmsmq, userid , idbarang , lptgl , lpnotransaksi, bulan , bulann ,  rightt ,  merk , bkode , warna ,  namabarang ,hargabeli , cstmdbl, divisi) values" & strInsert.ToString & ""
                        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlPLjadi, strCon) = False Then
                            'result(2) = "Failed proccessing Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
                            result(2) = sqlPLjadi : GoTo selesai
                        End If
                    End If
                Next
            Next
        End If
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------





        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
        progressPersen = 100

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai

        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

    Public Function M0_label_barcode2(ByVal param As String) As String
        '//LAPORAN NILAI PERSEDIAAN PERTANGGAL

        'MAPPING BUAT WS ----------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer, MenuName(1) As String, Query(2) As String, FileFormat(3) As Integer, Param1(4) As String, 
        'Param2(5) As String, Param3(6) As String, Param4(7) As String, Param5(8) As String, namaPerusahaan(9) As String, 
        'namaReport(10) As String, rp2(11) As String, rp3(12) As String, rp4(13) As String, rp5(14) As String, idMsmq(15) As String

        'Detail
        'tglAwal(0) As String, tglAkhir(1) As String, barangAwal(2) As String, barangAkhir(3) As String,
        'orderBy(4) As String, gudangAwal(5) As String, gudangAkhir(6) As String

        'MAPPING BUAT FLEX --------------------------------------------------------
        'Utama
        'ModuleId, MenuName, Query, FileFormat, Param1, 
        'Param2, Param3, Param4, Param5, namaPerusahaan, 
        'namaReport, rp2, rp3, rp4, rp5, idMsmq

        'Detail
        'tglAwal, tglAkhir, barangAwal, barangAkhir, 
        'orderBy, gudangAwal, gudangAkhir

        Dim paramSplit(6) As String     'WebsiteAccessKey(0), paket(1), paging(2), userid(3), isUpdate(4), data(5)
        Dim pagingSplit(6) As String    'pageNumber(0), itemLimit(1), strFilter(2), strSort(3), formatTgl(4), formatTglWaktu(5)
        Dim dataSplit(), dataUtama(), dataDetail() As String

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)
        Dim resultPaging(5) As String   'ispaging(0), isNext(1), isPrev(2), countPage(3), countRow(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""
        Dim strResult, strResultPaging, strResultData As String

        Dim sql As String = "", notransaksi As String = "", formatTgl As String = "", formatTglWaktu As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim FilterBarang As String = "", FilterGudang As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        'Dim strValue As New StringBuilder, strInsert As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0, counter As Double = 0, batasCounter As Double = 1000

        'VARIABLE FUNGSI REPORT
        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", barangAwal As String = "", barangAkhir As String = "", orderBy As String = ""
        Dim gudangAwal As String = "", gudangAkhir As String = ""

        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method
        result(1) = 0 : result(2) = "" : result(3) = 0 : result(4) = 0

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================


        'VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY =========================================================
        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "WebsiteAccessKey can't be empty." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        ''Cek apakah WebsiteAccessKey valid
        'Dim ClsValidKey As New ClsSecurity
        'Dim validKey As RsValidKey
        'validKey = ClsValidKey.ValidateKey(paramSplit(0))
        'If Not validKey.success Then result(2) = validKey.errmessage : GoTo selesai

        'SET IDLOGIN = WEBSITE ACCESS KEY
        idLogin = paramSplit(0)

        ''///Validasi Hak akses. Cek ModuleID dan MenuID
        'If ClsValidKey.ApaBisaAkses(1, 1, 1) = False Then
        '    result(2) = "Access denied for insert/update data"
        'End If
        'END OF VALIDASI WEBSITEACCESSKEY ==================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ===========================================================
        'CEK USERID
        If (IsNumeric(paramSplit(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String
        MenuName = dataUtama(1)

        'Query(2) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(2)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "Query can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            Query = dataUtama(2)
        End If

        'FileFormat(3) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(3)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "FileFormat required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)
        End If

        'Param1(4) As String
        Param1 = dataUtama(4)

        'Param2(5) As String
        Param2 = dataUtama(5)

        'Param3(6) As String
        Param3 = dataUtama(6)

        'Param4(7) As String
        Param4 = dataUtama(7)

        'Param5(8) As String
        Param5 = dataUtama(8)

        'namaPerusahaan(9) As String 
        namaPerusahaan = dataUtama(9)

        'namaReport(10) As String
        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        'rp2(11) As String
        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String
        rp3 = dataUtama(12)

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

        'rp5(14) As String
        rp5 = dataUtama(14)

        'idMsmq(15) As String
        If Len(dataUtama(15)) = 0 Then
            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else
            idMsmq = dataUtama(15)
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ======================================================
        dataDetail = dataSplit(1).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA DETAIL

        'CEK ARRAY DATA DETAIL 
        If (dataDetail.Length <> 8) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid detail transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA DETAIL ===============================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL =========================================================

        'tglAwal(0) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(0)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(2) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAkhir required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(1))
            End If
        Else
            tglAkhir = AsFormatTanggal("2100-12-31")
        End If

        'notransaksiAwal(2) As String
        notransaksiAwal = dataDetail(2)

        'notransaksiAkhir(3) As String
        notransaksiAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'kategoriAwal(4) As String 
        kategoriAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'kategoriAkhir (5) As String 
        kategoriAkhir = dataDetail(5)

        'barangAwal(6) As String 
        barangAwal = dataDetail(6)

        'barangAkhir(7) As String 
        barangAkhir = dataDetail(7)


        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================


        'TRANSAKSI KE DATABASE =============================================================
        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ DI M2r_Kartu_Stok
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_barcode WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Stock Card data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA M2r_Kartu_Stok -----------------------------------


        'FILTER BARANG (KODE/NAMA)
        If Len(barangAwal) > 0 And Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL DAN BARANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= BARANG AWAL
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " >= '" & FixQuotes(barangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(barangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA BARANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= BARANG AKHIR
            FilterBarang = IIf(Len(FilterBarang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterBarang, " AND "), FilterBarang)
            FilterBarang &= " i." & FixQuotes(orderBy) & " <= '" & FixQuotes(barangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        If Len(FilterBarang) > 0 Then
            FilterBarang = " AND " & FilterBarang
        End If

        'FILTER GUDANG
        If Len(gudangAwal) > 0 And Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL DAN GUDANG AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN
            FilterGudang = IIf(Len(FilterGudang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterGudang, " AND "), FilterGudang)
            FilterGudang &= " it.gudang BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER >= GUDANG AWAL
            FilterGudang = IIf(Len(FilterGudang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterGudang, " AND "), FilterGudang)
            FilterGudang &= " it.gudang >= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(gudangAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA GUDANG AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA FILTER <= GUDANG AKHIR
            FilterGudang = IIf(Len(FilterGudang) > 0, String.Concat(FilterGudang, " AND "), FilterGudang)
            FilterGudang &= " it.gudang <= '" & FixQuotes(gudangAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        If Len(FilterGudang) > 0 Then
            FilterGudang = " AND " & FilterGudang
        End If

        'AMBIL SALDO AWAL HPP
        Dim sqlHppSa As String = "", sqlSAJadi As String = ""
        sqlHppSa = "  SELECT i.bid, (CASE IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang * hpp ELSE jmlbarang * hpp * (-1) END)),0)) / (IFNULL(SUM((CASE jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN jmlbarang ELSE jmlbarang * (-1) END)),0)) END ) as kssaldohpp "
        sqlHppSa &= " FROM m1_item i "
        sqlHppSa &= " JOIN m1_item_transaction it ON i.bid = it.idbarang AND it.tgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' " & FilterBarang
        sqlHppSa &= " JOIN m0_nomor n ON it.sumber = n.kodetabel AND n.transaksihpp = 1 "
        sqlHppSa &= " GROUP BY i.bid "
        Dim dtHppSa As DataTable = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sqlHppSa, strCon)

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        progressPersen = 10 : stepKe = 1
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed updating progress Data Stock Card " & stepKe : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'INSERT DATA SALDO AWAL HPP KE TABEL PEMBANTU
        If dtHppSa.Rows.Count > 0 Then
            Dim strHppSa As New StringBuilder : counter = 0
            For Each dr1 As DataRow In dtHppSa.Rows

                counter += 1
                strHppSa.Append(IIf(Len(strHppSa.ToString) = 0, "", ", "))

                'mapping :                       idmsmq,                                bid,                                       kssaldohpp

        Dim result(5) As String         'target(0), success(1), errmessage(2), errstep(3), idtransaksi(4)

        Dim wsResult As String = ""

        Dim pg1 As New RsPaging
        Dim search As String = ""
        Dim Filter As String = "", Filterr As String = "", Sorting As String = "", GroupBy As String = "", stepKe As Double = 0, Prosentase As Double = 100
        Dim strValue As New StringBuilder
        Dim progressPersen As Double = 0

        Dim idLogin As String = ""
        Dim ModuleId As Integer = 0, MenuName As String = "", Query As String = "", FileFormat As Integer = 0, Param1 As String = ""
        Dim Param2 As String = "", Param3 As String = "", Param4 As String = "", Param5 As String = "", namaPerusahaan As String = ""
        Dim namaReport As String = "", rp2 As String = "", rp3 As String = "", rp4 As String = "", rp5 As String = "", idMsmq As String = ""
        Dim sumber As String = "", tglAwal As String = "", tglAkhir As String = "", kontakAwal As String = "", kontakAkhir As String = ""


        'SET DEFAULT RESULT
        result(0) = System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name 'Mengambil nama method

        'SET DEFAULT PAGING
        resultPaging(0) = 0 : resultPaging(1) = 0 : resultPaging(2) = 0 : resultPaging(3) = 0 : resultPaging(4) = 0

        'VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL =========================================================
        'SPILIT PARAM
        paramSplit = param.Split(sptParam)

        'CEK ARRAY PARAM
        If (paramSplit.Length <> 6) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI PARAMETER GLOBAL ==================================================

        If Len(paramSplit(0)) = 0 Then

        End If

            result(2) = "userid required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        End If

        'SET USERID
        userid = paramSplit(3)
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET USERID ====================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA =============================================================
        dataSplit = paramSplit(5).Split(sptSubParam)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA
        If (dataSplit.Length <> 2) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA ======================================================


        'VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA =======================================================
        dataUtama = dataSplit(0).Split(sptField)    'SPLIT PARAMETER DATA UTAMA

        'CEK ARRAY DATA UTAMA
        If (dataUtama.Length <> 16) Then
            result(2) = "Invalid main transaction data parameter." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI DAN SET DATA UTAMA ================================================


        'VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ==========================================================
        'ModuleId(0) As Integer
        If (IsNumeric(dataUtama(0)) = False) Then
            result(2) = "ModuleId required numeric." : GoTo selesai
        Else
            ModuleId = dataUtama(0)
        End If

        'MenuName(1) As String

            Query = dataUtama(2)

            FileFormat = dataUtama(3)

        namaReport = dataUtama(10)

        rp2 = dataUtama(11)

        'rp3(12) As String

        'rp4(13) As String
        rp4 = dataUtama(13)

            result(2) = "idMsmq can't be empty" : GoTo selesai
        Else

        End If
        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA UTAMA ===================================================

            If (IsDate(dataDetail(0)) = False) Then
                result(2) = "tglAwal required date." : GoTo selesai
            Else
                tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal(dataDetail(0))
            End If
        Else
            tglAwal = AsFormatTanggal("1900-01-01")
        End If

        'tglAkhir(2) As String
        If Len(dataDetail(1)) > 0 Then
            If (IsDate(dataDetail(1)) = False) Then

            End If

        'kontakAkhir(3) As String
        kontakAkhir = dataDetail(3)

        'kotaAwal(4) As String
        kotaAwal = dataDetail(4)

        'kotaAkhir(5) As String

        'END OF VALIDASI TIPE DATA DETAIL ==================================================

        Con1 = New MySql.Data.MySqlClient.MySqlConnection(strCon)
        Con1.Open()

        'HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan ------------------------------------------
        'HAPUS DATA BERDASARKAN IDMSMQ m2r_penjualan
        sql = "DELETE FROM m2r_penjualan WHERE idmsmq = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then
            result(2) = "Failed replace Inventory Balance data." : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF HAPUS IDLOGIN PADA m2r_penjualan -----------------------------------

        Dim sqlJadi As String = "", sqlSI As String = "", sqlSI2 As String = ""

        'QUERY SI ###############################

        sqlSI = " SELECT '" & FixQuotes(idLogin) & "' as idlogin, '" & idMsmq & "' as idmsmq, '" & userid & "' as userid , si.sitgl , si.sinotransaksi , k.kkode , k.knama , k1kota As kodekota , c.cnama AS kota , c.cpropinsi As kodepropinsi, prov.pnama AS propinsi , sid.namabarang , b.bkode , sid.jml , sid.satuan , sid.harga , sid.jmldiskon , ((sid.jml * sid.harga) - sid.jmldiskon) AS total , si.sitotalpajak1detail , si.sitotalpajak2detail , si.sibiayalain , si.sijmldiskon , si.sijmluangmuka, si.sitotaltransaksi, "

        sqlSI += " (SELECT SUM(sid.jml)  "
        sqlSI += " FROM m5_si si "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sibagianpenjualan = k.kid   "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi AND (si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7)) AND (si.sisaldoawal = 0 )  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_item b ON sid.idbarang = b.bid   "
        sqlSI += " LEFT JOIN m1_city c ON k.k1kota = c.ckode   "
        sqlSI += " LEFT JOIN m1_province prov ON c.cpropinsi = prov.pkode "


        'Filterr TGL

            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA Filterr BETWEEN 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr >= TGL AWAL 
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sitgl >= '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr <= TGL AKHIR
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " si.sitgl <= '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr <= TGL AKHIR

        End If

        ElseIf Len(kotaAwal) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr >= TGL AWAL

            Filterr &= " b.bkode >= '" & FixQuotes(kotaAwal) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kotaAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AKHIR SAJA YANG DIISI MAKA Filterr <= TGL AKHIR
            Filterr = IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(Filterr, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filterr &= " b.bkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kotaAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'Filterr 
        sqlSI += IIf(Len(Filterr) > 0, String.Concat(" WHERE ", Filterr), Filterr)

        sqlSI += " ) As tjml "

        sqlSI += " FROM m5_si si  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_contact k ON si.sibagianpenjualan = k.kid  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON si.siid = sid.idsi AND (si.sistatus IN(2,3,4,7)) AND (si.sisaldoawal = 0 )  "
        sqlSI += " JOIN m1_item b ON sid.idbarang = b.bid  "
        sqlSI += " LEFT JOIN m1_city c ON k.k1kota = c.ckode  "
        sqlSI += " LEFT JOIN m1_province prov ON c.cpropinsi = prov.pkode  "


        'FILTER TGL 
        If Len(tglAwal) > 0 And Len(tglAkhir) > 0 Then
            'JIKA TGL AWAL DAN TGL AKHIR DIISI MAKA FILTER BETWEEN 
            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " si.sitgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(tglAwal) > 0 Then

        ElseIf Len(kontakAkhir) > 0 Then

            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filterr)
            Filter &= " k.kkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kontakAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'FILTER KOTA 
        If Len(kotaAwal) > 0 And Len(kotaAkhir) > 0 Then

            Filter &= " b.bkode BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(kotaAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(kotaAkhir) & "'"
        ElseIf Len(kotaAwal) > 0 Then

            Filter = IIf(Len(Filter) > 0, String.Concat(Filter, " AND "), Filter)
            Filter &= " b.bkode <= '" & FixQuotes(kotaAkhir) & "'"
        End If

        'result(2) = sqlSI : GoTo selesai


        'INSERT KE TABEL PEMBANTU #########################
        sqlMutasi = " INSERT INTO m2r_penjualan (" & sqlSI & ")"
        'END OF PROSES SELECT DATA PERSEDIAAN ---------------------------------------


        'INSERT KE DATABASE =================================
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sqlMutasi, strCon) = False Then
            'result(2) = "Failed proccessing Inventory Balance." : GoTo selesai
            result(2) = sqlMutasi : GoTo selesai
        End If
        'END OF INSERT KE DATABASE ==========================


        'UPDATE PROGRESS ====================================
        'HITUNG PROSENTASE PROGRESS 100
        progressPersen = 100

        'UPDATE PROGRESS REPORT M0_MSMQ
        sql = "UPDATE m0_msmq SET progress = '4', progresspersen = '" & FixDouble(progressPersen) & "' WHERE id = '" & FixQuotes(idMsmq) & "'"
        If AsEksekusiSQL(sql, strCon) = False Then

        End If
        'END OF UPDATE PROGRESS =============================

        result(1) = 1
        result(2) = notransaksi
        result(3) = 0
        result(4) = result(4)


selesai:
        If result(1) = 0 Then
            If Len(result(2)) = 0 Then result(2) = "Nomor : " & Err.Number & ". Sumber : " & Err.Source & ".  Fungsi : " & System.Reflection.MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod.Name & ". Uraian : " & Err.Description & ". "
        End If

        strResult = String.Join(sptSubParam, result)
        strResultPaging = String.Join(sptSubParam, resultPaging)
        strResultData = search
        wsResult = String.Concat(strResult.Substring(0, strResult.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultPaging.Substring(0, strResultPaging.Length - 1), sptParam, strResultData)

        Return wsResult
    End Function

            sql &= "JOIN m1_coa c ON t.tnorek = c.cnomor AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) "
            sql &= "AND t.tnorek IN " & ftAkun & " "
            sql &= "AND t.ttgl < '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' "
            dtData = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)
            If dtData.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                vBB4SAw = FxDB(FixDouble(dtData.Rows(0)("saldo")), 0)
            End If

            stepKe = 43
            sql = " SELECT cnomor, cnama, tsumber, IFNULL(SUM(tdebit),0) as debit, IFNULL(SUM(tkredit),0) as kredit FROM m2_transaction_journal t "
            sql &= "JOIN m1_coa c ON t.tnorek = c.cnomor AND t.tstatus IN(2,3,4,7) "
            sql &= "AND t.tnorek IN " & ftAkun & " "
            sql &= "AND t.ttgl BETWEEN '" & FixQuotes(tglAwal) & "' AND '" & FixQuotes(tglAkhir) & "' "
            sql &= "GROUP BY t.tsumber"
            dtBB4 = AsDataTableAmbilDariDB(sql, strCon)

            vBB4SAk = vBB4SAw + AsDataTableDSum(dtBB4, "debit") - AsDataTableDSum(dtBB4, "kredit")

            'TERSEDIA = SALDO AWAL + MASUK

            'TOTAL PEMAKAIAN = TERSEDIA - SALDO AKHIR

            'PRT = SUM DEBIT - KREDIT SUMBER PRT
            vBB4Prt = AsDataTableDSum(dtBB4, "debit", "tsumber = 'PRT'") - AsDataTableDSum(dtBB4, "kredit", "tsumber = 'PRT'")
            'PEMAKAIAN UTK PRODUKSI
            vBB4Pd = vBB4Tp + vBB4Sa + vBB4Prt
